Shopping at Rothy’s IRL is not your ordinary retail experience—so naturally, our Stores team is extraordinary, too. Experts in the fit, wear and sizing of our shoes, these team members provide deep knowledge of every Rothy’s style and out-of-this-world customer service—creating long-lasting brand loyalty. Customers love shopping in our stores due to these exceptional interactions.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Retail Ambassador, you will be the representative of the brand on the sales floor, delivering exceptional customer experiences and living our company values in every interaction. You’ll focus on creating meaningful connections with customers, driving sales through service, and supporting a welcoming, inclusive store culture. While your primary focus is on sales, you will also assist with limited operational tasks to ensure the store is well-maintained and running smoothly.




WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Customer Experience (90%)

 - Deliver the Rothy’s Experience to every customer—a best in class service experience rooted in Rothy’s values—consistently embodying the brand through presentation, communication, and product expertise

 - Drive personal sales and results and contribute to team goals

 - Create lasting relationships with our customers by engaging in strong clienteling practices

 - Contribute to a positive, inclusive, and service driven store culture by modeling collaborative, team focused behavior

Operational Excellence (10%)

 - Execute assigned responsibilities accurately as part of daily store operations, including stock replenishment, visual merchandising support, and store organization and cleanliness

 - Demonstrate knowledge of store operations and policies, following established procedures and SOPs to ensure operational excellence and compliance




YOU ARE:

 - Guided by Rothy’s values and committed to fostering a welcoming, service driven environment:
   
   - Embrace Possibility.  We dream BIG, really big
   
   - Obsess Over Innovation: We never accept the status quo
   
   - Make the Planet Proud.  We make the right choice, not the easy one
   
   - Collaboration is Key.  We’re laser focused on driving results

 - 18 years of age or older




YOU HAVE:

 - Strong communication skills and the ability to build genuine customer connections

 - A passion for service and the drive to achieve personal and team sales goals

 - Willingness to support operational tasks as part of the team

 - Availability to work at least 16 hours/week, either 3 Peak Days (Friday, Saturdays, Sundays + Holidays) OR 2 Peak Days (Friday, Saturdays, Sundays + Holidays) + 2 Non-Peak Days (Mondays - Thursdays)

 - Ability to lift, push carry or otherwise move up to 25 lbs

 - Ability to frequently bending, reaching, stretching, and safely use ladders and step stools

 - Ability to uphold Rothy’s Experience by following our dress code, including wearing Rothy’s shoes during every shift




PAY RANGE:

$18.00 - $19.00 per hour

Base pay is one part of the total rewards package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work.  This role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, as well as a comprehensive benefits package.

Base pay will vary based on factors such as qualifications, experience, skill level, competencies and work location. We will meet minimum wage or minimum of the pay range (whichever is higher) based on city, county and state requirements.

What You’ll Do

• Help drive technical design and delivery of core platform capabilities spanning cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platforms, Observability, CI/CD systems, and developer tooling

• Deep understanding of the AWS cloud platform and cloud-native architectures.

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and developer productivity tooling.

• Deep expertise with Kubernetes and container orchestration in production environments.

• Strong knowledge of observability (logging, metrics, tracing) and experience improving system visibility and reliability.

• Experience with incident management and operational best practices for large-scale systems.

• Proficiency in Go or Python.

• Ability to collaborate effectively across teams, communicate complex topics clearly, and influence engineering best practices.

• Outcome-driven mindset with a focus on solving real-world engineering challenges.

• Experience scaling services globally

• FinOps or cloud cost management experience

• Regulated or high-availability environment experience

• Experience with Java or Kotlin

• Familiarity with GitHub Actions

• Collaborate with experienced engineers who value technical excellence and innovation.

• Play a key role in shaping the developer experience and operational foundations of Fan Ecosystem.

• Join a culture that encourages learning, growth, and technical leadership.

jobs.title: Payroll Manager
jobs.description:
Policy Expert is a forward-thinking business that loves to get things done. Having achieved rapid growth since being founded in 2011, we’ve won over 1.5 million customers in Home, Motor and Pet insurance and have been ranked the UK’s No.1-rated home insurer by Review Centre since 2013.

We’re looking for passionate and self-driven people to join us as customer Sales & Service Advisors. Curious minds who want to help customers, build their skills and create something bigger for themselves.

This is a cross-skilled role, combining both sales and customer service. You’ll support customers throughout their journey with Policy Expert, from their first enquiry and getting a quote, through to purchasing a policy and managing their ongoing needs. Whether you’re fresh into the working world or looking to pivot into a new path, we’ll meet you where you are.

What’s In It For You

📍 This role will be based in our Milton keynes office(hybrid working)

📚 Career Development and professional qualifications

🎟️ Enhanced Holiday, Maternity and Paternity Packages

🎉 Social events throughout the year and vibrant workplace atmosphere

🌈 Employee Wellbeing Programme

💷 Buy and Sell Holiday Scheme

👤 Life Assurance x4 your salary

🚪Prayer room in office

📠 Financial Wellbeing Support through Bippit

Payroll Manager

The role

Payroll is one of those things that has to be right, every single time. And that’s where you come in.

As our Payroll Manager at Policy Expert, you’ll own our end-to-end payroll operation, making sure our colleagues are paid accurately and on time, every time.

You’ll be the go-to expert for all things payroll, bringing together technical know-how, sharp analytical thinking and a knack for making things work better.

Working closely with Finance and teams across the business, you’ll keep payroll running smoothly, maintain robust controls and ensure we’re always on top of compliance. But this isn’t just about keeping things ticking over. We’re big on finding better ways to do things, and you’ll have the freedom to challenge the status quo, streamline processes and make a genuine impact.

If you love getting the detail right, solving problems and taking ownership, this is your chance to make payroll work smarter.

What you’ll be doing:

Own the Payroll process

• Take the lead on end-to-end payroll, from gathering and validating data to processing changes and hitting every deadline.

• Manage new starters, leavers, promotions, salary changes and system updates, keeping records accurate and documentation on point.

• Work closely with Finance to deliver a seamless, reliable payroll service.

Get pay and benefits right

• Oversee salary increments, pension contributions, overtime, public holiday pay and other payroll-related calculations.

• Manage pension uploads, employee payments and related documentation.

• Be a trusted point of contact for colleagues, providing clear, helpful answers to questions about pay, tax and payroll.

Turn data into insight

• Deliver accurate weekly, monthly, quarterly and year-end payroll reports.

• Analyse payroll data, maintain accurate account balances and investigate discrepancies before they become bigger problems.

• Spot trends, highlight key insights and give the business the information it needs to make informed decisions.

Keep us compliant and in control

• Ensure payroll processes, records and procedures meet relevant statutory and regulatory requirements.

• Carry out regular checks and audits, support internal and external audit activity, and maintain accurate statutory documentation, including P45s, P60s and P11Ds.

• Oversee contractor timesheets and related payroll records, always protecting confidential information and managing risk.

Make things better

• Challenge existing processes and find smarter, more efficient ways of working.

• Strengthen controls, improve accuracy and build robust procedures that can scale as we grow.

• Take the initiative, solve problems and turn good ideas into practical improvements.

So, Who are you?

You’re a payroll pro who knows that the details matter. You take pride in getting things right, own your work from start to finish and understand the impact a great payroll operation has on people and the business.

You’re confident working independently, comfortable handling sensitive information and organised enough to juggle competing priorities without losing sight of a deadline. You can dig into the numbers, spot when something doesn’t add up and explain the answer in a way that makes sense to everyone.

You’re also naturally curious. You don’t just follow a process because that’s how it’s always been done. You look for better ways to work, tackle problems head-on and build strong relationships along the way.

In short, you bring the expertise to keep payroll running brilliantly and the mindset to keep making it better.

What you’ll bring:

• Payroll expertise: Solid experience in payroll management, with a strong understanding of end-to-end payroll processes and requirements.

• A sharp eye for detail: You’re meticulous with calculations, documentation and data, and you know accuracy is non-negotiable.

• Technical confidence: You’re comfortable using payroll software, systems and IT tools to manage data and process payroll efficiently.

• Analytical thinking: You can interpret data, investigate discrepancies, identify trends and turn numbers into useful insight.

• Reporting know-how: You have experience producing accurate reports and working with business data to support decisions.

• Organisation and pace: You can manage competing priorities, stay on top of deadlines and maintain high standards in a fast-moving environment.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Wild Alaskan Company’s mission is to accelerate humanity’s transition to sustainable food systems by fostering meaningful, interconnected relationships between human beings, wild seafood and the planet.

We deliver wild-caught, sustainable seafood to households across the United States. Powered by our custom-built eCommerce platform and three generations of history and expertise in the Alaskan fishing industry, we constantly strive to meet our promise of a top-notch product and experience. And we do it all in a fully-remote environment that is fast-paced, challenging, and fun.

Description of Role

You’re the type to see a metric move and immediately ask what system underneath it caused the change. You’re not satisfied with shipping features — you want to understand the loops, behaviors and incentives that create lasting business impact.

You naturally zoom between altitude levels. One moment you’re digging through data, customer feedback or operational workflows to uncover an overlooked opportunity. Then you’re kicking off a feature with engineering, product design and stakeholders before a session to help leadership decide where the company should invest the team’s time over the next quarter.

You identify the problems worth solving, articulate why they matter, build conviction across teams and create the path from insight to impact.

You’ll work across Product, Engineering, Data, Creative, Marketing, Member Experience, Finance and Supply Chain & Operations to discover and deliver step-change improvements that deepen our relationship with members and accelerate business growth.

Core Responsibilities

• Identify and solve high-leverage customer and business problems through data analysis, customer insights, experimentation and deep cross-functional discovery

• Uncovers leverage points across multiple domains by stringing multiple problems and opportunities together

• Lead complex, ambiguous initiatives from problem discovery through launch, measurement and iteration

• Build and effectively communicate compelling business cases that clearly communicate opportunity size, tradeoffs, risks, downsides and potential impact

• Create alignment across stakeholders by simplifying complexity and clearly communicating strategic choices

• Collaborate with data to design experiments and measurement frameworks that validate assumptions and accelerate learning

• Consistently identify problems and inefficiencies within the digital product process and facilitate a culture of continuous improvement

• Lead by example and help the product team improve its discovery skills, analytical thinking, communication and judgment

• Serve as a product leader who continuously pushes the organization toward value creation

• Stay close to emerging technologies, especially AI, and identify opportunities to transform how we build experiences and serve users

• Other duties and special projects as assigned

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Extensive product management experience leading complex, high-impact digital experiences in DTC commerce and/or applications that help form habits

• Proven ability to independently identify systems building solutions, define and communicate strategy, drive measurable business outcomes

• Exceptional analytical ability with experience using data to uncover opportunities, not just validate decisions

• Has led too-many-to-count prioritization and design collaboration sessions

• Strong product intuition paired with deep user empathy

• Ability to create alignment without relying on authority

• Technical fluency (database and systems architecture, product design) and ability to partner deeply with engineering teams

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Experience building experimentation frameworks and using insights to guide product direction

• Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities evolve and accountability matters

• Willingness to fill gaps in a selfless manner

• Experience building with AI prototyping tools

Nice to Haves

• Experience applying AI to improve customer-facing experiences

• Background in UX/UI, software engineering and/or data analytics

• Previous exposure to food, supply chain or physical goods businesses

*If you have a comparable depth of professional experience, believe your skills are directly transferable, and are passionate about our mission, please apply!

The starting salary range for this position is $180,000 - $200,000, commensurate with skills and experience. Wild Alaskan’s benefits package includes health, vision, and dental insurance, 401k, PTO, safe/sick time, vacation, parental leave and more, as well as a delicious box of free fish every month.

Wild Alaskan participates in E-Verify. Please see the Notice of E-Verify Participation and Right to Work posters for more information.

jobs.title: Marketing Ops Analyst
jobs.description:
What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!

If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb.io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1. #LI-Remote

Little more about the team:

As we continue to strengthen alignment across our go-to-market teams, we're focused on building a more connected approach to how we measure, analyze, and forecast performance across the full customer journey, from the first website visit through sales engagement to closed-won revenue. This new role, within our Revenue Operations team, will help bring that vision to life by creating a clear, shared view of the funnel that marketing, sales, customer success, and leadership can use to make more informed decisions. As a new role, you'll have the opportunity to shape how we work, partnering closely with marketing, RevOps, and the broader revenue organization to improve visibility, forecasting, and accountability across the business.

What you’ll do in the role:

• Build full-funnel reporting that connects marketing activity in tools like HubSpot to opportunities and closed-won business in Salesforce, and make it visible to executives and teams across the organization

• Work with marketing and sales to define and document how attribution works, including what “influenced” versus “marketing-sourced” means and how leads are tagged as marketing-led, sales-led, or SDR-led

• Partner with marketing on lead scoring and how leads flow into Salesforce

• Improve how we measure campaign ROI so teams can see what worked, double down, and shift spend away from what didn’t

• Work with marketing and go-to-market teams to agree on shared metric definitions, and publish them as a single source of truth

• Build reports and dashboards with AI tools, refine them with stakeholder feedback, and publish final versions to our BI tool on a regular refresh schedule

• Dig into the data, including with AI, to surface patterns and insights nobody has asked about yet

What you’ll bring to the role:

• About 3 to 5 years of experience, ideally in marketing, revenue operations, or a multi-hat go-to-market role

• Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience in Excel and BI tools

• Working knowledge of marketing concepts and terms, such as MQLs

• The interpersonal skills to negotiate shared definitions across teams with different perspectives

• Curiosity about AI and how to use it in your analysis

• Experience in a SaaS environment

• Bonus: the ability to read SQL (writing it is not required)

Base Salary based on level of experience

$125,500—$147,600 USD

What you'll get when you join the Hive:

• A stake in our success - generous equity with employee-friendly stock program

• It’s not about how strong of a negotiator you are - our pay is based on transparent levels relative to experience

• Time to recharge with unlimited PTO

• A distributed-first mindset and culture (really!)

• Home office, co-working, and internet stipend

• Full benefits coverage for employees, with additional coverage available for dependents

• Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave, regardless of path to parenthood

• Annual development allowance

• And much more...

Please note we cannot currently sponsor or support visa transfers at this time. Additionally, in compliance with applicable law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work.

Phishing and Recruitment Scam Warning:

We take your security seriously. Please be aware that recruitment scams are increasingly common and scammers may create email addresses or websites to impersonate Honeycomb employees. To help protect you:

• All communications will come from an @honeycomb.io email address We occasionally work with external recruiting agencies. These partners will use legitimate business email addresses—never personal accounts like Gmail or Yahoo.

• Our recruiting process will never ask you to provide financial or sensitive personal information, including but not limited to: Social security or tax identification numbers Credit card numbers Bank account information

Diversity & Accommodations:

We're committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace—where people of all backgrounds, identities, experiences, and abilities are welcomed, valued, and supported. We recognize that there is no single path to success and embrace nontraditional career journeys and diverse perspectives as key to building stronger, more innovative teams.

We strive to ensure an inclusive experience throughout every stage of our hiring process and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations as needed. If you require accommodations or accessible formats at any point during our hiring process, please let your recruiter know.

As an equal opportunity employer our hiring process is designed to put you at ease and help you show your best work. If there’s anything we can do to improve your experience, we’re always open to feedback.

Privacy Notice:

If you apply for a job at Honeycomb and your application is unsuccessful (or you withdraw from the process or decline our offer), Honeycomb will retain your information after your application for a period of time in accordance with local laws. We retain this information for various reasons, including in case we face a legal challenge in respect of a recruitment decision, to consider you for other current or future jobs at Honeycomb, and to help us better understand, analyze and improve our recruitment processes.

For more information regarding our privacy practices please see the Honeycomb Privacy Notice.

If you do not want us to retain your information, or want us to update it, please contact privacy@honeycomb.io. Please note, however, that we may retain some information if required by law or as necessary to protect ourselves from legal claims.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
Fleetworthy offers the only complete technology suite for fleet readiness, uniting safety and compliance, toll management, and weigh station bypass solutions. We help fleets streamline operations, control costs, and operate with confidence.

About the role:
In this role, you will be joining the Unified Experience Product Management team focused on the core experience of our users, customers, and partners. This team develops, supports, and continually improves our core software applications, portal products, partner and customer integration services, and platform capabilities. The team’s primary goal is to maintain a high level of customer satisfaction and engagement through continuous improvement, innovation, and a seamless experience across the Fleetworthy platform.

As an Associate Product Manager for Unified Experiences, you will play a key role in helping deliver simple, connected experiences for Owner Operators, fleet managers, partners, and internal product teams. The majority of your role will focus on the day-to-day product management and execution of Partner Experience and Owner Operator onboarding, working closely with the Senior Product Manager for Partner Experience/OO. You will help manage the ELD partner experience, partner onboarding and integration lifecycle, partner-facing requirements and feedback, roadmap execution, documentation and enablement, and prioritization of smaller partner investments.

You will also support the Cloud Platform product team, developing enough technical fluency to understand the platform components owned by the team and how changes to those components impact other products and engineering teams. You will serve as a key product partner to Engineering by participating in standups, backlog grooming, sprint planning, retrospectives, and quarterly business review planning. You will help translate business and cross-team needs into prioritized work, create and maintain JIRA tickets and requirements with support from the engineering team, and ensure that platform maintenance, dependencies, and other team needs are appropriately considered in prioritization.

The remaining portion of your role will support Unified Experiences coordination and reporting, including Foundations (the Fleetworthy free-tier Product Led Growth product). You will help maintain the Unified Experiences dashboard and reporting, coordinate cross-product Foundations initiatives, and support efforts to productize Foundations dashboards in partnership with Data Platform. You will help coordinate go-to-market activities and execution for Foundations and ensure that cross-team initiatives remain aligned with the broader Unified Experiences strategy.

This role is designed for a developing product leader who is ready to build broad product management experience across customer-facing experiences, partner integrations, and technical platform products. You will have the opportunity to work across multiple teams and problem spaces while receiving guidance from experienced Product Managers and gradually taking on greater ownership and independence.

Success in this role requires strong organization, communication, curiosity, follow-through, and a willingness to learn. You should be comfortable working in an agile environment, collaborating closely with Engineering and Product, managing multiple workstreams, and bringing structure to ambiguous or fast-moving situations. You do not need to have deep technical expertise, but you should be curious about how software systems work and willing to develop the technical fluency necessary to understand dependencies and make informed product decisions.

To excel, you should be able to build strong relationships with internal teams and external partners, communicate clearly, stay organized across multiple priorities, and consistently follow work through to completion. Your impact will be defined by helping teams execute effectively, improving the experience for partners and Owner Operators, and building the product management skills needed to take increasing ownership of product outcomes.

Job responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Drive the vision. Be a strong collaborative leader of the vision, strategy, and innovation for your products & services as well as contributing to the broader portfolio vision. Being tech-savvy, you have a knack for aligning technical solutions to marketplace needs and by nature, see the future as full of possibilities.

• Lead the product journey. Communicate a vision, strategy, roadmap, and releases aligned to business outcomes. Drive the product lifecycle from ideation, problem validation, solution discovery, and delivery working with internal teams such as marketing and business development to define positioning, messaging, and launch plans ensuring launch success.

• Be curious. Know your market, customers, and users, collecting metrics, user feedback, market trends, and other intelligence to steer and evolve product approach. You model a user-centric, value-driven philosophy and consultative, collaborative style that directly aligns with your ability to drive CSAT and engagement.

• Enable others. Educate stakeholders on products within your portfolio to build understanding. This includes providing support for marketing and sales initiatives that enhance product KPI’s and training the sales and customer success teams so they can educate customers and users. You will also work with software development teams in an agile setting to prioritize activities, assess and evaluate technical and business dependencies, and guide activities. As the lead, work with the team to assess scope, effort, and trade-offs, effectively managing the backlog and the refinement of stories. Your partnership with UX to produce mock-ups and demos for upcoming released features, combined with your ability to collaborate with technical leads to impactful product documentation elevates your ability to drive success.

Additional Information:

• Travel – 5%

Minimum requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, business, information systems, or a related field; or equivalent practical experience.

• 1+ year of experience in Product Management, Product Operations, or a related product role in an agile software environment; or 2+ years of project/program management experience supporting software, technology, or data initiatives.

• Demonstrated experience supporting the execution of product or cross-functional initiatives, including coordinating stakeholders, tracking deliverables, identifying dependencies, and helping move work from planning through delivery.

• Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to quickly absorb technical concepts and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Working knowledge of software products, cloud platforms, APIs, databases, or other technical systems, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering, Data, Design, and business stakeholders.

• Experience working with data, reporting, or analytics, including familiarity with SQL, database reporting, or modern data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or similar technologies.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with an ability to use data and structured thinking to identify issues, understand trends, and support product decisions.

jobs.title: idea.ai Market Launcher (US-Based)
jobs.description:
About Creative Fabrica

Creative Fabrica is a fast-growing AI platform that makes it easy for everyday consumers to create whatever they imagine, from images and videos to audio and 3D creations, using the latest generative AI models.

This role is US-Based, targeting the US Market

idea.ai is a subscription platform serving millions of creators worldwide with AI tools that serve video, image, audio and 3D workflows. We're built on the principle that everyone can be creative. We remove what stands in the way: expensive software, technical expertise, and time-consuming production.

Our idea.ai suite offers more than 26 specialized AI tools that automate technical work: generate custom images, remove backgrounds, create videos, and produce publication-ready marketing assets in minutes instead of hours.

About the role: idea.ai has built a successful consumer product used by hundreds of thousands of paying subscribers. We are now opening our technology to businesses through Teams and API solutions that allows brands and technology partners to integrate our AI capabilities directly into their own products and customer experiences.

We are already seeing meaningful demand from brands and partners. Our next step is to turn that traction into a focused, repeatable B2B business.

We are looking for our first dedicated commercial hires: Market launchers who can win customers while helping us build the sales motion from the ground up. You will own the commercial process for our API and Teams platform products, from identifying and qualifying opportunities through technical evaluation, commercial negotiation and closing.

This is not a role in which you inherit a finished playbook, a large SDR team or a perfectly organised CRM. You will work directly with the COO and product team to determine which customers we should pursue, how we should position the API, and how we turn early market interest into recurring revenue.

You will personally sell. At the same time, you will establish the foundations on which we can later build a larger sales organisation.

What you'll do

• Drive a 90-Day Impact Mandate:

• Day 30: Fine-tune your ICP, configure your tech stack, launch live outbound outreach, and run discovery calls.

• Day 60: Build qualified pipeline, establish a bi-weekly feedback loop with Product, and advance deals to proposal stages.

• Day 90: Close your first initial deals and document a preliminary, repeatable sales motion.

• Own Full-Cycle Pipeline Generation: Identify target accounts, source contact data, and build a data-driven outbound engine and scalable system of outreach.

• Run Deep Discovery: Lead calls to uncover deep operational pain points regarding design bottlenecks, API integrations, and asset creation, rather than just pitching features.

• Close Revenue: Guide prospects through product demos, technical evaluations, pricing negotiations, and final contract signatures.

• Act as the Voice of the Market: Synthesize why deals are stalling and report this directly to the founders and product leads to influence the roadmap.

• Build the Playbook: Document winning email templates, call scripts, and objection-handling techniques to lay the foundation for future specialized hires.

What you'll need

• 3-5 years of high-performance experience in rigorous, analytical roles. We care more about intellectual horsepower and system-building than a traditional SaaS resume. You might be a top-performing full-cycle AE who treats pipeline generation like a data problem, or you might come from a non-traditional background—such as investment banking, strategy consulting, or engineering—and are ready to apply mathematical rigor to early-stage go-to-market challenges.

• The Zero-to-One Mindset: You thrive in ambiguity. You don't need a perfectly polished deck or a 10-page enablement guide to sell the vision and core value proposition.

• Scrappy Execution: You are completely comfortable doing the unglamorous work of cold calling, scraping leads, and managing your own inbox alongside strategic negotiations.

• Technical fluency and intellectual curiosity: Effectively pitch complex API/AI products to both developers and business leaders.

• Exceptional Communication: The ability to clearly articulate complex value propositions and act as a reliable translator between the market and our internal product teams.

• Drive for Closed-Won Revenue: A hunter mentality focused on pushing deals across the finish line to prove the business case.

• Excellent communication skills in English (for US roles).

Nice to have

• Early-Stage Startup Experience: Previous experience at a Seed or Series A startup launching a brand new product or market segment.

• Established Networks: An existing network of decision-makers within filmmaking, marketing agencies, and other organizations that produce digital and creative assets at scale.

• Domain Expertise (API Track): Technical fluency with the ability to hold your own in a conversation with a VP of Engineering about endpoints, latency, and integration roadmaps.

• Domain Expertise (Teams Track): A strong understanding of the creative workflows, software stacks, and bottlenecks of advertising agencies and D2C marketing teams.

• Sales Ops Knowledge: Experience setting up and configuring your own outbound tools or proven ability to build your own.

Is this you?

Get in touch! We'd love to speak to you.

You can apply by clicking the "Apply now" button.

Creative Fabrica is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and hands-on Senior Demand Generation & Campaign Manager to own our multi-channel demand generation programs and full-funnel campaign strategy — spanning web, social, email, search (SEO/AEO/GEO), and paid media. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in campaign strategy and knows how to build programs that drive awareness and pipeline, with a data-driven approach to campaign execution, conversion rate optimization, and funnel efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Demand Generation

• Support demand generation strategy & execution: support the planning, building, implementing, and measuring integrated, multi-channel demand generation programs — spanning web, organic/paid social, email, search, paid media, and webinars/events — to drive awareness, pipeline, and revenue. jobs.title: Materials Specialist
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Advanced Infrared Solutions (AIRS), formerly American Infrared Solutions, was acquired by Anduril Industries in 2025 and now operates as part of the Imaging Business Line. For more than 10 years, AIRS has designed and built world-class, high-performance cooled infrared cameras and subsystems, including critical components such as Integrated Dewar Cooler Assemblies (IDCAs). From its site in Hudson, NH, AIRS is expanding to supply these critical components both internally, to Anduril's Imaging products, and externally, to serve as a merchant supplier to the broader defense, space, and commercial industrial base. Growing the external merchant supplier business alongside internal production is a core strategic priority for the Business Line.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Materials & Quality Specialist to oversee our warehouse inventory accuracy and material flow. In this role, you will play a critical part in keeping our systems and physical inventory aligned, executing cycle counts, and collaborating with our production and purchasing teams. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience in manufacturing operations, excellent communication skills, and a continuous-improvement mindset to help us optimize our processes.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

• Support the receipt, identification, and documentation of inventory.

• Support the shipping & receipt, identification, and documentation of inventory.

• Ensure inventory stock levels and locations in the physical inventory locations match corresponding quantities and locations in the ERP system.

• Responsible for inventory accuracy, Cycle Counts and physical space optimization.

• Execute cycle counting process between Physical Inventory and the ERP system.

• Collaborate with stakeholders to review, identify and resolve inventory discrepancies.

• Collaborate with the Purchasing and Production teams regarding inventory counts and locations.

• Improve processes to address root causes of discrepancies, preventing recurrence.

• Supply the production floor with needed materials (daily kitting) per the monthly Production Plan.

• Perform mechanical inspection of incoming and in-stock materials, including dimensional verification using calipers and other precision measurement tools, and material composition analysis using XRF equipment.

• Operate pre-programmed CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machine) routines to verify part conformance and support quality documentation efforts.

• Must be able to lift/carry/handle/transport up to 50lbs (unassisted).

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Minimum of High school or vocational school diploma.

• 5+ years' experience in Material Management, Manufacturing Operations or related field

• Experience with ERP systems

• Experience with mechanical inspection tools (calipers, XRF, CMM)

• Hands on attitude and strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

US Salary Range

$28—$36 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. JOB SUMMARY:       The Baltimore Orioles are seeking a full-time Certified Athletic Trainer (ATC) for the Minor League Medical Coordinator vacancy. The Minor League Medical Coordinator will provide leadership, coordination, and operational oversight for Minor League medical staff located in domestic and international facilities. This position supports staff development, facilitates communication regarding player health status and rehabilitation progress, and serves as a key liaison among Player Health, Player Development, coaching staffs, and baseball operations leadership.

• Provide leadership, guidance, performance feedback, and professional development support to Minor League medical staff.

• Travel regularly to Minor League affiliates and organizational training complexes in Florida and the Dominican Republic to support medical staff and player health operations.

• Work in conjunction with the Director of Player Health, Major League Head Athletic Trainer, and other members of the Player Health leadership to develop continuing education curriculum for minor league athletic trainers and physical therapists.

• Collaborate with the Director of Minor League Strength and Conditioning to provide a well-rounded oversight within the Player Health and Strength and Performance spaces.

• Assist with physician follow-up exams for Minor League Players.

• Maintain proper medical records in accordance with best practices and minimum standards within the Electronic Medical Record (EMR) system.

• Will operate out of Baltimore, MD, during the Major League and Minor League regular and post seasons.

• Will operate out of Ed Smith Stadium and Twin Lakes Park in Sarasota, Florida, during Major League and Minor League Spring Training.

Required:

• National Athletic Trainers’ Association Board of Certification, in good standing.

• Eligible and in good standing for Maryland and Florida Athletic Training State Licensure.

Desired:

• Previous professional baseball experience (Major or Minor League).

To date, more than 500,000 youth have been meaningfully impacted across Uganda, Rwanda, Kenya, and Tanzania, and along the way, Educate! has become the largest youth employment and skills provider in East Africa.

Educate! is a team of over 300 largely African staff and 300 volunteer youth mentors. We prioritize building an engaging, fulfilling and growth oriented work environment. 50% of our top 30 leaders have been with us for over 5 years, 10+ alumni have started their own organizations, and 6 current or former team members were Acumen Fund East Africa fellows.

We have been backed by top foundations such as Imaginable Futures, Livelihood Impact Fund,  Jack Dorsey’s #startsmall, CIFF and Echidna Giving. Educate! won a 2018 Klaus J. Jacobs Prize and a 2015 WISE Award, and has been highlighted by the World Bank’s S4YE's Impact Portfolio, an Al Jazeera documentary, BBC, The Brookings Institution as one of 14 case studies on scaling education, and the Gates Foundation as a Goalkeepers Accelerator. In 2022, we received a catalytic investment from philanthropist Mackenzie Scott to scale our systems change work.

Educate!'s long-term vision is to design solutions that measurably impact millions of youth across Africa each year.

Good to note: To Our Awesome Applicants! 🚀💫

We know that incredible candidates sometimes hesitate to apply if they don’t meet every requirement. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply!

We’re looking for passionate individuals who believe in our mission and can bring unique perspectives to our team—not just those who check every box. We value diversity and strongly encourage women and individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Position Overview

Educate!, the largest youth skills service provider in East Africa, is seeking a Performance Metrics Officer to support monitoring, reporting, and data quality for the MEWAKA program in Tanzania. This role is important in helping teams collect accurate and timely data across different program locations. The Performance Metrics Officer will work closely with the Performance Metrics Coordinator and frontline teams to support daily reporting, data tracking, data cleaning, and use of monitoring tools and systems.

In this role, you will help ensure that program data is complete, accurate, and submitted on time. You will support frontline staff by answering questions about reporting tools, following up on missing or incorrect data, supporting training, and carrying out field visits to ensure tools are being used correctly. You will also support the maintenance of systems such as SurveyCTO, Google Forms, and dashboards, while helping prepare reports and simple data analysis to support program decisions.

This role is based in Mwanza, one of Educate!’s three main hubs of operation in Tanzania. The Performance Metrics Officer will spend most of their time in the field, supporting field staff to make sure data collected is high quality and that our monitoring tools reflect field realities. This means frequent travel (at least once a month, typically 4 days per trip) from Mwanza to the schools we coordinate from the Mwanza Hub, including in Kagera, Geita, Tabora and Simiyu, where we support teachers. You may also occasionally travel to our other hubs in Arusha and Dar es Salaam.

The ideal candidate has strong field experience, is willing to travel, and is organized, detail-oriented and comfortable working with data and digital tools. You should be able to manage your work independently and communicate well with different teams. This role is a good fit for someone interested in data, program operations, and supporting youth-focused programs through strong monitoring and reporting practices.

What You’ll Do🌟

Data Collection support and Coordination (40%)

• Support the Performance Metrics Coordinator in ensuring timely and high-quality reporting by the frontline team on key metrics around program implementation status across all program locations.

• Coordinate with frontline teams to ensure timely completion of monitoring responsibilities, including proactive follow-up with staff and their supervisors when data is missing or submitted inaccurately.

• Ensure production of timely and accurate Monitoring data through daily data tracking and data cleaning.

• Support Performance Metrics Coordinator to conduct regular training on monitoring tools and systems, and ensure that monitoring tools and systems are properly tested before rollout.

• Support Performance Metrics Coordinator by ensuring frontline team is aware of any changes to existing monitoring tools or introduction of new tools; support frontline team in addressing any issues around the use of monitoring tools or escalate to coordinator if necessary.

• Conduct regular performance metrics field visits to support frontline teams and ensure that they are using monitoring tools effectively.

• Support on all performance metrics printing and procurement to ensure timely delivery and high quality of performance metrics materials.

• Support on data collection for miscellaneous projects, both within and outside the performance metrics department, as needed.

• Serve as a resource person for frontline teams on performance metrics, responding to day-to-day technical questions on tools, forms, and reporting procedures.

Performance Metrics System Maintenance (20%)

• Support Performance Metrics coordinator to maintain up-to-date monitoring tools, reflecting any changes to program design or KPIs and feedback from field visits on what works in practice.

• Support the maintenance of the reporting system on SurveyCTO, Google forms,Textit, etc.

• Ensure the logistics database is up-to-date.

Data analysis and reporting (20%)

• Apply Performance metrics principles and best practices to prepare regular communications for frontline teams, including automated progress reports that track the completion of program activities.

• Support the Performance Metrics coordinator to ensure accurate compilation and timely publication of Monitoring Reports as well as the timely and accurate maintenance of the performance metrics Dashboards.

• Support the Performance Metrics Coordinator during data analysis and independently run some analysis and generate reports.

Performance metrics Data Quality Checks (20%)

• Conduct routine data quality checks on submitted data — reviewing for errors, duplicates, inconsistencies, and missing entries, and correcting them or flagging to the Performance Metrics Coordinator.

• Collaborate with the Performance Metrics Coordinator to compile data error rates by frontline Team, and provide timely, individualized feedback to support data quality improvement.

Who You Are 🦸‍♀️🦸‍♂️

• Education: Degree in Social Sciences, Statistics or similar fields

• Experience: 1 - 2 years of experience working in data-related projects or monitoring, including hands-on field data collection in rural settings

• Familiarity with education or youth-impact focused programs; experience with Educate!'s program is an added advantage.

• Strong organizational skills and detail-oriented.

• Excellent verbal and written communication — collaborates easily with other teams and shares feedback proactively.

• Self-driven and resourceful — able to manage day-to-day data work independently, with minimal supervision.

• Willingness and ability to travel frequently to field sites.

• Working experience using online survey platforms (e.g., Google Forms, SurveyCTO) for data collection — comfortable designing, deploying, and troubleshooting forms.

• Fits our Five Culture Tenets (see What is Educate! About? below); Learn more by looking at Educate!’s culture deck here

What We Offer

• A vibrant, mission-driven environment with a supportive and fun team.

• Competitive salary based on experience.

• Learning & growth opportunities

Application Process: Rolling basis, interviews happening soon!

Terms

• Location is Mwanza, Tanzania

Our Culture & Tenets(Values) 🌱

We’re ambitious. Are you? Educate! is growing fast, so new opportunities are opening up and expanding all the time. We’re inspired by people with drive, and we love to help them reach their full potential. We expect everyone at Educate! to contribute above and beyond their job description, grow their skills, and advance their careers, and we are committed to supporting our staff members on that journey of their careers, and we are committed to supporting our staff members on that journey.

• We put Youth First, Impact-Obsessed - We are purpose-driven, focused on impact, and prioritize what truly matters. We listen to youth, design our efforts around their needs, and ensure every dollar creates transformative experiences they value.

• We Exceed Expectations - We take pride in going above and beyond to achieve the best results—proactively identifying problems and seeking solutions without waiting or stopping at what's requested.

• We Are Always Learning - We are committed to seeking and applying new knowledge and ideas. We stay open-minded and continuously try new things, experiment, grow, and improve. We invest in learning for ourselves and our teams.

• We are One Team, Many Views - We value all individuals, believe diverse ideas and open dialogue drive excellence, foster a supportive and respectful environment where everyone can freely express themselves. We work as one team and prioritize the organization's mission over personal or team interests.

• We have the Startup Mindset - We innovate relentlessly to grow our impact, we never think “we have arrived” or “we’re done.”We constantly challenge the status quo, embrace change, and move quickly toward our vision. Unafraid of failure, we question anything that hinders progress.

Every person at Educate! — from interns to the executive director — is evaluated by how they live up to these five cultural tenets. They are at the core of how we achieve our mission and why we work as well as we do.  Educate is committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment for all who interact in our community. In creating this environment, we encourage people from a variety of cultures, backgrounds and life experiences to join our diverse team.

We’re committed to ensuring all candidates are screened for child and youth safety. As part of the process, candidates must successfully complete our standard background verification and safeguarding review in accordance with local legal standards. Educate! reserves the right to withdraw an offer of employment if any screening results indicate potential risks to youth.

jobs.title: Live Operations Coordinator - SEC
jobs.description:
Department: Operations – College SEC

Contract: Full-time

Salary: $43,112 - $57,482 base salary, plus bonus

Location: Birmingham, AL (Up to 5 days/week in the office)




ROLE AND TEAM OVERVIEW

As a College Live Ops Coordinator, you will work as part of a growing team to ensure the operational quality of Video Replay services for the Southeastern Conference (SEC). The sports included in our SEC delivery span Women’s Soccer, Volleyball, Men’s & Women’s Basketball, Baseball, and Softball.

The 2024-25 season marked our inaugural year partnering with the SEC. As we close out Year 2, we are looking to expand our team to further support and scale this delivery. We will equip you with comprehensive training, support, and full exposure to our proprietary systems. We highly encourage professional development and career progression to ensure you can make a lasting impact on what we do.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Operational Quality: Take responsibility for the "live" operational quality of replay deliverables. Verify system readiness for every assigned sporting event and ensure all system workflows are strictly followed while corresponding directly with onsite personnel.

 - Documentation & Training: Produce thorough documentation for (and assist in delivering) training programs for college replay staff, including both onsite technicians and the Birmingham team (in alignment with Service Ops).

 - Workflow Refinement: Create and refine comprehensive documentation for operational workflows, including checklists, post-event reporting, and disaster recovery protocols.

 - Process Improvement: Continuously challenge existing processes to identify operational gaps and inefficiencies.

 - Hardware Monitoring: Partner with the Atlanta Project Team to monitor system performance and ensure any hardware anomalies or quirks are addressed in a timely manner with a definitive rectification plan.

 - First-Line Issue Resolution: Act as the first level of resolution for operational software issues and challenges before escalating to the Tech Ops engineering teams.

 - Software Feedback: Provide constructive feedback on software functionality, UI, and general ease of use from an end-user standpoint to help drive development.




WHAT TO BE PREPARED FOR

Because this position is incredibly versatile, there is no "typical day in the life." Instead, your schedule will adapt to the sporting calendar, shifting between fast-paced live event support on game days and structured project collaboration mid-week.

 - Event Readiness: Your primary role will be to ensure the quality of assigned events are operationally sound from pre-game, in-game, and post-game checklists.

 - Primary Contact: You will be the main point of contact for on-site personnel if remote assistance is required, as well as relaying all necessary information regarding each assigned event to the wider Hawk-Eye team.

 - Logistical Support: You and your team will be responsible for ensuring the operational preparedness of events that require logistical support and attention (Staffing, hardware/network/software requirements).

 - Travel: You will be expected to travel at times to select events that require on-site staff, and times events around the conference that require Birmingham staff representation.




SKILLS, ATTRIBUTES, AND REQUIREMENTS

Essentials

 - Core Soft Skills: High adaptability, a strong willingness to learn, and a genuine passion for sport.

 - Remote Support Experience: A strong background in providing remote technical or operational support, with excellent system-level troubleshooting and communication skills.

 - Attention to Detail: Meticulous attention to detail, specifically when creating and maintaining technical documentation.

 - Process Improvement Mindset: Comfortable challenging current operational processes to drive improvements.

 - Collegiate Sports Knowledge: A deep knowledge of collegiate sports and a general interest in the sports this encompasses.

 - Problem-Solving Attitude: A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a strong desire to learn, adapt, and grow your career within sports technology.

Desirables

 - Industry Experience: Prior experience within the broadcast A/V industry.




WHAT DIFFICULTIES MIGHT I FACE?

 - Non-Traditional & Live Hours: Due to the live nature of the events this role spans, you must be prepared to work non-traditional hours. This includes long days over consecutive weekends and midweek evenings—because we work whenever sport happens, flexibility is key to success in this position.

 - Technical Troubleshooting: In this role, you will be the primary remotely supervising contact for Hawk-Eye on-site personnel, meaning you will be responsible for ensuring the technical and operational readiness for each assigned event. You will step in to fix issues remotely as they arise under tight timelines. Taking ownership of replay service delivery will require a strong problem-solving mindset and clear communication in high-pressure situations.




TEAM CULTURE

At Hawk-Eye, we pride ourselves on a collaborative, high-performance culture where trust, passion, and innovation thrive. We believe in fostering an environment where every team member is empowered to push boundaries and contribute to the future of sports technology. Our work is guided by three core values:

 - We are Brave: We challenge the status quo, embrace big ideas, and constantly seek new ways to innovate in the sports entertainment industry. We aren't afraid to take risks in pursuit of excellence.

 - We are Owners: We take personal accountability for our work, our decisions, and our collective success. We celebrate our wins together and treat every challenge as an opportunity to learn, grow, and improve.

 - We are Inclusive: We believe our diversity makes us stronger. We cultivate a welcoming environment where unique perspectives are valued, all while being united by our shared love for sports and technology.




SALARY & BENEFITS DISCLOSURE

The anticipated annual base salary for this position is $43,112 - $57,482. This range does not include any other compensation components or bonuses for which an individual may be eligible. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include the applicant's qualifications, years of relevant experience, unique skill sets, educational background, professional certifications, and geographic location.

In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package including:

 - Healthcare coverage (medical, dental, and vision)

 - Paid vacation time

 - 80 hours of accrued paid sick leave annually

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Analyst
jobs.description:
IXL Learning is looking for a passionate Digital Marketing Analyst to join our digital advertising team. In this role, you will help build and manage ad campaigns for the top brands in edtech, including IXL, Rosetta Stone, Education.com, and TPT. You’ll report directly to the Director of Digital Advertising and collaborate closely with a small team of analysts to craft, launch, measure, and optimize all of our ads. You'll balance your time between the creative and quantitative, writing copy and managing graphic design cases but also analyzing and presenting data. This is a rare opportunity to quickly get hands-on, build skills, and play a meaningful role in connecting learners around the world with truly impactful edtech tools. #LI-CC1

We’re looking for new talent with strong potential. Our ideal candidate is a gifted writer, a pro at Excel and Google Sheets, extremely detail-oriented, and naturally curious about advertising, consumer psychology, and the ways technology is transforming how students learn. Bring your creativity and analytical skills and we’ll support your growth with on-the-job training and mentorship.

This position requires you to be in our San Mateo, CA, headquarters office.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

• Building and monitoring ad campaigns in Google, Bing, Facebook, TikTok, and more digital advertising platforms

• Analyzing performance data to help us hone our strategy

• Writing clear, effective ads for diverse audiences across all of IXL’s brands

• Designing and implementing tests to help us understand what kinds of copy, landing pages, audiences, and other factors make a clear impact on ad performance

• Participating in team brainstorms for new campaign creative

• Collaborating with our graphic design team to produce engaging creative

• Meeting regularly with marketing team leaders for input on your work

jobs.title: Consumer Researcher – Adorama Used/Trade (Contract)
jobs.description:
Our Story
With over 50 years of serving the creative community, Adorama has grown from a beloved New York City camera store into the world’s only full-service destination for photo, video, and electronics. We’re more than a retailer—we’re a creative partner for professionals, hobbyists, and tech enthusiasts alike.

From iconic brands like Sony, Canon, and Nikon to the latest in drones, smart home tech, musical instruments, and pro audio gear, Adorama provides creators with the gear and services they need to bring their visions to life. Our passion for education, innovation and commitment to customer experience make us a dedicated and trusted resource.

At Adorama, we don’t just support creativity—we live it. Join a team that’s shaping the future of how the world captures, creates and connects.

Our Leadership Principles

• Growth Mindset: We set high standards, embrace failure, and are open to change.

• Be Customer-Centered: We focus on the end-to-end customer experience.

• Take Ownership & Dig Deeper: We are proactive, use data, and avoid shortcuts.

• Think Like a Start-Up: We move fast, stay flexible, and celebrate every win.

• Be Humble & Respectful: We assume positive intent, listen actively, and support one another.

About Adorama Used/Trade & Role

Adorama's Used/Trade department is seeking a Freelance Consumer Researcher to better understand what drives customers to buy, sell, and trade pre-owned gear, and translate those insights into more effective advertising, landing pages, and offers.

Our Used/Trade department specializes in buying, evaluating, and reselling pre-owned equipment, as well as managing our trade-in program. Unlike customers purchasing new gear, Used/Trade customers are often more price-conscious, focused on product condition, and looking for reassurance and trust throughout the buying or selling process.

While we have extensive transaction data, we're looking to gain a deeper understanding of our customers' motivations, concerns, and decision-making behaviors.

In this role, you'll independently manage research initiatives from start to finish, including conducting customer interviews, testing ads and landing pages, analyzing customer behavior, and developing surveys. You'll report to the Paid Media team and collaborate closely with our marketing teams to turn research findings into actionable insights that improve the customer experience and drive business results.

Employment Type: Freelance / Independent Contractor

Location: Remote

Schedule: Approximately 20 hours per week, with flexibility based on interview and survey schedules

Duration: Initial 3-month engagement, with the possibility of extension based on business needs

Application Requirements:

When applying, please submit your resume along with 1–2 samples of previous research work, such as a redacted readout, report, or case study, demonstrating how you translated research findings into actionable recommendations.

What Will Help You Thrive

• Moderated customer interviews. Recruit, schedule and conduct one-on-one interviews with real Used/Trade customers (buyers, sellers and trade-in customers). Write the discussion guides, run the sessions and synthesize what you learn so it enriches our internal customer data: motivations, objections, trust signals, and how people describe their own gear and buying decisions.

• Unmoderated research on ads and landing pages. Design and run unmoderated tests that show where our paid ads and landing pages confuse, mislead or fail to persuade. This may include evaluating and recommending the right user research tool for our needs (platform fit, participant panel quality, cost, and ability to screen for used-gear shoppers) before running studies in it.

• Heatmap and click analysis. Set up and analyze heatmaps, scroll maps and click data on our landing pages. Identify where visitors stall, what they ignore and what they click that is not clickable, and translate the patterns into specific page recommendations.

• Hypothesis-driven surveys. Work with our paid media and email teams to turn their questions into testable consumer hypotheses, then plan, field and analyze surveys designed to prove or disprove them. Own questionnaire design, sample definition and the readout of results, including what the data does not tell us.

Deliverables
Each study ends with something the team can act on, not a raw data dump.

• A short research plan before each study: question, method, sample and timeline

• Interview recordings, transcripts and a synthesized readout with direct customer quotes

• If relevant, a written recommendation on the user research tool, with the options compared

• Annotated heatmap and click-analysis findings with prioritized page changes

• Survey instruments, raw results and a plain-language readout that states whether each hypothesis held

• A running log of insights the paid media, email and Used/Trade teams can reference

Qualifications

• 3+ years of consumer or UX research experience

• A track record of running moderated interviews and turning them into clear, usable insights

• Hands-on experience with unmoderated testing platforms (such as UserTesting, Maze, Lyssna or similar) and the judgment to compare them

• Experience analyzing heatmaps, scroll maps and click data (such as Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity or Crazy Egg)

• Survey design skills: writing unbiased questions, defining samples and reading results with appropriate caution

• Comfort working with paid media and email marketers and translating their questions into testable hypotheses

• Strong written and verbal communication, including concise readouts for non-researchers

• Able to work independently and manage your own schedule and participant recruiting

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with the photography, video or consumer electronics market, or with resale and trade-in marketplaces

Ready to Join Our Team of Creators? Apply today and let’s create something extraordinary together.

Pay range for this role:

$80—$80 USD

jobs.title: Department Manager (Beograd)
jobs.description:
ŠTA ĆEŠ RADITI

Kao menadžer odeljenja, bićeš lider u pružanju podrške i podsticanju celog svog tima. Negujući inkluzivnu kulturu koja promoviše saradnju i preduzetnički duh, stvaraćeš okruženje u kome svako može da napreduje. Postupajući u skladu sa našim vrednostima, doprinosićeš i svom, kao i kompanijskom uspehu.

Takođe ćeš:

• Voditi svoj tim ka postizanju izvanrednog iskustva kupaca, obezbeđujući odlične operativne i vizuelne standarde, dok aktivno promovišeš prodaju naših artikala.
• Preuzeti odgovornost za prednosti svog odeljenja i prodavnice, analizirati prodajne performanse, prepoznavati komercijalne mogućnosti, postavljati ciljeve i praviti planove za poboljšanje rezultata, profita i nivoa zaliha.
• Upravljati planiranjem tima i rasporeda i obezbeđivati neometane rutine zatvaranja i otvaranja prodavnice.
• Zapošljavati, obezbeđivati obuku i razvoj svog tima, negujući inkluzivnu kulturu punu saradnje koja promoviše razvoj i inovaciju.
• Biti u toku sa modnim trendovima, preferencama kupaca, kao i ponudom konkurentnih brendova, kako bi se održala konkurentska prednost.
• Predstavljati sebe i brend na pozitivan način tokom svake interakcije sa kupcima.

• Obezbeđivati ukupno OMNI iskustvo kupaca, promovišući aktivno naš program lojalnosti.

​

SA KIM ĆEŠ RADITI

Naše prodavnice su srce naše kompanije, gde naši kupci imaju direktan dodir sa našim brendom. Kao deo dinamičnog tima u prodavnici, svaka uloga – od prodajnih savetnika, menadžera odeljenja, menadžera prodavnice i aranžera, do glavnog blagajnika — doprinosi stvaranju inspirativnog okruženja punog dobrodošlice.  Takođe ćeš sarađivati sa širim timom područja, kao i između prodavnica, kako biste delili iskustva i podsticali uspeh zajedno. Zajedno sa svojim timom, imaćeš ključnu ulogu u pružanju pomoći kupcima da se osećaju samouvereno i ističu svoju individualnost uz najnovije trendove i beskrajne stilske mogućnosti. Gradeći značajne veze sa kupcima u našim prodavnicama, mi modu činimo dostupnom i održivom za sve.

KO SI TI

Tražimo osobe sa…

• Iskustvom u prodajnom menadžmentu i operativnosti.
• Ekspertizom u planiranju prodaje, analiziranju i praćenju, koristeći alate orijentisane prema kupcima i izveštavanje.

I osobe koje su…

• Snažni i samouvereni lideri, koji inspirišu, podučavaju i razvijaju svoj tim, dok ilustruju kompanijske vrednosti i kulturu.
• Uživaju u saradljivim i dinamičnim okolnostima, sa načinom razmišljanja koji je orijentisan prema pronalaženju rešenja.
• Motivisani da stvaraju odlično iskustvo kupaca, dok promovišu i prodaju naše artikle.
• Istinski zainteresovani za modne trendove, komercijalnost i uvide u konkurente radi podsticanja prodaje.
• Efikasni u komunikaciji, kreativni i znatiželjni.
• Fleksibilni, analitični i orijentisani ka postignućima, sa umećem da upravljaju statistikom i rade sa brojevima.

​

KO SMO MI

H&M Grupa je globalna kompanija snažnih modnih brendova i poduhvata. Naš cilj je da dokažemo da ne postoji kompromis između odličnog dizajna, pristupačnih cena i održivih rešenja. Želimo da oslobodimo modu za sve, a naši kupci su srce svake odluke koju donosimo.

​

Naš tim čine hiljade posvećenih i talentovanih kolega, koje su ujedinjene našom kulturom i vrednostima. Zajedno, želimo da koristimo našu moć, našu veličinu i znanje da usmerimo modnu industriju kao inkluzivnijoj i održivijoj budućnosti.

​

ZAŠTO ĆEŠ OBOŽAVATI DA RADIŠ OVDE

U H&M Grupi, ponosni smo na to što smo energična kompanija puna dobrodošlice. Našim zaposlenima nudimo atraktivne benefite i beskrajne mogućnosti za razvoj širom sveta.

• 10% popusta za zaposlene u svim brendovima H&M grupe, u prodavnicama i onlajn
• H&M Incentive Program (podsticajni proram) – HIP. Više o programu saznaj ovde.
• Poklon kartica za bebu
• Privatno zdravstveno osiguranje
• Poklon za odlazak u penziju
• Bonus za preporuku prijatelja protivvrednosti
• Naknada za prevoz
• Naknada za dugogodišnji rad u kompaniji nakon 10, 15 i 20 godina
• Božićni/Novogodišnji poklon za decu zaposlenih

PRIDRUŽI NAM SE

Naša jedinstvenost potiče iz kombinacije mnogo stvari – naše kulture pune inkluzije i saradnje, naših snažnih vrednosti i mogućnosti za razvoj; ali najviše iz ljudi koji nas čine onim što jesmo.

Neka tvoj sledeći korak u karijeri bude sa nama. Putovanje počinje ovde.

​*Posvećeni smo procesu zapošljavanja koji je pošten, zasnovan na jednakosti i kompetencijama. Zbog toga te molimo da u svojoj prijavi ne šalješ motivaciono pismo.

jobs.title: Research Engineer - RL Infrastructure
jobs.description:
OWN YOUR INTELLIGENCE

 

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

 

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

 

We train open frontier models and ship the same stack to our customers. Its spans the full stack of training, deploying and continuously improving models — compute, large-scale RL, environments, sandboxes, evals, and deployment.

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

 


ROLE IMPACT

The next frontier in AI will not be unlocked by models alone. It will be unlocked by systems that let those models train faster, adapt continuously, and operate across real environments at scale.

That infrastructure does not exist yet in the form the world needs.

We’re building it.


RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Build and optimize the systems infrastructure behind large-scale RL and distributed training workloads by contributing to our prime-rl https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-rl framework.

 - Improve end-to-end training efficiency across compute, memory, networking, and scheduling layers.

 - Design and implement low-level performance optimizations, including kernels, communication paths, and runtime improvements.

 - Work on distributed training systems spanning data, tensor, and pipeline parallel workloads.

 - Help shape the architecture of our RL training stack, including async rollout and post-training systems.

 - Contribute to open-source libraries and internal infrastructure used for frontier-scale model training.

 - Collaborate closely with researchers and infrastructure engineers to translate bottlenecks into concrete systems improvements.

 - Stay at the frontier of training systems, inference systems, compiler/runtime tooling, and hardware-aware optimization techniques.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Strong systems engineering experience in AI/ML infrastructure, especially around large-scale model training or inference.

 - Deep familiarity with PyTorch and distributed training frameworks such as PyTorch Distributed, DeepSpeed, FSDP, Megatron, vLLM, Ray, or related tooling.

 - Experience optimizing training performance across kernels, memory movement, communication overhead, or parallelization strategy.

 - Hands-on experience with large-scale training techniques including data parallelism, tensor parallelism, and pipeline parallelism.

 - Strong understanding of GPU architecture, profiling, and performance debugging.

 - Ability to identify bottlenecks across the stack and drive improvements from first principles.

 - Comfort working in a fast-moving environment with ambiguous problems and high ownership.

Especially Exciting (optional)

 - Experience writing or optimizing CUDA / Triton kernels.

 - Experience with compiler or runtime optimization for ML systems.

 - Experience working on RL training infrastructure, rollout systems, or asynchronous training pipelines.

 - Experience with multi-node GPU clusters and high-performance networking.

 - Contributions to open-source ML systems or infrastructure projects.

 - Interest in publishing technical work or sharing insights through engineering blogs and technical writing.


BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Cash Compensation Range of $150-350k, including equity incentives, aligning your success with the growth and impact of Prime Intellect.

 - Flexible work arrangements, with the option to work remotely or in-person at our offices in San Francisco.

 - Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance for international candidates.

 - Quarterly team off-sites, hackathons, conferences and learning opportunities.

 - Opportunity to work with a talented, hard-working and mission-driven team, united by a shared passion for leveraging technology to accelerate science and AI.

If you’re excited about building the systems foundation for frontier-scale RL and open superintelligence, we’d love to hear from you.
