jobs.title: Field Service Diesel Technician
jobs.description:
Mobile Diesel Technician – Field Service – Northern VA & MD

$43–$49/hr | $2,500 Sign-On Bonus | Take-Home Service Truck | Monday–Friday | OT Available

We’re adding Mobile Diesel Technicians to our field service team.

If you’re a Diesel Technician who likes variety, troubleshooting, and working hands-on in the field, this is an opportunity to put your skills to work on a wide range of heavy-duty trucks and equipment. Supporting our Clinton, MD branch, this is a home-dispatched field service role covering Northern Virginia and Maryland. You’ll travel directly from home to customer locations in a take-home service truck to perform scheduled maintenance, troubleshoot issues, and make repairs. All work is scheduled at customer locations—no roadside service.

You’ll work on everything from service cranes and roll-offs to street sweepers, dump trucks, and other specialized equipment. The work includes electrical troubleshooting and repairs, 3rd Eye camera installations, hydraulic repairs, preventative maintenance, and component repairs. You’ll have the opportunity to put your skills and problem-solving abilities to work across a variety of equipment and service needs.

You’ll have the support of the MATE team behind you, along with manufacturer and vendor training and the tools and equipment you need to get the job done in the field.

What We Offer

• $43–$49 per hour based on demonstrated skill level

• $2,500 Sign-on bonus

• Take-home service truck

• No flat-rate pay

• $1,000 Annual Tool Allowance — $250 per quarter

• $200 Annual Boot Allowance

• Monday–Friday: 7:00 AM–3:30 PM

• Optional OT available

• Company-provided uniforms

• Manufacturer and vendor technical training

Benefits That Work for You

• 80 hours of PTO in your first year, increasing with your years of service

• 8 hours of paid Personal Leave each year, in addition to PTO

• Paid holidays

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• MATE-funded HRA contribution toward your medical deductible — up to $3,000

• 401(k) with company match: MATE matches 50% of the first 8% you contribute, for a maximum company match of $3,000 per year

• Company-paid $50,000 Basic Life & AD&D Insurance

• Company-paid Short-Term Disability

• Company-paid Long-Term Disability

• Employee Assistance Program and additional support resources for you and your family

What You’ll Do

As a Mobile Heavy Diesel Technician, you will:

• Travel to customer sites in your MATE service truck to diagnose, repair, and maintain heavy-duty trucks and equipment.

• Work on a diverse product line, including service cranes, roll-offs, street sweepers, dump trucks, and other specialized equipment.

• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, diesel engine, and related system issues using diagnostic equipment.

• Perform preventative maintenance, inspections, lubrication, tire and component replacement, cooling system maintenance, and other repairs.

• Troubleshoot and repair hydraulic systems, including pumps, cylinders, valves, hoses, PTO-driven systems, and related components.

• Diagnose and repair electrical systems, including wiring, sensors, power, and other electrical components.

• Complete more complex repairs such as body swaps, hydraulic pump replacement, and other component-level repairs.

• Maintain accurate electronic work orders documenting diagnostics, repairs, parts used, and additional work recommended.

• Communicate with the Service Manager and team regarding diagnoses, repair needs, parts, and additional support.

• Continue developing your technical skills through manufacturer training, vendor resources, and hands-on coaching.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

What We’re Looking For

• Experience diagnosing and repairing heavy-duty trucks and/or equipment

• Strong working knowledge of diesel engines, electrical systems, hydraulics, brakes, drivetrains, and related mechanical systems

• Ability to troubleshoot mechanical and electrical problems using diagnostic tools and a systematic approach

• Experience working with hydraulic systems, including pumps, cylinders, valves, hoses, and PTO-driven systems

• Experience with MIG and stick welding is a plus

• Ability to work independently in the field while communicating effectively with the Service Manager and team

• Ability to use hand tools, power tools, measuring devices, and diagnostic equipment

• Must have your own basic hand tools

• Valid driver's license required

• Class A or B CDL is a plus

Why MATE?

Field service gives you the opportunity to work on a wide variety of equipment and solve problems where they happen. No two customer sites or repairs are exactly the same, and you’ll have the support of the MATE team while working in the field.

You’ll also have access to manufacturer and vendor training, hands-on coaching, and the tools and equipment you need to continue developing your technical skills.

Technician level and starting pay are based on demonstrated technical ability across the systems and repairs required for the role.

If you’re a Diesel Technician who enjoys variety, troubleshooting, and getting customers back up and running, we’d love to hear from you.

Physical Requirements

• Ability to frequently kneel, bend, squat, push, pull, and reach

• Ability to lift and move up to 50 lbs. without assistance

• Ability to safely get into and out of various vehicles and equipment

• Must pass a DOT physical, including drug screening

Communication Requirements

This position requires the ability to read, write, speak, and understand English sufficiently to safely perform the essential functions of the job. Effective communication is necessary to understand and follow safety procedures and instructions, communicate with customers and team members, and complete required job-related documentation.

•    System Optimization: Assess existing financial system configurations, identify areas for improvement, and ensure the scalability and security of the solution.

Required Skills and Experience:

•    Deep, hands-on expertise in implementing, configuring, and leading the Oracle EBS R12 General Ledger (GL) module, including expert-level knowledge of Chart of Accounts (COA) design and Subledger Accounting (SLA).
•    Proven experience as a functional lead on at least two full lifecycle Oracle EBS Financials implementations, demonstrating leadership in requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, and testing.
•    Extensive experience with the broader Oracle EBS Financials suite, including Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), and Fixed Assets (FA).

•    A bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field. Additional years of experience in lieu of degree will be considered.

Desired Skills and Experience:

•    Ledger Consolidation Experience and Historical Sub-Ledger Transaction cross-walking / CCID alignment
•    Experience with Oracle EBS modules for Contracting LifeCycle Management (CLM), Procurement, iSupplier (or similar product), and Purchasing.

jobs.title: Authorized Special Status Species Field Biologist (CBB, QCB, WSP, SKR) - on call position
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a highly motivated Authorized Special Status Species Field Biologist for immediate employment in the southern California desert regions.

This is a field-based, fully remote, on-call position requiring the ability to be local on field assignments for extended periods but linked to a Southern California-based office.

This position would support numerous natural resource projects with a focus on biological surveys and regulatory compliance monitoring primarily for Crotch’s Bumble Bee, Quino checkerspot butterfly, western spadefoot, and/or Stephen’s kangaroo rat with potential to assist with vegetation mapping, wildlife assessments, habitat restoration, and/or permitting implementation with support from junior biologists.  Training and/or experience conducting surveys for listed species local to southern California, particularly Crotch’s Bumble Bee, Quino checkerspot butterfly, western spadefoot, and/or Stephen’s kangaroo rat, is preferred.

The responsibilities of this position could include a subset of those listed below based on relevant experience:

• Lead protocol and pre-construction Crotch’s Bumble Bee, Quino checkerspot butterfly surveys and monitoring.
• Lead and conduct focused western spadefoot surveys and monitoring, including implementation exclusionary fencing, artificial watering to elicit a movement response, and relocation.
• Lead and conduct focused Stephen’s kangaroo rat trapping surveys and monitoring, including implementation exclusionary fencing, trapping, and relocation.
• Conduct general wildlife and/or botanical surveys, including vegetation and habitat mapping.
• Identify and record native and non-native fauna and/or flora in the field.
• Conduct other special-status species surveys, following established protocols or guidelines as relevant.
• Conduct avian species nesting surveys and avian mortality monitoring.
• Support project execution, including pre-construction surveys and construction monitoring.
• Assist with environmental compliance monitoring.
• Provide oversight of restoration crew work and restoration vegetation performance monitoring.
• Perform other related duties assigned, such as coordination with team members, scheduling of work, etc.
• Utilize electronic data collection methods in the field; manage, interpret, and analyze data, as needed.
• Conduct monitoring and survey fieldwork as part of a team and independently in inland and desert environments, which can include rugged terrain.
• Work under the supervision of a senior project manager or senior-level team member.
• Ensure assigned tasks stay on schedule and budget.
• Elevate compliance concerns to project or construction managers.
• Provide clarification of resource project requirements to the compliance and construction teams.
• Promote safety culture and adherence to Safe Work Plans.

About AECOM’s Environment Business Line

Join AECOM to be part of an expert global team who is connected through a well-developed, worldwide, internal technical practice network through which you can learn from and brainstorm with the best in the world. AECOM is an industry-leading, world class environmental firm, and we want you to succeed within it.  We respect and encourage your own pathway to excellence via our Freedom to Grow initiative.

AECOM is known for our award-winning technical excellence, leading-edge science and innovative project delivery. We provide sustainable solutions for some of the world’s most challenging issues. Our global clients and their projects span a variety of market sectors and geographies and require innovative technical solutions to solve wide-ranging environmental problems.

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in related field (biology, ecology, etc.)
• 4 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education working in southern California ecoregions focused on conducting surveys for listed species local to southern California, particularly Crotch’s Bumble Bee, Quino checkerspot butterfly, western spadefoot, and/or Stephen’s kangaroo rat.
• Valid US Driver's License and pre-employment driving record verification are required.
• Due to the nature of the work, US Citizenship is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Prior consulting experience is preferred, but non-consultant candidates with relevant experience will be considered.
• Experience conducting biological surveys and/or environmental compliance monitoring and biological construction oversight.
• Experience implementing the terms and conditions of USFWS biological opinions or Habitat Conservation Plans, CDFW incidental take permits, and/or California Environmental Quality Act Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Programs.
• Previously approved as a biological monitor or designated biologist by USFWS and/or CDFW for Crotch’s Bumble Bee, Quino checkerspot butterfly, western spadefoot, and/or Stephen’s kangaroo rat.
• Permits or experience for one more of the following species:10(A)(1)(a) permit to conduct protocol surveys for Quino checkerspot butterfly and monitoring experience10(A)(1)(a) permit to conduct focused surveys for Stephen’s kangaroo rat. Experience must include at least 40 calendar nights performing small mammal live-trapping surveys and handling at least 40 individual Stephens’ kangaroo rat. Experience must include using exclusion fencing to salvage and exclude small mammals from construction work areas, and/or experience performing small mammal translocations.Substantial field experience to conduct western spadefoot surveys and monitoring. Must be able to identify the species visually and vocally and have experience in handling and translocating western spadefoot. In addition, experience must include all life stages of the western spadefootSubstantial field experience to conduct Crotch’s bumble bee surveys and monitoring.
• Knowledge of southern California wildlife and plant species.
• Flexibility and willingness to support multiple projects as needed.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Strong organizational and proactive communication skills.
• Experience with electronic data collection (Fulcrum, Field Maps, etc.).
• Field experience with special status species of southern California, and knowledge of regulatory requirements.
• Possess a CDFW Scientific Collecting Permit and/or Memorandum of Understanding for Crotch’s Bumble Bee, Quino checkerspot butterfly, western spadefoot, Stephen’s kangaroo rat or other southern California State Listed Species.
• Ability to drive a 4-wheel drive vehicle over difficult terrain.
• Strong leadership and diplomacy skills.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Familiarity with mitigation, monitoring, and reporting programs.
• Experience on construction-associated transmission and/or utility projects.
• Familiarity with regulatory and permitting requirements under the federal Endangered Species Act, California Endangered Species Act, NEPA, CEQA, and the Clean Water Act.

jobs.title: Director, Product Marketing
jobs.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

TEGNA is looking for a Director, Product Marketing to lead go-to-market strategy and messaging for our linear and streaming TV and advertising business, with a strong focus on Premion, TEGNA's streaming ad platform (DSP). This role reports directly to the VP of B2B and Integrated Marketing and sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Marketing. The Director will translate platform capabilities into clear, compelling positioning that helps our sales teams win and grow streaming advertising revenue — and will build and lead a small product marketing team. They will identify and translate the needs of our key customer segments, mid-sized to large SMBs and the agencies that serve them, as well as our publisher partners, to the larger organization.

This is a high-visibility leadership role for someone energized by the pace of the CTV/streaming market who wants to shape how TEGNA tells its story to agencies and advertisers — and who is ready to develop talent alongside doing the work.

Key Responsibilities

Product and Sales Collaboration

• Partner deeply with Product to translate CTV/streaming and Premion DSP capabilities into positioning, messaging, and sales-ready narratives

• Act as the voice of the customer in product conversations, advocating for solutions and features that deliver the most value to advertisers and agencies

• Build strong working relationships across product, sales, customer success and other key stakeholders to stay ahead of roadmap changes and market shifts

Messaging and Positioning

• Own product marketing messaging for Premion and TEGNA's broader CTV/streaming offering, ensuring consistency with TEGNA's brand pillars and current terminology

• Develop clear, differentiated positioning against competitors in the CTV/streaming ad tech space

• Translate complex product and data capabilities — outcomes-based buying, first-party data, audience targeting — into messaging that resonates with agencies and advertisers

Sales Enablement

• Design, create and oversee sales enablement assets — pitch decks, one-pagers, talking points, objection-handling guides, case studies — that equip the sales organization to grow streaming advertising revenue

• Partner with sales leadership to identify enablement gaps and prioritize asset development accordingly

• Train and support sales teams on new product launches, features, and positioning updates

Revenue Growth and Market Focus

• Support pipeline growth for streaming advertising by arming sales with the right tools at the right moments in the sales cycle

• Build messaging and enablement tailored to local and regional agency buyers, a key and growing segment for TEGNA

• Partner with Marketing Strategy and Insights on packaging, upfront kits, and go-to-market campaigns tied to CTV/streaming priorities

Team Leadership

• Manage and develop a Product Marketing Analyst, setting clear priorities, providing regular coaching, and building their capability over time

• Model strong cross-functional partnership and help the broader B2B Marketing team understand and use product positioning effectively

• Build scalable processes for asset management, messaging governance, and sales enablement delivery

Qualifications

• 10+ years in product marketing, with meaningful experience in digital content, CTV, or streaming media (ad tech, media company, or streaming platform background preferred)

• Demonstrated leadership experience — prior people management preferred, but strong mentorship and cross-functional leadership also considered

• Proven track record building messaging and positioning for advertising or media products, ideally in a DSP, ad platform, or programmatic environment

• Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally with Product and Sales, including building sales enablement materials that directly drove revenue

• Experience working with or selling to local and regional agencies is a strong plus

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to translate technical/product complexity into clear, persuasive messaging for both internal and external audiences

• Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, ambiguous market and adapting messaging as the competitive and product landscape shifts

• Bachelor's degree required; MBA a plus but not required

Location and Reporting

• New York City or Washington, D.C. metro area preferred but not required; hybrid work model

• Reports directly to the VP of B2B and Integrated Marketing

• Manages: Product Marketing Analyst

• Some travel expected for sales meetings, agency visits, and industry events #LI-MS1

Pay Range

$140,000—$170,000 USD

Benefits:

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year.

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

jobs.title: Research Engineer / Scientist - Reinforcement Learning
jobs.description:
OWN YOUR INTELLIGENCE

 

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

 

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

 

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

 


ROLE IMPACT

Help develop the algorithms and systems used to train Prime Intellect’s open models with reinforcement learning. We’re hiring research engineers and scientists across RL algorithms, scaling research, and training frameworks. Your focus will reflect your strengths; you don’t need to cover all three.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Algorithm research

 - Develop and test RL methods for reasoning, coding, and long-horizon tasks, including changes to training objectives and policy optimization.

 - Investigate stability in asynchronous RL, including policy staleness, trainer/sampler mismatch, and numerical differences between training and rollouts.

 - Work with data and evaluation researchers to understand how task selection, rewards, and training data affect what the model learns.

Scaling science

 - Design experiments to understand how RL performance and learning dynamics change with model size, training compute, and task horizon.

 - Use controlled ablations and evaluations to distinguish learning gains from reward exploitation, evaluation artifacts, or training bugs.

 - Turn experimental findings into training recipes, then test whether the improvements hold across larger models and longer runs.

RL frameworks

 - Extend prime-rl https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-rl to support new algorithms, models, and asynchronous training workflows.

 - Improve the performance and numerical correctness of research runs across trainers, rollout workers, and environments, working with the infrastructure team.

 - Build diagnostics that make unstable runs and performance regressions easier to reproduce, and help distinguish algorithm problems from implementation or runtime issues.


REQUIREMENTS

 - Demonstrated depth in at least one of RL algorithms, empirical research on model training, or distributed ML systems. This could come through research, open-source contributions, or systems you’ve built.

 - Strong programming skills in Python and experience with PyTorch or a comparable ML framework.

 - Ability to design controlled experiments, interpret results, and debug unexpected model or system behavior.

 - Experience taking a research idea or systems change through implementation, testing, and evaluation, with a clear account of what worked and what didn’t.

Nice to have

 - Experience with distributed training frameworks or asynchronous rollout pipelines.

 - Experience diagnosing unstable RL runs, including policy-staleness or numerical issues.

 - Work on coding agents, verifiable rewards, or long-horizon environments.


BENEFITS AND PERKS

 - Cash Compensation Range of $150-350k, including equity incentives, aligning your success with the growth and impact of Prime Intellect.

 - Flexible work arrangements, with the option to work remotely or in-person at our offices in San Francisco.

 - Visa sponsorship and relocation assistance for international candidates.

 - Quarterly team off-sites, hackathons, conferences and learning opportunities.

 - Opportunity to work with a talented, hard-working and mission-driven team, united by a shared passion for leveraging technology to accelerate science and AI.

If you're excited about the opportunity to build the foundation for the future of decentralized AI and create a platform that empowers developers and researchers to push the boundaries of what's possible, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
COMPANY

At 0x https://0x.org/, our mission is to "Create a Tokenized World Where All Forms of Value Can Flow Freely". We deliver this to web3 builders with a delightfully simple suite of developer APIs that provide faster trading, better prices, and superior user experience.

Founded in 2017, we’ve processed over 211M+ transactions and $180B+ in trading volume from users trading on Matcha, Coinbase Wallet, Robinhood Wallet, Phantom, Rainbow, DefiLlama, MetaMask, Zerion, Zapper, and many more. Our investors include Greylock Partners, Pantera Capital, and Jump Crypto.

When you join 0x, you’ll become part of a veteran team of crypto builders who know the importance of code quality, team cohesion, and a culture of learning.



About the team

Behind every 0x trade is a lot of hard work. We integrate hundreds of liquidity sources, optimize for gas, slippage and latency, split routes and simulate every result to get traders the best possible outcome. The API Products team turns that routing logic into easy-to-integrate APIs that wallets, exchanges, trading apps, bridges and developers around the world rely on.

This team of four built, maintains and continues to evolve our flagship Swap, Gasless and Cross-Chain APIs, which have moved billions in volume. Next, they’re building new products that give developers even more tools for building trading apps.



About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Software Engineer to expand what the API Products team can take on. You’ll lead projects from first idea to production, on new products and on the APIs that are already live, working closely with our product team and some of our biggest customers. This is a hands-on IC role for someone who wants real ownership and works well with little direction. Remote, EU timezones preferred.



What you’ll do

 - Build new APIs and trading products, from researching the problem and designing the architecture to shipping the first version.

 - Maintain and extend our existing APIs, including support for new chains, bridges and customer-requested features.

 - Keep our APIs fast and reliable as traffic grows, and participate in the on-call rotation.

 - Investigate failed trades and stuck transfers using logs, traces and onchain data, and resolve the root cause.

 - Work with product, legal and GTM, turning business and compliance needs into technical decisions.

 - Write design documents for your work and review your teammates’ designs and pull requests.

Who you are

 - Senior or Lead Engineer with a track record of owning complex projects end to end.

 - Built and maintained developer-facing APIs.

 - Deep onchain knowledge, especially EVM: how transactions work, including calldata, contract interfaces, gas and approvals.

 - Strong system design experience for production-scale backend services.

 - Clear communicator, comfortable explaining technical tradeoffs to non-engineers.

 - Aligned with our core values https://0x.org/post/the-0x-mission-and-values: do the right thing, consistently ship, and focus on long-term impact.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director
jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As the Regional Director, Sales for Germany, you’ll lead a high-performing team of Strategic & Major Account Executive professionals to grow adoption of GitLab’s AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You’ll be responsible for managing software sales, bookings, and revenue, while building strong relationships with new and existing customers who rely on GitLab to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, and reduce security and compliance risk. Reporting to the VP, Central EMEA, you’ll hire and develop top talent, set clear territory and industry strategies, and ensure your team’s sales plans align with GitLab’s overall growth goals in this market. In your first year, you’ll focus on building a strong team culture, deepening our presence with German clients, and consistently meeting or exceeding performance objectives in a fast-paced, open source software and SaaS environment.

Responsibilities

• Lead, coach, and motivate a team of Strategic & Major Account Executives focused on the German market to deliver software sales, bookings, and revenue results

• Drive territory and industry planning by analyzing market dynamics, customer needs, and competitive trends to identify and execute on growth opportunities

• Develop and own accurate sales forecasts, territory management plans, and growth strategies that align to GitLab’s overall revenue goals

• Establish, track, and report on key performance metrics for the team, and take action to address gaps and improve outcomes

• Collaborate closely with Renewals, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners to manage pipeline health, renewal performance, and deal execution

• Recruit, hire, and onboard top sales talent while building and maintaining a strong pipeline of potential future hires in the region

• Create a high-performing, inclusive, and positive team culture through regular coaching, clear expectations, and ongoing development

• Educate and enable your team on GitLab’s product, pricing, AI-powered DevSecOps positioning, and key industry and regulatory factors relevant to the German market, such as data privacy, data sovereignty, and sector-specific compliance requirements

Requirements

• Progressive experience in field sales and sales operations in an open source software, DevOps, or similar software-as-a-service environment

• Demonstrated success leading and developing account-focused sales teams, including hiring, coaching, and performance management

• Proven track record of meeting or exceeding performance objectives (revenue targets, pipeline targets, etc.)

• Experience building and executing go-to-market strategies for the German market, with a willingness to both lead and participate directly in selling activities

• Commercial and analytical skills to interpret sales performance data and adjust regional plans in ways that drive sustainable, long-term growth

• Practical experience working with CRM and sales/marketing tools (for example Salesforce, Clari, Marketo) to manage forecasts, territories, and pipeline

• Ability to analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive dynamics to inform territory planning and team enablement

• Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and presentation skills, including executive-level written and verbal communication and the ability to mentor others

• Alignment with GitLab’s values and interest in open source, with openness to candidates who bring transferable leadership and regional sales experience from adjacent software markets

Remote-Global

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

• Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

• Flexible Paid Time Off

• Team Member Resource Groups

• Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

• Growth and Development Fund

• Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. jobs.title: Title 1 Teacher
jobs.description:
About the Team

ACCEL Schools is hiring a highly qualified Title 1 Teacher at Youngstown Academy of Excellence in Youngstown, Ohio dedicated to providing a superior education for all students. We are seeking teachers who are passionate and dedicated to bringing the curriculum to life for each student. We want our teachers to be excited to create a positive classroom environment that prioritizes student learning and social-emotional development.

Be part of the difference at Youngstown Academy of Excellence! Founded in 2005, Youngstown Academy of Excellence (YAE) serves EK-8th grade students in the Greater Mahoning Valley. The award-winning school provides well-rounded, college prep education featuring daily Spanish instruction, STEM, and career readiness. The campus supports learning and overall wellness with features such as a climbing wall, gym, and playground. Youngstown Academy of Excellence is part of ACCEL Schools, an established network of public charter schools serving K-12 students throughout the United States since 2014.

About the Opportunity:

Responsibilities of the Teacher include to-

• Prepare and deliver lesson plans with the ability to modify accordingly during the school year

• Differentiate instruction to meet the needs of all students

• Maintain accurate and complete records of students’ progress and development

• Utilize research-based best practices in daily planning and classroom instruction

• Manage student behavior in the classroom

• Create a positive classroom environment for students to learn in

• Utilize school approved curricula that reflects the diverse educational, cultural, and linguistic backgrounds of the students

• Implement school-wide culture expectations and norms

• Communicate and meet with families regarding the academic and social-emotional growth of their child

• Incorporate technology skills into daily classroom practice to support learning

• Participate in the planning and implementation of non-instructional activities, as needed

• Collaborate and communicate effectively with colleagues

• Perform other duties as assigned

About You:

• Active and current state of Ohio teaching license in appropriate content area

• Bachelor’s degree in education or related field

• High level of comfort working in a growth-focused coaching environment based on frequent observations, debriefs, action planning, and progress monitoring

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to properly manage confidential information

• Able to supervise students of various ages in different school settings (playground, cafeteria, etc.)

• Ability to pass federal and state criminal background checks

• Experience working within an urban environment

About Us

“We believe that every child should be able to be anything they want in life, regardless of their birthplace and circumstances.” – Ron Packard, CEO & Founder

ACCEL Schools is a network of 80+ high-performing, public charter schools serving PK-12 students. We proudly advocate for school choice and work to address educational inequities throughout the United States. Our schools are inclusive and widely differ to reflect the unique values of the many urban, suburban, and rural communities we serve. Our brick and mortar, and virtual schools specialize in closing educational gaps and offer innovative models such as career-technical education, sports training, bilingual programming, and more. We have been recognized and praised by legislators, authorizers, and researchers for providing exceptional education options to students in historically under-resourced communities.

We offer the following benefits:

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $39,000 - 48,500.  Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

Life benefits – time & peace of mind

• Paid time off

• Retirement contributions

• Optional Basic Life and AD&D insurance

• Voluntary life insurance (employee, spouse, child)

• Discounted childcare at Early Learning Academies locations

Health benefits – stay well & thrive

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance

• Employee Assistance Program

• Voluntary short-term disability insurance

• Voluntary long-term disability insurance

Career benefits – keep growing

• Career advancement opportunities throughout Accel Schools and our strong network of 4,000+ instructors and education professionals

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

jobs.title: Coordinator, People & Workplace Experience
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Coordinator, People & Workplace Experience is a foundational role for someone who wants broad exposure, meaningful responsibility, and the chance to learn how a growing business operates from the inside. You'll sit at the center of MEI's employee experience in our NYC office and help build the connective tissue that keeps people connected to one another and to MEI — all while getting direct exposure to executive support, workplace operations, culture and events, and cross-office collaboration.

This is a highly visible, high-touch role that reports into the Director, People & Talent. In this role, you'll be responsible not just for making the day-to-day run exceptionally well, but for anticipating needs, connecting dots, and finding smarter ways to work as MEI grows. It's a strong fit for someone who's equally comfortable executing the details and thinking beyond them — proactive, resourceful, and eager to build a foundation that opens doors to broader responsibilities at MEI over time.

NOTE: This role is be expected to travel on occasion for office and team support.

What You’ll Own

Office Management

• Own on-the-ground office management for our NYC office, keeping day-to-day operations running smoothly

• Oversee supplies, vendor coordination, facilities, IT/office systems support, and building management relationships; serve as primary point of contact for office-related needs

• Support meeting logistics (room scheduling, AV, catering) and coordinate all-hands and team meetings for NYC

Culture, Events & Employee Experience

• Help drive culture programming across MEI, partnering with the Tysons-based People Coordinator to adapt programming across offices

• Plan and execute corporate-wide events, including quarterly meetings, company events, leadership offsites, and external office events (e.g., MEI+ lab)

• Support recognition and community experience initiatives that strengthen connection across a distributed team

• Tackle special projects and emerging needs, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and driving work through completion

Executive Support

• Partner with the CEO and other senior stakeholders, including board-level contacts, on scheduling and logistics for high-stakes meetings and leadership convenings

• Provide day-to-day administrative support to the CEO, CPO, and CLO, including calendar management, scheduling, travel coordination, and meeting logistics

• Bring sound judgment and discretion to every interaction as a trusted partner to senior leadership

What Will Help You Succeed

(You don’t need to check every box, but here’s what will help you thrive.)

• 1–3 years of experience in a fast-paced, high-accountability, cross-functional environment (executive support, people operations, project coordination, events, consulting, or another cross-functional role)

• Exceptional judgment, discretion, and attention to detail; anticipates what needs attention, keeps things from falling through the cracks, and can be trusted with sensitive information

• Exceptional written and verbal communication and stakeholder management skills; communicates clearly, thoughtfully, and proactively, builds trust across levels and functions, and closes loops without prompting

• Fluent in using AI and modern productivity tools to work smarter; thoughtfully uses technology to research, synthesize information, improve communications, streamline workflows, and automate repetitive work

• Intellectually curious, resourceful, and quick to learn; asks thoughtful questions, seeks to understand "the why," and can take an ambiguous ask and drive it forward

• Thrives in a fast-moving environment with competing priorities; context-switches effectively and moves fluidly between detailed execution and the bigger picture

• Strong interpersonal instincts, reads people well, and takes pride in handling every interaction with care

• Motivated by breadth and growth; energized by learning across functions and taking on new responsibilities over time

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with systems such as Greenhouse and Lattice a plus

Benefits

• PTO and company holidays

• Medical, dental, vision

• Employer-paid short-term disability, long-term disability, life insurance

• 401(k) and company match

• Professional development stipend

• Strong culture of collaboration, performance, and personal growth

$85,000 - $105,000 a year

The actual salary offered may vary depending on job-related factors including, but not limited to knowledge, skills, experience and location.

How We Work

At Madison Energy Infrastructure, we believe in the power of clean energy infrastructure to drive real impact—for our customers, our partners, and the communities we serve. We’ve quickly emerged as a preeminent developer, investor, and operator of distributed generation, helping organizations across sectors meet their energy goals with certainty, speed, and trust. Our robust portfolio consists of over half a gigawatt of clean energy infrastructure projects across more than 25 states.

We’re building a team that thrives on ownership and ambition. As we expand into direct, end-to-end services for Fortune 500 companies, public entities, and nonprofits alike, we rely on collaborative thinkers who bring structure to complexity, energy to execution, and curiosity to every challenge.

Our environment is fast-paced and outcome-oriented—but grounded in the belief that how we work together matters as much as what we deliver. If you’re excited to shape the future of clean energy and be part of a high-performance, high-integrity team, we’d love to meet you.

Madison Energy Infrastructure is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

jobs.title: Process Engineer (Starlink/Akoustis) - Night Shift
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

PROCESS ENGINEER (STARLINK/AKOUSTIS) - NIGHT SHIFT

Akoustis is now operating as a wholly owned subsidiary of SpaceX providing industry leading RF filters using patented XBAW technology to help drive the mission of making human life multi-planetary, while also connecting the world through Starlink. Our work helps further the impact that Starlink is already making on millions of users around the world, while allowing us to broaden that reach dramatically and continue connecting the unconnected here on earth.

This position supports RF filter production for SpaceX’s Starlink satellite internet constellation and growing defense communications portfolio. An Akoustis Process Engineer sustains and monitors manufacturing processes to improve yield, quality, and efficiency.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Develop processes to improve efficiency and yield

• Analyze data, identify process deviations, and assist in root cause analysis to resolve issues

• Perform design of experiments to understand process mapping

• Recommend measures to reduce process variation and improve product quality and yield

• Assist operations and maintenance teams to maintain, qualify and troubleshoot process and equipment issues

• Ensure safety and quality protocols are followed

• Review work center SPC charts

• Document process specifications and OCAP’s

• Train operators and technicians

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or physics

• 1+ years of experience with semiconductor fabrication processes or statistical process control (internship, extracurricular, or academic experience is applicable)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Advanced degrees in semiconductor or science-related fields such as material science, chemical or electrical engineering, microelectronics, nanotechnology, chemistry, or physics

• Proficiency with metrology and failure analysis techniques

jobs.title: GPU & AI Infrastructure - Reserved Deal Desk Broker
jobs.description:
GPU & AI Infrastructure – Reserved Deal Desk Broker

Independent Contractor

PADO AI Orchestration, Inc., a new venture born out of LG Electronics and backed by LG NOVA, is revolutionizing energy management for the modern AI data center. We are on a mission to maximize Compute Per Megawatt™ by bridging the gap between infrastructure constraints and the explosive demand for AI-driven compute.

That mission has a commercial front door: PADO’s GPU marketplace. We broker compute between the neocloud and aggregator supply base and the AI-native companies that need capacity now — moving from on-demand and spot into the reserved market, where the real contracts get written. With LG’s backing in BESS storage, high-efficiency chillers, and liquid cooling, we bring credibility to the supply side that a broker alone does not have.

We are seeking a GPU & AI Infrastructure – Reserved Deal Desk Broker to run transactions across both sides of that marketplace. This is not an SDR seat and it is not account management. You will source supply, source demand, match them, price the spread, and carry the deal to signature. Our buyers are the ones the hyperscalers cannot serve — AI-native platforms, defense and robotics programs, biotech, and capital markets firms whose compliance requirements exclude standard hyperscaler options, and whose infrastructure decisions are made at the board level. If you have spent the last two years living in GPU pricing sheets and know who actually has inventory this quarter, this is a desk built for you.

Responsibilities:

• Supply-Side Sourcing: Build and maintain a live supplier network across neoclouds, aggregators, marketplaces, and colocation-backed operators. Negotiate reserved capacity pricing, prepayment terms, and service levels across H100, H200, B200/B300, GB200/GB300, RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, and AMD Instinct MI300X/MI355X.

• Demand-Side Origination: Source and qualify AI-native buyers — inference platforms and foundation model developers, defense technology, robotics and simulation, biotech, and quantitative finance — and translate their workloads into a capacity specification a supplier can actually quote.

• Transaction Matching: Match workload requirements — interconnect, bare-metal access, region, term length, memory and network profile — against available inventory. Know when a cluster genuinely fits a workload and when it does not.

• Multi-Stakeholder Deal Navigation: Run procurement cycles that require simultaneous commercial alignment across engineering leaders, CFOs, founders, compliance officers, and board or investment stakeholders. Reserved commitments with significant upfront capital are decided at the board level, not by a single champion.

• Spread and Margin Ownership: Price to a target spread and own the gross margin on every transaction you originate. You will be measured on realized margin, not on gross contract value.

• Commercial Structuring: Negotiate prepayment and escrow mechanics, payment timing, SLA pass-through, and non-circumvention terms, including export control and cross-border deployment constraints. Work with PADO’s counsel to keep upstream and downstream agreements mirrored so risk does not sit with PADO.

• Counterparty Diligence: Assess offtaker creditworthiness, supplier delivery risk, and concentration risk before any capacity is committed. Reserved capacity is a balance-sheet commitment, and the discipline not to commit it prematurely is part of the job.

• Deal Registration and Pipeline Hygiene: Maintain high standards for Salesforce hygiene and provide accurate forecasting to the executive team. Deal registration governs both PADO’s exposure and your commission crediting.

• Market Intelligence: Track spot and reserved pricing by chip, region, and term, and feed pricing signal back into PADO’s marketplace and product roadmap.

• Industry Representation: Serve as a PADO brand ambassador at major trade shows and industry events.

Qualifications:

• Live Network: 3+ years of full-cycle enterprise sales in GPU or compute brokering, neocloud sales, data center capacity sales, or infrastructure and commodity trading. Existing relationships on the supply side, the demand side, or both are the single most important qualification for this role.

• Market Fluency: Current on GPU spot and reserved pricing, and fluent in what actually moves it — chip generation, interconnect, bare metal versus virtualized, region and power cost, term length, and prepayment structure.

• Technical Literacy: Able to qualify a workload without an engineer in the room. You understand ML training environments and foundation model infrastructure, AI infrastructure failure modes, when multi-GPU sharding and NVLink matter and when they do not, and why a fast network without a shared filesystem can still be the wrong cluster.

• Reserved Compute Planning: Comfortable structuring long-term commitments — one- to five-year terms carrying 25–50% upfront capital — alongside prepayment and escrow, SLA and service-credit regimes, and term-versus-price tradeoffs. You know the difference between GMV and margin, and you work the second one.

• Regulated and Constrained Environments: Working knowledge of export controls, cross-border AI deployment, and data residency, and the requirements that follow from them — compute segregation for defense programs, auditable GPU cost structures for pre-IPO companies, and hardware-level isolation for proprietary model training in capital markets.

• Commercial Judgment: You know when not to do a deal. Reserving inventory against unsigned demand is how brokers go out of business, and we expect you to hold that line even when a quarter is thin.

• Sales Discipline: Rigorous qualification methodology (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC or equivalent) and the ability to build account intelligence from live business signals, infrastructure decision triggers, and buyer-specific friction points.

• AI-Augmented Professionalism: Beyond understanding AI/ML workloads and what they demand from infrastructure, you proactively use AI and go-to-market tooling — Salesforce, Clay, Apollo.io, Gong, and modern AI assistants — to streamline sourcing, automate counterparty research, and compress your own deal cycle.

• Startup Resilience: Self-motivated and comfortable in a high-growth environment where you are expected to help build the “playbook,” not just run it.

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent market experience. In this role, the network and the judgment matter more than the credential.

Why Join PADO?

• The LG Advantage: Join a nimble, venture-backed startup that has the global scale and hardware engineering might of LG Electronics behind it. On the supply side, that name opens doors a standalone broker cannot.

• A Live Marketplace: PADO’s marketplace is launching with real supplier inventory and a real demand pipeline through the LG ecosystem. You are not building a desk from an empty book.

• Earning Potential: We believe in rewarding our deal makers. This role features a competitive monthly retainer plus commission, credited on the margin you actually realize and paid as PADO collects. Per-transaction caps apply.

• Own the Desk: This is the first dedicated deal desk seat at PADO. You will define how the reserved book gets sourced, priced, and papered.

• Supportive Culture: Collaborate with a team of experts in energy, AI, and data center operations who are passionate about the next industrial paradigm.

Engagement: Independent Contractor (1099)

Location: Remote

Travel: ~25% of time

Compensation: Monthly retainer, plus commission credited on realized gross margin.

Apply: hr@pado.co

PADO AI Orchestration, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Teaching Assistant for BEAM Entry Points After-School Math Club
jobs.description:
About BEAM

Bridge to Enter Advanced Mathematics (BEAM) creates pathways for students from low-income, low-access backgrounds to become scientists, mathematicians, engineers, and computer scientists.

We provide BEAM students the same access to high-quality preparation in STEM as their more affluent peers, and we invest deeply in our students' success, with programming from middle school through college graduation focused on joyous, exciting, and rigorous mathematics, building vibrant communities, and supporting students in key life transitions such as college admissions and financial aid.

BEAM has grown from a small summer program serving 17 students in the summer of 2011 to a year-round, national program, serving 450+ students at six summer program sites and 600+ students in year-round programming in New York City and Los Angeles this school year. In addition, our BEAM National pilot program now reaches around 1000 elementary-aged students in seven different states, working to create a new nationwide pathway modeled on our local work. We've seen our students' successes first-hand, and it's backed by data: a quasi-experimental study found that students who attended our 7th grade summer program were 1.3X as likely to declare a STEM major as a matched comparison group.

DESCRIPTION OF THE POSITION

This upcoming academic year will be part of a transformative experience for students from low-income and historically marginalized communities with exceptional potential in math. Be a role model and mentor to your students as they begin their path to advanced mathematics.

Bridge to Enter Advanced Mathematics (BEAM), a project of the Art of Problem Solving Initiative, Inc., is seeking teaching assistants for our pilot year of an after-school math club that gives 4th grade students an opportunity to develop their problem solving skills and have fun with math.

What You’ll Do:

During BEAM’s Entry Points club, you’ll support a lead instructor and a group of 12-18 fourth graders as they tackle logic puzzles, math games, and challenge problems. Our club staff are supported by a full-time team who manage our school partnerships and provide curriculum materials. This is our pilot year, and we are actively refining the program based on what actually happens in the classroom.

As a Teaching Assistant, you will:

• Assist the lead club instructor with classroom management and implementing curriculum.

• Step into a mentorship role, building relationships with students and supporting their growth to develop a positive club environment for elementary students.

• Supervise students during club while the lead instructor pulls students aside for one-on-one or small group conversations and vice versa.

• Work with students on mathematics, both one-on-one and as a teaching assistant.

• Support student safety during club and the transitions before and after club.

• Provide feedback on clubs to Entry Points full-time staff.

Who You Are:

Teaching assistants must have experience with elementary-aged children in a group setting, be reliable, and take initiative. They should be able to balance helping the kids have fun while ensuring students meet behavior expectations. Ideally, our TAs will also be able to relate to our students and build positive connections through shared lived experiences.

All teaching assistants must be at least 18 years old by the beginning of the program. In addition, applicants must be authorized to work for an employer in the US. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time. International students able to obtain CPT or OPT are welcome to apply.

Exceptional candidates will also have:

• Strong conceptual understanding of 4-8th grade math, especially fractions and integer operations.

• Experience with math competitions and logic puzzles/games

• Prior experience with BEAM, either as a student or staff

• Classroom management skills

• Flexibility to go to at least 3 of our schools as needed

APPLICATION PROCESS

Our process, as described below, has approximately two stages and we anticipate the process lasting about 4-6 weeks in total with someone starting in the role as soon as possible, although we are flexible with the specific date.

The initial step is to submit your application, including resumé and responses to a few short application questions, via our online portal. When your application is complete, we will follow up with next steps.

Next steps in our process will include a 45-minute virtual interview and reference checks.

We will review applications on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

Must be able to perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation

• Constant (50%+) sitting/standing

• Frequent (26-50%) walking/bending

PAY & SCHEDULE

The hourly pay for this role is $19/hour.

• Club times/locations: note that time ranges include a buffer before and after club for setup, dismissal, and cleanup. Actual club durations are between 90-120 minutes, depending on location.

You must be able to commute to one Tuesday location and one Wednesday location.

• Tuesdays 3:00-5:30pm, 1077 Remsen Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11236

• Tuesdays 3:00-6:00pm, 188 Rochester Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11213

• Wednesdays 3:15-5:45pm, 625 W 133rd St, New York, NY 10027

• Wednesdays 1:30-4:00pm, 655 Parkside Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11226

In addition to hours worked in-person at schools, you will also be asked to provide feedback on clubs in virtual debrief meetings and/or in writing. The total estimated hours per week is 6-7 hours

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY AND INCLUSION

Beyond a commitment to nondiscrimination, we are committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

BEAM is an equal opportunity employer and does not unlawfully discriminate against employees or applicants for employment on the basis of an individual’s race (including traits historically associated with race (including, but not limited to, hair texture and protected hairstyles, such as braids, locks and twists), ethnicity, religion (including clothing or facial hair worn in accordance with the religious tenets), color, sex, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, breastfeeding, gender (including actual or perceived sex, gender identity, and gender expression including a person’s actual or perceived gender-related self-image, appearance, behavior, expression, or other gender-related characteristic, regardless of the sex assigned to that person at birth), sexual orientation, sexual and reproductive health decisions, national origin, immigration or citizenship status, status as a veteran, active military service member, or uniform service member, marital or partnership status, familial status, caregiver status, age (18 or older), predisposing genetic characteristics, disability, creed, status as a victim of domestic violence, sexual violence or stalking, unemployment status, salary history, credit history, an individual’s status as having a known relationship or association with a member or members of a protected category, or any other protected status in accordance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. This policy applies to all terms, conditions, and privileges of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, compensation, promotion, discipline, and termination.

All personnel decisions will be made in accordance with the principles of equal employment opportunity and subject only to valid (job-related) requirements for employment, benefits, or promotional opportunities.

jobs.title: Mechanical Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
10Beauty is a robotics startup based in Burlington, MA on a mission to forever change the beauty and wellness space. We have raised $70M from some of the leading venture and celebrity investors in the country to build the world’s first fully autonomous 5-step manicure machine. We have pre-sold our first 1,000 machines to some of the most iconic brands in America, including Ulta Beauty, Nordstrom, Equinox and Marriott.

As of November 2025, we launched our first robot at Ulta Beauty in Everett, MA and are continuing to scale across said brand locations above. We are a fast growing 60+ person organization with deep robotics experience.

Come join the company who will put 'beauty robotics' on the map!

Introduction

We're looking for a hands-on Mechanical Engineering Manager to lead a team of 7 mechanical engineers while remaining deeply involved in the technical work. This is a true player/coach role for someone who wants to design, build, test, and troubleshoot alongside their team—not simply delegate and manage from a distance.

You'll help set technical direction while contributing directly to mechanical design, CAD, prototyping, debugging, and product development. You'll lead by example, solve complex engineering problems, and help the team build reliable, production-ready robotic systems.

What You'll Do

• Lead, mentor, and develop a team of 7 mechanical engineers while remaining an active technical contributor.

• Work hands-on in CAD, mechanical design, prototyping, testing, and troubleshooting.

• Own complex mechanical problems and drive solutions from concept through validation and production.

• Review designs, challenge technical assumptions, and maintain a high bar for engineering quality.

• Drive improvements in reliability, performance, manufacturability, and design for assembly.

• Partner cross-functionally with software, electrical engineering, manufacturing, and supply chain to resolve issues and scale production.

• Balance technical execution, team development, and project priorities.

What You have:

• Degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline.

• Strong experience designing and developing complex mechanical systems, electromechanical products, or robotic hardware.

• Deep technical expertise in CAD, prototyping, testing, and mechanical troubleshooting.

• Experience leading engineers while remaining directly involved in engineering execution.

• Track record of bringing physical products from prototype through production.

• Strong understanding of design for manufacturing, tolerance analysis, and mechanical reliability.

• A low-ego, hands-on leadership style and a willingness to dive into the details to solve difficult problems.

What Makes You Successful

You're an engineer at heart who enjoys solving hard problems and building great products. You lead by doing, coach through technical collaboration, and know when to dive into the details versus empower your team. You care about both the quality of the engineering and the success of the people doing it.

At 10Beauty, we consider a wide-range of factors when determining compensation, based on individual qualifications, skills, and experience. Equity and benefits are included for all full-time employees. If you believe you can contribute to our team, we invite you to apply. We appreciate diversity and welcome those who can bring fresh perspectives and skills to our team.

$175,000—$190,000 USD

jobs.title: Plant Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

As the Plant Manager, you will serve as a dynamic, transformational leader responsible for revolutionizing our high-complexity manufacturing plant in Lowell, IN, accelerating throughput, and driving absolute operational excellence across every shift. This role holds full operational and cultural ownership of the facility, spearheading continuous improvement, championing a safety-first floor culture, and building the manufacturing strategy of the future to meet evolving business needs. By developing local talent, fostering collaborative growth, and aligning site objectives with broader organizational goals, the Plant Manager ensures sustainable financial performance, world-class quality yields, and seamless execution.

Key Responsibilities

This is a full-time, on-site role located at our manufacturing facility in Lowell, IN.

• Safety-First Floor Culture: Champion an accident-free workplace culture that treats Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) as a non-negotiable core value while actively engaging, mentoring, and inspiring operators directly on the shop floor.
• High-Velocity Production & Financial Ownership: Scale plant throughput, optimize supply chain coordination, and maintain full operational and P&L financial ownership across custom graphics materials.
• Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement: Spearhead continuous improvement by embedding Enterprise Lean Sigma (ELS) and Six Sigma principles across manufacturing lines to eliminate waste, optimize workflows, and maximize yield.
• Precision Execution & Quality Standards: Enforce and promote uncompromising quality standards backed by ISO 9000 systems, leveraging Voice of Customer (VOC) feedback to deliver rapid turnaround times and flawless execution.
• Strategic Governance & Capital Planning: Formulate long-term site strategy and short-term operational goals, aligning with the broader business framework while managing capital expenditure (CapEx) budgets to future-proof facility capabilities.

• Optimize & Empower: Partner with teams to reduce waste, elevate first-pass ISO 9000 quality yields, and build out line-level change agent development paths for floor leadership and drive continuous improvement.
• Deliver Strategic Growth: Deliver against overall site OGSM framework (objectives,goals, strategies and measures)—achieving throughput milestones, operational cost targets, and capital project implementation deadlines.

Qualifications

• Operational Leadership Experience: 8+ years of progressive operational leadership experience running fast-paced manufacturing plants, with direct domain expertise in converting, pressure-sensitive materials, printing, or custom graphics production.
• Education & Process Safety Management: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (or technical equivalent) paired with practical Process Safety Management (PSM) expertise, including Process Hazard Analyses (PHA), Management of Change (MOC) compliance, and high-hazard risk mitigation.
• Lean & Operational Excellence: Demonstrated mastery of Enterprise Lean Sigma (ELS) or equivalent Lean Manufacturing systems with proven success leading kaizen events and sustainable workflow optimizations.
• Quality Systems & Execution: Deep familiarity with ISO 9000 quality systems, Voice of Customer integration, and structured root-cause problem-solving methodologies.
• Servant Leadership & Change Management: Proven track record of floor-first servant leadership that energizes teams, develops local talent, navigates change, and upholds uncompromising corporate ethics.

jobs.title: Research Consultant
jobs.description:
Lifecycle Marketing Manager- 3 month FTC

Team: Marketing

Prolific

At Prolific, our marketplace is rooted in academia, and that commitment runs deep. Alongside our work to accelerate the future of AI, we’re continuing to redefine how the world conducts academic research.

What started as a research-driven idea has evolved into the world’s most trusted infrastructure for human data. Today, tens of thousands of researchers from top universities across the globe rely on Prolific to power their work, from peer-reviewed studies to the next generation of technological breakthroughs.

We're doubling down on our mission to serve the academic community, deepening relationships, building smarter tools, and making high-quality human data more accessible than ever.

The role

Prolific’s self-serve motion is a core growth engine for Prolific. We’re looking for an experienced lifecycle marketer to scale and ship the foundations of our lifecycle programme: onboarding, activation, retention and reactivation across email and in-app, plus the product-qualified signals that tell Sales which accounts are worth a conversation.

You’ll work with Product, Customer Success, Sales/RevOps and Product Marketing. We need someone who can get up to speed quickly, make sound calls with minimal direction, and deliver programmes, dashboards and documentation.

This is not a traditional B2B SaaS marketing role. We’re looking for someone who has run lifecycle in a product-led, self-serve business, where users sign up and start on their own and marketing’s job is to drive behaviour in and around the product. Demand gen, MQL/SQL pipeline, events and sales-led nurture are not the right background.

This is a full-time, 3 month fixed-term contract, with the potential to extend depending on business needs.

What you’ll bring to the role

• 5-7 years in lifecycle, CRM, retention or growth marketing at a product-led / self-serve company, with a track record of moving activation, retention or expansion metrics (not just sending campaigns)

• Prior contract, consulting or agency experience, or a clear record of delivering scoped work independently to a deadline

• Hands-on ownership of lifecycle programmes for a freemium, free-trial or pay-as-you-go funnel

• Strong experience with email/CRM platforms (HubSpot or equivalent) and in-product messaging tools (Pendo, Appcues, Intercom, Braze, Customer.io, Iterable or similar)

• Experience defining activation, building behavioural segments and triggers, and using product usage data to drive messaging

• Analytical fluency: cohort analysis, activation and retention curves, funnel conversion, LTV. You can run your own analysis in HubSpot/Hex or equivalent without a data team

• Experience designing and running experiments, and knowing which results to trust

• Experience partnering with Sales/RevOps on PQL or usage-based handoff

• A clear communicator who can prioritise, push back and manage stakeholders without needing close supervision

• Comfortable with ambiguity in a small, high-output team

What you’ll be doing in the role

Month 1: Diagnose and prioritise

• Audit current lifecycle programmes, journeys, segmentation and tooling (HubSpot, Pendo, Hex)

• Map the self-serve journey by customer segment and identify the biggest activation and retention gaps

• Agree a prioritised roadmap and success metrics with Growth Marketing, Product and Customer Success

• Ship at least one quick win, such as a fix to an existing onboarding email or in-app message

Months 2-4: Build and launch and document

• Design, build and launch onboarding and activation programmes across email and in-app (Pendo), aimed at faster time to first value

• Launch retention, top-up and reactivation/win-back flows for lapsed and dormant users

• Define PQL and expansion signals with Sales/RevOps: behavioural thresholds, validation against conversion outcomes, and a CRM handoff process

• Start a structured experimentation programme across onboarding, email and in-app

• Report on results, learnings and experiment outcomes

• Document journeys, segmentation logic, triggers, PQL definitions, naming conventions and

Why Prolific is a great place to work

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breath and the best of humanity.

Working for us will place you at the forefront of AI innovation, providing access to our unique human data platform and opportunities for groundbreaking research. Join us to enjoy a competitive salary, benefits, and remote working within our impactful, mission-driven culture.

jobs.title: Occupational Therapist - Milwaukee, WI
jobs.description:
Occupational Therapist - PRN - Milwaukee WI
 
Roshal Health was founded over 20 years ago by a Clinical Professional who wanted to create a company with both the patient and the Clinical employee in mind, providing more time for our patients and a better work/life balance for our employees. 
Top 5 Reasons our employees love working here:
Work that fits into your life — not the other way around: Reclaim your schedule for what matters most
Security: W2 Employment with PTO & Full Benefits - benefits are available to all full-time & most part-time employees
Daily Variety: Enjoy conducting a wide range of scans, primarily in an ER environment (Both hospital and free-standing)
Professional Development: Additional Training Programs and a clear path to career growth
Culture: We’ve built a culture where people are trusted to work independently, supported to succeed, and encouraged to enjoy meaningful work together.
Responsibilities:
An Occupational Therapist helps individuals of all ages improve their ability to perform daily activities and live as independently as possible. You will assess patients' needs, develop personalized treatment plans, and use a variety of therapeutic techniques to enhance their function, promote independence, and improve their overall quality of life.
·        Conduct comprehensive evaluations of patients' physical, emotional, cognitive, and social capabilities related to daily functioning.
·        Develop individualized treatment plans to address impairments and promote functional independence in areas such as self-care, work, school, and leisure.
·        Implement therapeutic activities and interventions tailored to the patient’s goals and progress.
·        Train patients and caregivers in the use of adaptive equipment and strategies for daily living.
·        Modify environments (home, work, school) to enhance safety and accessibility.
·        Document patient evaluations, treatment plans, progress notes, and discharge summaries in accordance with regulatory and organizational standards.
·        Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams, including physical therapists, speech therapists, physicians, and nurses.
·        Educate patients, families, and caregivers on therapy techniques, goals, and expectations.
·        Stay current with best practices, licensing requirements, and continuing education.
 
Requirements:
·        1+ year(s) of clinical experience in a relevant setting (e.g., hospital, outpatient, pediatric, school, skilled nursing facility).
·        Experience working with specialized populations (e.g., autism spectrum, stroke recovery, orthopedic rehab, geriatrics) is a plus.
·        Familiarity with electronic health records (EHR) and documentation systems.
·        Strong interpersonal, communication, and problem-solving skills.
·        Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
·        Bachelor or Master’s degree in Occupational Therapy from an accredited program.
·        Current state license (or eligible) to practice as an Occupational Therapist.
·        NBCOT certification (National Board for Certification in Occupational Therapy).
·        CPR/BLS certification (may be required depending on setting).
 
 
Requires some public contact with client patients, client staff, and doctors, requiring considerable interpersonal skill, professionalism, and customer service.
The position occasionally involves frequent bending, reaching, repetitive hand movements, standing, walking, squatting, and sitting. It also requires some heavy lifting of up to 20 lbs and regular pushing and pulling throughout the duration of tests. Manual dexterity and hand-eye coordination are necessary for operating equipment. The work environment may vary, including outpatient clinics, hospitals, nursing homes, rehabilitation centers, or patients' homes.
