jobs.title: Director of Enterprise Payor Growth
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION: HOSPITAL-QUALITY CARE, EVERYWHERE.

The healthcare industry still relies on faxes and phone tags to coordinate critical care for patients at home. We think patients and the clinicians who serve them deserve better than a system stuck in 1995.

Verse Medical is building the modern software infrastructure to make it happen. We're a well-funded Series C company (backed by General Catalyst, SignalFire, and Sapphire Ventures) on a mission to heal a fragmented system. Our platform connects the dots between providers, payors, and patients, ensuring people get the high-quality care they need, reliably and right where they live. We’re growing fast and looking for people who are driven by this mission to join us!




OUR VALUES: THE PRINCIPLES THAT GUIDE US

Our values are the operating system for how we work together and with our partners. They aren't just words on a wall; they are the principles we bring to every decision, every day.

 - We are transparent, upfront and direct. We operate with honesty and clarity. We share information openly, the good and the bad, and believe that direct, respectful feedback is the foundation of trust and progress.

 - We value speed of iteration. We are building something new, which means we learn by doing. We prioritize rapid iteration and getting solutions into the hands of users, believing that progress is more valuable than perfection.

 - We give 110% effort, 30% of the time. We are passionate about our mission, and there are moments that require us to go the extra mile. We believe in focused intensity when it counts, balanced by a sustainable pace that keeps our team energized for the long run.

 - We empathize with customers to a fault. When our users face a problem, we own it. Instead of asking them to change, we ask ourselves, "How can we make this better?" We believe true innovation comes from deep empathy and a relentless focus on solving the real-world challenges of healthcare.
   
   


YOUR IMPACT: HOW YOU'LL HELP US HEAL A BROKEN SYSTEM

We're looking for a Director of Payor Growth to join our growing team within Verse. We’ve established our business with a strong footprint in the Provider vertical. Now we are excited to be further expanding by deepening our Health Plan business, building our team under this vertical with a new approach to home medical supplies and healthcare at home. This role is solely focused on strategic initiatives with health plans and broader payor organizations.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: A GLIMPSE INTO YOUR CONTRIBUTIONS

Within your first year, you will have the opportunity to:

 - Own your own book of strategic Health Plan Sales targets and opportunities, acting as the primary point of accountability for deal progression, quota attainment, and successful implementation with national and regional health plans.

 - Build and maintain executive-level relationships with C-suite and VP-level decision makers at health plans to navigate and close complex 6-18 month sales cycles.

 - Collaborate with marketing on positioning and materials development, providing insight and input to messaging effectiveness, needs for deal cycle progression, and content development as we continue to grow our brand recognition in this new vertical.

 - Design, sell, and negotiate innovative contract models, including pricing, SLAs, and triage with Verse’s legal and data teams.

 - Travel to customer meetings or conferences as needed to represent Verse in person at key moments in the relationship or publicly at industry conferences.

 - Identify and clear blockers to deal progression and quota attainment. Raise blockers to leadership and work to find creative solutions across the organization to positively impact our progress to goal as a company.

 - Turn what you learn into a repeatable playbook, so our growing team has the tools and processes in place for long-term success.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING: THE SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE YOU'LL LEVERAGE

We believe that diverse experiences and backgrounds lead to better solutions. While we have an idea of what will help someone succeed in this role, we are open to being convinced by your unique story and skills. If you believe you can achieve the outcomes above, we encourage you to apply.


CORE SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - 10+ years selling in healthcare, including 5+ years selling to health plans, with a consistent track record of exceeding targets.

 - Experience sourcing and closing enterprise health plan contracts, managing the sales cycle across multiple executive stakeholders.

 - A demonstrated ability to ramp up quickly on complex financial and regulatory domains within healthcare, to build deep fluency in Verse's product, operations, and customer value proposition.

 - Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail to consistently deliver zero-defect work, and experience with CRM tools and other sales and marketing technology is a plus.

 - Strong written and verbal communication, and a track record of leading others by setting high standards, understanding their motivations, and communicating empathetically.

 - Willingness to work extended hours when required.
   
   


THE REWARDS & REALITY: COMPENSATION, BENEFITS & LOGISTICS

We believe in taking care of our team, both professionally and personally. Here's what we offer:

 - Meaningful Compensation: $300-400k OTE: $175k base

 - Comprehensive Health & Wellness: We cover 100% of your health insurance premium and provide access to high-quality dental and vision insurance plans for you and your dependents.

 - Plan for the Future: We offer a 401(k) plan to help you save for your future. At this time, the company does not offer a 401(k) match.

 - Career Growth: You'll have opportunities for rapid career advancement in a company that's at a major inflection point. We want you to grow with us.




OUR PLEDGE FOR AN EQUITABLE FUTURE

At Verse Medical, our mission is to deliver equitable, hospital-quality care to everyone, regardless of their background or where they live. We can only achieve this if our own team reflects the diversity of the patients we serve. We are committed to building a workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, where their contributions are valued, and where they can do their best work. We embrace diversity of all kinds: race, gender, age, religion, identity, experience. We are actively working to build a more inclusive and equitable world, starting from within our own walls. We are an equal opportunity employer.

We are also committed to providing a positive and accessible interview experience. If you require any accommodations to participate in our process, please contact us at recruiting@versemedical.com.

jobs.title: FSQA Superintendent (Core)
jobs.description:
The Core FSQA Superintendent is responsible for overseeing the implementation, execution, and continuous improvement of core Food Safety & Quality programs at Home Chef. This role ensures compliance with the SQF (Safe Quality Food) Management System, including the development, execution, and monitoring of the cleaning and sanitation program, master sanitation schedule, food safety and quality plan, and pest control management. The Core Superintendent is also accountable for the Management Review process.The FSQA Superintendent leads by example in driving food safety culture.

Detailed Responsibilities

Support the design, Implementation & Verification of the Food Safety & Quality Management System

• Ensure the enforcement and continuous improvement of Home Chef’s Food Safety and Quality Systems, designed to meet regulatory, Food Safety and Quality requirements to assure compliance with SQF requirements.

• Oversee the development, implementation, and execution of the cleaning and sanitation program, including the Master Sanitation Schedule.

• Lead the Management Review process, ensuring that all critical aspects of the FSQA programs are evaluated and improved as necessary.

• Act as the SQF Practitioner, ensuring compliance with SQF standards and maintaining documentation for audits.

• Assist in the gathering, trending and reporting of metrics that effectively measure and communicate performance.

• Works closely with the plant FSQA teams and cross-functionally in understanding, identifying gaps and proposing changes to processes that affect quality systems compliance.

• Act as a backup to the FSQA Manager during their absence, assuming responsibility for managing quality assurance functions and leading the QA team effectively

Support Core FSQA Supervisor & Hourly Staff in day to day operations

• Respond and provide solutions to escalations in a 24/7 production environment

• Provide coverage support as needed in a 24/7 production environment

• Work with recruiting teams to adequately staff each shift

• Assist supervisors in personnel coaching as needed

Drive Improvements of Food Safety & Quality Management System

• Identify gaps in programs through internal audit or CAPA

• Provide thorough corrective actions to deviations and gaps, ensuring that corrective actions are implemented effectively.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address any non-conformities and drive continuous improvement.

• Deliver training to plant FSQA teams related to program rollout

• Deliver communication with plant and corporate stakeholders regarding new or updated programs and any critical issues

Develop RTH Supervisory Staff

• Lead weekly supervisory meetings

• Perform as subject matter expert to new programs rollouts

• Identify and coach supervisory team on developmental opportunities

• Conduct performance reviews on direct reports

This position may require up to 10% travel

Qualifications

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability needed for this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities.

• Completion of a two-year program such as an Associate degree

• Minimum of 2 years of supervisory experience in quality assurance, food safety, food distribution, food manufacturing, supply chain, or related field

• Previous experience with GFSI, SQF and USDA audits preferred.

• Understanding of Quality Management Systems

• Experience developing, implementing, and maintaining food safety and quality programs

• Exceptional written, verbal and interpersonal skills

• Self-starter who is results-oriented, resourceful, and takes initiative

• Capable of handling multiple responsibilities

• Demonstrated ability to embrace change and learn quickly in a fast-paced environment

More About Us

Perks and Benefits

• Candidates can experience Home Chef as a customer - enter promo code PEOPLE30 for $30 off your first order!

• Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance available

• Paid holidays, sick time and vacation time

• 401k program

• Flexible spending accounts for qualified medical, dependent care, parking, or transit expenses

How We Work Together

We are humble team players.
We are warm and gracious with team members and customers. We seek feedback to improve ourselves - and respectfully listen to and accept input.

We are pragmatic next-level thinkers.
We come up with novel and unique ideas. We explore new strategies to avoid being constrained by conventional thinking.

We take ownership.
We approach ambiguous problems, prepared to dive in, get curious, and learn more. We are results-driven, always challenging ourselves to exceed goals.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Analyst (Brazil & Argentina ONLY)
jobs.description:
About Niche

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.

About The Role

**We are currently recruiting for this role in Argentina and Brazil only.  We will not be considering US based candidates at this time.  All interviews are being held remotely. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.**

**Only applications/resumes written in English will be accepted.**

Niche's product teams make dozens of decisions each quarter about what to build. We are looking for an analytically rigorous, product-minded Senior Product Analyst to help Niche decide what to build and know whether it worked. This is a senior individual contributor role on the Analytics team, embedded with our product teams and reporting to the Director of Product Analytics.

You will own how we measure key product areas across our family-facing and school-facing experiences, such as rankings, scholarships, registration, and new products. You will be a strategic partner to product leadership, not a request queue. That means shaping questions before work starts, running the experiments that answer them, and staying with the work through the decision.

Our analytics team works Claude-first: you will use Claude and Claude Code every day and help shape how the team and its partners use them.

What You Will Do

Product Strategy & Insight

• Embed with product teams as their analytics partner. Join planning and roadmap conversations and help identify and size opportunities before work is prioritized

• Define the metrics that matter for each product area and keep definitions consistent across dashboards and the semantic layer

• Own the measurement of product funnels, feature adoption, engagement, and retention for both families and school partners

• Run deep-dive analyses on user behavior and segments, and pair every finding with a recommendation and a clear next step

• Identify where users struggle or drop off and bring those opportunities to product managers proactively. Partner with Design and UX Research to pair behavioral data with qualitative insight

Experimentation

• Own A/B tests with product teams end to end: design and sizing based on product requirements, guardrails and duration, tracking setup in GTM and GA4, and interpreting results with honest calls on signal versus noise

• Contribute to experimentation standards and apply them across your teams so tests are tied to business outcomes, not just clicks

• Measure launches that can't be randomized, using appropriate causal methods and clear statements of confidence

Measurement Partnership

• Write clear measurement requirements and GA4 event specs for new features before launch, build and test the GTM tags, and partner with Data Engineering on server-side and pipeline needs

• QA product data after launch, review GTM changes from partner teams, account for consent and tracking gaps, and flag quality issues early

• Build and maintain the dashboards and self-serve views (Streamlit) that let product managers answer their own recurring questions.

• Contribute to dbt models and the self-serve semantic layer with Data Engineering

• Support new data systems and tracking changes, such as consent management, with reporting requirements, GA4 reconciliation, and launch measurement

Claude-Powered Analytics

• Use Claude and Claude Code as core daily tools: writing and reviewing SQL, exploring data, drafting readouts, and building Streamlit apps

• Build and maintain the semantic layer, Claude skills, and context (metric definitions, table guides, experiment standards) that make Claude reliable on Niche's data

• Automate recurring work, such as test readouts, KPI monitoring, and launch reviews, with Claude-driven workflows

• Keep pace with AI-assisted product development by using Claude to spot launches that need measurement

• Help product managers self-serve with Claude: maintain the skills and sanctioned definitions they rely on, coach them on reading data, and review findings before they drive decisions

• Help analysts and product partners adopt Claude, and help define the team's standards for validating its output

Analytical Rigor & Influence

• Model rigor in product data: reproducible SQL, documented methods, validated results, and a clear line between correlation and causation

• Hold AI-assisted work to the same bar as your own: check the queries, numbers, and logic before anything ships

• Mentor analysts informally, and review and pressure-test analyses from the team and from product partners, including AI-assisted work

• Present findings to product and company leadership with a clear "so what"

During the First Month:

• Meet stakeholders across Product, Analytics, and Data Engineering to learn team goals, roadmaps, and workflows

• Get set up with Claude, Claude Code, and the team's existing skills. Learn our stack (Snowflake, dbt, Streamlit, GA4 data) and how product events are defined and captured

• Review existing product dashboards and reports to build a baseline view of core product KPIs

Within 3 Months:

• Act as analytics partner to your assigned product teams, including defining metrics and reading out launches and tests

• Write measurement requirements for upcoming launches with Data Engineering

• Learn the boundaries and collaborations between Product Analytics and Data Engineering so ownership of shared data is clear

Within 6 Months:

• Apply and help evolve experimentation standards across your teams

• Become the go-to expert on product behavior data, presenting findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams

• Ship at least one self-directed deep dive that influences a product decision, and build or improve one Claude skill or workflow the team reuses

Within 12 Months:

• Use deep product and user knowledge to inform roadmap prioritization

• Build a scalable measurement framework for your product areas that helps teams make data-informed decisions on their own

• Contribute to the Analytics roadmap with new methods, tools, or process improvements

What We Are Looking For

Experience

• 5+ years in product analytics, data analytics, or a closely related data role

• Demonstrated experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and owning product measurement end to end

• Hands-on experience analyzing web or app behavioral data (GA4, GTM, PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or similar), including its limitations

• Hands-on experience using Claude, Claude Code, or similar AI tools in analytics work, with examples of workflows you built or automated

• Track record of influencing product decisions and roadmaps with data

• Proven ability to turn complex findings into clear recommendations for non-technical partners, and to say plainly when the data won't support the question

• Experience in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with shifting priorities

Skills

• Senior SQL proficiency; comfortable writing, reviewing, and debugging complex queries independently

• Strong grounding in statistics and experimentation, with Python or R for analysis

• Experience with Snowflake, dbt, and version-controlled analytics work

• Strong dashboarding skills in Streamlit, Looker, or similar

• Fluency with Claude or similar AI tools: prompting well, giving models the right context, and checking every query and number they produce

• Comfort operating as a senior IC: influencing without authority and working self-directed on ambiguous problems

Education

• Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. A Master's degree is a plus

Nice to Have

• Experience building Claude skills, MCP connectors, or agent workflows for a team

• Understanding of K-12 or college admissions processes

• Experience with causal inference methods beyond A/B tests

• Experience contributing to a semantic layer or self-serve metrics layer

• Background in marketplace, consumer internet, SaaS, or education technology

Interview Process

Candidate experience is a top priority for our talent and hiring teams.  We believe in providing a transparent, authentic and comprehensive interview process where you have the opportunity to learn about us while we get to know you and your experience.  The interview process is outlined here:

• Video Interview with Talent Acquisition Partner - 30 Minutes

• Video Interview with Hiring Manager - 30 Minutes

• Team Interview - 3 separate 30 Minutes Interviews

• Case Study & Presentation w/ Analytics Team

• Hiring Manager Follow-up if successful - 30 Minutes

**We are currently recruiting for this role in Argentina and Brazil only.  We will not be considering US based candidates at this time.  All interviews are being held remotely. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.**

**Only applications/resumes written in English will be accepted.**

jobs.title: Manager, Supercomputer Site Reliability Engineering - Memphis
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

SpaceXSI operates multi-campus, hyperscale GPU infrastructure where cluster availability directly determines training throughput, customer handover commitments, and capital efficiency of the fleet. The Manager of Supercomputer Site Reliability Engineering will be responsible for both compute and infrastructure performance, and will be responsible for significantly increasing the SRE team size. On the compute side, focus will be put on continuous site monitoring, cross-discipline incident command, deep hardware root-cause analysis (RCA), and emphasis on software systems that orchestrate repair velocity. Additional focus will be on physical infrastructure reliability as well. Understanding system margins and resiliency will be key.

Site Reliability engineering manager owns >99% compute uptime outcome, drives unplanned facilities compute losses to 0, ensures efficient allocation of > 3GW site power, upgrade robust fault-free megapack failover systems capable of supporting all halls for >4 hours (160 MWhr per hall), drives robust hardware inventory systems and repair velocity to eliminate hardware chokepoints.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Serve as the senior operational authority for the SRE organization and represent production reliability concerns in engineering and leadership discussions.

• Lead integrated Supercompute systems engineering reliability team responsible for reactive and increasingly proactive cluster and facilities health and reliance initiatives

• Build out the site reliability engineering sub-teams: compute hardware failure analysis, software tools, cluster monitoring, and integrated site reliability engineering

Drive operational superiority

• Define SRE organizational structure and develop culture of 24/7 operational excellence

• Physics limit anomaly response times and robust proactive health processes

• Define on-call responsibilities, incident management protocols, leadership structure, and communication discipline

• Develop training schemes for tough, competent, and disciplined monitoring and response teams

• Establish clear operational interfaces with Datacenter Operations, engineering teams, vendors, and other service owners

• Own vendor oversight and accountability mechanisms

• Drive mean time to repair toward physics limits

• Define and continuously improve operational procedures and analysis documentation mechanisms with strong emphasis on intelligent automation

• Lead robustification of documentation workflow

• Ensure efficient signal to noise in execution

• Define operational targets, health indicators, alerting standards, and incident severity definitions that facilitate measurable team performance insights and accountability mechanisms

Cultivate engineering excellence

• Drive high technical standard for hardware root cause analysis and remediation teams ensuring industry-leading hardware failure diagnostic expertise

• Integrate with platform engineering teams to develop sophisticated hardware and system understanding to drive high operational reliability

• Drive repeat hardware issues to a minimum and lead automation efforts to eliminate manual overhead for unavoidable remediation needs

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of experience working in a large scale operations with 2+ years leading people leaders of technical teams or 10+ years of experience working in a large scale operations with 5+ years leading people leaders of technical teams.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Proven ability to lead large, multi-site, 24/7 operations organizations in fast-paced, high-responsibility settings.

• Deep expertise in server hardware, cluster reliability, and data center technologies, from deployment through lifecycle management.

• Experience supporting compute-heavy environments like AI, machine learning, or high-performance computing at scale.

• A track record of owning uptime, Service Level Agreements, or reliability metrics for large compute clusters.

• Experience leading site reliability engineering or equivalent reliability-focused teams, including root cause analysis and procedure ownership.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, from technicians to executive and tenant partners.

• A history of partnering with vendors at scale, driving mean time to repair down, and scaling operations across multiple sites.

• Familiarity with tooling and automation (e.g., Jira, Python, Bash) used to monitor cluster health and improve team efficiency.

• Enthusiasm for SpaceXAI's mission to accelerate human discovery and unravel the universe.

• Ability to thrive in a dynamic, mission-focused environment with on-call ownership of cluster-impacting events.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Willingness to travel frequently to data center locations to support operations across sites.

• Physical capability to handle data center tasks, including lifting up to 50 lbs unassisted, standing for long periods, and occasional ladder use.

• Must be willing to work extended hours and/or weekends as needed.

SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.location: Los Angeles, United States; San Francisco, United States
jobs.description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary and Impact

This role is within WPP Media, where you will be instrumental in owning production stability, observability, and system health for a mission-critical global campaign governance and compliance platform. As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will operate and improve a system running natively on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will investigate complex production issues, implement minor code-level fixes in Python, lead root cause analysis, and improve the reliability of distributed systems. Working closely with the EMEA-based Engineering Tech Lead, Product Owner, and Quality Assurance partners, you will connect production insights with technical roadmap priorities.

The opportunity combines hands-on Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) with technical squad leadership. There's an initial monitoring setup to build from, but it's a great opportunity to evaluate what exists, form your own point of view, and define where observability needs to go. From there, you'll shape the future support squad for a dedicated product used across global advertising campaigns, while also owning advanced L2+ and L3-oriented support, incident response, and the service-level and business-as-usual work that keeps the system running.

Key Responsibilities

• Own production stability, system health, and observability for a mission-critical campaign governance and compliance platform running on GCP.

• Define and advance the observability strategy using GCP Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Error Reporting, Prometheus, PromQL, and suitable service level indicators and objectives.

• Lead incident response, post-incident reviews, and end-to-end root cause analysis, partnering with the EMEA Engineering team on permanent remediation.

• Diagnose and resolve complex, intermittent, and high-priority incidents across application, database, infrastructure, and networking layers.

• Read, debug, and implement minor fixes and patches directly within the existing Python production codebase.

• Monitor execution flows, performance, data refreshes, automated checks, and recurring compliance reporting to ensure reliable system operation.

• Identify opportunities to automate manual support activity, develop and maintain runbooks, and reduce operational toil.

• Provide technical leadership to the L2+ support squad through coaching, knowledge sharing, prioritization, and effective handovers.

• Partner with Product, Engineering, and Quality Assurance teams to assess operational risk, improve release and change management, and influence technical roadmap decisions.

Skills and Experience

• Advanced education in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• 7+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure/platform engineering roles, including meaningful experience operating and troubleshooting production systems at scale.

• Deep, hands-on experience supporting enterprise systems on Google Cloud Platform, including Compute Engine, Google Kubernetes Engine, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Firestore, Cloud Functions, Identity and Access Management, and virtual private cloud networking.

• Strong, current Python proficiency, including the ability to read, debug, and implement fixes directly within a shared production codebase.

• Strong Python and Bash scripting skills for automating support tasks, parsing logs, developing operational tools, and reducing manual effort.

• Complex production troubleshooting and root cause analysis experience across distributed systems, including leadership of post-incident reviews.

• High proficiency with GCP Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Error Reporting, Prometheus, and PromQL, including establishing service level indicators and service level objectives.

• Strong experience with Docker and Kubernetes, particularly deploying, managing, and troubleshooting applications running in Google Kubernetes Engine.

• Experience using Terraform for infrastructure as code, tracing infrastructure-level issues, and identifying improvements to infrastructure management.

• Solid querying and troubleshooting experience across Firestore, BigQuery, PostgreSQL, and MySQL.

• Experience leading, mentoring, or serving as a technical lead for a squad or technical team, along with strong knowledge of Incident, Problem, and Change Management practices and the software development lifecycle.

Life at WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we've adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

WPP Media is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact the hiring team to discuss your needs.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, go to https://mybenefits.wpp.com/public/welcome for more details.

jobs.description:
About AppDirect

Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world.  AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service.  We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations.  We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.

About You

The CSM - Network Development Specialist is a junior, internally-facing role focused on growing and strengthening the PartnerStack Network — the marketplace connecting vendors with high-performing affiliates and partners. This role is less about managing external client relationships and more about the behind-the-scenes work that keeps the Network healthy: sourcing and vetting new partners, matching existing partners to the right vendor opportunities, and building the categorization systems and processes that make the Network easier to navigate and scale. You'll work closely with the Network Manager to support day-to-day Network operations, with a particular focus on partner recruitment, partner segmentation, and spotting emerging talent within the partner base before they become obvious.

What you’ll do and how you’ll have an impact

• Source and reach out to prospective affiliates/partners across relevant verticals to grow the size and quality of the Network

• Conduct initial vetting of inbound and outbound partner applicants against Network fit criteria

• Maintain a consistent outreach cadence and track pipeline of prospective partners from first contact through onboarding

• Review existing partner profiles (audience, content type, performance history, niche) and proactively identify good-fit vendor opportunities for them

• Support vendor onboarding by helping surface a shortlist of relevant, high-potential partners for new programs

• Develop and maintain a structured taxonomy for categorizing partners (e.g., by vertical, content type, audience size, performance tier)

• Build repeatable processes and lightweight tooling/tracking systems to keep partner data organized and up to date

• Assist the Network Manager with day-to-day administrative and organizational tasks related to Network health

• Help prepare internal reporting on partner recruitment, categorization coverage, and pipeline of emerging partners

What we’re looking for

• Prior experience in a BDR, recruiting, partnerships, or affiliate marketing-adjacent role (internships welcome)

• Strong organizational instincts — comfortable building structure and process where none exists yet

• Comfortable with outbound outreach and initial-stage relationship building

• Detail-oriented, with an ability to work with data/spreadsheets to track and categorize information at scale

• Curious and analytical — genuinely interested in figuring out “what makes a partner successful” and spotting patterns before they're obvious

• Strong written communication skills for partner outreach and internal documentation

About AppDirect:

AppDirect is the only end-to-end commerce platform for selling, distributing, and managing cloud-based products and services to succeed in the digital economy. The AppDirect ecosystem connects channels, developers, and customers through its platform to simplify the digital supply chain by enabling the onboarding and sale of products with third-party services, for any channel, on any device, with support. Powering millions of cloud subscriptions worldwide, AppDirect helps organizations, including Jaguar Land Rover, Comcast, ADP, and Deutsche Telekom connect their customers to the solutions they need to reach their full potential in the digital economy.

We believe that the unique contributions of all AppDirectors is the driver of our success. For more information about our use and handling of personal data from job applicants, please read our Candidate Privacy Policy. For more information of our general privacy practices, please see AppDirect Privacy Notice: link: https://www.appdirect.com/about/privacy-notice

jobs.title: Clinician Scheduling Coordinator
jobs.description:
Array Behavioral Care is the nation's leading virtual psychiatry and therapy practice. As the leading mental health provider, Array is on a mission to transform access to quality, timely behavioral health care through innovative telepsychiatry solutions and services that span the entire care continuum, from the hospital to the home. Array partners with an extensive network of hospitals, health systems, community healthcare organizations, and payors to improve access and deliver the highest quality of care to patients. 

 

ABOUT THE ROLE 

The Clinician Scheduling Coordinator is responsible for supporting Array’s clinical operations by maintaining accurate and efficient clinician schedules across all Array service lines. This role plays a critical part in ensuring clinician availability aligns with patient demand, contractual requirements, and workforce plans.

Working closely with Clinician Workforce Analyst, the Clinician Scheduling Coordinator executes workforce scheduling strategies, manages real-time schedule adjustments, and supports data accuracy across scheduling systems. This position requires strong attention to detail, clear communication, and the ability to balance competing priorities in a fast-paced, remote healthcare environment.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

 - Build, maintain, and update clinician schedules in alignment with workforce plans, forecasted demand, and contractual coverage requirements.

 - Partner closely with the Clinician Workforce Analyst to operationalize staffing models, coverage strategies, and schedule changes.

 - Execute daily and near-term schedule adjustments related to PTO, call-outs, onboarding, shift swaps, and coverage gaps.

 - Monitor schedules for accuracy, completeness, and coverage risk, proactively identifying and escalating issues as needed.

 - Serve as a primary point of contact for clinicians regarding scheduling questions, requests, and changes.

 - Communicate schedule updates clearly and professionally to clinicians and internal stakeholders.

 - Ensure clinicians are scheduled only when fully credentialed, onboarded, and eligible to provide care.

 - Maintain accurate scheduling records within workforce management and scheduling systems.

 - Support reporting, audits, and documentation needs related to clinician scheduling and utilization.

 - Identify scheduling inefficiencies and recommend process improvements to support operational scalability and clinician experience.

 - Performs other duties as needed.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR 

 -  High school diploma or equivalent required.

 - 2+ years of experience in telehealth, 24/7, nationwide scheduling, workforce coordination, or clinical operations support.

 - Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

 - Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and scheduling or workforce management systems. (Qgenda & Planbase - Preferred)

 - Experience working in a remote or distributed healthcare environment preferred.

 - Experience supporting clinician, provider, or behavioral health schedules strongly preferred.



POSITION LOGISTICS 

 - Position is Remote

 - Full-time employment

 - Reports to Director, OnDemand Operations



COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS 

 - The pay range for this role is $22 - $27 per hour. This information reflects the anticipated salary range for this position using current market data. The final offer will be determined based on an individual's skills, years of experience, education, capacity, licenses, and other job-related factors permitted by law. 

 - Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employer paid life & long-term disability insurance, additional voluntary benefits include short-term disability, voluntary employee, spousal and child life insurance, accident, critical illness, hospital, or confinement insurance and flexible spending accounts (FSA) and health savings account (HSA) contributions 

 - 15 days of accrued PTO annually, plus 8 paid holidays and 3 floating holidays 

 - 401k

jobs.description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the role

Veeam's Competitive Intelligence department is seeking a Senior Competitive Intelligence Manager to expand our coverage of the competition and help us gain market share in data and AI security markets. You will own all tasks related to the markets and competitors you cover, including gathering, analyzing, and delivering factual, unbiased, and actionable competitive insight and resources. You will provide competitive support to a broad set of technical and non-technical stakeholders worldwide, including Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Pricing, Leadership, partners, and customers.

jobs.title: Manager, Commercial Strategy Analytics
jobs.description:
The Organization

What's happening at Entrada Therapeutics? Entrada is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company aiming to transform the lives of patients by establishing a new class of medicines that engage intracellular targets that have long been considered inaccessible. Through proprietary and versatile approaches, Entrada is advancing a robust development portfolio of genetic medicines for the potential treatment of neuromuscular and inherited retinal diseases, among others. Our lead oligonucleotide programs are in development for the potential treatment of people living with Duchenne muscular dystrophy (DMD) who are exon 44, 45, 50 and 51 skipping amenable. Entrada has partnered with Vertex Pharmaceuticals to develop a clinical-stage program, VX-670, for myotonic dystrophy type 1 (DM1).

2026 represents a catalyst-rich period for Entrada. We expect multiple clinical data readouts as we advance several DMD programs across the U.K., EU, and U.S. By year-end 2026, we anticipate four clinical-stage programs in our DMD franchise (ENTR-601-44, ENTR-601-45, ENTR-601-50, and ENTR-601-51). These programs are complemented by the ongoing clinical progress of our DM1 collaboration with Vertex (VX-670).

We are a tight-knit team of experts and leaders in both therapeutic development and rare diseases and are excited to grow and attract colleagues who are ready to join a high-energy, dedicated team that likes to get things done and dramatically improve the lives of patients and their families.

The Perfect Addition to Our Team

You are interested in working at the intersection of life sciences and business. You want to join a high-growth biotech company in a business strategy role to support the team by synthesizing and communicating strategic insights as we prepare for commercial launch. You bring to the table a combination of an inquisitive spirit, critical thinking, and deep analytical skills and you love performing data-driven analyses to generate strategic insights. You are comfortable working in ambiguity and thrive in fast paced situations. You look forward to working with and learning from leaders across the organization in a high impact role.

The Opportunity

This position will report to the Director of Business Development and Corporate Strategy and support a variety of projects for the early commercial strategy team. Example workstreams include partnership and ownership across competitive intelligence, market research, and forecasting analysis. You’ll conduct primary and secondary market research to gather data to drive key insights and analyses to support Entrada’s pre-commercial strategy. You’ll be expected to be a key member of the team by distilling market insights and data in a timely fashion to generate strategic takeaways and recommendations for key decision makers across the organization.

Responsibilities

• Support development of asset-level and portfolio-level pre-commercial or commercial readiness analyses across target indications and geographies.

• Conduct market sizing, epidemiology, competitive landscape, and pricing & reimbursement analyses.

• Build and maintain revenue forecast models incorporating insights from the evolving clinical, regulatory, and market landscape.

• Support continued development of existing initiatives across the corporate strategy team.

• Gather and capture market data to support data-driven analyses, generate strategic insights, and communicate findings in an efficient manner.

The Necessities

At Entrada, our passion for science, our devotion to patients and our values drives our behavior:

• Humanity - We genuinely care about patients and about one another.

• Tenacity - We are relentless and persistent in the pursuit of developing therapies for patients.

• Creativity - We are creative problem solvers.

• Collaboration - We are more than the sum of our parts.

• Curiosity - We have a growth mindset and push conventional thought and theory.

To thrive on our team, you will need to come with:

• Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences discipline required; PhD, MBA or other advanced degree strongly preferred.

• 5+ years of relevant experience, preferably in an analytical role such as market research, equity research, life sciences consulting, commercial analytics, or prior experience in biotech/pharma.

• Direct experience synthesizing and communicating competitive insights from drug development programs and/or companies.

• Exceptional analytical skills combined with a broad understanding of the life sciences business and R&D process.

• Excellent communication skills engaging with external experts and internal stakeholders to gather insights and feedback.

• Experience building and interpreting financial models and communicating modeling outputs to support strategic decision making.

• Familiarity with the rare disease space and a desire to work in a fast-paced, innovative, and collaborative environment.

• Ability to be a team player with a can-do attitude and a willingness to embrace new challenges and the flexibility to adjust course, based on new findings and team inputs.

This is a hybrid position, with the requirement for candidates to be based out of Entrada Therapeutics headquarters office 2-3 days per week in Boston, MA.

What We Offer: Meaningful Work, Fair Rewards, and Real Support

At Entrada Therapeutics, we understand that compensation and total rewards are a major consideration when exploring a new opportunity. We believe in transparency and equity and are committed to sharing salary ranges for every position, along with insight into our compensation philosophy, in accordance with certain state requirements in the United States and fostering a fair and open environment at the onset.

But we also know it is more than just pay. When you join Entrada, you’ll be part of a mission-driven team with access to comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage; life and disability insurance; with a 401(k) match. We pride ourselves on offering competitive benefits that empower our employees and reflect the value of their contributions – offering paid, gender-inclusive parental leave, holistic support for your health and well-being, education reimbursement, discretionary time off and commuting benefits aligned to your working model. If you find yourself working from our office in Boston’s Seaport District, this puts you steps away from some of the best the city has to offer.

At Entrada, our approach to compensation is grounded in transparency, equity, and performance, recognizing the unique contributions each person brings. We believe meaningful work deserves meaningful reward, and view compensation as one way to show appreciation for the collaboration, curiosity, and commitment that drive our mission forward.

The salary for this opportunity ranges from $126,800 - $166,500. The final base compensation offered will depend on several considerations which include but may not be limited to a candidate’s skills, competencies, experience and other job-related factors permitted by law. The final salary offered may fall outside of this range. #LI-Hybrid #LI-JF1

Equal Opportunity Employer

Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, mental or physical disability, and genetic information, marital status, citizenship status, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by law.

Third Party Staffing Agencies

jobs.title: Analyst, Data & Analytics
jobs.description:
Come join one of America’s fastest-growing insurance companies. Since 1848, National Life Group has aimed to keep our promises, providing families with stability in good times and in bad. Throughout that history, we have provided peace of mind to those families as they plan their futures.

Our mission extends beyond the insurance and annuities policies that we offer. We strive to make the world a better place through our grants from our charitable foundation, paid volunteer time for our employees, environmentally sustainable and healthy workplaces, and events that promote the work of nonprofits in our own backyard.

We foster a collaborative environment with opportunities for growth and encourage our associates to live our values: Do good. Be good. Make good.

Please note that we do not offer visa sponsorship for this position.

We are seeking an analytically curious, and solutions-oriented Business Insights Analyst to join our Research & Insights team. This role combines business intelligence, data analytics, and market research to deliver actionable insights that inform business strategy, improve customer experience, support product development, and drive growth.

The analyst will primarily focus on developing data solutions, querying and analyzing data, building dashboards, and supporting ongoing performance monitoring and evaluation. Working collaboratively with cross-functional stakeholders, this individual will help translate business needs into analytical solutions that enable data-driven decision-making.

This position also offers the opportunity to develop skills in market research, including research design, qualitative and quantitative methodologies, data collection, and insight development. The ideal candidate is technically capable, curious, adaptable, and eager to grow beyond reporting and analytics to understand the broader business questions that drive research and strategic decision-making.

As our Research & Insights function continues to evolve, this role will support a diverse range of analytical and research initiatives, providing opportunities to develop new capabilities and contribute to emerging business priorities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Business Intelligence & Data Analytics

• Develop and maintain SQL queries, data workflows, and analytical datasets to support business intelligence, research, and reporting needs.

• Organize, clean, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities related to business performance, customer engagement, sales, and market dynamics.

• Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, reports, and other data solutions that enable stakeholders to monitor key performance indicators, evaluate initiatives, and make informed business decisions.

• Support ongoing monitoring and evaluation of business initiatives, including developing measurement approaches, tracking outcomes, and identifying opportunities for improvement.

• Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights through data visualization, reporting, and effective communication.

Market Research & Insights

• Support market research initiatives designed to better understand consumers, financial professionals, competitors, markets, and emerging business opportunities.

• Collect, organize, analyze, and interpret qualitative and quantitative research data, including surveys, interviews, industry research, and internal business data.

• Synthesize findings from primary research, secondary research, and internal data sources to identify meaningful insights and business implications.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Problem-Solving

• Collaborate with stakeholders across marketing, sales, product development, strategy, IT, and other business units to understand business questions, identify data needs, and deliver analytical and research solutions.

• Partner with technical teams to access data, develop and troubleshoot workflows, and ensure adherence to data governance standards.

• Apply critical thinking and problem-solving skills to ambiguous business questions, helping identify appropriate data sources, analytical approaches, and potential solutions.

• Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in data science, computer science, business, marketing, statistics, or a related field.

• Proficiency in SQL, including the ability to query, join, and manipulate data for analysis.

• Experience with Microsoft Excel and business intelligence or data visualization tools, such as Tableau or Power BI.

jobs.description:
Van Metre is seeking a Leasing Consultant at Broadlands Apartments in Ashburn, VA. Our Leasing Consultants take pride in their work, recognizing the value of teamwork and ownership of their responsibilities and impact. They are not only the face of our residential properties, but the heart of the community. Leasing Consultants are key contributors to the company’s success and we’re here to support you in your journey with professional development, career mentorship and growth opportunities, and great benefits and perks.

As a Leasing Consultant, your primary focus will be to develop productive and positive relationships with residents (both current and prospective) that maximize client satisfaction, occupancy, and retention, while remaining true to Van Metre’s mission, vision, and values.

Responsibilities:

• Greet every visitor to the community with a warm welcome, making yourself available to answer questions and assist as needed

• Engage in sales activities to increase traffic and occupancy (i.e., grassroots marketing)

• Maintain thorough knowledge of the property and its amenities, and act as a resource for current and prospective residents

• Build relationships with prospective residents by conducting phone and email follow-up, scheduling and conducting property tours, and processing rental applications

• Provide excellent customer service by checking in with residents, addressing concerns, and conducting lease renewals

• Monitor service requests and communicate with the service team and residents to ensure concerns are resolved quickly and adequately

• In conjunction with the rest of the team, plan, organize, and conduct resident events

• Complete three exterior community inspections weekly and report any deficiencies found (i.e., landscaping/paint needs, property damage, etc.)

• Inspect vacant apartments and report needed repairs to service team in order to maintain superior product quality

• Prepare and complete all sales administrative tasks and reports (i.e., market surveys, etc.)

• Other sales, customer service, and property-related tasks, as needed

Requirements:

• Previous experience in customer service, sales, hospitality, or related fields

• Ability to conduct community and apartment inspections (inside and outside) in varying weather conditions

• Weekend work is required

• Bilingual preferred

Competencies:

• Aptitude for working with people

• Professional demeanor and attitude

• Customer service skills

• Verbal and written communication skills

• Sales and goal orientation

• Time management and prioritization skills

• Social media skills

Compensation and Benefits information: Van Metre offers excellent benefits, and a work environment that fosters and rewards excellence. We also promote work/life balance, including a robust Employee Wellness Program.  We encourage employees to make full use of vacation and other company-paid leave to refresh their bodies and minds.

• Salary: $20.00-$21.00 per hour (Pay is commensurate with experience, education, training, and skills)

• Annual Bonus Potential: $5,000 annually, paid quarterly

• Renewal and Leasing Commissions

• Paid Time Off: 11 paid holidays; 10 vacation days, 10 sick days, Two Volunteer Days off, Two Personal Days, Winter Break, Day off for Annual Physical, Day off for your Birthday; comprehensive parental and bonding leave

• Retirement Planning: Company Matched 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan; access to retirement planning coaches

• Wellness: Annual Wellness Reimbursement of up to $900; Free and unlimited access to TaskHuman Wellness App for yourself and your family members.

• Professional Development: tuition reimbursement; company paid certifications, memberships, and licensures; mentoring programs; growth paths; regular performance evaluations and training opportunities

• Discounts: Rental and Van Metre Home purchase discounts; employee discount through Walker Title Company, Employee discount through Walker Title Company

Van Metre Core Values

Integrity; Ownership; Respect and Dignity; Diversity and Inclusion; Teamwork; Community; Work/Life Balance

Van Metre Mission Statement

The mission of Van Metre Companies is to build and continually improve upon the storied reputation, earned over the years since the Company’s founding in 1955, of providing top quality homes, investment properties and services to our customers and clients. The Company’s emphasis on integrity, professionalism and philanthropy ingrained by our founder Albert G. Van Metre, Sr. has garnered trust and respect in the Washington, D.C. area and beyond. It is critical to our future that we maintain that reputation and assure that Van Metre Companies continues to excel in real estate development and construction and in the management of apartment, retail and office investment properties, as well as in the provision of mortgage and related services. It is the task of our dedicated, energetic, and involved professionals to advance our ability to set the benchmark for luxury living and refined commercial development. The capstone of our mission is to make the “Van Metre” signature an icon for elegant residential communities, and industry leading condominium and apartment communities, as well as Class A neighborhood retail centers and office developments.

• Support hiring, onboarding, and development of new team members in partnership with cross-functional teams

• Handle complex or escalated member issues and ensure timely, high-quality resolution of sensitive cases

• 2–5+ years of experience in a customer support or call center environment, with prior people management experience preferred

jobs.description:
About Ascend

Backed by private equity from people-focused Alpine Investors, Ascend is building a dynamic platform for regional accounting firms that enables them to stay independent while accessing the resources of a Top 25 firm to help them grow. Ascend provides access to growth capital, robust talent acquisition and training, leading quality management resources, best-of-breed technology, AI tools, an offshore captive, shared back-office services, a catalytic leadership system, and modernized equity incentives so that firms can surmount today’s industry challenges to reach their full potential. For more information, visit www.ascendtogether.com.

As of May 2026, Jackson Thornton has joined the Ascend network.

Find Your Home with Jackson Thornton!

Jackson Thornton, an accounting and consulting firm, was established in Montgomery, Alabama, on March 3, 1919. From our beginning, the firm has operated with personal integrity and professional excellence while evolving and expanding to provide more of what businesses need- whether strategic planning, business consulting, technology consulting or specialized industry services. Jackson Thornton has grown to serve clients in six locations throughout Alabama with a team of more than 200 professionals and is looking to welcome more driven, client-focused individuals to the firm.

We are seeking a Tax Senior Associate with public accounting experience to join our team. This role is ideal for a motivated professional who thrives in a client-focused environment and is passionate about delivering high-quality service. As a Tax Senior Associate, the duties are focused around two core concepts: technical expertise and delivering excellent client service.  This individual will work closely with team members to ensure accurate and timely completion of tax engagements, while also mentoring interns and Associates, and contributing to a positive team culture. This position could be a fit if you are interested in working with a collaborative and supportive team that values your growth and contributions, if you are seeking ongoing training and development opportunities, and you would enjoy supporting the firm in the community through volunteer opportunities and civic engagement.

This position will work primarily out of Jackson Thornton's Birmingham office with hybrid flexibility.

Key Responsibilities

• Prepare individual, corporate, partnership, and trust tax returns.

• Review returns prepared by interns and provide constructive feedback.

• Communicate directly with clients to gather necessary tax information and resolve questions.

• Research tax issues and contribute to client tax planning strategies.

• Apply technical tax knowledge to identify planning opportunities and potential tax implications for clients.

• Stay current on changes in tax laws and regulations.

• Support the development and training of Tax Associates and Interns.

• Use firm tax software and automation tools to work efficiently, and apply professional judgment when reviewing technology- and AI-assisted output before it reaches the client.

• Collaborate with team members to ensure efficient workflow and exceptional client service.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting.

• CPA license preferred, or actively pursuing (at least two parts of the CPA exam passed).

• Two years of public accounting experience with a focus on tax.

• Strong technical knowledge of tax regulations and compliance.

• Proficiency with professional tax preparation software and Microsoft Excel, and the ability to learn new systems quickly.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

• Interest in applying AI and automation tools to tax workflows, paired with the judgment to know when professional review is required.

• Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.

Jackson Thornton offers a comprehensive, competitive benefit package to all of our professionals, which includes health, dental, and vision coverage, life insurance, long term and short term disability plans, medical and dependent care flexible spending accounts, paid time off plan, and a 401(k) plan with a match.

How to Apply

Submit your information in the application section directly below! This will include:

• Basic contact information

• Resume/CV and optional cover letter upload

• Work eligibility and compensation

• Voluntary demographic & self-ID questions

For further questions or inquiries about the role, please reach out to Olivia Riley, Sr. Recruiter at olivia.riley@ascendtogether.com.

jobs.description:
About Ascend

Backed by private equity from people-focused Alpine Investors, Ascend is building a dynamic platform for regional accounting firms that enables them to stay independent while accessing the resources of a Top 25 firm to help them grow. Ascend provides access to growth capital, robust talent acquisition and training, leading quality management resources, best-of-breed technology, AI tools, an offshore captive, shared back-office services, a catalytic leadership system, and modernized equity incentives so that firms can surmount today’s industry challenges to reach their full potential. Find Your Home with Jackson Thornton!

Jackson Thornton, an accounting and consulting firm, was established in Montgomery, Alabama, on March 3, 1919. From our beginning, the firm has operated with personal integrity and professional excellence while evolving and expanding to provide more of what businesses need- whether strategic planning, business consulting, technology consulting or specialized industry services. Jackson Thornton has grown to serve clients in six locations throughout Alabama with a team of more than 200 professionals and is looking to welcome more driven, client-focused individuals to the firm.

About the Role

We are seeking a Tax Manager with public accounting experience to join our team. Tax Managers own assigned engagements from planning through Principal review, often serving as the client service contact, and provide detailed review of complex tax returns, tax authority notices, and research engagements. You will apply professional judgment to work supported by automation and AI-enabled tools, surface planning and advisory opportunities throughout the year, and participate in billing your engagements.

You will also develop, train, and motivate team members — including those working remotely or on shared-service teams — and may serve as a Career Advisor. This role fits someone who wants to own client relationships end to end, build a specialized area of tax expertise, and work with a collaborative team that invests in your growth and community involvement.

This position will report into Jackson Thornton's Birmingham office with hybrid flexibility.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage assigned engagements from planning through Principal review.

• Review complex individual, corporate, partnership, trust, and estate returns, tax authority notices, and research engagements.

• Serve as the primary client contact and business advisor for assigned clients.

• Identify tax planning and advisory opportunities throughout the year, not just at deadlines.

• Delegate with engagement economics and team development in mind, including work prepared by shared-service or outsourced teams.

• Develop and coach team members across in-person, hybrid, and remote settings; provide timely feedback and evaluation input.

• Monitor engagement progress, staffing, out-of-scope work, and billing input.

• Use AI-enabled research and review tools appropriately, retaining ownership of every conclusion delivered to clients.

• Represent clients at audits, document tax advice, and monitor team adherence to quality assurance and ethical standards.

• Support business development through referral sources, networking, proposals, and expanded services.

Qualifications

• B.A./B.S. degree in Accounting or a related field.

• CPA license required; EA or JD/LL.M. also considered.

• Five or more years of public accounting experience with a focus on tax.

• Small and mid-sized business (SMB) tax return experience preferred.

• Strong federal and state tax compliance knowledge, with experience reviewing complex returns.

• Working knowledge of tax research, preparation, and AI-enabled review tools.

• Proven ability to manage multiple complex engagements while developing team members.

• Strong project management, communication, and interpersonal skills, including with remote teams.

Jackson Thornton offers a comprehensive, competitive benefit package to all of our professionals, which includes health, dental, and vision coverage, life insurance, long term and short term disability plans, medical and dependent care flexible spending accounts, paid time off plan, and a 401(k) plan with a match.

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Dubai, UAE

About the Team:

In this role, you will contribute to Cloudflare's revenue generation engine by delivering pipeline at scale to the Sales counterparts. You will do this through a maniacal focus on people, process, and tools. The Business Development organization is anchored in a culture focused on the development & training of its employees, incubating talent across the company, teamwork, and celebrating success. With flawless execution, we believe the Business Development organization will be a competitive differentiator for Cloudflare.

This is a great opportunity to be a member of our high performing Sales team at a hyper-growth technology company. The Business Development Representative (BDR) will:

• Be the first point of contact for customers that need help finding solutions

• Develop your customer centric sales skills to deliver a stellar customer experience

• Learn Cloudflare’s products and services in detail

Similar to other roles that Cloudflare, this role has a tenure requirement of 18-24 months before you may be eligible to apply for another role within the company.

About the Role

Languages required: English

This is a great opportunity to be an early member of a high performing sales team at a fast growing technology company. We are looking for ownership-oriented team members with excellent communication skills and technical curiosity. As the Business Development Representative (BDR), you will:

• Create excellent customer experiences

• Learn customer-centric sales skills

• Become an expert in Cloudflare’s product

• Team members have opportunities to move into roles across the organization, especially in mid-market sales, customer success, solutions engineering, and sales operations

Day in the Life of BDR at Cloudflare

• Own and meet target quota related to number of qualified opportunities, response SLA, value of sales pipeline, and revenue

• Develop new business opportunities from inbound and marketing-generated leads

• Discover pain points and use case, map them to broad set of Cloudflare solutions and qualify for Enterprise sales opportunities

• Work cross-functionally with stakeholders (account executives, marketing, sales operations, fellow BDRs)

• Report, track, and manage sales activities and results using SFDC

• Play an active role in the creation and iteration of team processes

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience

• 2+ years of experience working as a BDR in a similar capacity in technology industry in the META region (experience in SaaS will be a plus)

• Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit

• Ability to work as part of a team or independently

• Analytical, organization and time management skills

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

• Strong interpersonal communication skills

• Customer-oriented mindset with empathy and curiosity

• Aptitude to learn technical concepts/terms

• Ability to manage multiple tasks/projects simultaneously

• Experience in Outreach and Salesforce is a plus

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
