jobs.title: ITAD Operations Associate (finance-focused)
jobs.description:
About AppDirect

Become a digital, global citizen and enable the new generation of digital entrepreneurs around the world.  AppDirect offers a subscription commerce platform to sell any product, through any channel, on any device - as a service.  We power millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations.  We do this by our values-driven culture—one that enables you to Be Seen, Be Yourself, and Do Your Best Work.

About Firstbase, an AppDirect Subsidiary

Firstbase helps companies equip their teams with everything they need to do great work—from computers and furniture to company swag and perks. We give businesses the ability to instantly support employees with the right physical goods, and give employees the flexibility to choose what works for their unique needs. Firstbase is part of AppDirect, a subscription commerce platform that powers millions of subscriptions worldwide for organizations selling any product, through any channel, on any device—as a service.

About You

The ITAD Operations Associate will own the financial side of our IT Asset Disposition program, a small, fast-moving team responsible for what happens to hardware at the end of its life, and for the money that comes back when it's resold or recycled. You'll own the final word on whether a settlement is right. Half of that is investigative: a deposit that doesn't match any invoice, a partner file that's quietly missing a hundred devices, revenue a vendor earned months ago that never reached our books. You find it, you prove it, you close it. Increasingly, you won't do that hunting alone. We're building AI agents that work these queues inside ITAD OS, our internal operations platform, pulling partner files apart, matching deposits against revenue, flagging the rows that look wrong, and we're putting the best AI tooling available into this team's hands as fast as it ships. That moves the job up, not away: the agent proposes, you decide. Your value becomes knowing what the right answer should look like, catching the case the agent got confidently wrong, and turning a workflow you've been running by hand into one that runs itself with you supervising it. If you'd rather be the person who automates their own job than the one it gets automated around, this is that seat.

This posting is for the finance-focused seat on the team. Alongside your primary ownership, you'll be trained across the rest of our ITAD operations —data destruction documentation, vendor management, shipping and logistics — so the team can cover for one another. Everyone here rotates.

What you’ll do and how you’ll have an impact

• Ingest settlement and revenue reports from our resale and recycling partners. Every partner sends a different format, and a real part of the craft is turning messy vendor data into clean, trustworthy records without introducing errors.

• Reconcile device-level and order-level ITAD revenue against actual bank deposits, and allocate deposits to settlements.

• Investigate unmatched records, ambiguous serials and variances.

• Own the end-to-end credit issuance workflow in partnership with Finance.

• Raise and resolve discrepancies directly with our vendor partners.

• Own financial reporting for the ITAD program, including revenue and margin, and produce executive-ready summaries that go straight to leadership.

• Review and ingest Certificates of Destruction and data destruction reports from partners, matching them to the devices they cover.

• Monitor ITAD action queues, ensuring steps are followed per SOPs and that we're hitting our service level objectives.

• Support shipment and recycling order workflows with our warehouses and partner facilities: pick lists, ship and receipt dates, and resolving receipt exceptions.

• Maintain and enrich our internal database of fair market value estimates per device, drawing on secondary market platforms, trade-in partners and historical resale data.

• Act as a primary point of contact between Operations, Finance, Customer Success and Warehouse teams for ITAD financial workflows.

What we’re looking for

• 2–5 years in reconciliation, cash applications, billing, audit, accounts payable/receivable, or financial operations. This is a hands-on execution role.

• Demonstrated experience finding and resolving discrepancies, not just processing transactions. We'll ask you about a number that didn't tie and what you did about it.

• Strong Excel / Google Sheets: lookups, pivots, text-to-columns, deduplication, and genuine comfort cleaning up badly formatted exports.

• Strong spoken and written English. You'll speak and write directly to partners in the US and UK, and to colleagues over Slack. Expect this to be assessed.

• The judgment to know when something is wrong, and the confidence to escalate rather than force a match.

• High attention to detail, and the ability to run several parallel workflows without losing track of any of them.

• Comfortable with structured SOPs, but restless about improving them.

(*) Interested candidates should submit their resume in English. Please note that Spanish versions will not be reviewed.

AppDirect is the only end-to-end commerce platform for selling, distributing, and managing cloud-based products and services to succeed in the digital economy. The AppDirect ecosystem connects channels, developers, and customers through its platform to simplify the digital supply chain by enabling the onboarding and sale of products with third-party services, for any channel, on any device, with support. Powering millions of cloud subscriptions worldwide, AppDirect helps organizations, including Jaguar Land Rover, Comcast, ADP, and Deutsche Telekom connect their customers to the solutions they need to reach their full potential in the digital economy.

We believe that the unique contributions of all AppDirectors is the driver of our success. jobs.description:
A leading Industrial AI company, Augury helps the world’s manufacturers leverage real-time production insights and data to drive new levels of efficiency. By combining predictive and prescriptive technology with operational data and customized AI agents, production teams can improve uptime, reduce costs, and maximize yield and capacity. Our mission is to transform how people and machines work together to push the boundaries of human productivity.

We are seeking a highly organized, execution-focused Scale Client Partner to manage a large high volume portfolio of customers, with a focus on retention, renewals, and delivering consistent customer value. Working alongside a Technical Success Manager, this role oversees the post-sale life cycle of customer relationships, ensuring customers adopt our solutions, realize measurable value, and successfully renew their contracts.

Unlike traditional enterprise account management roles, this position focuses on managing a high volume of accounts efficiently, rather than building deep relationships with a smaller number of customers. Success requires strong prioritization, structured processes, accurate forecasting, and the ability to proactively identify risks and renewal opportunities across a diverse customer portfolio. This is a remote position, with a preference for candidates located in the Eastern or Central US time zones.

Key Responsibilities

• Own a portfolio of up to ~100 accounts across SMB and mid-market segments

• Prioritize engagement based on renewal timing, risk signals, and growth potential

• Manage by exception using dashboards, health scores, and triggers rather than high-touch engagement

• Own end-to-end renewal management, including timeline creation, stakeholder alignment, and deal execution

• Maintain accurate, data-driven renewal forecasts with clear visibility into risk, upside, and expected outcomes

• Proactively identify at-risk accounts and drive mitigation plans to ensure predictable renewal outcomes

• Partner with Sales on pricing, packaging, and lightweight expansion opportunities where applicable

• Execute standardized, scalable engagement models (e.g., program reviews, scaled QBRs) to ensure value realization

• Communicate clear, repeatable value narratives tied to customer outcomes and usage

• Identify and progress expansion opportunities based on usage signals and customer needs

• Maintain disciplined use of systems such as Gainsight and Salesforce as the source of truth

• Execute against defined playbooks for renewals, risk management, and customer engagement

• Ensure high-quality data hygiene, documentation, and visibility across all accounts

• Partner with Technical Success Managers, Sales, Support, and Product to drive aligned customer outcomes

• Act as the central point of coordination for renewal and risk-related activities

• Escalate product or delivery gaps impacting retention in a structured and timely manner

Experience

• 5–8+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or renewal management within software and/or hardware environments

• Proven track record managing high-volume portfolios with strong retention outcomes

• Experience in renewal ownership and forecasting, with a focus on predictability and risk mitigation

• Background in industrial manufacturing, digital transformation, or process optimization

jobs.title: Executive Meeting Manager
jobs.description:
Located in the heart of the Dallas Arts District, Fairmont Dallas is committed to delivering exceptional luxury hospitality and unforgettable meeting and event experiences. As part of our Sales & Marketing team, the Executive Meeting Manager plays a vital role in cultivating client relationships, driving group business, and delivering seamless meeting experiences that reflect the Fairmont brand.

Reports To: Director of Group Sales

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Executive Meeting Manager is responsible for managing the complete lifecycle of assigned group meetings and events—from initial sales through successful execution and post-event follow-up. This role combines proactive business development with exceptional event management to maximize guest satisfaction, client loyalty, and hotel revenue.

Working collaboratively with Conference Services, Operations, Culinary, Front Office, and Revenue Management, the Executive Meeting Manager ensures every meeting is executed with precision while identifying opportunities to expand business, strengthen client relationships, and position Fairmont Dallas as the preferred destination for corporate meetings and group events.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Sales & Business Development

• Proactively solicit, negotiate, and secure small group and corporate meeting business while consistently achieving established revenue goals.
• Develop strong relationships with corporate clients, third-party planners, and industry partners to generate repeat and referral business.
• Conduct hotel site inspections and client presentations that showcase Fairmont Dallas' unique meeting facilities and luxury service experience.
• Maximize revenue opportunities through strategic upselling of guestrooms, food and beverage, audiovisual services, and additional hotel offerings.
• Maintain an active sales pipeline and respond promptly to client inquiries and proposal requests.

Client Experience & Event Management

• Serve as the primary point of contact throughout the meeting planning process, ensuring an exceptional and personalized client experience.
• Coordinate all meeting specifications and event details with Conference Services and operational departments to ensure flawless execution.
• Lead pre-convention meetings and communicate all program requirements effectively across hotel teams.
• Manage rooming lists, billing requirements, deposits, and event documentation with accuracy and attention to detail.
• Meet with clients during and after events to ensure expectations are exceeded and identify future business opportunities.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience preferred.
• Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in hotel group sales, conference services, catering sales, or meeting management within an upscale or luxury hospitality environment.
• Demonstrated success in achieving sales goals and delivering exceptional client service.
• Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and organizational skills.
• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build lasting client and internal relationships.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and hotel sales systems such as Delphi, Opera Sales & Catering, or similar CRM platforms.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail in a fast-paced environment.
• Flexible schedule, including evenings and weekends, as business demands require.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This position operates primarily within the Sales & Marketing offices and throughout the hotel, including meeting and event spaces. The role requires regular interaction with guests, clients, and colleagues and may involve walking event spaces, attending networking functions, and participating in site visits. Occasional evening and weekend work is required to support client events and business needs.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

• Ability to communicate effectively with guests, clients, and colleagues.
• Ability to remain stationary for extended periods while working at a computer.
• Ability to walk meeting spaces and hotel facilities throughout the day.
• Ability to lift, carry, or move materials weighing up to 20 pounds on an occasional basis.
• Ability to use computers, mobile devices, and standard office equipment.

What’s in it for you:

• Paid time off
• Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance, 401K
• Complimentary Shift Meal
• Employee benefit card offering discounted rates in Accor worldwide
• Learning programs through our Academy designed to sharpen your skills
• Ability to make a difference through our Corporate Social Responsibility activities, such as Planet 21
• Career development opportunities with national and international promotion opportunities

jobs.title: VP of Global Field Marketing
jobs.description:
Dataiku is the Platform for AI Success, the enterprise orchestration layer for building, deploying, and governing AI. In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.

The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog, LinkedIn, X, and YouTube.

Vice President, Global Field Marketing

As VP of Global Field Marketing, you own the in-region and in-person demand engine that turns Dataiku’s global positioning into regional pipeline. That covers field marketing across AMER, EMEA and APJ, partner marketing, and a global events portfolio: our owned flagship events (Dataiku Succeed, regional Summits and Exchanges) and pipeline-generating presence at Snowflake Summit, Databricks Data + AI Summit and AWS re:Invent. You lead a team of 25 accountable for a material share of company pipeline and sit on the marketing leadership team.

Your first mandate is regional sales alignment: generating pipeline and accelerating in-flight deals. Regional sales leaders will turn to you for territory-level program design, and you’ll be measured on pipeline alongside them.

You’ll also run this function as an AI-native operation. Dataiku sells The Platform for AI Success, and our marketing should prove it works. Using generative AI to compress planning, scale personalization, speed up follow-up and sharpen investment decisions isn’t an innovation project. It’s how the work gets done, and it’s a performance expectation for you and your team.

Dataiku is an established leader in a market still being defined, and the field engine that captures that opportunity is largely yours to design. The role requires regular travel across all three regions.

What you’ll do

Regional sales alignment & pipeline

• Own field-sourced and field-influenced pipeline targets across all regions, jointly accountable with regional sales leadership for both new pipeline and deal acceleration.

• Build a joint planning rhythm with each region’s sales leadership: territory and account-level programs, QBRs and shared forecasting. No program launches without a named sales owner, a follow-up motion and a pipeline number.

• Use AI to deliver account research, prospect briefs, meeting prep and program recommendations to sales in hours, not weeks.

Field marketing leadership

• Lead and develop three regional teams that adapt global campaigns into credible regional programs across account tiers, industries and product plays, while keeping one consistent brand, message and event experience worldwide.

• Build a cross-region rhythm of shared playbooks, results and best practices so learnings compound instead of staying siloed.

• Own the field marketing budget across regions, program types and account tiers, shifting spend based on performance.

• Use AI to localize campaigns and tailor account-level content without adding proportional headcount or agency spend.

• Run account engagement programs (executive roundtables, dinners, advisory moments) that create pipeline and unstick late-stage deals, coordinated with Digital & Growth.

Global events

• Own the events portfolio and its pipeline contribution, shifting it from presence to performance.

• Own Succeed and our regional Summits and Exchanges end to end (strategy, audience targets, content, sponsorship, production and on-site experience) with pipeline accountability for each, plus our presence at major ecosystem events.

• Run a tiered event strategy with brand, pipeline and account targets by tier, and enforce activation planning gates.

• Ensure tight sales integration and fast, AI-personalized follow-up on every event.

• Rationalize the portfolio continuously on ROI data, investing where events perform and cutting what doesn’t, even when it’s unpopular.

Partner marketing

• Own partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, integrating partner motions into regional field plans rather than running them in parallel.

• Work with the Global Partner Organization at leadership level on joint GTM priorities and MDF deployment.

AI-powered execution

• Set the AI standard for the team: define where it’s expected, build the enablement, and hold people accountable.

• Eliminate manual work (briefs, localization, event recaps, list building, reporting) and redirect that capacity to sales alignment and account engagement.

• Build AI into decisions, not just production: investment analysis, performance synthesis and account prioritization.

Measurement & operating discipline

• Set a consistent ROI standard for field and events, and use it to reallocate investment regularly.

• Hold all three regions to a common planning, activation and follow-up rhythm, and bring pipeline reality to the leadership team, including what’s underperforming and why.

What you bring

• 10+ years in B2B marketing, including global field marketing leadership in high-growth enterprise software or SaaS, managing 20+ people through regional directors. Bachelor’s degree required; MBA preferred.

• A named pipeline number carried jointly with sales, not activity metrics.

• Ownership of a 1,000+ attendee flagship event and major ecosystem event presence, with budget, sponsorship and pipeline accountability.

• A track record of deploying generative AI in a marketing org with measurable results. Personal fluency counts; driving team adoption counts more.

• Peer-level credibility with enterprise sales leaders.

• Strong command of tiered event strategy, event ROI and large-scale event operations.

• Hands-on AI fluency, including knowing where it changes the economics of a motion and where it doesn’t.

• Enough fluency in CRM, marketing automation, attribution and ABM to challenge the numbers, not just receive them.

• Strong partner instincts, or the judgment to lead a partner marketing leader well.

How you operate

• Comfortable being measured on the same number as sales.

• Urgent about AI adoption; “we’ve always resourced it this way” is a problem to solve.

• Direct and low-ego, able to raise the bar between global marketing and three sales orgs without creating friction.

• Willing to make and defend unpopular, data-backed trade-offs.

• Builds leaders, not just programs, across regions of uneven maturity.

• Enterprise over function: field and partner marketing serve company pipeline.

• Owns outcomes and escalates early, with a recommendation.

• Speaks truth, including where programs or partners underperform.

• Challenges decisions in the room, then commits fully.

#LI-Remote

#LI-CM

What are you waiting for!

At Dataiku, you'll be part of a journey to shape the ever-evolving world of AI. We're not just building a product; we're crafting the future of AI. If you're ready to make a significant impact in a company that values innovation, collaboration, and your personal growth, we can't wait to welcome you to Dataiku! And if you’d like to learn even more about working here, you can visit our Dataiku LinkedIn page.

Our practices are rooted in the idea that everyone should be treated with dignity, decency and fairness. Dataiku also believes that a diverse identity is a source of strength and allows us to optimize across the many dimensions that are needed for our success. Therefore, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All employment practices are based on business needs, without regard to race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. This applies to all policies and procedures related to recruitment and hiring, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion and termination and all other conditions and terms of employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation, please contact us at: reasonable-accommodations@dataiku.com

Protect yourself from fraudulent recruitment activity

Dataiku will never ask you for payment of any type during the interview or hiring process. Other than our video-conference application, Zoom, we will also never ask you to make purchases or download third-party applications during the process. If you experience something out of the ordinary or suspect fraudulent activity, please review our page on identifying and reporting fraudulent activity here.

jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s B2B Marketing team helps businesses understand, adopt, and get value from our products. We work closely with Product, Research, Sales, and Communications to connect advances in AI to the problems organizations are trying to solve.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Messaging Lead to shape how businesses understand OpenAI and the value of our portfolio. You’ll develop a clear enterprise narrative, connect individual product stories to it, and help explain how AI is changing the way people and organizations work.

You’ll work directly with senior leaders and technical teams to make difficult positioning decisions and turn them into work that customers, executives, and the field can use. You’ll be a hands-on writer and editor as well as a strategic partner, responsible for the quality and coherence of our most important business stories.

This is a senior individual contributor role, with the potential to build and lead a team as the function grows.

In this role, you will:

 - Define and evolve the enterprise narrative and the messages that connect our products to customer needs and business outcomes.

 - Partner with product and industry marketers to make the portfolio clear and differentiated while preserving the depth each audience needs.

 - Translate complex capabilities into precise, compelling stories with Product and Research.

 - Personally develop core enterprise pitches, executive narratives, major launch messages, and other high-priority materials.

 - Bring customer insight, competitive context, and credible proof into the story with GTM and Customer Marketing.

 - Help Marketing, Communications, and Enablement apply the narrative, and improve it through customer feedback and testing.

 - Coach partners on messaging and writing, and help define how the function should grow.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - 14+ years of experience in B2B product marketing, positioning, or messaging, with a track record of shaping enterprise narratives and translating complex technology portfolios into clear, differentiated stories for business audiences.

 - A track record of leading messaging, positioning, or product marketing for complex technology portfolios serving business customers.

 - Exceptional writing and editing skills, with examples of work you personally created and an ability to explain the decisions behind it.

 - Strong product and technical judgment, including the ability to distinguish a supported claim from an appealing assertion.

jobs.title: Microelectronics Ultrapure Water (UPW) Senior Process Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Role

Process Engineers on our Process Engineering team are key partners for customers in the North American market. As a creative technical leader, you'll support the successful sale, execution, commissioning, and operation of complete system solutions for customers' ultrapure water (UPW) treatment needs. To deliver winning solutions, you'll apply deep technical knowledge of our solutions and technologies combined with an

understanding of the customer's process, the market, regulations, and our competitors to continually balance capital and operating costs and technical risk with project success.

Core Responsibilities

Microelectronics UPW Process Engineers lead the process design of ultrapure water treatment solutions for the

microelectronics industry.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Water chemistry characterization and design basis development, including reclaim-to-UPW applications
• Unit process selection and design, equipment sizing, and process guarantees
• Application of advanced treatment technologies including solids separation, low and high pressure membrane treatment (ultrafiltration, nanofiltration, reverse osmosis - conventional and high-pH), ion exchange, UV treatment, and gas-transfer membrane processes to meet the stringent requirements specific to the microelectronics industry
• Owning the system integration across multiple unit operations, and/or work in close collaboration with a dedicated system integrator on complex flowsheets
• Evaluation of system operation under both design and upset conditions, identification of potential points of failure, and participation in detailed hazard and operability reviews (HAZOPs)
• Engagement in piloting and benchmarking treatability studies as part of design, commissioning, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of UPW treatment solutions

Key Success Factor:

• Given the complex nature of these treatment flowsheets, the ability to act as system integrator and clearly identify and communicate the impacts that any given unit process will have on upstream and downstream unit processes is essential.
• Industry Leadership & Expertise
• You'll build long-term relationships with customers and key experts in the industry and present at industry conferences and technical forums to position Veolia as UPW experts within the microelectronics market. You'll serve as an expert within the business, participating in innovation of solutions, technologies, and markets, and training and mentoring others in process design.

What We're Looking For:

We seek a Senior-level process engineering professional who communicates with confidence and leadership in cross-functional bidding and project-execution teams, manages competing priorities effectively, and is strong at balancing autonomy with collaboration

Core Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or advanced degree in an Engineering field – Environmental, Chemical, or Mechanical preferred, or other technical discipline with a combination of process design and hands-on UPW system experience
• 10+ years of relevant experience in UPW treatment design - a combination of process design experience with a background in field operations will be considered
• Demonstrated experience with UPW treatment processes and system design/operation for the microelectronics industry
• Proven ability to integrate multiple unit operations into cohesive, optimized treatment systems

Valuable Skills, Experience & Qualifications:

• Familiarity with process design software/tools such as WinFlows, WAVE, and/or GasCAD (Liqui-Cel GTM), along with strong proficiency with spreadsheet tools (Google Sheets, Excel)
• Clear, concise communication and presentation skills with internal and external stakeholders
• Ability to exercise strong engineering judgment under changing conditions
• Strong team collaboration skills and ability to take ownership of the system integration process
• Licensed as a Professional Engineer (PE / P.Eng. / Ing.) in a US or Canadian jurisdiction, or willingness to obtain licensure
• Willingness to travel up to 10% within North America

At Veolia, we realize diverse teams make smarter decisions, deliver better results, and build stronger communities. We’re an organization that champions diversity and inclusion at every rung of the ladder and are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

As an inclusive company, Veolia is committed to diversity and gives equal consideration to all applications, without discrimination.

jobs.title: Human Data Strategist
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION

Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.




ROLE OVERVIEW

The Data Acquisition Team is responsible for ensuring that Reflection has all the data it needs to train the world’s best models. We're looking for a Human Data Strategist to own the pipelines that turn human expertise into better AI models. You will partner closely with researchers, deeply understand their needs, and source from vendors the data that improves our models’ usefulness and performance.

This role combines program ownership with hands-on work on task design, contributor workflows, data quality frameworks, and success metrics. The ideal candidate brings organizational rigor, technical curiosity, and sound judgment about when to move quickly and when to investigate the details.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Collaborate with research: Translate critical model capabilities, and researchers’ plans for developing them, into executable data acquisition strategies.

 - Orchestrate providers: Assess vendors’ capabilities, forecast capacity, define task instructions, acceptance criteria and then hold vendors accountable for quality, delivery, and cost.

 - Track and optimize campaigns: Build dashboards tracking throughput, turnaround time, acceptance rates, rework, and cost per accepted task. Leverage data analytics to investigate bottlenecks and guide improvements.

 - Ensure alignment: Experiments and priorities evolve. You will surface vulnerabilities early and turn feedback into concrete changes to subsequent sourcing. Work with research to close the loop; tracking how our data acquisitions improve model capabilities




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4+ years of experience delivering a portfolio of complex programs and prioritizing across changing research needs.

 - An understanding of LLM training, evaluation, and prompt design, with the ability to learn unfamiliar research concepts quickly.

 - Proficiency in SQL for querying datasets and building dashboards, and Python for data analysis, API integrations, and workflow automation.

 - Clear written communication, strong stakeholder judgment, and a willingness to inspect individual tasks and datasets when the headline numbers do not tell the full story.

 - High agency, bias towards action, and the ability to drive impact in fast-paced, dynamic, and ambiguous environments

 - Experience with annotation, expert data collection, human feedback, or AI evaluation is a plus.




WHAT WE OFFER:

We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models.

We want you to do the most impactful work of your career with the confidence that you and the people you care about most are supported.

 - Top-tier compensation: Salary and equity structured to recognize and retain our talent globally.

 - Stock options: Everyone who joins and contributes to Reflection's success gets to share in the upside through stock options.

 - Health & wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life, with an annual wellness allowance.

 - Meals: Lunch and dinner are provided in the office daily.

 - Life & family: 22 weeks paid parental leave for all new birthing and non-birthing parents, including adoptive and surrogate journeys.

 - Vacation days: Unlimited paid time off in the U.S. and 30 days in the U.K.

 - Sponsorship support: We sponsor visas to help exceptional talent join our team and support long-term immigration pathways where applicable.

 - Team building: We have regular off-sites, happy hours, and team celebrations.

jobs.title: Principal Security Engineer
jobs.description:
MongoDB's Global Security Organization (GSO) is looking for a Principal Security Engineer. The GSO secures MongoDB's products, infrastructure, and the trust our customers place in us — spanning product security, corporate security, and risk, and working across engineering, go-to-market, and corporate development to keep security moving at the same speed as the business.

The Principal Security Engineer will serve as a senior technical anchor for the team. This is a deep individual-contributor role that will stay hands-on with hard security and architecture problems, form sharp independent opinions, and know how to debate, align, and commit once GSO has made a call.

Key topic areas will include collaborating with our product teams to ensure identity and permission models meet customer needs for our new autonomous agent platform and working with integration security teams to push the envelope on automated detection, reproduction, and remediation of security vulnerabilities via AI.  What we need here is depth, judgment, and the ability to build up the bench of senior technical talent around you.

This role can be based out of our NYC office or remotely in the North America region.

Responsibilities

• Maintain real technical depth in security and in MongoDB's product architecture — compute, network, and storage — deep enough to evaluate actual risk rather than apply generic best practice

• Form independent, well-reasoned opinions on security and architecture decisions, and voice them even when they cut against consensus or a leader's default plan

• Push teams to move faster when process or over-engineering is introducing complexity without reducing risk — and push teams to slow down when GTM pressure is outrunning a clear-eyed view of the risk

• Debate hard, then align, then commit: help the org land on the right call, then execute on it

• Seed and grow a working community of senior ICs embedded in security operations, product security, and enterprise security — connecting people, sharing knowledge, and creating the venues (formal or informal) for that to happen

• Lead time-boxed, high-stakes, cross-functional engagements such as M&A security due diligence and partner risk assessments, often with incomplete information and a short runway

• Draw on your own expertise where it applies, and quickly figure out how to close knowledge gaps elsewhere — staying accountable for the outcome either way

Requirements

• 12+ years of experience in security engineering, software engineering, or a related discipline, including senior individual-contributor or technical-lead experience

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

• Deep, credible technical expertise in security, plus working depth across compute, network, and storage architecture

• A track record of forming and defending independent technical positions, along with the judgment to know when to stop debating and commit

• Experience influencing without formal authority, including with management and cross-functional partners, in both directions — accelerating and slowing down decisions

• Comfort owning ambiguous, deadline-driven work such as M&A diligence or partner risk reviews, and being accountable for the result even without the full picture upfront

• A genuine interest in mentoring and connecting other senior engineers, without needing a management title to do it

Don't feel that you meet all of the requirements? We encourage you to apply anyway — studies show strong candidates sometimes rule themselves out prematurely. MongoDB has a diverse, inclusive, equitable, and high-performing environment, and we want to keep improving our ability to deliver for customers.

Nice to Haves

• Direct experience leading M&A security due diligence or partner/vendor risk assessments

• Background spanning multiple layers of the stack (e.g., network and storage, or application and infrastructure security)

• A history of building or growing technical communities of practice

Success in This Role Means

• Leadership trusts your technical judgment on the hardest, most ambiguous calls

• Your willingness to disagree — in either direction, faster or slower — makes decisions better, not just louder

• A real community of senior security talent has formed around you in GSO

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

jobs.description:
As a Process Engineer at Avery Dennison, you will play a critical role supporting day-to-day manufacturing operations and driving continuous improvement for coating and compounding assets within a 24/7 manufacturing environment. In this position, the Process Engineer is responsible for reducing product and process variation through the rigorous use of Six Sigma methodologies, statistical process control tools, experimental design, and the development or enhancement of standard operating procedures and process controls. Acting as an essential technical partner to site leadership, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including Operations, Marketing, and R&D—to optimize product performance, execute capital projects, and deliver sustainable improvements in safety, quality, productivity, and cost.

Key Responsibilities

This is an on-site position based at our manufacturing facility in Mentor, OH.

• Support day-to-day product and process operations for coating and compounding assets in a 24/7 manufacturing environment, serving as an active technical business partner to the site leadership team.
• Identify, investigate, and analyze production issues using Six Sigma methodologies, statistical process controls (SPC), and structured root-cause problem solving to eliminate losses and continuously enhance coating line productivity and quality.
• Continually improve and optimize current product lines and manufacturing processes by reducing variation, executing line trials, and conducting thorough process capability studies.
• Partner cross-functionally with Marketing and R&D teams to support new product development, raw material qualifications, and production scale-ups across manufacturing assets.
• Initiate, scope, manage, and execute capital engineering projects and site continuous improvement initiatives, implementing new equipment, establishing long-term sustainment control strategies, and developing technical training to mentor operations personnel.

• Bachelor of Science degree in engineering, combined with 2+ years of engineering experience in a manufacturing environment.
• Demonstrated experience utilizing statistical analysis and quality engineering methodologies, including Statistical Process Control (SPC), Design of Experiments (DOE), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and Measurement Systems Evaluation (MSE); Six Sigma exposure or Green Belt/Black Belt certification is preferred.
• Strong technical working knowledge of process optimization and continuous manufacturing operations, with hands-on experience in web handling, pressure-sensitive adhesive (PSA) coating, compounding, or 24/7 operational environments highly preferred.
• Proven project management, decision analysis, and situational appraisal skills, with a track record of scoping, prioritizing, and executing capital projects and functional improvement plans while managing multiple concurrent priorities.
• Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the demonstrated ability to communicate and influence across all organizational levels, deliver technical training, give and receive constructive feedback, and maintain schedule flexibility for on-call after-hours/weekend support as needed.

jobs.title: Senior Assistant Property Manager
jobs.description:
At Bozzuto, every team member shares a deep commitment to doing good for those around us. We live this each day by designing, building, managing and maintaining one-of-a-kind residences. Whether it’s the talent within our communities or the expertise across our property operations teams, we work together to make extraordinary happen for our clients, residents and fellow team members.

Our people are dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to everyone we serve including each other. This shared purpose drives us to excel in every role and fosters a welcoming, inclusive workplace where teamwork thrives. Guided by our core values of concern, creativity, passion and the pursuit of perfection, we are inspired and empowered to reach higher, unlock our full potential and be truly extraordinary.

Primary Responsibilities:

You’re a role model, people person, jack-of-all-trades. Which is how you successfully "do" and lead, and why you enjoy the variety that comes with accomplishing both. You’re passionate about apartment living, connecting with the local community and creating experiences for our residents that bring both of these together. You’re a quick thinker and thrive in a fast-paced environment, yet your obsession for details positions you perfectly for this second in command role.

As a Senior Assistant Property Manager, your primary responsibilities include:

• Leading by example, living the standards and behaviors consistent with the core values and culture of Bozzuto

• Contributing to the achievement of established financial objectives by collecting resident rent, posting rental receipts and managing delinquency

• Achieving occupancy levels by conducting informative and personalized tours of the community which result in new leases

• Building brand loyalty and reaching resident retention goals by striving to ensure every resident interaction is positive

• Ensuring that the community’s interior and exterior are impeccable and the team appropriately represents the Bozzuto brand with a crisp, professional appearance

• Respectfully coaching and mentoring team members when the PM/GM is not present

• Working weekends when prospective residents are out looking for their new home, one to two weekends per month with two days off during the week

You Create Value by:

• Building a motivating environment that encourages your team to give their very best

• Stepping in and taking responsibility for leading when the GM is not present

• Connecting with people by engaging in meaningful conversations that demonstrate your concern and genuine desire to make them feel at home

• Taking responsibility for solving customers issues with care and enthusiasm

• Jumping in and covering for your team members when needed

• Seeking out opportunities to get to know and understand your residents

What You Bring to Us:

• 4 year college degree or equivalent relevant experience

• 2+ years of experience in the property management, hospitality or retail industries

• Exposure to rent collection processes, budgets and account receivables

• Proficient in leveraging social media platforms such as Facebook and Instagram and a passion to create and deliver engaging and distinctive content

• Outstanding communication skills, both written and verbal

• A sharp professional appearance

• Competent with industry software (YARDI preferred), apps and computer programs

• Sales aptitude

This position is eligible for additional bonus opportunities.

Salary Range

$68,000—$72,000 USD

When you join Bozzuto, you're not just accepting a job; you are becoming part of a community that cares about your overall well-being and professional growth. We recognize that our team members are the core of our business, and we are committed to taking care of them so they can deliver outstanding experiences to our residents. In addition to an award-winning culture, our benefits take into consideration everything from career development, retirement, family matters and health and wellness.

Working on our team and in this position, you can expect:

• Competitive compensation.

• Health & wellness benefits. We offer coverage for medical, dental, and vision, including access to the best doctors at an affordable price.

• Paid leave. We provide 20 days of paid time off plus holidays.

• Retirement planning. We offer a 401k program with a company match.

• Tuition reimbursement. Plus, many other programs to support career development and growth.

• A place you belong. We proudly offer a diverse range of employee resource groups, providing opportunities for our employees to connect over shared experiences, backgrounds, and cultures.

Bozzuto is proudly an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Customer Service Representative
jobs.description:
About PayZen

PayZen is on a mission to bring financial health to healthcare. Our products improve both access and affordability for patients and reduce administrative complexity for medical providers. We are trusted by a rapidly growing number of health systems, hospitals, and physician groups, and are backed by leading venture capital investors including NEA, SignalFire, Viola Group, and 7Wire Ventures.



The Role

We are seeking a proactive and empathetic Customer Service Representative to support patients in navigating payment plans through our platform. In this role, you will serve as a trusted point of contact for patients and providers, helping resolve billing questions, set up payment arrangements, and advocate for an exceptional patient experience.

You will primarily handle inbound customer support calls and emails, with a portion of your role dedicated to outbound payment plan support. This is a mission-driven role for someone who genuinely cares about helping people access the healthcare they need.

Hours: 9:30 AM - 6:00 PM Eastern Time



Responsibilities

 - Represent PayZen values and deliver excellent, empathetic service in every patient and provider interaction

 - Handle inbound and outbound calls and emails to address topics including account questions, billing issues, and payment plan enrollment

 - Educate and guide patients on digital payment options and the benefits of PayZen's platform

 - Conduct outbound payment plan conversations with patients to resolve overdue accountsCollaborate with providers to resolve issues related to patient payment plans

 - Identify opportunities for process improvement and proactively surface solutions to enhance the patient experience
   
   

Requirements

 - 3+ years of customer service experience, preferably in healthcare, financial services, or payment plan servicing

 - Passion for helping patients and making a meaningful impact in healthcare access

 - Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve issues independently and with minimal supervision

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both languages

 - Comfortable working in a remote environment with reliable communication and self-accountability

 - Adaptable to evolving tools, processes, and schedules in a fast-paced startup environment

 - Experience collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams
   
   

Nice to Have

 - Experience in healthcare and/or fintech

 - Familiarity with payment servicing platforms or CRM tools



What We Offer

 - An opportunity to positively affect the lives of thousands of patients

 - A flexible lifestyle that fits the modern work-life balance

 - A chance to join a high-growth company at an early stage

 - Highly skilled co-workers with whom you can grow your skillset

 - Be a part of a team that revolutionizes medical payments in ways never seen before

 - The ability to impact company values and culture in a collaborative environment — we value all comments and suggestions

 - Competitive pay, employer-paid healthcare, and stock options

jobs.title: Account Executive - New Markets
jobs.description:
The Company

Medely is a high-growth series-C technology start-up reimagining the future of healthcare work by providing an on-demand marketplace and workforce management tools. With the support of top-tier investors, Medely has quickly become a go-to platform for healthcare professionals to instantly access high-paying jobs with the freedom and flexibility to work when and where they want. 



As a fully remote team of sharp, collaborative, and entrepreneurial individuals, we are dedicated to redefining the way healthcare workers and facilities work together to provide for patients. We are looking for passionate and skilled professionals to join our team and help us take on tough challenges in this fast-expanding healthcare industry segment.  



Join us in our mission to transform the healthcare staffing industry and improve patient lives!




THE ROLE:

As an Account Executive, New Markets at Medely, you’ll be responsible for opening entirely new territories and bringing our healthcare staffing platform to markets where we have little to no existing presence. You’ll build demand from the ground up, establish relationships with outpatient healthcare facilities, and close net-new business.

 

This is a true hunter role with no SDR/BDR support. You will own the full new-business motion end-to-end: including self-prospecting, generating your own pipeline, and executing creative, multi-channel outreach strategies to break into new accounts.

 

Success in this role requires grit, strong organization, and comfort operating in ambiguity. You’ll be navigating multiple stakeholders across the full sales cycle, testing what works, and creating pipeline where none exists. If you're a seller who thrives with autonomy and are motivated by building something from scratch, this is for you.



Location: Remote (Must be in EST or CST)

Compensation: $124,000 - $138,000 OTE (base + commission at plan). Commission is uncapped with accelerators, so earnings increase significantly when you exceed quota.




THE IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE:


WITHIN ONE MONTH, YOU WILL…

 - Ramp quickly on Medely’s platform, our value proposition, and the healthcare staffing landscape.

 - Begin 1:1s with your manager, align on your 30-60-90 plan, and shadow discovery and closing calls.

 - Map your new territory and identify high-potential outpatient facilities.

 - Build your initial prospect list and launch first-wave outreach campaigns.


WITHIN THREE MONTHS, YOU WILL…

 - Own a launch territory plan with a focus on building net new relationships from zero.

 - Run consultative discovery calls with clinical and operational leaders to uncover staffing challenges.

 - Demonstrate Medely’s platform with confidence, tailoring use cases to each facility type.

 - Generate pipeline entirely through your own outreach - leveraging cold calls, email, LinkedIn, networking, and local market knowledge.

 - Begin closing your first launch-market deals.


WITHIN SIX MONTHS, YOU WILL…

 - Have an active, healthy pipeline built solely from self-generated opportunities.

 - Navigate multi-stakeholder sales cycles, engaging both economic buyers and operational champions.

 - Share early market feedback with leadership to influence our go-to-market strategy.

 - Collaborate with Marketing, Customer Success, Clinical Ops, and Product to adapt messaging for your market.


WITHIN ONE YEAR, YOU WILL…

 - Be a top-performing Launch AE, exceeding quota and firmly establishing Medely in your territory.

 - Act as the subject-matter expert for your region, helping shape the playbook for future launches.

 - Mentor new Launch AEs as they ramp and expand into other greenfield markets.


WHO YOU ARE:

 - Must have: proven success launching a new territory, market, or product from scratch - this is a dealbreaker.

 - A minimum of 4 years of quota-carrying, full-cycle sales experience, preferably in healthcare or software/technology.

 - Demonstrated ability to create pipeline without SDR/BDR support - you know how to find, engage, and convert opportunities from zero.

 - Strong organizational skills to track early pipeline and document market learnings.

 - Consultative sales approach, excellent discovery skills, and comfort engaging with clinical and operational teams.

 - Resilient, proactive, and relentless in pursuing new business opportunities.

 - BS/BA degree or equivalent in relevant sales experience






Why Medely: Benefits & Perks

 - Competitive Compensation: Based on experience and performance

 - Long-term Incentives: 401k

 - Healthcare Benefits: Full suite of benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance

 - Flexibility: We believe that work/life balance is important, so we offer flexible and unlimited PTO

 - Paid parental leave

 - Purpose: Join a growing mission-oriented startup that is modernizing the healthcare industry nationally!

 - Ownership: Drive meaningful business impact on a team you’ll help build and define!

 - Remote: Work in a digital environment with all the tools to achieve your work as though you were in the office!



We're an equal opportunity employer to all. We interview and hire applicants of all backgrounds, orientations, expressions, and identities.



Work location is flexible if approved by Medely.



Medely does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. We consider any resume (CV) or biography received from an agency or outside recruiter without prior approval from a member of the Medely Human Resources or Recruiting team to be unsolicited and gratuitous, and such submissions will not be recognized by Medely for purposes of “ownership” of the candidate.



We are an E-Verify company.

jobs.title: Head of Channel | USA
jobs.description:
Why Cast AI?

Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production.

The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don’t. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation.

Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS.

Global team, diverse perspectives
We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead.

Unicorn momentum
In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.

Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.

About the role

This is a ground-floor build, not a maintenance job. The foundation is real - a defined partner tiering model, a growing partner base, and two Partner Managers already running the MSP and VAR tiers day-to-day. What's missing is the person who turns that foundation into a repeatable, scaling engine: recruiting and activating the partners that actually move revenue, standing up the GSI motion from scratch, and making partner-sourced pipeline a forecastable line in Cast AI's growth.

You'll manage and grow the PAM team, but you'll also carry your own strategic relationships - particularly at the GSI level - and be the person the Director of Partnerships and sales leadership turn to for how the channel is performing and where it's headed. As Cast AI scales past unicorn status, this is a genuine build-and-own mandate, not an inherited process to maintain.

Requirements:

• Track record building or scaling a multi-tier partner programme (MSP, VAR, GSI, or similar) at a high-growth SaaS or cloud infrastructure company

• Direct experience with GSIs - you know how to structure and activate a relationship with a systems integrator, not just a reseller

• Proven experience managing a team of PAMs or a channel team - hiring, coaching, and performance-managing multiple direct reports, with the judgment to know when to let them run and when to get involved

• Excellent executive presence - able to represent Cast AI credibly with senior partner stakeholders and with internal sales/exec leadership

• Comfortable selling to and through DevOps, Platform Engineering, and FinOps personas; working familiarity with AWS, GCP, and Azure

• Hands-on with the mechanics of a channel programme: deal registration, joint account planning, QBRs, co-sell motions, partner incentives

• Background at a digital-native company, startup, or ISV preferred - someone who has scaled a channel function before, not just inherited one

• This role requires the candidate to be based in the U.S. Eastern or Central time zone to support close collaboration with our international teams.

What You'll Own:

You'll have full ownership of the Cast AI Channel Program - strategy, structure, and results.

• The GSI motion, built from the ground up - recruitment, executive relationship-building, and joint go-to-market planning with systems integrators

• A scaled strategy for MSPs and Cloud Consultants that turns the tier into its own revenue stream

• The PAM team, managed directly across territories, with room to hire and develop as the function grows

• Recruitment, onboarding, and activation across all three tiers, with direct focus on the top strategic MSP and VAR targets

• The operating cadence across the programme - QBRs, joint account planning, partner advisory input

• Program infrastructure - tiering criteria, incentive structures, deal registration process, enablement and certification content

• Cross-functional alignment with Sales, SEs, Marketing, Product, Finance, and Legal to keep channel strategy tied to company priorities

What’s in it for you?

• Join a fast-growing company at the forefront of cloud-native automation and Kubernetes technology.

• Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.

• 401(k) retirement plan 100% company match on employee contributions up to 6% of pay (available after 3 months of employment).

• Access UnitedHealthcare plans including medical, dental, and vision coverage.

• Equity options.

• Learning budget for your professional and personal growth.

• Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.

• Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.

• Competitive salary (Expected OTE: $250,000 – 300,000 USD + meaningful equity)

Hiring process

• Screening call with Recruiter

• Hiring Manager interview

• 1-2 additional interviews based on the role

• Culture Check interview with an executive

*As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.
*Please note that Cast AI does not provide any form of visa sponsorship/work permit.

jobs.description:
At Van Metre, we believe that each employee contributes directly to our growth, success and culture, and are seeking a candidate who loves to challenge themselves and work with others to fulfill this role. Van Metre has a Multi-Site Service Manager position available to oversee service at two of our properties in Fayetteville, NC: Hunter's Ridge Apartments and The Villagio Apartments!

As Service Manager, you will be responsible for the overall management of the apartment complex and all areas related to the day‐to‐day maintenance operations of the residential community under the direction of the Property Manager and Director of Facilities.

Essential duties include but are not limited to:

• Manage maintenance team members

• Oversee electrical, plumbing, carpentry work, appliance repair and painting

• Organize and manage the different programs required by State and Federal Jurisdictions

• Meet with and direct contractors as needed

• Work closely with the Property Manager to ensure all areas of the property are maintained to the Van Metre standards.

• Manage the facility side of the budget

• Repair and treat structures such as showers, sinks, appliances, doors/cabinets, walls and building exteriors

• Keep informed of pending vacant units and schedule all the vendors for the make ready process

• Manage the daily flow of service requests

• Submit the required weekly reports to the corporate office

• Have a working knowledge of HVAC systems and be able to maintain, repair and replace HVAC systems

• Responsible for managing and carrying out 24 hour emergency maintenance schedule

• Schedule and complete preventative maintenance program

• Coordinate special projects as directed

Requirements:

Service Manager must maintain a professional and courteous manner with residents, visitors, contractors and fellow employees. Service Manager must have the necessary skills to effectively complete tasks outlined above. One must have the ability to follow oral and written instructions and be able to maintain effective and cooperative working relationships.

Education/Qualifications:

• 3+ years' of maintenance supervisor experience

• 3+ years of prior supervisory experience

• EPA Universal/HVAC certification required

• CPO required

• Strong understanding of appliance, electrical and plumbing repair

• Basic knowledge of HVAC and electrical circuitry

• Current on OSHA, building and safety standards

• Provide own basic tools and be knowledgeable and skilled in the safe use and maintenance of tools

• Valid drivers’ license

Weekend work is required.

Benefits information: Van Metre offers excellent benefits, and a work environment that fosters and rewards excellence. We also promote work/life balance, including a robust Employee Wellness Program.  We encourage employees to make full use of vacation and other company-paid leave to refresh their bodies and minds.

• Salary: $27.00-$30.00 per hour (Pay is commensurate with experience, education, training, and skills)

• Annual Bonus Potential: $5,000 annually, paid quarterly

• Renewal Commissions

• Paid Time Off: 11 paid holidays; 10 vacation days, 10 sick days, Two Volunteer Days off, Two Personal Days, Winter Break, Day off for Annual Physical, Day off for your Birthday; comprehensive parental and bonding leave

• Insurance Benefits: Medical and Dental Coverage through Cigna; Vision Coverage through EyeMed; Life, AD&D, Disability Insurance; Flexible Spending Account

• Retirement Planning: Company Matched 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan; access to retirement planning coaches

• Wellness: Annual Wellness Reimbursement of up to $900

• Discounts: Rental and Van Metre Home purchase discounts; employee discount through Walker Title Company; employee discount through Intercoastal Mortgage

Van Metre Core Values

Integrity; Ownership; Respect and Dignity; Diversity and Inclusion; Teamwork; Community; Work/Life Balance

Van Metre Mission Statement

The mission of Van Metre Companies is to build and continually improve upon the storied reputation, earned over the years since the Company’s founding in 1955, of providing top quality homes, investment properties and services to our customers and clients. The Company’s emphasis on integrity, professionalism and philanthropy ingrained by our founder Albert G. Van Metre, Sr. has garnered trust and respect in the Washington, D.C. area and beyond. It is critical to our future that we maintain that reputation and assure that Van Metre Companies continues to excel in real estate development and construction and in the management of apartment, retail and office investment properties, as well as in the provision of mortgage and related services. It is the task of our dedicated, energetic, and involved professionals to advance our ability to set the benchmark for luxury living and refined commercial development. The capstone of our mission is to make the “Van Metre” signature an icon for elegant residential communities, and industry leading condominium and apartment communities, as well as Class A neighborhood retail centers and office developments.

jobs.title: Operatore esperto addetto al taglio
jobs.description:
Stiamo cercando un/una operatore/trice esperto/a addetto al taglio che entri a far parte del nostro team di produzione a Cadorago, in Italia. L'operatore lavora in piena autonomia, senza la necessità di una particolare supervisione. Adatta con successo procedure, utensili e attrezzature per soddisfare i requisiti di produzione, assumendo il ruolo di operatore principale sulle macchine da taglio (slitter) e sulla linea di imballaggio. In questa mansione, ha la completa responsabilità del setup delle macchine, dell'ottimizzazione della velocità e dell'esecuzione del piano di produzione rispetto agli obiettivi previsti.

In sede

• Eseguire il setup completo delle macchine da taglio (slitter) e della linea di imballaggio, ottimizzandone la velocità in base al piano di produzione.
• Svolgere la manutenzione autonoma di 1° livello (TPM) per garantire l'affidabilità dei macchinari e la stabilità del processo.
• Rispettare rigorosamente le linee guida EHS (Salute, Sicurezza e Ambiente), le procedure operative standard (SOP) e gli standard 5S.
• Condurre in totale sicurezza le attrezzature per la movimentazione delle merci, tra cui carrelli elevatori, transpallet manuali e carrelli retrattili.
• Partecipare al sistema di lavoro collaborativo, fungendo da esempio comportamentale per l'intero team attraverso un'elevata consapevolezza e orientamento al miglioramento continuo.

Requisiti:

• Diploma di scuola secondaria di secondo grado o titolo equivalente, con almeno 5 anni di comprovata esperienza in ambito produttivo o manifatturiero.
• Buona padronanza nell'utilizzo di software e sistemi gestionali per la produzione, unita a un livello di inglese comunicativo/operativo.
• Costituisce un forte vantaggio una precedente esperienza lavorativa diretta su macchine da taglio/taglierine, linee di imballaggio, nel settore della stampa o in contesti manifatturieri ad alto contenuto tecnologico
• Il possesso del patentino per il muletto sarà considerato un plus.

Competenze necessarie per avere successo:

• Eccellente attitudine a lavorare in ambienti dinamici e veloci, dimostrando buone capacità di problem solving logico e un'attitudine matematica e meccanico/tecnica.
• Ottime doti interpersonali, di comunicazione e di lavoro in squadra, con la capacità di operare in autonomia, in sicurezza e nel rispetto delle tempistiche.

Cosa Offriamo

Offriamo, inoltre, le seguenti opportunità formative:

• Corso di Primo Soccorso e Antincendio
• Formazione EHS (Salute, Sicurezza e Ambiente)
• Formazione per la conduzione di carrelli elevatori o macchine per la movimentazione
• Formazione sull'uso di transpallet manuali e carrelli retrattili
• Formazione su YC, BC e processi di escalation
• Formazione sul metodo 5S
• Formazione sulle procedure operative standard (SOP)
• Formazione su Magma
• Utilizzo e compilazione STA
• Corso per Front Line Leader (opzionale)
• Formazione abilitante per lavori in quota su piattaforme (opzionale)

Per aiutarci a elaborare rapidamente la tua candidatura, ti preghiamo di caricare il tuo CV in formato PDF o Word. Ti chiediamo inoltre gentilmente di inviare il tuo curriculum nella stessa lingua di questo annuncio di lavoro.

Perché entrare in Avery Dennison

Siamo un'azienda globale specializzata nella scienza dei materiali e nelle soluzioni di identificazione digitale con sedi in oltre 50 paesi e circa 35.000 dipendenti in tutto il mondo. Come azienda orientata alla scienza e all'innovazione, crediamo che i team diversificati siano i più forti. Ci impegniamo a promuovere una cultura basata sulla curiosità e sul coraggio, dove puoi far crescere la tua carriera all'interno di un'azienda che ha l'innovazione nel proprio DNA. Fondati sull'idea di creare un impatto reale per garantire un futuro migliore, ci impegniamo a offrire un ambiente di lavoro aperto e collaborativo in cui la diversità di pensiero è incoraggiata e rispettata. Scopri cosa pensano i nostri dipendenti dell'esperienza di lavoro in Avery Dennison. Maggiori informazioni su www.averydennison.com. In Avery Dennison, collaboriamo con i più grandi marchi nei settori FMCG (Beni di consumo in rapido movimento), Abbigliamento, Automotive e Farmaceutico. Il nostro Centro di Distribuzione di Cadorago, fondato nel 1964, offre un ambiente collaborativo e dinamico che supporta le nostre divisioni LPM e Graphics e impiega circa 87 professionisti di talento. jobs.title: Shipping & Receiving Manager
jobs.description:
What is Cirkul?

Cirkul is a rapidly growing company on a mission to transform how beverages are developed, distributed, and enjoyed. It’s a new way to hydrate—so much so that 96% of customers say they drink more water with Cirkul!* With over 150 flavor options available without sugar or calories, Cirkul provides customers with a fully customizable, reusable water bottle and cartridge system. Since 2018, millions have dropped sugary soda and energy drinks, and turned up their plain boring water with Cirkul! A full range of products is available at DrinkCirkul.com, and Cirkul is also sold by Amazon, Costco, Walmart, Kroger, and grocery stores nationwide.

*Based on a survey conducted with 3,258 Cirkul Customers

What is this role?

The Shipping & Receiving Manager oversees all inbound and outbound shipments to ensure materials, products, and retail customer orders move efficiently, accurately, and safely throughout Cirkul’s operations, ultimately shipping On Time to deliver to Customer expectations. This role manages daily execution of shipping and receiving activities, carrier coordination, and team performance to support production demands and fulfill retail customer orders on time.  This role also manages our Pick & Pack team that is responsible for all of our Case Pick operations to support our customers.

As Cirkul continues to grow across retail, e-commerce, and other sales channels, this leader will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, maintaining inventory accuracy, controlling shipping efficiencies, and meeting the needs of our internal teams and external customers. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who can balance daily execution with process improvement, develop a high-performing team, and proactively identify opportunities to improve speed, accuracy, and cost efficiency.

What does an average day look like?

Driving Results:

• Oversee daily shipping and receiving operations to ensure inbound deliveries and outbound shipments are processed accurately, safely, and on schedule.

• Monitor key performance indicators, including on-time shipping, receiving accuracy, order accuracy, dock-to-stock time, labor productivity, and freight costs.

• Analyze operational performance, identify gaps, and implement corrective actions to improve throughput, accuracy, and efficiency.

• Ensure the team consistently meets shipping deadlines, production requirements, and customer fulfillment expectations.

Taking Ownership:

• Take accountability for the end-to-end execution of inbound and outbound logistics, including shipment scheduling, receiving, documentation, and order fulfillment.

• Proactively address shipment delays, receiving discrepancies, inventory errors, and capacity constraints.

• Identify opportunities to improve workflows, dock utilization, labor planning, and shipping and receiving processes.

• Ensure all receipts, transfers, and shipments are accurately documented in the applicable systems.

• Maintain compliance with company procedures, workplace safety standards, equipment requirements, and applicable shipping and receiving regulations.

Making Decisions:

• Prioritize shipments and receiving activities based on business needs, production schedules, customer commitments, and available resources.

• Make informed decisions regarding labor allocation, carrier coordination, dock scheduling, and workflow adjustments.

• Troubleshoot daily operational challenges and determine appropriate corrective actions to minimize delays and disruptions.

• Balance service levels, freight costs, labor efficiency, and operational capacity when making decisions.

Cultivating Relationships:

• Lead, coach, and develop shipping and receiving team members, establishing clear expectations for productivity, accuracy, attendance, and safety.

• Coordinate with warehouse, inventory, production, planning, procurement, and customer-facing teams to prioritize shipments and manage incoming materials.

• Build strong relationships with freight carriers and logistics partners to resolve service issues, address missed pickups, and improve delivery performance.

• Communicate operational priorities, shipment risks, delays, and resolutions to relevant stakeholders.

Instilling Trust:

• Maintain accurate shipping and receiving records and ensure inventory movements are properly documented.

• Establish consistent processes that support inventory integrity, operational accountability, and compliance.

• Reinforce safe work practices and ensure team members follow established procedures for material handling and equipment use.

• Hold team members accountable for performance while fostering a culture of transparency, reliability, and continuous improvement.

• Follow through on commitments and communicate proactively when operational challenges arise.

Customer Focus:

• Ensure accurate and timely fulfillment of orders for Cirkul’s retail partners and direct-to-consumer customers.

• Coordinate with internal teams to meet retailer shipping requirements, delivery windows, and customer commitments.

• Proactively identify and communicate potential shipment delays or fulfillment issues that could impact customers.

• Maintain high standards for order accuracy, shipment quality, and on-time delivery.

• Identify opportunities to improve the shipping experience while balancing customer expectations with operational efficiency and cost.

What background should you have?

• 7+ years of experience in shipping, receiving, warehouse, distribution, or logistics operations, with at least 2+ years in a supervisory or management role.

• Experience leading teams in a fast-paced warehouse, distribution center, manufacturing, or consumer packaged goods (CPG) environment.

• Demonstrated success managing inbound receiving and outbound shipping operations, including carrier coordination, shipment scheduling, documentation, and order fulfillment.

• Strong understanding of inventory control processes, receiving discrepancies, inventory transactions, cycle counting, and warehouse accuracy.

• Experience managing operational KPIs, analyzing performance data, and implementing process improvements that increase productivity, accuracy, and cost efficiency.

• Proficiency with warehouse management systems (WMS), enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

• Experience coordinating with freight carriers, third-party logistics providers (3PLs), and internal supply chain stakeholders.

• Strong leadership, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a dynamic environment.

• A hands-on management approach with a demonstrated ability to hold teams accountable while building a positive, productive, and safety-focused culture.

• Knowledge of warehouse safety practices, material-handling equipment, and applicable shipping and receiving procedures.

• Ability to work on-site and adapt to changing operational demands, including fluctuating shipment volumes and business priorities.

What do we offer?

• Competitive salary based on experience and market

• Generous benefits, 401k match, and PTO (even insurance for your fur babies!)

• Employee discounts on Cirkul products

• New corporate office space with great amenities

• Opportunity to work with a best in class team, in a hyper growth company, taking over the hydration industry

• A culture that rewards results

Please review our privacy policy here.

Please note: At this time, we will not provide sponsorship for employment visas. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship.
