jobs.title: Buyer
jobs.description:
Position Summary & Objective

The Buyer is a strategic procurement professional responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and managing the supply of materials, components, and services required for a heavy fabricating manufacturing environment. This role oversees complex, high‑value purchasing activities across a global supply base, ensuring cost competitiveness, supply continuity, and adherence to quality and delivery requirements. The Buyer partners closely with engineering, operations, quality, and finance to support production schedules and long‑term business objectives.

Essential Functions Performed by the Position

• Develop and execute sourcing strategies for raw materials, fabricated components, capital equipment, and specialized services used in heavy manufacturing.
• Identify, evaluate, and qualify global and domestic suppliers to ensure capability, capacity, and compliance with technical and quality standards.
• Lead supplier negotiations focused on cost reduction, long‑term agreements, risk mitigation, and performance improvement.
• Monitor supplier performance using KPIs such as on‑time delivery, quality, and cost competitiveness.
• Drive supplier development initiatives to strengthen supply chain resilience and reduce total cost of ownership.
• Monitor reporting and ERP system for purchase demand requirements.
• Expedite or follow-up on purchases when required and update record if ship dates change.
• Negotiate Blanket Orders, with suppliers, for frequently needed materials.
• Support logistics and customs activities.
• Using data analytics across spend categories to drive organizational decision making through Power BI.
• Satisfy ISO 9001 Quality Standard as it applies to purchasing functions.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills
• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Basic understanding of manufacturing processes, blueprint reading and quality assurance procedures.
• Proficient with Microsoft Office: Word, Excel, and Power BI.
• Proficient in use of ERP systems to support purchasing activities (Epicor)

Required Education and Experience

• Associates degree or Bachelors degree preferred or one to two years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Experience in a job shop or engineered to order manufacturing environment is preferred.
• Heavy manufacturing experience preferred.

Licenses or Certifications Required

• None

Environment and Working Conditions

• Normal office environment; some interaction in a heavy steel fabrication environment to coordinate with manufacturing team members

Travel Requirements (percent)

• 10%

jobs.description:
Legend Biotech is a global biotechnology company dedicated to treating and, one day, curing life-threatening diseases. Headquartered in Bridgewater, New Jersey, we are advancing the next generation of cell therapy through a portfolio of innovative technologies, including autologous, allogeneic, and in vivo cell therapy approaches. Our research spans chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (CAR-T), T-cell receptor (TCR-T), natural killer (NK) cell-based therapies, and other emerging platforms designed to transform the treatment of serious diseases. From our global network of research and development sites, we are committed to discovering and developing safe, effective, and cutting-edge therapies for patients worldwide.

Legend Biotech entered into a global collaboration agreement with Johnson & Johnson to jointly develop and commercialize CARVYKTI® (ciltacabtagene autoleucel; cilta-cel). Through this strategic partnership, we combine complementary expertise and capabilities to advance innovative immunotherapies for patients living with multiple myeloma.

Legend Biotech is seeking a Manager, Network FP&A as part of the Finance team based in Bridgewater, NJ.

Role Overview

The Manager, Network FP&A is responsible for financial planning, forecasting, performance management, and analytics across Legend Biotech’s global manufacturing and supply network. The role consolidates financial and
operational information across manufacturing sites, external manufacturing partners, and supply-chain functions to deliver an integrated view of performance, risks, and opportunities.

Financial Modeling and Decision Support

• Develop and maintain financial models supporting capacity planning, network scenarios, product costing, gross-margin analysis, and operational decisions.

• Support the Senior Manager, Network Finance & Strategy in evaluating manufacturing investments, automation initiatives, and make-versus-buy or sourcing alternatives.

• Perform scenario and sensitivity analyses that clearly connect operational assumptions to COGM, profitability, cash flow, and other financial outcomes.

Performance Management and Reporting

• Own consolidated monthly and quarterly reporting across the manufacturing and supply network, including actual-to-budget, forecast, prior-year, and long-range-plan comparisons.

• Analyze COGM, cost per batch, productivity, volume, capacity, labor, overhead, external manufacturing, and gross-margin drivers.

• Identify key risks, opportunities, trends, and required actions and communicate findings through concise, decision-oriented reporting.

Financial Modeling and Decision Support

• Develop and maintain financial models supporting capacity planning, network scenarios, product costing, gross-margin analysis, and operational decisions.

• Support the Senior Manager, Network Finance & Strategy in evaluating manufacturing investments, automation initiatives, and make-versus-buy or sourcing alternatives.

• Perform scenario and sensitivity analyses that clearly connect operational assumptions to COGM, profitability, cash flow, and other financial outcomes.

Gross Margin and Network Competitiveness

• Develop analytics supporting manufacturing productivity, cost competitiveness, and long-term gross margin expansion.

• Consolidate and evaluate cross-site savings and productivity initiatives in partnership with Site Finance and operational leaders.

• Track financial performance against approved initiatives and provide visibility into forecasted benefits, risks, timing, and execution gaps.

Portfolio Manufacturing Finance

• Support financial planning and analysis for pipeline products as programs progress through development and toward commercialization.

• Incorporate pipeline volumes, manufacturing costs, capacity needs, investment requirements, and sourcing assumptions into financial plans.

• Partner with Finance and operational stakeholders to develop repeatable planning and reporting processes for new products.

KPI and Management Analytics

• Own the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Network Finance dashboards, KPI reporting, and performance analytics.

• Establish consistent metric definitions, assumptions, data sources, and reporting standards across sites and functions.

• Develop clear executive-ready presentations that connect financial results with operational drivers and business implications.

Business Partnership

• Partner with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, MSAT, Engineering, Procurement, Site Finance, and other stakeholders on financial planning and performance.

• Provide timely analysis and financial insights that help business partners understand trade-offs, improve performance, and make informed decisions.

• Build effective relationships across functions, sites, and regions while maintaining clear ownership, accountability, and follow-through.

Finance Transformation and Automation

• Improve and standardize Network FP&A processes, planning models, reporting tools, and analytical methodologies.

• Partner with Finance, IT, and data teams to automate reporting, strengthen data quality, and reduce manual data extraction and spreadsheet-intensive activities.

• Support development of scalable data and analytics capabilities that improve forecast accuracy, reporting timeliness, and decision support.

The Manager, Network FP&A works closely with the Senior Manager, Network Finance & Strategy; Director, Supply Chain Finance; Raritan and Belgium Site Finance teams; Global Supply Chain Accounting; Corporate
FP&A; Commercial Finance; Manufacturing; Supply Chain; Quality; MSAT; Engineering; Procurement; Clinical Supply; IT; and data and analytics teams.

Requirements

• Advanced degree and/or relevant professional accounting/finance qualification preferred.

• Progressive experience in FP&A, manufacturing finance, supply-chain finance, corporate finance, or a related discipline.

• Demonstrated experience with budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, management reporting, and financial modeling.

• Experience translating operational and commercial assumptions into financial plans and actionable business insights.

• Manufacturing, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, cell-therapy, or other regulated-industry experience preferred.

• Experience with ERP, enterprise planning, reporting, visualization, or analytics platforms preferred.

• Strong FP&A, forecasting, financial-modeling, and analytical capabilities.

• Understanding of manufacturing economics, including COGM, capacity, productivity, inventory, and gross-margin drivers.

• Ability to integrate financial and operational data from multiple sites and functions.

• Strong attention to detail while maintaining focus on the broader business narrative and decision.

AECOM is actively seeking a talented entry-level Geologist for immediate employment in the Westlake Village, CA office. This position is expected to begin ASAP.

Under the supervision of a Project Manager or senior-level team member, the successful candidate’s responsibilities will include:

• Use on-the-job learning to apply standard field practices and techniques using basic field equipment to collect samples of soil, groundwater, surface water, sediment; prepare samples for shipping, and complete chain-of-custody or similar paperwork.
• Perform supervised field tasks, such as soil logging, monitoring well installation, slug testing, water level/groundwater gradient surveys, etc.
• Gather and interpret chemical and non-chemical data and other information to be used in the preparation of scientific reports, compiles and organizes environmental data collected by others.
• Prepare basic data and scientific documents and can apply knowledge of natural sciences (hydrology, chemistry, biology, etc.) to explain observations.
• Assist senior-level team members in planning and coordination efforts of field programs.
• Qualified candidates must be comfortable with travel. Out-of-state travel may be required.
• Anticipated division of job-related tasks is about a 50/50 percent split between field and office work.

The ideal candidate must be able to work effectively both as an individual and within a collaborative team-environment. They must be able to demonstrate effective and timely communication skills especially during field work. The flexibility to work on a multitude of diverse projects, a positive attitude, and commitment to workplace health and safety are imperative. • Bachelor’s degree in Geology or related science.

• Due to the nature of the work, U.S. citizenship is required.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Has general knowledge of geologic and environmental concepts (e.g., stratigraphy, geological processes, hydrogeology, hydrology, etc.).

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to document.

jobs.title: Incident Response Engineer
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.



We are hiring a Security Incident Response Engineer to join our Incident Response team. You will help redefine how incidents are handled at scale, pairing autonomous AI agents with human judgment so that we can detect, investigate, and contain threats faster across a rapidly growing cloud and AI footprint.




AS A SECURITY INCIDENT RESPONSE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

 - Join a high-impact team of security experts to scale security at one of the fastest-growing software companies ever

 - Spearhead an agentic approach to Incident Response by deploying, guiding, and refining autonomous AI agents that execute initial triage, context gathering, and rapid investigation alongside human Incident Commanders

 - Handle escalations, lead security investigations, and act as Incident Commander for critical incidents

 - Build scripts, automation pipelines, and agentic workflows that continuously enhance Snowflake's incident response capabilities

 - Partner closely with our Threat Detection, Automation, Product Security, Legal, HR, Cloud, and Data teams

 - Create and improve detections, threat signatures, and guardrails for both traditional and AI-driven attack vectors

 - Participate in a periodic on-call rotation, which may involve non-traditional working hours




OUR IDEAL SECURITY INCIDENT RESPONSE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

 - 2+ years of relevant experience in incident response or security operations preferred

 - Strong experience in incident response, security investigations, and running incidents as the Incident Commander

 - Advanced experience using security stack capabilities (EDR, SIEM, SOAR, DLP) across endpoints, identity providers, SaaS, and cloud workloads

 - Deep familiarity with AI/LLM tooling, security copilots, and AI-driven telemetry to accelerate investigations, threat triage, and post-incident reporting

 - Knowledge of securing frontier AI infrastructure, including model training and serving pipelines and AI agent permissions

 - Proven ability to detect and respond to modern AI-driven attacks

 - Proficiency in Python to build automated orchestration pipelines, reduce manual incident response toil, and programmatically enrich security alerts

 - Expert-level understanding of cloud security architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container runtime isolation (Docker, Kubernetes)

 - Ability to translate incident findings and root-cause analysis into short-term tactical fixes and long-term security engineering objectives

 - Ability to perform static and dynamic malware analysis using sandbox environments and modern AI-assisted reverse engineering tools




BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

 - Experience with threat hunting or building detection-as-code programs

 - Experience running sensitive investigations alongside Legal and HR, such as insider risk cases

 - Familiarity with large-scale data platforms and using them to analyze security telemetry

 - Contributions to open-source security tooling, detection rules, or the broader security community

 - Industry certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, or GREM




WHY JOIN OUR INCIDENT RESPONSE TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

This is an opportunity to shape what incident response looks like in the agentic era. You will work on the front line of defending one of the world's most important data platforms, building the AI-driven workflows that let a team of experts respond with the speed and precision that modern threats demand.



You will work across Detection, Product Security, Cloud, Legal, and HR, see incidents end to end, and turn what you learn into lasting improvements to how Snowflake protects its customers and its people.



Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

We are trying to solve problems from scalable connections to bespoke external systems to crafting data contracts between services which reliably create product value.We believe in taking data and transforming it into consistent models, and making it available to application services securely and reliably.

You'll help shape how those systems work: how data is organized, how changes are processed, how pipelines recover when something fails, and how the architecture scales as we grow. You'll also support the shared data foundations used by analysts, data scientists, and  engineering teams. We measure success by making sure it is accurate, appropriately accessible, ready when the product needs it, and most importantly: provides value to our users.

What you'll do

• Embed with engineering teams to turn application requirements into data models, pipeline designs, and clear interfaces between systems.

• Design, build, and operate production data operations using SQL, Python, PySpark and cloud data technologies such as Databricks, integrating APIs, databases, and structured, semi-structured, and unstructured content.

• Build ingestion and transformation workflows that deliver usable data to application services and downstream capabilities.

• Design customer-aware data flows that preserve tenant boundaries, source permissions, and data lifecycle requirements, including updates, deletions, and regional constraints.

• Make pipelines resilient through incremental processing, checkpointing, safe retries, backfills, replay, and data-quality checks.

• Build observability that helps the team understand data freshness, completeness, processing progress, and failures across the pipeline.

• Evaluate architecture and tooling choices against product needs, balancing reliability, performance, maintainability, and operating cost.

• Maintain and improve shared datasets and pipelines that support both application features and internal analytics, avoiding unnecessary duplication of data and processing.

• Contribute to design reviews, testing, documentation, and deployment practices. Share what you learn and mentor less experienced engineers.

Skills and requirements

We expect to see:

• 5+ years of relevant engineering experience, including building and operating production data pipelines and contributing to their architecture.

• Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience in relational databases, data modeling, and query optimization.

• Experience integrating external APIs and working with changing schemas, imperfect source data, and incremental updates.

• Experience applying software engineering practices to data systems, including version control, automated testing, code review, CI/CD tooling, observability logging and monitoring.

• You love solving hard problems with the ability to investigate issues across ingestion, transformation, and downstream delivery.

• The ability to explain technical tradeoffs and collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to deliver customer value through reliable, understandable, and maintainable solutions.

• A track record of sharing knowledge and helping other engineers grow, along with the communication and self-direction needed to work effectively on a distributed team.

• Experience with Azure/GCP and cloud data platforms such as Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, or comparable technologies.

Helpful, but not required

• Experience building data systems for customer-facing applications, particularly multi-tenant products or integrations with third-party services.

• Experience with document processing, knowledge systems, or pipelines that support AI-powered features.

• Experience with access controls, data governance, regional data requirements, or customer-data retention and deletion.

• Experience with event-driven processing, infrastructure as code, and monitoring or optimizing cloud workload costs.

• Examples of work you're proud of, whether from a previous role, a personal project, open source, or contributions to the Stack Overflow community.

What you’ll get in return:

• Competitive Base Salary

• Generous paid vacation

• Generous parental leave, family care leave, and unlimited sick days

• Industry-leading health benefits that are applicable per country of residence for all our full-time employees

• Company-paid Life Insurance

• Home Internet stipend

• Professional allocation for your growth and development

• One-time allowance to assist with your home office setup

• Company-paid access to Calm, Prosus Academy and Overdrive

Stack Overflow is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We value diversity, inclusion, equity and belonging and these pillars are at the heart of how we work together here at Stack. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

For individuals based in California, and other locations where required, we will consider employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Overjet is the world-leader in dental AI. Already, thousands of dental providers and insurers rely on our platform to deliver the best possible care. Now, we’re looking for talented people to fulfill our mission: improve oral health for all.

Overjet is where builders become leaders. Everyone here loves to make new things: new products, new partnerships, new content, and a new category of AI technology. And as Overjet grows ridiculously fast, so will you.

Simply put, there’s no better place to accelerate your career. Come join us!

The Role

At Overjet, Staff DevOps Engineers are technical leaders responsible for building and architecting the software, systems and automation infrastructure that powers our healthcare AI products. In this role, you will partner closely with engineering teams to drive technical strategy, mentor engineers, and own critical systems that enable reliable, scalable delivery. You'll work at the intersection of infrastructure, security, and developer experience, serving as a trusted technical advisor across the organization while architecting and building solutions that impact all of engineering.

jobs.title: National Manager, Oncology Nurse Educator Field Strategy & Execution
jobs.description:
The National Portfolio Manager is a strategic partner to the National Lead, Oncology Nurse Educator (ONE) field team, responsible for development and support of portfolio nursing strategy and tactical plan and translating brand and portfolio strategies into effective field execution and ensuring the ONE organization has the tools, resources, processes, and cross-functional alignment needed to perform at a high level.

This role works across three hematology franchises and serves as a key connector between ONE, Brand, Sales, Field Operations, Field Force Effectiveness, Analytics, Training, Medical, and other enterprise partners. This role leads through influence in a highly matrixed environment, balancing portfolio priorities with the unique needs of each franchise while leading above brand portfolio nursing strategy  for AbbVie Oncology Hematology portfolio products and customers it serves.

This position will not have external customer responsibilities but is expected to use previous external customer experience to help maximize performance.

Key Responsibilities

• Drive Portfolio Education Strategy & Execution: Translate oncology portfolio and brand priorities into clear ONE field priorities, plans, milestones, and execution requirements across three franchises.
• Support and Direct Creation of Portfolio Nurse Education Strategy: Support National Director in creation of portfolio above brand nursing strategy and tactics to support HCP/nurse education of disease and therapy management before, during, and after therapy.
• Lead Through Influence: Build alignment and drive decisions across cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority; navigate competing priorities with strong judgment, credibility, and organizational savvy.
• Optimize Field Operations: Partner with Field Operations to ensure ONE has effective tools, processes, systems, reporting, training, and infrastructure to execute efficiently and compliantly.
• Advocate for ONE: Represent the voice, needs, and value of the ONE organization in cross-functional planning; build compelling business cases for appropriate resources, capabilities, and support.
• Enable Field Performance: Identify emerging field needs, barriers, and opportunities and rapidly mobilize resources and partners to address them.
• Leverage Insights & Analytics: Use field data, customer insights, and performance trends to identify opportunities, inform priorities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
• Lead Strategic Initiatives: Own complex, cross-functional projects from strategy through implementation, managing priorities, dependencies, timelines, risks, and stakeholder accountability.
• Strengthen Communication & Engagement: Develop clear, compelling communications and executive presentations that create alignment, reinforce priorities, and keep the ONE and other in-field partners informed and engaged.
• Advance Innovation & Technology: Identify and implement opportunities to use technology, automation, analytics, and AI to improve ONE effectiveness, productivity, and scalability.
• Ensure Operational & Compliance Excellence: Partner with Legal, Compliance, and relevant stakeholders to ensure ONE activities, processes, and resources meet AbbVie standards and requirements. Explore benchmarking against other ONE networks to continuously evolve ways of working.
• Continuously Improve: Benchmark and evolve ONE ways of working, capabilities, and infrastructure to support a high-performing, scalable national organization.

• Bachelor’s degree required; nursing, healthcare, business, or life sciences preferred.
• 5+ years of pharmaceutical, healthcare, biotech, or related industry experience; oncology/hematology strongly preferred.
• Previous field leadership, sales leadership, field operations, commercial strategy, or field effectiveness experience preferred.
• Clinical & Industry Expertise: Strong clinical patient management experience, oncology clinical acumen and understanding of hematology/oncology treatment, nursing practice, healthcare environments, and the pharmaceutical industry.
• Strategic & Business Acumen: Ability to translate strategy into focused field execution; understand customer and account dynamics; use data and insights to prioritize resources and make sound business decisions.
• Influence & Collaboration: Proven ability to influence without authority and lead effectively across cross-functional teams and organizational levels. Demonstrated track record of delivering results, building trusted relationships, and operating with an enterprise mindset.
• Communication: Exceptional communication, presentation, facilitation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to translate complex clinical and business information into clear, actionable messages.
• Judgment & Agility: Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, sound business judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities and lead effectively through ambiguity and change.
• Talent & Growth Mindset: Demonstrated commitment to developing others and continuously expanding personal and organizational capability; ability and desire to grow into broader leadership responsibilities.
• Compliance & Integrity: Demonstrated understanding of pharmaceutical compliance and regulatory requirements and the ability to maintain appropriate boundaries between clinical education and promotional activity.
• Project Management Excellence: Strong project management, prioritization, and execution skills with a demonstrated sense of urgency. Proficiency with technology, analytics, and emerging AI capabilities to improve business effectiveness.

These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases, fingerprinting & specific licenses required by states or cities.

jobs.title: LinkedIn Exec Content Writer
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a LinkedIn executive content writer to run our executive content program for two brands: Darkroom, our growth marketing agency, and Shadow, our AI commerce platform. Ad Age recently described us as "if Omnicom was rebuilt on AI." Our buyers, founders and operators, spend their professional attention on LinkedIn, and our executives reach more of them than any company page.

You make our executives sound like themselves, consistently, every week. You interview them, write for them, plan what each of them posts, and edit until it reads like a person, not a brand. Team members who want to post get your help too.

This is a hybrid role based in New York City, hiring in the US only, or remote in New Jersey, Florida, or Texas. Working with a team in the EST Time Zone, and all business is conducted 100% in English.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - The Executive Content Program: Run it day-to-day across our executive team, so every account has a clear voice, a plan, and a steady rhythm.

 - Voice Interviews: Recorded interviews with executives that become posts close to their own words.

 - Context Files: A living file for every executive: voice, expertise, stories and the lines they won't cross, built from calls, talks and interviews.

 - Ghostwriting: Ideas, drafts, edits and approvals for executive posts, end to end.

 - The Executive Calendar: One calendar across all executive accounts. You decide who posts for each launch and keep topics from colliding.

 - Launch Days: Coordinate executive posts around launches, webinars, and events so the accounts reinforce each other.

 - Formats: Text posts, carousels, short video clip scripts, and posts repurposed from talks and appearances.

 - Editing: Every draft gets a human edit. Marketing speak comes out; the person's voice stays in.

 - Reading What Works: Track which topics, formats, and voices reach our buyers, and feed it back into the calendar.




YOU SHOULD APPLY IF THIS SOUNDS LIKE YOU

 - You have ghostwritten for founders or executives on LinkedIn, and the posts sounded like them. Send links.

 - You understand B2B buyers making considered decisions.

 - You know commerce and growth well enough to write about DTC, performance marketing, retention, and AI tooling without a briefing.

 - You can interview a busy executive for 20 minutes and leave with a week of posts, in several distinct voices.

 - You are a sharp editor who cuts marketing speak and keeps a person's voice.

 - You know LinkedIn formats and distribution: hooks, carousels, native video, comments.

 - You already work with Claude, ChatGPT, or similar daily for research and ideas, and you know where AI stops and editing starts.
   
   


HARD DISQUALIFIERS

 - No ghostwriting samples for executives or founders.

 - Copy that reads like marketing, not like a person.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

jobs.title: New Mexico | Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner – PMHNP – Telehealth Addiction & Mental Health Care
jobs.description:
Affect is transforming behavioral health care by combining mobile technology with counseling and medical services, offering 100% virtual treatment. We break down barriers to care, making it more accessible and effective for our members.

Our innovative approach integrates a smartphone app with a dedicated care team to deliver real-time, data-driven treatment for better outcomes and lower costs.

About the Role:

As a PMHNP, you will lead member care alongside a team of counselors, therapists, peer support specialists, and case managers. You’ll provide evidence-based treatment for individuals with substance use disorders and mental health disorders.

We do not prescribe controlled substances other than Suboxone for the treatment of Opioid Use Disorder. Affect provides extensive training on evidence-based approaches to treatment, though medication decisions are ultimately made at the provider’s discretion in collaboration with the member. You must hold an active, unrestricted license in New Mexico

We have a full-time and part-time opportunity in New Mexico!

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct initial and follow up telehealth evaluations

• Deliver care for both substance use and mental health conditions.

• Prescribe medications as appropriate and answer member questions.

• Complete documentation in our EHR (Healthie).

• Collaborate with your care team and attend occasional scheduled team meetings.

Requirements:

• Active and verifiable PMHNP license (Medicaid enrollment is a plus) in the state(s) where you practice, as well as your state of residence if it is not New Mexico.

• At least 2 years of experience, ideally in addiction or mental health treatment. We will consider relevant previous experience for those with less than 2 years experience as a PMHNP.

• Experience prescribing Suboxone and active DEA registration.

• Willingness to obtain multi-state licensure (cost covered by Affect).

• Empathy for members facing behavioral health challenges.

• Comfort using technology, including EHRs and mobile apps.

Additional Information:

You’ll need a quiet, private office with a reliable internet connection for HIPAA-compliant telehealth visits. The role may include periodic meetings with internal teams; reasonable accommodations are available as needed.

Why Join Affect?
We are passionate about reimagining behavioral health treatment. Join a mission-driven team focused on meaningful work, offering competitive compensation, remote flexibility, professional growth, and a strong, supportive culture.

Be part of the mission.  Help us reshape the future of substance use disorder and mental health care!

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director (IC)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

Job Summary

Please note: This is an Individual Contributor (IC) role with no people management responsibilities. You will own the full enterprise sales cycle—from prospecting through to close—building your own pipeline and driving net-new enterprise revenue.

The Regional Sales Director is responsible for identifying, qualifying and closing net-new enterprise opportunities within our highest-potential target accounts. As the digital marketing landscape continues to evolve, you'll help enterprise brands navigate increasingly complex partnership and performance marketing strategies to deliver measurable commercial outcomes.

You'll become a trusted advisor to senior marketing leaders, building consultative relationships, uncovering strategic business challenges and demonstrating how Partnerize's technology creates long-term value. We're looking for a proactive hunter and accomplished enterprise seller who thrives on generating pipeline, managing complex sales cycles and consistently exceeding revenue targets.

Responsibilities

• Build & Own Your Pipeline: Proactively generate new enterprise opportunities using AI-powered sales tools, intent data, outbound prospecting and strategic account planning.

• Lead Consultative Discovery: Conduct high-impact discovery conversations with senior marketing stakeholders to uncover business challenges and position Partnerize's solutions against measurable commercial outcomes.

• Develop Commercial Business Cases: Build compelling value propositions and ROI-driven business cases that demonstrate revenue growth, operational efficiency and long-term business value.

• Manage Complex Enterprise Sales Cycles: Navigate multi-stakeholder buying processes across marketing, procurement, legal, security and finance to progress opportunities from discovery through to close.

• Forecast with Accuracy: Maintain accurate CRM data, manage pipeline health and deliver reliable sales forecasting through disciplined opportunity management.

• Deliver Executive-Level Presentations: Tailor presentations and product demonstrations that clearly communicate Partnerize's value proposition and differentiate our platform within the partnership ecosystem.

• Achieve Revenue Targets: Consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual sales targets while maintaining a high level of customer engagement and pipeline activity.

Required Qualifications & Competencies

• Enterprise Sales Experience: Up to five years of quota-carrying experience selling enterprise SaaS, MarTech, digital media or technology solutions into mid-market and enterprise organisations.

• Individual Contributor Mindset: A highly motivated self-starter who enjoys building pipeline from scratch and thrives in a high-autonomy, high-performance sales environment.

• Consultative Selling Expertise: Experience applying value-based sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger or similar frameworks to manage complex enterprise sales cycles.

• Executive Presence: Strong commercial acumen with the confidence to influence and challenge senior decision-makers through consultative conversations.

• AI & Sales Technology: Comfortable leveraging AI-powered sales tools, CRM platforms, sales engagement technologies and intent data to improve prospecting, research and pipeline management.

• Ecommerce & Digital Marketing Knowledge: An understanding of ecommerce, affiliate marketing, partnerships or the wider digital marketing landscape. Direct affiliate marketing experience is advantageous but not essential.

• Modern Marketing Fluency: Strong understanding of today's performance marketing ecosystem, including affiliate marketing, creator partnerships and ecommerce.

• Highly Autonomous & Driven: Exceptionally organised, resilient and self-motivated, with the discipline to manage a high-volume outbound sales cadence while working remotely.

Desired Qualifications & Competencies

• Experience selling MarTech, affiliate marketing or partnership technology solutions.

• Experience working within a high-growth enterprise SaaS organisation.

• Proven success selling into retail, ecommerce or D2C brands.

• Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.

• Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms and modern sales engagement tools.

US Benefits & Perks

• Flexible Time Off Policy – Take the time you need.

• Enhanced Parental Leave: 16 weeks for birth parents and 8 weeks for non-birth parents at full pay after one year of employment.

• Robust company-sponsored Health & Welfare Benefits.

• 401(k) Plan with a 4% company match.

• Enhanced Wellness Programme, including access to an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), Wellness Coaching and Wellness Fridays.

• Regular company events and activities.

Compensation Range

USD $150,000–$180,000 base salary + commission package

Our salary range is intended to cover roles across the United States. An individual's base salary will be determined based on factors including geographic location, relevant experience, skills, knowledge and overall qualifications.

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization’s success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

jobs.title: Technical Campaign Manager, Programmatic Sales Operations
jobs.location: New York, NEW YORK, United States
jobs.description:
NBCUniversal’s Advertising Products & Solutions team is responsible for the product development, project management, and day-to-day operations of NBCUniversal’s full advertising technology suite. The division services both internal and external customers in support of NBCUniversal’s $8B annual advertising business.

The Programmatic Ad Operations team within Business Operations & Services is a close-knit, fast-paced team tasked with executing all programmatic guaranteed and private marketplace deals domestically and globally. The Programmatic Sales Operations Technical Campaign Manager oversees post-launch delivery and troubleshooting for programmatic deals. This involves ensuring campaigns are pacing toward their goals, identifying delivery blockers, and providing actionable recommendations to help clients optimize performance and scale effectively.

The Programmatic Sales Operations team works side-by-side with the planning and sales team to ensure that advertising campaigns run smoothly and exceed client expectations. We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically savvy, problem solver with superior customer service skills and leadership qualities to join our team.

Responsibilities

• Identifying technical issues with bids for guaranteed and non-guaranteed deal types, and working with appropriate cross-functional teams to find a timely resolution
• Lead live troubleshooting calls with clients, alongside Campaign Manager counterpart
• Attend weekly POD meetings to ensure sales, planning, and operations are in lockstep
• Setup regularly cadenced reporting to identify trends amongst creative failures within various ad distributors/ DSPs
• Must seek to gain knowledge within the Programmatic ecosystem to better support our internal and external partners
• Direct interaction with Programmatic Sales Team and Clients to ensure campaign fulfillment
• Advanced knowledge on programmatic deal setup within various SSPs, such as FreeWheel and Google Ad Manager

• Bachelor’s degree is required
• 2+ years of experience in Digital Sales Operations
• Understanding of programmatic advertising ecosystem

Eligibility Requirements

• Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States
• Desire to work in the entertainment media industry, which requires availability during weekends if we are supporting a live event
• Must be 18 years or older

Desired Characteristics

• Excellent client relationship & interpersonal skills
• Prior experience trafficking in DSP and/or SSP
• Interest in DSP nuances a plus
• Fluency in the language of digital media: impressions, CTR, CPMs, eCPMs, etc.
• Keen problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities
• Strong verbal/written communication skills and the ability to prioritize tasks
• Must be self-motivated and able to work independently as well as part of a team
• Must be organized and detail oriented with great attention to accuracy

Additional Requirements

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

Salary range: $70,000 - $90,000

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

You can submit your request to AccessibilitySupport@nbcuni.com.

jobs.title: People Operations Partner, Benefit & Leave
jobs.location: New York, NY / Dallas, TX / Livingston, NJ
jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.

About the Role

CoreWeave is seeking a Senior People Operations Partner to own benefits, leave of absence, and accommodation administration across the United States and Canada. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Employee Lifecycle, you will run these programs day to day, accurately and compliantly, while partnering with Total Rewards, People Business Partners, Payroll, Legal, People Systems, and our brokers, carriers, and vendors.

This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role. You will serve as the subject matter expert for benefits and leave operations in the region and the primary contact for our leave, benefits, and COBRA vendors. Total Rewards owns benefits strategy and plan design; you own how those plans and policies are executed.

What You’ll Do

US benefits administration

• Own new-hire and life-event enrollments, eligibility, qualifying-event reviews, dependent verification, and open enrollment execution, maintaining clean data in Workday and at every carrier.

• Monitor carrier and vendor EDI feeds and reconcile discrepancies before they reach employees.

• Partner with Payroll on deductions, imputed income, and arrears so pay and coverage match.

Leave of absence and accommodations

• Administer the full US leave lifecycle, including FMLA eligibility and designation, state PFML and disability programs, STD and LTD coordination, USERRA, intermittent leave tracking, benefits continuation during leave, and return to work.

• Run the accommodation interactive process under the ADA and PWFA, including intake, documentation requests, partnering with managers and PBPs on options, documenting decisions, and keeping medical information confidential and separate from personnel files.

Canada benefits and leave

• Administer group benefits enrollment and changes, EI leave coordination, employer top-ups, Records of Employment, and provincial employment standards leaves.

• Apply the duty to accommodate under provincial human rights law, to the point of undue hardship.

Vendors and compliance

• Manage day-to-day relationships with the leave and disability TPA, COBRA administrator, broker, and carriers; hold them to SLAs, escalate errors, and bring vendor performance data to Total Rewards.

• Support compliance cycles, including ACA reporting, COBRA and required benefits notices, Form 5500 data requests, and audit-ready leave and accommodation documentation.

• Support federal contractor obligations, including Section 503 and VEVRAA requirements.

Inquiries, playbooks, and continuous improvement

• Resolve Tier 2 and Tier 3 benefits, leave, and accommodation inquiries, escalating to Legal or Total Rewards when appropriate.

• Build and maintain leave and accommodation playbooks, including state and provincial leave matrices, manager guidance, and templated notices.

• Coach People Operations Specialists on benefits and leave questions.

• Identify and reduce manual work and friction, such as improving leave intake, EDI reconciliation, and automated reminders before a leave ends.

Who You Are

• You have 6–9+ years of experience in benefits administration, leave administration, or People Operations, with hands-on ownership of US benefits and leave.

• You have working knowledge of FMLA and multi-state leave, including state PFML and disability programs, CFRA and PDL, intermittent leave, and leave stacking.

• You have hands-on experience running the ADA interactive process and PWFA accommodations, with sound documentation and confidentiality practices.

• You have practical knowledge of COBRA, ACA employer reporting, HIPAA privacy for plan data, Section 125 qualifying events, and ERISA administrative requirements.

• You have Canadian benefits and leave experience, including group benefits, EI and top-up coordination, Records of Employment, provincial leaves, and the duty to accommodate.

• You have experience managing leave TPAs, COBRA administrators, brokers, and carriers, including EDI feed troubleshooting.

• You have Workday HCM experience in Benefits and Absence and can execute transactions accurately. This is a Workday user role, not a configuration role.

• You are proficient with Google Workspace and Slack.

Preferred qualifications

• Federal contractor experience, including Section 503 and VEVRAA self-identification and recordkeeping.

• Quebec benefits and leave experience.

• CEBS, CBP, or CLMS certification.

• Experience in operationally complex environments, such as data centers or mixed corporate and frontline workforces.

• Active use of AI tools in day-to-day work, with clear practices for protecting PHI and personal data.

“Wondering if you’re a good fit?”

We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk.

• You love connecting teams and ensuring every campaign runs smoothly from start to finish.

• You’re curious about how strategy, brand, creative, and execution all interlock to drive real business impact.

• You’re an expert at managing complex, multi-stakeholder projects and keeping everyone aligned without missing a detail.

Why CoreWeave?

At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:

• Be Curious at Your Core

• Act Like an Owner

• Empower Employees

• Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences

• Achieve More Together

We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for take off, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!

Compensation and benefits

The base salary range for this role is $127,000 to $168,000. The starting salary will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

What We Offer

The range we’ve posted represents the typical compensation range for this role. To determine actual compensation, we review the market rate for each candidate which can include a variety of factors. These include qualifications, experience, interview performance, and location.

In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs. The benefits below reflect our US-based offerings for full-time employees; for roles in other locations, benefits vary and are shared during the hiring process. These include:

• Medical, dental, and vision insurance - 100% paid for by CoreWeave

• Company-paid Life Insurance

• Voluntary supplemental life insurance

• Short and long-term disability insurance

• Flexible Spending Account

• Health Savings Account

• Tuition Reimbursement

• Ability to Participate in Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

• Mental Wellness Benefits through Spring Health

• Family-Forming support provided by Carrot

• Paid Parental Leave

• Flexible, full-service childcare support with Kinside

• 401(k) with a generous employer match

• Flexible PTO

• Catered lunch each day in our office and data center locations

• A casual work environment

• A work culture focused on innovative disruption

California Applicants

California Consumer Privacy Act

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

As part of this commitment and consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), CoreWeave will ensure that qualified applicants and candidates with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations for the hiring process, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed, please contact: careers@coreweave.com.

Export Control Compliance

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

jobs.title: Social Worker - Mental Health team
jobs.description:
Liquid Personnel is recruiting Social Worker for its client's Mental Health team at Sefton.

What will your responsibilities be?

• Undertake comprehensive mental health and social care assessments to identify individuals’ needs, strengths, risks and desired outcomes.

• Develop, implement and review person-centred care and support plans that promote recovery, independence and wellbeing.

• Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams, including psychiatrists, community psychiatric nurses, psychologists, occupational therapists and other professionals.

• Apply relevant legislation, including the Care Act 2014, Mental Health Act 1983 (as amended) and Mental Capacity Act 2005.

• Undertake safeguarding enquiries and respond appropriately to concerns relating to abuse, neglect, exploitation and self-neglect.

• Assess and manage risk, including risks relating to suicide, self-harm, harm to others, vulnerability and deterioration in mental health.

• Support individuals to access appropriate community services, housing, welfare benefits, advocacy and other resources to promote social inclusion.

• Work in partnership with individuals, families, carers and other agencies to support recovery and improve outcomes.

• Contribute to discharge planning and ensure safe transitions between inpatient, community and other care settings.

jobs.title: Area Director, DC
jobs.description:
MISSION

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. 

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.



Overview

As the Clinic Area Lead, DC, you will be accountable for bringing Neko Health’s operating model, culture, and member‑first standards to life across a growing portfolio of clinics in DC.

This role sits at the intersection of leadership, execution, and local adaptation — ensuring that global ways of working translate into consistently high‑quality experiences on the ground, while continuing to mature and evolve as we scale.

Neko Health has now entered the US market starting with New York with a clear operating philosophy, emerging global processes, clinical standards, and service principles already in place ready to scale across the US. While these are still being built and refined, the role is firmly focused on adoption rather than reinvention — shaping how these ways of working show up locally, strengthening them through practical execution, and enabling teams to operate with increasing confidence, consistency, and care.

Reporting to the Country Leader, US, you will own regional performance end‑to‑end — from pre‑opening readiness through sustained multi‑site operations. You will act as the cultural and operational anchor for Neko Health in DC, setting expectations, building capability, and establishing how clinics lead, operate, and serve members from day one.

 

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

 

Bring the operating model to life

 

 - Embed Neko Health’s operating model across the DC clinics, focusing on strong leadership behaviours, cultural norms, and consistent execution rather than net-new process design. Ensure global standard are understood, embraced and brought to life in day-to-day clinic operations

 - Lead the successful local adoption of existing playbooks and standards, tailoring them thoughtfully to local regulations, team dynamics, and member expectations while preserving the integrity of Neko’s global member experience.

 - Create strong clinic‑level leadership capability by coaching managers and clinical leads on how to translate standards into practice — setting clear expectations, reinforcing accountability, and role‑modelling a member‑first mindset.

 - Operationalise readiness for new clinic openings by ensuring teams are culturally aligned, well‑trained, and confident in executing established processes, with clear ownership of go‑live success and early performance.

 - Establish clear performance rhythms (metrics, reviews, feedback loops) that reinforce behaviours, surface issues early, and continuously improve both team effectiveness and the member experience.

 - Partner closely with the Country Leader, US and central teams to ensure the global operating model works in practice locally — identifying where light adaptation is required and driving disciplined, high‑quality implementation at scale.

 
 

Clinic & Member Experience

 - Ensure each clinic consistently delivers a seamless, premium member experience aligned with Neko Health's service standards and brand promise.

 - Lead regional initiatives to elevate service quality based on member feedback, NPS insights, and frontline observations, iterating playbooks in real time as you learn.

 - Foster a hospitality-driven culture where empathy, professionalism, and precision define every member interaction — and where that culture is embedded through training, not just expectation.

 - Oversee the physical and experiential standards of all clinics — ensuring consistency in ambiance, cleanliness, and overall presentation across a growing portfolio.

 

Medical Quality & Compliance

 - Partner with Lead Doctors to build and uphold Neko's clinical quality standards in the US context — ensuring adherence to federal and state regulatory requirements from the ground up.

 - Drive continuous improvement in medical delivery and inspection readiness across all sites, establishing audit-ready documentation and escalation protocols.

 - Serve as the bridge between clinic operations and the Medical Excellence team, ensuring best practices are embedded regionally through structured processes rather than informal norms.

 - Mentor and develop Lead Doctors and Clinic Leads, building their leadership capabilities and accountability for quality outcomes.

 

Operational & Financial Performance

 - Own regional operational KPIs and full P&L accountability — building the financial frameworks alongside the clinics themselves, not inheriting them.

 - Design scalable operational frameworks, cost controls, and workflow efficiencies that can flex as the DC portfolio grows from four clinics to more.

 - Oversee workforce planning and staffing models in collaboration with central teams — building hiring profiles, ramp plans, and scheduling logic suited to demand patterns.

 - Contribute to regional business strategy, including market expansion planning, new clinic launches, and network optimisation — as someone who has been in the room from the start.

 

Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

 - Recruit, onboard, lead, and coach a team of Clinic Leads and Lead Physicians across all assigned clinics — many of whom you will hire yourself.

 - Build a strong culture of accountability, communication, and collaboration across distributed teams from day one, establishing the norms and rituals that will define how the DC team works.

 - Act as the primary regional liaison between clinic teams and central functions — including Customer Support, Facilities, Workforce Planning, People Operations, Talent Acquisition, and working closely with the Market Activation Lead, DC

 - Champion cross-functional alignment to ensure smooth execution and a unified member and employee experience, acting as the voice of DC into the broader organisation.

 

Minimum Qualifications

 - Proven experience in a senior operational leadership role (Area Director, Regional Director, District Leader, General Manager or equivalent) within a premium, consumer‑facing, multi‑site environment such as premium healthcare‑adjacent, wellness, fitness or technology‑enabled services with physical operations/stores.

 - Ability to be based and/or local travel distance to Washington, DC as this role will be based across all the sites. 

 - Demonstrated success implementing and embedding established operating models, standards, and playbooks across multiple locations — driving adoption through leadership, coaching, and accountability rather than documentation alone.

 - Strong track record leading clinic‑level or site‑level leaders, with the ability to build capability, reinforce culture, and translate standards into consistent day‑to‑day execution.

 - Experience operating in regulated environments, with accountability for quality, compliance, and inspection readiness, ideally in partnership with medical or clinical leadership.

 - Proven financial and operational acumen, including ownership of regional KPIs, budgets, and P&L performance in a scaling context.

 - Ability to balance strategic perspective with hands‑on execution, particularly during periods of growth, new site openings, and organisational change.

 - Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with confidence operating in a matrixed, fast‑moving organisation across central and regional teams.

 - Comfort leading through ambiguity and change, with a bias toward action, continuous improvement, and disciplined execution.

jobs.title: Label Machine Operator - 2nd Shift
jobs.description:
This role will be on 2nd Shift, 2PM-10:30PM M-F.

The hourly rate for this position is $17.79 - $23.72 / hour.

About the Role Are you a mechanically inclined problem-solver who takes pride in quality and precision? Join our team as a Label Machine Operator! In this role, you will own the operation of our label manufacturing equipment, ensuring production runs smoothly, safely, and efficiently to meet customer demand.

What You’ll Do

• Operate & Maintain: Set up, calibrate, and run label machines according to daily job schedules and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Maintain and handle dies carefully to ensure continuous line performance.
• Troubleshoot & Improve: Monitor equipment for accuracy and quality. Identify root causes of malfunctions and partner with supervisors to resolve production issues.
• Inventory & Systems: Log raw materials accurately in the ERP system using FIFO (First-In, First-Out) methods to minimize waste and track quality control.
• Safety & Workplace: Maintain a clean, safe, and organized workstation. Strictly follow all plant safety rules, policies, and required PPE guidelines.
• Team Collaboration: Assist with distribution tasks and support team members across shifts when needed.

What You Bring

• Experience: 1–2 years of experience in machine operation, manufacturing, or mechanical equipment setup.
• Mechanical Aptitude: Strong troubleshooting skills with a drive to understand equipment operation.
• Attention to Detail: Ability to distinguish colors, read fine measurements, and perform visual quality checks at close range (20 inches or less).
• Physical Stamina: Comfortable standing most of the shift, reaching, and safely lifting up to 50 lbs.
• Education: High School Diploma or GED.

The hiring wage rate range above represents what Avery Dennison reasonably expects to pay for this position as of the date of this posting. Actual salaries will vary within the range. In some circumstances, this may be above or below the range (based on various factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate’s relevant skills, experience, education and training, location, as well as the job scope and complexity, responsibilities, and regular and/or necessary travel required for the position). That may change, depending on the candidate pool. Avery Dennison reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable laws.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or other protected status. EEOE/M/F/Vet/Disabled. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

These checks are conducted post-offer and are a condition of employment. All results will be considered in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws.

jobs.title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Business Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina. Guiados por um propósito compartilhado de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram, contamos com um portfólio diversificado de marcas e soluções, em diferentes países da América Latina, que contemplam todas as fases da jornada do morar e ainda um Hub de Tecnologia em Portugal. Desenvolvemos tecnologias e inovação para transformar e impulsionar a experiência de moradia como um todo.

Com o apoio de uma equipe de classe mundial de investidores e consultores, como Kaszek, Qualcomm, General Atlantic e SoftBank, o Grupo QuintoAndar está atualmente avaliado em mais de US$ 5,1 bilhões e continua a crescer ano após ano.

Aqui você trabalhará com os melhores profissionais do mercado, em um ambiente que respira inovação, colaboração e alto desempenho. Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse https://grupoquintoandar.com/pt/

Localização & Modelo de Trabalho

• Modelo: Híbrido (encontros presenciais mensais com o time em São Paulo).

• Jornada: Segunda a sexta-feira.

• Horário: Comercial, com flexibilidade.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

As etapas dos nossos processos seletivos têm como objetivo avaliar suas experiências e oferecer a você a oportunidade de conhecer nossos times e oportunidades de carreira, sendo estruturadas da seguinte forma:

• Entrevista com People;

• Entrevista com Hiring Manager;

• Case;

• Entrevista com Stakeholder;

• Offer o/

Sobre a Área

O time de Business Operations (BizOps) do QuintoAndar é responsável por fazer as principais métricas do negócio de compra e venda (For Sale) acontecerem. Para isso, executa a estratégia junto com diversas áreas da empresa.

O time atua em três frentes:

• Encontrar e dimensionar oportunidades: entender dados e clientes a fundo para descobrir onde estão os problemas e as alavancas de crescimento.

• Comunicar e consolidar: construir planos junto às áreas envolvidas e criar as governanças para acompanhá-los.

• Facilitar a execução: atuar como co-owner do resultado ao lado dos times que executam.

Requisitos

Obrigatórios

• Formação superior completa em Administração, Engenharia, Economia ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência em funções analíticas com forte visão de negócio, como Business Operations, Business Analyst, Strategy, Consultoria ou Planejamento.

• Capacidade analítica e estruturação de problemas, com autonomia para conduzir investigações sem se perder.

• Domínio de Excel / Google Sheets.

• Facilidade para lidar com ambiguidade e com mudanças frequentes de prioridade.

jobs.title: Supervisor, Phone Operations
jobs.description:
Supervisor, Phone Operations

Location: North Macedonia & Pristina, Kosovo

We believe independent restaurants deserve the same advantages as big chains without giving up their independence.

Ilir Sela started Slice in his family’s pizzerias, where he saw firsthand what it takes to run a local shop. Now we’re taking everything we’ve learned beyond pizza, to taquerias, delis, burger joints, and other neighborhood staples.

We put technology, marketing, buying power, and support to work for more than 15,000 restaurants, so owners spend less time on admin, marketing, and order management and more time growing their business. They remain independent, but never alone.

We’re growing our team to help bring this next chapter to life. That’s where you come in.

The Challenge to Solve

Build and lead customer-obsessed teams that help thousands of independent pizzerias never miss an order.

The Role

As a Supervisor for our Phone team, you'll lead a team of Community Team Leads and oversee day-to-day operations across multiple pods and shifts. You'll be responsible for driving performance, building accountability, and creating consistency across the operation so every team delivers a great experience to both our restaurant partners and their customers.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who loves coaching people, solving problems, and using data to drive results. You'll spend your time developing Team Leads, improving operational performance, managing escalations, and ensuring the systems, processes, and expectations that drive a high-performing operation are consistently executed.

Most importantly, you'll be relentlessly focused on the customer experience. Every missed call is a missed opportunity for one of our restaurant partners. You'll lead teams that understand what's at stake and take pride in delivering a great experience on every interaction.

Key focus areas include:

• Coaching, developing, and holding Team Leads accountable through regular 1:1s, feedback, and performance management.

• Driving operational performance across pods and shifts, including service levels, answer rates, staffing execution, and adherence.

• Creating consistency across coaching, QA, scorecards, and performance expectations.

• Managing escalations across teams and shifts while identifying root causes and driving long-term solutions.

• Partnering with GTM, Implementations, Product, and Operations teams to improve the experience for our restaurant partners.

• Supporting onboarding and hypercare efforts for new Phones customers.

• Monitoring timecards, attendance, and workforce management metrics to ensure operational reliability.

• Building a culture of accountability, ownership, teamwork, and customer obsession.

• Partnering with People Business Partners to address employee relations and performance matters.

• Providing feedback and recommendations that improve processes, tools, and the overall Phones experience.

The Team

The Phone team exists to make life easier for independent pizzeria owners. By handling phone orders on their behalf, we help restaurants focus on making great food, serving customers, and growing their businesses. You'll play a critical role in helping us deliver on that promise every day.

The Winning Recipe

• Customer obsessed. You understand that every missed call can mean a missed order for a small business owner, and you build teams that treat every interaction accordingly.

• 2+ years of operational leadership experience with a strong track record of coaching and developing people.

• Experience leading frontline teams in a contact center, customer support, operations, or service environment.

• Strong performance management skills and experience holding teams accountable to high standards.

• Comfortable using operational metrics and dashboards to identify issues, spot trends, and drive action.

• Experience managing Team Leads, Supervisors, or other frontline leaders.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to engage effectively with senior leaders and restaurant owners.

• Familiarity with contact center technology, including phone systems, CRMs, workforce management, or messaging tools.

• Intermediate proficiency with Google Workspace tools, including Sheets, Docs, Gmail, and Slack.

• English proficiency at C1 level or higher, both written and spoken.

• Willingness to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends as needed.

Nice to Have

• Experience managing organizations of 50+ employees through multiple layers of leadership.

• Experience in workforce management, scheduling, or capacity planning.

• Experience supporting operational process improvement initiatives.

• Experience in a high-growth technology, marketplace, or customer operations environment.

The Extras

At Slice, you'll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on thousands of independent businesses while building your career alongside talented teammates who care deeply about our mission.

Pizza brings people together. Slice is no different. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.
