jobs.title: Nuclear Treaties Subject Matter Expert
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

ANSER enhances national and homeland security by strengthening public institutions. We provide thought leadership for complex issues through independent analysis, and we deliver practical, useful solutions. ANSER values collaboration, integrity, and initiative and we are client focused in all that we do. Because we were established for the purpose of public service and not for profit, we measure our success in the impact of our service.

Position Summary:
Analytic Services, Inc. (ANSER) is actively hiring for a Nuclear Treaties Subject Matter Expert (SME) to provide direct support to the Headquarters United States Air Force, Directorate of Strategic Deterrence and Nuclear Integration (AF/A10). In this key role, you will provide technical, analytical, and policy support for the implementation of and compliance with international arms control treaties and agreements.

This position does not offer a hybrid or remote work schedule with all job duties performed full-time onsite at Joint Base Anacostia-Bolling (JBAB) in Washington, DC with occasional site visits to the Pentagon as required.

Day to Day Responsibilities:

• Serve as the primary point of contact and subject matter expert for all Air Force nuclear treaty requirements, providing guidance on treaty implementation compliance concepts and issues.

• Provide historical background, analysis of treaty implications, and recommendations on all nuclear treaty matters to the Air Force senior leaders and staff.

• Provide subject matter expertise to support implementation, training, and compliance activities for all arms control agreements affecting Department of the Air Force (DAF) operations.

• Research, review, and analyze the policy and technical aspects of in-force and contemplated arms control treaties to support the development of implementation and compliance guidance.

• Draft, review, and coordinate documents representing Air Force positions on treaty issues, including policy instructions, summaries, briefings, and responses to higher headquarters taskings.

• Support the formulation of Air Force positions within the Department of Defense, the U.S. Government interagency process, and international forums.

• Review and track Air Force acquisition programs and concepts of operation to ensure compliance with in-force treaties and agreements.

• Develop and execute training materials, exercises, and courses to prepare Air Force personnel for treaty implementation and verification activities.

Required Qualifications:

• Possess an active TS/SCI security clearance.

• Bachelor's degree in international relations, national security studies, or other related field.

• 15+ years of experience working with nuclear arms control treaties.

• Expert knowledge of nuclear arms control concepts, objectives, and history.

• Knowledge of Air Staff, Joint Staff (JS), and Office of the Secretary of Defense (OSD) organization, roles, and responsibilities with respect to New START Treaty (NST) requirements.

• Experience providing brief recommendations and analysis to a wide audience, from senior leaders to action officers.

• Ability to travel within and outside of the U.S., as needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master's degree in international relations, national security studies, or a related field.

• Experience serving as a technical advisor on a U.S. Delegation for arms control negotiations or implementation bodies (e.g., Bilateral Consultative Commission (BCC), Joint Compliance and Inspection Commission (JCIC), Special Verification Commission (SVC)).

• Knowledge of and hands-on experience with the Arms Control Enterprise System (ACES) and Information and Resources Support System (IRSS).

• Experience working with interagency partners, such as the Department of State and the Defense Threat Reduction Agency, on arms control policy and compliance issues.

• Experience as a national escort or inspector for on-site inspections under an arms control treaty.

Individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including but not limited to: business considerations, local market, internal equity, candidate qualifications such as skills, education and experience. ANSER provides employees benefits to support all aspects of their life including health, financial and well-being. For more information, please visit: http://www.anser.org

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
Hi, I'm Brayden, Founder at Sola, and I'll be leading the hiring for this role.

Sola owns every layer of insurance, from pricing with weather data to paying claims, and thousands of independent agents now trust us to protect their clients' homes. Almost all of those agencies found us through word of mouth, and as we grow beyond wind and hail into broader home coverage, the agencies that already sell Sola are the heart of our business. We're looking for an Account Manager who will treat a book of those agencies as their own, help them win more with Sola every month, and show our newer teammates what great partnership looks like.

I look forward to meeting you,

Brayden



TL;DR

 - Role: Account Manager

 - Level: Mid-level individual contributor, one step above Associate Account Manager

 - Key focus: Owning and growing a book of independent agency partners

 - Location: West Midtown, Atlanta, GA


THE ROLE

We're hiring an Account Manager to own a book of active independent agency partners and grow what they write with Sola. The job is to become the person each of your agencies calls first, keep Sola part of their everyday sales conversations, and turn quiet agencies into consistent producers.

You are someone who has already owned a set of accounts or partners on your own, who measures your work by retention and growth, and who enjoys being both a trusted advisor and a problem solver. This is not a traditional service desk role where you wait for tickets, and it is not a hunting role focused on signing new agencies, since our Territory Sales Managers bring partners in and you help them thrive.

You should constantly be:

 - Checking in with your agencies by phone, video and in person so they feel confident quoting Sola

 - Spotting which agencies are slowing down and acting before they go quiet

 - Training agents on our product, tools and process so selling Sola feels easy

 - Solving escalations quickly with our underwriting, claims and product teams

 - Bringing what you hear from agencies back to the team so we keep improving

You'll work closely with the rest of Account Management, our Territory Sales Managers and our product team, and you'll help build the playbook that the next wave of Associate Account Managers learns from.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - A defined book of active independent agencies and their retention with Sola

 - Growth in quotes and policies written across your book

 - A regular cadence of check-ins, reviews and agency visits

 - Agent training on Sola's product, quoting tools and process

 - Fast, complete resolution of agency escalations across teams

 - Clean CRM records and a clear view of the health of every account

 - Agency feedback shared with product and leadership

 - Day-to-day coaching for Associate Account Managers who shadow your work


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR


MUST-HAVES

 - Experience owning a book of accounts or partners yourself in account management, customer success or a partner-facing role, typically two to four years

 - Real results in retaining and growing accounts that you can walk us through with numbers

 - A steady, self-driven cadence for check-ins, follow-ups and escalations

 - Strong CRM habits and the instinct to use data to decide where to spend your time

 - Clear, warm communication with business owners on the phone, in writing and in person

 - Curiosity, coachability and low ego, with a habit of asking why

 - Based in Atlanta or open to relocating, and someone who enjoys building alongside the team in person. We work together from our West Midtown office five days a week because we've found that our best ideas, fastest problem solving and closest working relationships come from being in the same room.


STRONG PLUS

 - Experience working with independent insurance agents, brokers or another reseller channel

 - Time at an early-stage startup where you helped build the process

 - Experience training customers or coaching junior teammates

 - Comfort using dashboards, simple analysis or AI tools to manage a book


NOT A FIT

 - You prefer a support role where someone else owns the relationship and the growth goal

 - You want a pure new business hunting role

 - You need a fully built playbook before you can perform

 - You are looking for a remote or hybrid schedule


BENEFITS & PERKS

 - Stock options, so you share in what you help build

 - 100% paid medical, dental & vision insurance for you and your family

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Daily lunches and snacks in the office

 - Regular team dinners, happy hours and other evenings out, because we genuinely enjoy spending time together beyond the workday


OUR VALUES

 - We are a team of owners. Every role at Sola has a direct and measurable impact on the success of the company.

 - The best idea always wins. We leave egos at the door, no matter the title.

 - Always raise the bar. Our goal: improve at least 1% every day.

 - Customer and partner driven. Our north star is delivering the best experience to the people we serve.

 - Results focused. We're a hands-on, results-oriented team with a bias for action.

 - Ask why, stay curious. Curiosity drives progress. We question the status quo and learn every day.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Sola Technologies Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Freelance Business Analyst (Data)
jobs.description:
This is a freelance position: Expected project duration is 6 months, starting as soon as possible, full-time.

Why Valtech? We’re the experience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

• The work we do and the innovation we drive

• Our values of share, care and dare

• A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy

• Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

We are looking for a Business Analyst (Data) to join the delivery squad building a Loyalty Revenue Accounting solution on Databricks. The solution takes data from the Loyalty platform and other source systems and produces the accounting outputs Finance needs, including journals and reports. You will define the data requirements, business logic and mapping rules that the data engineers build from, and keep them current as requirements evolve.

You will thrive in this role if you are:

• A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo

• A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing

• Excited by the intersection of technology, finance and data

• Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role responsibilities

• Define and document data requirements for a data platform solution, working closely with Product Teams from Finance, Loyalty and architecture stakeholders

• Define business logic in precise, testable terms, including calculations, allocations and rules for how transactions are treated

• Produce source-to-target mapping specifications, covering field-level mappings, transformations and reference data

• Write clear requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria in Jira, with enough detail for engineers to build from and testers to validate against

• Maintain traceability from business need through requirements to mappings and design, and keep documentation up to date as requirements change

• Identify gaps, edge cases and anomalies early, and raise them with options and impact

• Work with the product manager, data engineers, architects and QE through delivery, answering questions and validating what is built against the requirements

• Support walkthroughs and sign-off with Finance and other business stakeholders

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

• Proven experience as a Business Analyst on data-focused projects, such as data platforms, data warehouses or data migration – a must

• Experience defining both business logic and data mapping logic, not only high-level process requirements – a must

• Strong written requirements skills, including writing and managing requirements in Jira

• Ability to read and reason about data structures, tables and fields, with working knowledge of SQL

• Strong communication skills, able to work with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Experience working in an agile delivery team where requirements iterate

Nice to have qualifications

• Experience with Databricks or a similar cloud data platform

• Experience in finance, revenue accounting or accounting journals

• Experience with loyalty, airline or travel data

• Familiarity with event-driven or streaming data sources

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
Hi, I’m Brayden, Founder at Sola, 

Millions of homeowners can no longer get affordable home insurance, and the process is often confusing, slow, and frustrating. We invented a first-of-its-kind weather data-driven wind and hail policy that reduces fraud and enables more people to get covered at a price that actually makes sense.

We are already live, growing fast, and partnering with thousands of agencies. Now we need to scale the software experience to match the opportunity.

At Sola, you will design the product experience that enables agents to protect more homeowners and move faster, and helps people get through claims with confidence and clarity. If you love building simple, high-quality software that real people depend on, I look forward to meeting you.

Brayden

----


TLDR CHECKLIST

✓ In person. Nice West Midtown Atlanta office with skyline views + daily catering + snacks

✓ Startup environment. 20 employees, ground floor opportunity with equity.

✓ Hyper growth. 400%+ since May

✓ Flat structure. No layers upon layers of management. Work directly with leadership

✓ Long-term vision. This is the founder's life's work; we're building for decades

---

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

In this role, you will own product interface design across our ecosystem, including agent tools, policyholder experiences, and internal platforms. You will work closely with product and engineering from discovery through implementation, shaping flows, interactions, and systems that prioritize clarity, consistency, and long-term quality.

This role has meaningful ownership over core product surfaces and will help shape how Sola’s platform evolves as we scale.

You will also contribute to the patterns and design systems that allow Sola to scale while maintaining a high bar for usability and visual craft.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Design and ship clear, intuitive product interfaces across multiple user types

 - Own end-to-end user flows from concept through implementation

 - Partner closely with product managers and engineers to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints

 - Use research, testing, and product metrics to inform and improve designs

 - Contribute to and evolve Sola’s design system and shared UI patterns

 - Maintain a high standard of interface quality across visual design, interaction design, and usability
   
    


YOU’LL FIT RIGHT IN IF YOU

 - Have 3+ years of experience as an in-house product designer working on shipped products

 - Have a portfolio demonstrating strong product thinking and interface design, especially in simplifying complex systems

 - Can design across levels of fidelity from high-level flows to detailed interactions

 - Bring a structured approach to design using research, principles, and clear rationale

 - Have experience collaborating closely with product managers, engineers, and designers

 - Understand how design supports adoption, usability, and long-term product quality

 - Communicate clearly and present your work well

 - Have strong visual and interface design skills focused on hierarchy, clarity, and consistency


WHAT YOU BRING

 - Experience designing complex, data-driven products or interfaces with multiple user types

 - Experience contributing to or evolving a design system across multiple product surfaces

 - Strong collaboration with engineers to ensure designs are feasible, maintainable, and consistent

 - Familiarity with accessibility and responsive design best practices

 - Experience with modern design and prototyping tools such as Figma or similar

 - Experience creating prototypes using code or code-adjacent tools (Cursor, Framer, React, or similar) to validate complex interactions


BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary with bonus ($100k-$125k)

 - Stock options

 - Medical, dental & vision insurance

 - Unlimited PTO

 - Dynamic work culture that promotes growth, collaboration, and risk-taking
   
    

 


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

You’ll be joining a team that’s reimagining an industry most people find frustrating. While traditional insurance companies are stuck in outdated processes, you’ll help build software that agents and homeowners actually want to use.

This is a chance to make a real impact in a space that affects millions of people, while working with cutting-edge technology in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

Ready to help us change how people think about insurance?

jobs.title: Thought Leader Liaison
jobs.location: East Coast, United States; Jersey City, New Jersey
jobs.description:
Company introduction:

Compass Pathways plc (Nasdaq: CMPS) is a biotechnology company dedicated to unlocking urgently needed new treatment options in mental health care.

The Company is headquartered in London, UK, with a U.S. office in New Jersey. We believe mental health patients deserve the possibility of a better future. Our initial focus is developing COMP360 psilocybin, a proprietary, investigational, synthetic psilocybin treatment under evaluation for treatment-resistant depression (TRD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). COMP360 is a potentially first-in-class treatment and has Breakthrough Therapy designation from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), as well as Innovative Licensing and Access Pathway (ILAP) designation in the UK for TRD.

We are leading the world’s largest classic psychedelic clinical program in TRD, and building upon that robust foundation, we are executing a late-stage trial evaluating COMP360 for PTSD, another condition with high unmet need. Our goal is to advance treatments that move the field of psychiatry towards treatment options that offer rapid onset and sustained durability with infrequent dosing. - Compass Pathways

Job overview:

The Thought Leader Liaison (TLL) is a field-based commercial role responsible for developing and executing regional engagement strategies with key opinion leaders (KOLs), emerging thought leaders, and professional societies to support the future commercialization of COMP360.

As an extension of the Compass Marketing team, the TLL gathers actionable marketplace insights, serves as a critical link between regional stakeholders and headquarters, and helps inform brand strategy and launch readiness. Through compliant, customer-centric engagement and cross-functional collaboration, the TLL supports strategic decision-making, identifies partnership opportunities, and delivers a cohesive stakeholder experience that advances organizational goals and improves patient outcomes.

This role involves significant travel to national and regional medical congresses, professional society meetings, advisory boards, field engagements, and cross-functional business meetings.

You mentor consultants across the practice, drive integration and performance best practices, and proactively surface risks, dependencies, and improvement opportunities across the solutions you own.

jobs.title: Manager, Learner Services & Experiences
jobs.description:
The Organization: Meritus College

Meritus College is a new kind of not-for-profit online college, built from the ground up to meet the needs of working adults and career-changers who’ve been overlooked by traditional higher education.

The problem is clear: only 33% of Pell grant recipients complete their degrees at two-year colleges within six years. College has become too rigid, too expensive, and too disconnected from both student realities and career outcomes. Meritus College is different. Our online, asynchronous programs and "workplace as laboratory" approach allow students to learn and apply new skills directly to their jobs, while receiving personalized support from dedicated coaches every step of the way. We focus on real-world skills and stackable credentials in high-demand fields, ensuring graduates are prepared for today's jobs and tomorrow's opportunities. Founded in 2025 with an inaugural Associate of Applied Science in Technology and Innovation degree, Meritus College is building a mainstream pathway to economic mobility—one designed not for the privileged few, but for the talented many who’ve too often been left behind.

Role Overview

At Meritus College, learner support is not a collection of disconnected services - it is a coordinated system designed to remove barriers, accelerate progress, and ensure every learner has access to the resources they need to succeed.

The Manager, Learner Services & Experiences, is responsible for ensuring that this system functions seamlessly. This role oversees the full ecosystem of learner support services, including academic advising, tutoring, wellness, accessibility, and library services. These services are delivered through a combination of AI-powered tools and external partners. This role ensures that services are available, accessible, high-quality, and effectively integrated into the learner experience. As Meritus College continues to build, you will own the learner services system end to end, setting the standards for how services are delivered and holding providers, tools, and processes to them.

The Manager, Learner Services & Experiences, serves as the central coordination point across services and as the primary escalation point for complex learner needs. They work closely with Learner Success Partners (coaches), instructors, instructor and program design team, and external providers to ensure learners are connected to the right support at the right time. This role reports to the Director of Instruction and Learner Experience.

This is a high-ownership, systems-oriented role designed for scale.  It is a player-coach role that combines hands-on ownership of learner services with program management for the work: translating priorities into plans, coordinating providers and dependencies, tracking work, and building the service standards, policies, and workflows that do not yet exist. The Learner Success Partners (LSPs) report to this role. Because Meritus College is a small, collaborative team, you will lead as a working member of it: handling complex learner situations alongside LSPs, building shared coaching practices with them, and supporting their day-to-day work and growth.

You will be the connective point between how learner services are designed and how learners experience them. Working with the Manager, Instruction and Program Design, you will use what LSPs and service providers see in live delivery to improve services, policies, and courses rather than waiting for a formal review cycle.

Responsibilities

The responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following:

Program and Project Management (15%):

• Own the learner services portion of the instruction and learner support workplan, in coordination with the Manager, Instruction and Program Design, maintaining projects, milestones, owners, timelines, and statuses

• Coordinate the learner services operating rhythm: facilitate team meetings and internal reviews, set agendas, document decisions and next steps, and ensure follow-through

• Represent learner services in Functional Lead syncs within Meritus College, raising progress, asks, dependencies, decisions needed, and wins

• Define and report learner services metrics (e.g., service use, time to resolution, learner satisfaction, persistence) to College leadership

• Make staffing, capacity, and budget recommendations as enrollment grows, including LSP caseload ratios and vendor capacity

Learner Services Operations (20%):

• Ensure all learner support services are operational, accessible, and aligned with learner needs

• Create and maintain clear pathways for learners to access services such as academic advising, tutoring, wellness, and accessibility support

• Monitor service usage and identify trends in learner needs and barriers to access

• Continuously improve processes to create a seamless and intuitive learner experience

• Translate College model into a coordinated set of services spanning advising, academic support, wellness, career, coaching, and financial and child care resources

• Own the accommodations process end to end, from intake and documentation through approval, faculty notification, and record-keeping, in partnership with the Operations and Compliance team

• Create and maintain service standards, response-time expectations, and learner-facing guides so services are consistent, accessible, and usable at scale

Service Coordination & Escalation (15%):

• Serve as the primary escalation point for complex learner issues that require coordination across multiple services

• Partner with Learner Success Partners (coaches) to ensure learners are connected to the appropriate resources

• Ensure timely resolution of learner issues, maintain accurate documentation, and communicate with coaches and instructors

• Establish protocols for learner crises, wellness concerns, and other urgent situations, including when and how to involve College leadership and outside resources

• Manage the learner complaint and grievance process in partnership with the Compliance team, so complaints are documented, resolved, and tracked as accreditors and state regulators require

LSP Team Leadership & Support (15%):

• Serve as the day-to-day lead for the Learner Success Partners (LSPs): hold regular check-ins, help prioritize their work, and be their first call when a learner situation gets complicated

• Work with LSPs to build shared coaching practices (outreach, check-ins, referrals, and documentation), using case consultations and peer feedback to keep support consistent across learners

• Coordinate LSP caseloads with the team, balancing assignments as enrollment grows and learner needs shift

• Help onboard and train new LSPs on the learner services ecosystem, referral and escalation protocols, and FERPA and data privacy requirements

• Use shared team measures (e.g., learner contact rates, referral follow-through, persistence) to spot where learners need more support and where the team needs more capacity

Vendor & Tool Management (10%):

• Act as the primary liaison for external service providers including library and tutoring services, and AI-supported tools

• Monitor service performance and learner experience across vendors and tools

• Provide feedback and insights to improve service quality and effectiveness

• Partner with leadership to identify opportunities to enhance or expand services over time

• Manage vendor relationships end to end, including scoping, selection, contract terms and service-level expectations, performance reviews, and renewal recommendations

• Evaluate AI-enabled support tools before and after adoption, with safeguards for learner privacy and accuracy and clear handoffs to a person when a learner needs one

Process Design & Continuous Improvement (15%):

• Build and refine workflows for service access, triage, and escalation

• Identify gaps in the learner services ecosystem and build practical solutions

• Use learner feedback and data to inform improvements to services and processes

• Contribute to the long-term design of a scalable, high-impact learner support model

• Maintain learner services documentation (policies, procedures, service records, and outcome data) to a standard that holds up under accreditation review, in partnership with the Operations and Compliance team

Cross-Functional Collaboration (10%):

• Partner with the instruction team so learners get coordinated, consistent support.

• Provide guidance and clarity on how and when to utilize learner services

• Share insights and trends to inform learner experience improvements

• Partner with the Manager, Instruction and Program Design to turn what LSPs and service providers see in live delivery into course revisions, and to build learner services into courses where learners need them

• Partner with recruitment and enrollment on the handoff from admission to onboarding so new learners are connected to services and an LSP from day one

Skills and Competencies

We recognize that some individuals from underrepresented backgrounds may hesitate to apply if they don’t meet 100% of the listed qualifications.  Please don’t let that discourage you from applying! We value the unique skills, experiences, and perspectives that each applicant brings, and we encourage you to apply if you believe your background demonstrates the required skills and competencies:

Must Haves for all roles at Meritus College:

• Committed to Merit America’s mission to pave pathways to family-sustaining careers, break the poverty cycle, and create upward mobility for low-wage workers

• Demonstrated history of embodying our values, which inform our work and drive our organization's culture

• Shared sense of responsibility and ownership for our collective work in making a positive impact on the community we support, true to our value of Win & Lose Together

• Committed to continuous learning and growth in advancing inclusive excellence and closing gaps across lines of difference

• Passionate about fostering a workplace culture that embraces and values individual differences, aligned with our core value of inclusivity

Must Haves for this role:

Education

• Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree in higher education, counseling, or a related field preferred.

Experience

• 5+ years in student services, academic advising, coaching, or learner support, including designing or running support services for online, adult, or non-traditional learners

Systems Thinking & Operations

• Ability to manage and improve complex systems involving multiple stakeholders, tools, and processes

• Strong organizational and project management skills in fast-moving environments

• Experience building or refining processes to improve user experience

• Comfortable in a start-up environment, creating service standards, policies, and processes where none exist, and moving the work forward while building the system around it

Team Leadership

• Experience leading a team, formally or informally, ideally coaches, advisors, or other frontline support staff

• A collaborative leadership style: you build shared practices with colleagues, give and ask for direct feedback, and work through difficult learner situations alongside your team

Learner Support & Problem Solving

• Experience supporting learners, students, or participants in education, workforce, or customer-facing environments

• Familiarity with accessibility, accommodations, or wellness support frameworks

• Working knowledge of student data privacy laws and disability accommodation requirements (ADA/Section 504) in higher education, or the ability to get up to speed quickly

• Strong critical thinking skills to diagnose and resolve complex or ambiguous challenges

• Ability to navigate sensitive situations with empathy and sound judgment

Coordination & Communication

• Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills

• Ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholders, including external partners

• Clear, concise communication with both learners and internal teams

Data & Continuous Improvement

• Comfort using data and feedback to identify trends and inform decisions

• Ability to translate insights into actionable improvements

• Detail-oriented with strong follow-through

• Understands and can apply data privacy and data security framework to all sensitive learner data.

Nice to Haves for this role:

• Experience in higher education, student services, workforce development, or customer experience operations

• Experience working with external vendors or managing partnerships

• Experience working with or alongside AI-enabled tools or digital support systems

Other Logistics

• This position is full-time

• Location: Remote

• Salary: $105,000

We take care of our employees by providing the following perks and benefits (please note that some of the benefits do not apply to temporary employees):

• Medical, Dental and Vision insurance (100% Paid Employee Only Coverage)

• Flexible Spending Account and Health Savings Account

• Dependent care Flexible Spending Account

• Health Reimbursement Account fully funded by Merit

• Education & personal development reimbursement

• Catalog of courses for professional learning and development

• Short and long-term disability

• Flexible PTO (after a 90-day introductory period)

• Paid Parental Leave and Adoption benefits (after 1 year of employment)

• 11 federally recognized holidays

• 2 week holiday office closure in December/January

• 401(k) retirement plan with automatic Merit contribution

• Wellness Benefits/Wellness Resources

• Discount perks at work program

• Phone/technology stipend

• Home office setup stipend

• Affinity groups and community building via virtual, in-person, and/or regional meetups

*Eligibility for some benefits may vary based on employment status, full-time or part-time. Eligibility will be outlined during the hiring process.

Remote Work & Sponsorship

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Build the payment infrastructure powering global commerce.

Boku connects billions of consumers to the payment methods they prefer, one market at a time. Our platform connects the world’s leading digital businesses to the local payment methods their customers already use. Spotify, Meta, Microsoft, Netflix and Tencent already run on Boku’s payment infrastructure. We operate across 60+ countries, support 200+ local payment methods and reach 7.5 billion consumer accounts.

With headquarters in London and San Francisco and colleagues working across markets around the world, Boku is global by default. From London to Mumbai, São Paulo to Singapore, our teams collaborate across time zones, markets and cultures to build products for customers around the world.

Join us to solve complex, real-time payment challenges at global scale. We share knowledge freely, take ownership of complexity and look for people who question how things are done and find better ways to build.

Role Purpose

The Bundling Product Manager shapes and evolves a platform that enables digital service providers to reach customers through partners such as telcos, banks and enterprises.

The role connects customer, commercial and technical needs to create scalable, reusable bundled offers. It ensures the platform makes it easier to launch partnerships, manage activation and subscription lifecycles, and expand into new markets without bespoke integrations.

This is a collaborative, strategic role for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, setting clear priorities and turning opportunities into valuable products to scale. Its impact is central to growing distribution by helping partners broaden their service portfolios and helping merchants reach new customers at scale.

Key Responsibilities

• Product Strategy: Develop and execute the product strategy for our payment marketing products, aligning it with the overall company vision and goals as well as a wide range of internal stakeholders. Continually assess the needs of customers, market trends, competitive opportunities, and threats in defining and evolving the product strategy.

• Requirements-Definition: Develop comprehensive product plans, incorporating market requirements, define the competitive arena, and establish the objectives, strategies, and actions required to achieve business goals. Produce high-quality requirements documents and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each product launch to deliver key capabilities on time and on budget. Write user stories to communicate customer needs in an agile development environment.

• Prioritization: Provide value-based prioritization of product development initiatives to ensure maximum ROI and market-driven alignment. Deliver world-class innovation in features, usability, and product performance in a consistent cadence of releases. Manage a cross-functional process for prioritizing, delivering and launching major product releases.

• Product Development: Lead the end-to-end product development lifecycle, from ideation to launch and adoption to scalability.

• Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to gather feedback, understand their pain points, and incorporate insights into the product development process. Act as the primary point of contact for all product-related inquiries. Drive product adoption and customer satisfaction by monitoring product performance, gathering feedback, and implementing improvements.

• Product-Roll-out: Work with teams to create and execute go-to-market plans for new features. Monitor key performance metrics to ensure product performance and identify optimization opportunities.

• Industry Expertise: Stay up to date with the latest trends, best practices, and advancements in Martech and bundling solutions. Act as a thought leader within the organization, providing insights and recommendations to senior management

Measures of Success

• Product delivery - Roadmap delivery against agreed outcomes; Ensures investment is translated into usable, valuable capability

• Partnership growth - Number of live partners and merchants; expands distribution reach and revenue opportunity.

• Product adoption - Active offers; activated users, activation conversion rate; Demonstrates that customers and partners are receiving value from Boku

• Platform reusability - % of launches using standard capabilities; Improves scalability, margin and operational efficiency.

• Speed to market - Time from signed partnership to launch; time to configure a new offer; Reduces delivery cost and enables faster revenue generation

• Partner and merchant satisfaction - Partner satisfaction/NPS; support volume; Strengthens retention and makes the platform easier to grow.

Key Skills, experience and Competencies

• API Design - Expertise in understanding API design, reverse engineering, and developing comprehensive requirements for API specifications and solutions.

• Stakeholder Management - Experience working across functional teams and stakeholders (both internal and external).

• Building the Roadmap - Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition.

• Problem Solving – Investigates and understands the nature of the issues, thinks of way to turn potential issue into valuable solution.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Certificate Authority
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin or London

About the Role

TLS is the connective tissue of the Internet, and Cloudflare terminates a large fraction of it. Cloudflare sits in front of more than 20 percent of global Internet request traffic and terminates TLS for millions of domains. Every day, our network handles certificate operations across products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Cloudflare Access, and Cloudflare Tunnel.

That scale has taught us how the WebPKI ecosystem works from the consuming side.  As certificate lifetimes shorten, agentic activity increases, and post-quantum certificates move toward production, the number of certificates the Internet depends on will grow dramatically.

Cloudflare is building a certificate authority for the whole Internet: a public, redundant, transparent CA that provides another trusted source of automated certificates and helps make the encrypted web more resilient. We intend to be ACME-first, automation-first, and transparent by design. We also intend to lead where the ecosystem is going, including post-quantum certificates and Merkle Tree Certificates, while continuing to support the classic WebPKI customers rely on today.

As Principal Product Manager for Cloudflare's Certificate Authority business, you will define the product strategy, roadmap, customer experience, and commercial model for this new venture. You will work across product, engineering, security, compliance, legal, operations, sales, marketing, and the WebPKI ecosystem to turn Cloudflare's CA from a major technical commitment into a product customers trust and adopt.

This is an early-days role on a growing team. It is not a role for someone who only manages backlog. The right person will be comfortable with high-consequence infrastructure, deep customer discovery, ecosystem trust, compliance scrutiny, and zero-to-one product building. The decisions you make in the first year will shape how Cloudflare participates in the certificate authority market for years to come.

Responsibilities

• Define the product strategy for Cloudflare's CA business across publicly trusted certificates, certificate lifecycle automation, ACME issuance, renewal workflows, revocation, Certificate Transparency, customer controls, developer experience, and integrations with Cloudflare's broader platform.

• Build for the whole Internet by understanding the needs of developers, site owners, platform teams, SaaS providers, enterprise security teams, infrastructure operators, and partners who depend on certificates for availability, security, and compliance.

• Make resilience a product principle. Help design product requirements that fail small, reduce customer blast radius, support automated recovery, and make certificate replacement fast enough to handle compliance issues, revocation events, or ecosystem incidents.

• Drive an ACME-first customer experience that makes it easy for users of existing free or automated CAs to adopt Cloudflare with minimal tooling changes.

• Partner closely with engineering on systems that manage certificate lifecycles, automate issuance and renewal, integrate with HSMs, protect keys, support auditability, and operate within strict reliability and correctness requirements.

• Partner with compliance, legal, security, and operations to ensure product decisions align with CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements, WebTrust audits, root store program policies, Certificate Policy and Certification Practice Statement commitments, and public incident response expectations.

• Own go-to-market strategy including packaging, pricing, launch sequencing, competitive positioning, customer segmentation, sales enablement, developer messaging, and adoption metrics.

• Represent the customer and the ecosystem in product decisions where trust, transparency, uptime, security, and commercial adoption must all be balanced.

• Work across Cloudflare product teams including SSL/TLS, Application Security, Zero Trust, Workers, Registrar, DNS, Load Balancing, SaaS products, and infrastructure teams that consume or expose certificate services.

• Help make Cloudflare Customer Zero by ensuring our own usage of the CA exercises the product at Cloudflare scale and informs the roadmap before customers depend on it.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge and Experience

• 10+ years of product management experience building technical products for developers, security teams, infrastructure teams, enterprises, or cloud platforms.

• Experience with security, identity, infrastructure, or developer platform products where correctness, reliability, compliance, and trust are core product requirements.

• Working knowledge of PKI and certificate lifecycle management including TLS certificates, X.509, ACME, public and private CAs, revocation, Certificate Transparency, mTLS, HSMs, and enterprise certificate automation.

• Strong business judgment with experience defining product strategy, pricing and packaging, customer segmentation, and go-to-market plans for technical B2B products.

• Ability to operate in ambiguity and create structure around a new business, including market definition, customer discovery, roadmap tradeoffs, launch planning, and executive alignment.

• Technical fluency with engineering teams and comfort discussing APIs, distributed systems, key management, audit trails, reliability, operational failure modes, and security tradeoffs.

• Strong written communication for strategy documents, product requirements, launch narratives, customer-facing messaging, and high-stakes internal decisions.

• Comfort with high-consequence work. A mis-issued, mis-revoked, or unavailable certificate can become a public, ecosystem-visible event. You need the judgment to move quickly and the discipline to be careful.

Bonus Points

• Direct experience working on certificate authority, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, cloud security, identity, or trust services products.

• Experience with publicly trusted CAs, private PKI, managed certificate services, or platforms such as AWS Certificate Manager, AWS Private CA, Google Trust Services, DigiCert, Sectigo, Let's Encrypt / ISRG, Entrust, Microsoft PKI, HashiCorp Vault PKI, step-ca, or CFSSL.

• Familiarity with CA/Browser Forum requirements, browser root programs, WebTrust for CAs, WebTrust Baseline Requirements, or public CA incident reporting.

• Experience building API-first developer products, especially products involving ACME, SDKs, CLI workflows, Kubernetes, service mesh, mTLS, or infrastructure-as-code integrations.

• Experience launching new businesses or zero-to-one products inside a larger platform company.

• Familiarity with certificate automation challenges created by 90-day and shorter certificate lifetimes.

• Familiarity with post-quantum cryptography, crypto-agility, Merkle Tree Certificates, or customer migration planning for cryptographic transitions.

• Prior participation in WebPKI, IETF, browser trust, transparency, or security standards communities.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave

• Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Mortgage Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Come build at the intersection of AI and fintech. At Ocrolus, we’re on a mission to help lenders automate workflows with confidence—streamlining how financial institutions evaluate borrowers and enabling faster, more accurate lending decisions.

Our AI workflow and analytics platform for lenders is trusted at scale, processing nearly one million credit applications every month across small business, mortgage, and consumer lending. By integrating state-of-the-art open- and closed-source AI models with our human-in-the-loop verification engine, Ocrolus captures data from financial documents with over 99% accuracy. Thanks to our advanced fraud detection and comprehensive cash flow and income analytics, our customers achieve greater efficiency in risk management, and provide expanded access to credit—ultimately creating a more inclusive financial system.

Trusted by more than 400 customers—including industry leaders like Better Mortgage, Brex, Enova, Nova Credit, PayPal, Plaid, SoFi, and Square—Ocrolus stands at the forefront of AI innovation in fintech. Join us, and help redefine how the world’s most innovative lenders do business.

We’re looking for a Mortgage Forward-Deployed Engineer (Encompass) to join our team and be the bridge between our product and our customers. This is not your standard engineering role, you’ll be out in the field, working directly with clients, writing production code, and helping them reimagine how they run their business with our platform.  You will be working directly with our Account Management team, implementation team and onboarding team.  This role reports to the VP of Account Management.

As an FDE, you’ll wear different hats: engineer, architect, and trusted advisor. One day you might be prototyping a custom integration; the next, you’re running a proof-of-value with a C-suite exec; the next, you’re feeding back product insights that shape the roadmap. If you like variety, ownership, and making real-world impact, you’ll love this role. This role will report to our Lead Forward-Deployed Engineer and be a part of the Account Management team.

What you'll do:

• Act as a technical expert and trusted advisor during the post-sales process, embed with customer teams to understand their workflows and demonstrate how Ocrolus’ technology improves efficiency in mortgage origination.

• Review and consult on technical solutions, APIs, microservices, data pipelines, and integrations that solve real business problems.

• Build and support technical solutions and integrations for mortgage clients using Ocrolus, Encompass, and other POS/LOS mortgage platforms.

• Run proof-of-concepts and proof-of-value engagements that demonstrate ROI fast.

• Troubleshoot gnarly technical issues in live environments and get things back on track.

• Partner with the Account Management and Product teams to deliver value, and influence the roadmap.

• Travel occasionally (~30–50%) to customer sites and industry events

Who we're looking for: (Skill Sets and Qualifications)

• 3+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting.

• 3+ years of a background in mortgage, or lending workflows.

• Strong understanding and experience with Encompass

• Strong consultative sales/account management approach—able to map technology to business challenges and drive change management conversations.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience engaging senior mortgage executives.

• Backend: Python; APIs; Encompass Developer Connect; SQL.

• Frontend: React/TypeScript; JavaScript with ICE Secure Scripting Framework (SSF) for Encompass custom form and workflow logic.

• Supporting: Familiarity with mortgage LOS/POS platforms (Encompass, Blend, SimpleNexus, Floify); Git; cloud basics (AWS/Azure).

• Thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where you figure it out and get it done.

Nice to Have:

• Experience with SaaS integrations or loan origination systems.

• Additional mortgage LOS/POS experience

• Exposure to AI/ML or generative AI.

Why You’ll Love It Here

• You’ll have ownership from day one, our FDEs lead projects end-to-end.

• You’ll work directly with customers and see the immediate impact of what you build.

• You’ll shape the product by bringing the voice of the customer straight to engineering.

• You’ll work directly with a team focused on creating an excellent client experience

• You’ll have fun working with a highly proactive, collaborative team

Note:

The full-time salary range for this role is between $150,000 - $170,000 + commission + equity + benefits. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location.

Disclosure as required by N.Y.C. Admin. Code §§ 8-102 and 8-107(32) of the full time salary compensation range for this role when being hired into our offices in New York City.

Life at Ocrolus

We’re a team of builders, thinkers, and problem solvers who care deeply about our mission — and each other. As a fast-growing, remote-first company, we offer an environment where you can grow your skills, take ownership of your work, and make a meaningful impact.

Our culture is grounded in four core values:
Empathy – Understand and serve with compassion
Curiosity – Explore new ideas and question the status quo
Humility – Listen, be grounded, and remain open-minded
Ownership – Love what you do, work hard, and deliver excellence

We believe diverse perspectives drive better outcomes. That’s why we’re committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone has a seat at the table, regardless of race, gender, gender identity, age, disability, national origin, or any other protected characteristic.

We look forward to building the future of lending together.

jobs.title: Logistics Trade Compliance Specialist
jobs.description:
Vectra® is the leader in AI-driven threat detection and response for hybrid and multi-cloud enterprises.

The Vectra AI Platform delivers integrated signal across public cloud, SaaS, identity, and data center networks in a single platform. Powered by patented Attack Signal Intelligence, it empowers security teams to rapidly prioritize, investigate and respond to the most advanced cyber-attacks. With 35 patents in AI-driven threat detection and the most vendor references in MITRE D3FEND, organizations worldwide rely on the Vectra AI to move at the speed and scale of hybrid attackers. For more information, visit www.vectra.ai.

Logistics Trade compliance Specialist

Position Overview

The Logistics Trade Compliance Specialist is responsible for global trade compliance and logistics activities. This role coordinates the movement of products from order readiness through delivery with third-party logistics providers, carriers, customers, suppliers, and internal teams, and helps ensure shipments comply with applicable import and export requirements.

The ideal candidate combines strong logistics execution with practical trade compliance knowledge and the ability to interpret evolving legal and regulatory requirements, assess business impact, and translate requirements into effective operational processes.

This is a hybrid position in San Jose, with about 1-2 days in the office weekly.

Key Responsibilities

Trade Compliance

Support compliance with applicable U.S. and international trade regulations, company policies, contractual requirements, and customer requirements.

• Perform and document import/export classification activities, including HTS/HTSUS and ECCN classifications for physical goods and technology products, as applicable.

• Assess export requirements for products incorporating encryption, including applicable ECCN classifications, EAR encryption controls, license requirements or exceptions, and related documentation and reporting requirements.

• Assess end-use and end-user restrictions, restricted or sanctioned-party screening requirements, export license determinations, anti-boycott considerations, and other trade compliance requirements.

• Support export license applications and related documentation, including coordination with internal stakeholders and external partners as needed.

• Coordinate or support Electronic Export Information (EEI) filings through AES, as applicable, and verify required export data and documentation prior to shipment.

• Support import compliance activities, including country-of-origin, customs valuation, tariff/duty, and documentation requirements in coordination with customs brokers and internal stakeholders.

• Monitor changes to export and import laws and regulations, evaluate potential impact to company and partner processes, and help update procedures and controls to maintain compliance.

• Maintain complete and accurate trade compliance records, including classification rationale, screening results, licensing documentation, and shipment records, in accordance with applicable requirements and company retention policies.

• Respond to trade compliance requests, questionnaires, and documentation needs from logistics teams, customers, and business partners supporting global product deployments.

Order Fulfillment & Logistics

• Support end-to-end order fulfillment activities, from order readiness and shipment planning through final delivery and issue resolution.

• Coordinate domestic and international inbound and outbound shipments with 3PL providers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, carriers, suppliers, and other external partners.

• Monitor shipment status, proactively identify and resolve delays, exceptions, customs holds, or delivery issues, and communicate timely updates to internal and external stakeholders.

• Partner with customers and internal teams to understand shipping requirements, documentation needs, delivery expectations, and other order-specific requirements.

• Prepare, review, and maintain accurate shipping and trade documentation, including commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, and other import/export documents as required.

• Identify opportunities to improve logistics processes, service levels, cost efficiency, and global tariff cost containment.

Qualifications

3+ years of experience in domestic and international logistics and trade compliance.

• Working knowledge of import/export regulations, HTS/HTSUS and ECCN classification, export licensing requirements, restricted or sanctioned-party screening, and U.S. export control requirements applicable to products incorporating encryption.

• Experience coordinating with freight forwarders, customs brokers, carriers, 3PL providers, customers, suppliers, and cross-functional internal teams.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

• Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

• Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, analytical thinking, and problem-solving ability.

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in logistics, supply chain management, international trade, business, or a related field.

• Hands-on experience with AES/EEI filings, export license applications, and import/export documentation.

• Familiarity with technology products and global trade requirements for hardware, software, and technology is desirable.

• Familiarity with Salesforce, ERP/order-management systems, or trade compliance software is desirable.

Our competitive total rewards package includes cash compensation within the range provided below. Actual pay for this position may vary based on the hired candidate’s location, experience and relevant incumbent pay position.

Vectra Total Rewards

$76,800—$103,900 USD

Vectra provides a comprehensive total rewards package that supports the financial, physical, mental and overall health of our employees and their families. Compensation includes competitive base pay, incentive plan eligibility, and participation in the employee equity plan (stock options). Specific benefits offered varies by location, but commonly include health care insurance, income protection / life insurance, access to retirement savings plans, behavioral & emotional wellness services, generous time away from work, and a comprehensive employee recognition program.

Vectra is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 400+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, our annual revenue is in the hundreds of millions USD and millions use our browser on Mac https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-duckduckgo-for-mac/, Windows https://spreadprivacy.com/windows-browser-open-beta/, iOS https://spreadprivacy.com/duckduckgo-privacy-browser-ios14/, and Android https://spreadprivacy.com/introducing-app-tracking-protection/, our search engine https://duckduckgo.com/, and the DuckDuckGo subscription https://duckduckgo.com/pro. We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai https://duck.ai/, which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. 

 

Our culture https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-work of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place!




YOUR TEAM AND ROLE

Working on the Data Science Functional Team, you'll drive product and business impact by developing data scientists, setting clear expectations for them, providing hands-on mentorship, and removing blockers.



You will guide and advise multiple data science projects so that they stay on track and have timely delivery with maximum impact.  These projects will involve statistical modeling, experiment design, and classifier implementation across our search engine, instant answers, AI, and revenue optimization. You'll collaborate cross-functionally to validate direction through data, build trust in organizational tactics and strategy by consulting on experiments, and become an expert in our core metrics like searches, installs, and revenue. You'll also drive improvement of the data pipeline. Because of our strong privacy policies, you'll need to think creatively and develop strategies for how we can surface more actionable insights in an evidence-first culture where quantitative rigor is the baseline, not the exception.



As a Director, Data Science, you'll help shape our all-in-one privacy solution and join our mission to show the world that protecting your privacy online can be simple.  




ABOUT YOU

 - You have 10+ years of experience in data science or ML engineering, with 4+ years leading teams, and a track record of setting multi-team roadmaps and adapting swiftly as priorities shift.

 - You've driven organizational culture toward data-driven decision-making and can translate technical tradeoffs and risks clearly for executives and cross-functional stakeholders.

 - You enjoy coaching experienced data scientists who are already highly skilled.  You give direct, actionable feedback and you've built teams where people do the best work of their careers.

 - You can deploy and iterate ML and NLP solutions in production at expert level, with deep knowledge of when to reach for which tools - especially in constrained environments requiring fast responses and strict privacy standards.

 - You write production-grade code in Python or a comparable high-level language and stay close to the technical work when it matters most.

 - You have advanced SQL and query optimization skills, familiarity with columnar databases like BigQuery, Clickhouse, Redshift, or Druid.

 - You have strong LLM/AI experience including fine-tuning, LLM-as-judge evaluation, and AI-assisted development, and can design, implement, and analyze experiments across product surfaces using sparse or privacy-constrained data.

 - Preferred: experience at a consumer-facing tech company where data or analytics is core to the product strategy.




COMPENSATION

This role is paid on a regional pay scale, in local currency, and stock options:

 - United States: $263,300 USD annually

 - United Kingdom: £183,850 GBP annually

 - Canada: C$346,250 CAD annually

 - Europe/Rest of World: €214,950 EUR annually

In Spain, pay is expected to transition to the EUR scale on January 1, 2027, and in other Europe/Rest of World countries on February 1, 2027.

 

Compensation is transparent across the organization, and all team members within the same professional level and global region receive the same compensation.

 

Our Team Member Support Guide https://duckduckgo.com/assets/hiring/team_support_guide.pdf explains how we prioritize your wellbeing including paid parental leave, office setup, and co-working allowances.




HIRING PROCESS

Hiring works best when it's a two-way street. Learn how we help you get to know DuckDuckGo, envision your future role here, and find out more about how we hire https://duckduckgo.com/how-we-hire.




DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

DuckDuckGo provides equal work opportunities to all team members and applicants, and it prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type on the basis of race, color, ethnicity, caste, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by our policies or federal, state, or local laws.



We want to ensure that our hiring process is accessible. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an email to careers@duckduckgo.com to let us know the nature of your request.




PLEASE NOTE THAT:

 - You’ll be required to attend meetings on camera via video conferencing

 - Expect to travel at least two times a year: once for our all-hands meetup and again for a team retreat (each around 4-5 days). While extenuating circumstances may impact attendance, everyone is strongly encouraged to attend.

 - While we offer a flexible work arrangement with no core hours, expect an average full-time commitment of 40 hours per week.

You further acknowledge that providing false or fraudulent information during the application process is cause for denial of an offer, revocation of any existing offer, or other adverse action, up to and including termination after the start of your commencement of work.




DISCLOSURE STATEMENT: USE OF AI IN HIRING PROCESS

We use AI to flag potentially fraudulent applications, analyze and summarize applicants’ experience, interviews, and project performance, and help streamline our selection process.

jobs.title: Principal, Talent & Leadership Development
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines.  Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing American companies since 2008.

We are looking for an experienced, hands-on talent leader to build a culture that raises the bar on talent: where leaders know what great looks like, how to spot it, and how to grow it.
This person will build talent and leadership programs largely from the ground up using industry-leading practices, lead how we attract, identify, develop and promote high-potential talent, and evaluate, select, and bring in AI-driven talent practices, including predictive talent forecasting, for better and faster talent decisions. This role is about knowing the AI talent-tech landscape deeply and choosing and deploying the right platforms, whether vendor or in-house, not building AI models or algorithms from scratch.
This is a senior individual-contributor role with no direct reports. Impact comes through influence rather than authority: partnering with HR business partners and business leaders, earning credibility with senior executives, and using evidence and expertise to drive adoption of talent practices across the organization.
This work is as much about organizational design and change management as it is about building programs: getting the structure, roles, and processes right, and then leading the change management needed for leaders across the organization to adopt and sustain new ways of working.
We are a U.S.-based company operating globally, with colleagues across 10 countries. Programs need to work well beyond the U.S., which means designing with cultural differences in mind from the start and planning for translation and localization of content, not treating them as an afterthought.

jobs.title: Account Executive - Enterprise NYC
jobs.description:
ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE - ENTERPRISE NYC

New York




WORDSMITH

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents, and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling, and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe, and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.




THE ROLE

We’re hiring an Enterprise Account Executive to lead complex, high-value deals across large organisations.

You’ll be responsible for building and progressing a focused set of strategic opportunities. This means navigating multiple stakeholders, building internal champions, and creating alignment across legal, technical, and commercial teams.

You’ll work closely with Legal Engineers, Product, and Leadership, but you own the deal strategy and the outcome.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own a portfolio of high-value, enterprise opportunities

 - Build and execute deal strategies across complex buying groups

 - Navigate stakeholders across Legal, Finance, Security, IT, and Procurement

 - Develop strong champions and drive internal alignment within accounts

 - Lead longer sales cycles (6–12+ months) with clear structure and momentum

 - Partner closely with Legal Solutions Engineers on solution design

 - Maintain accurate forecasting and clear deal visibility
   
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience closing complex enterprise SaaS deals

 - Track record of landing and expanding high-value accounts

 - Strong stakeholder management across multiple functions

 - Ability to build champions and navigate internal politics

 - Structured, strategic approach to deal management

 - High ownership and accountability for outcomes
   
   


HOW WE WORK

We’re an in-office team in New York. We work together because it makes us faster, sharper, and more effective. You should expect to be in the office as your default.

This is a high performance environment. We set a high bar, move quickly, and expect people to take ownership of real problems.

There isn’t always a clear path. The people who do well here figure things out, stay close to the work, and keep pushing until they get to the right outcome.

This role requires patience, structure, and strong judgement. You’ll be trusted to run complex deals with a high degree of autonomy.




WHY WORDSMITH

We’re in a period of strong momentum — growing quickly, winning new customers, and expanding into larger accounts.

The product is landing well, the market is ready, and the team is scaling to meet demand.

If you want to be in the room, close meaningful deals, and grow quickly in a high bar environment, this is one of the best places to do it.

jobs.title: Director of AI Engineering, Internal Products
