With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally.

As the Director of AI Engineering, Internal Products at Via, you'll lead an engineering team that builds high-impact internal products using AI-native development practices, while pioneering a platform that enables people across the company to create their own software with AI agents. We call these empowered employees “nano engineers.” This is an opportunity to shape a new engineering discipline, solve problems across the business, and multiply our capacity to innovate.

About the Role:

• Build products that make our business run better, from internal systems supporting Finance, HR, Ops, Sales and Marketing to tools that help field teams coordinate work, surface operational insights, resolve exceptions, manage resources, and make better decisions in real time

• Work closely with the people doing the work, understand their needs firsthand, and turn those insights into products that deliver measurable business impact

• Rethink software development in the age of AI, using coding agents, AI-assisted development, automated testing, and new engineering workflows to accelerate the journey from identifying a problem to delivering a solution

• Lead the development of our AI-powered internal development platform, building the integrations, permissions, infrastructure, testing, deployment, and governance needed to make employee-created software reliable and useful

• Recruit, develop, and lead exceptional engineers, and define the architecture, engineering standards, operating model, and culture that will allow the team to scale its impact

🚗 Služobné vozidlo aj na súkromné účely

Poskytneme Vám plne vybavené služobné vozidlo vrátane palivovej karty s možnosťou využívania na súkromné účely.

💰 Ročný bonus až do výšky 10 %

Vaša úspešnosť bude odmenená výkonnostným bonusom naviazaným na individuálne výsledky a ciele spoločnosti.

🛠 Kompletné vybavenie pre výkon práce

Aby ste sa mohli sústrediť na to najdôležitejšie, zabezpečíme Vám všetko potrebné vybavenie:

• notebook a mobilný telefón,
• profesionálne servisné náradie (kompletný toolbox),
• pracovné oblečenie a bezpečnostnú obuv,
• osobné ochranné pracovné prostriedky (HSE vybavenie),
• každoročný príspevok vo výške 320 € na pracovné oblečenie značky Strauss.

• Máte technické vzdelanie v oblasti elektrotechniky alebo príbuznom odbore.
• Ste držiteľom minimálne osvedčenia podľa §21 Vyhlášky 508/2009 Z.z.
• Ovládate slovenský aj anglický jazyk na komunikatívnej úrovni a dokážete ich využívať pri práci so zákazníkmi aj medzinárodnými kolegami. Znalosť ukrajinského alebo poľského jazyka je veľkou výhodou.

Ponúkame:

• Stabilita: Pridajte sa k dobre zavedenej medzinárodnej spoločnosti.

jobs.title: Director, Strategic Services (Atlanta)
jobs.description:
Director, Strategic Services  – WorkBoardAI

Remote - must be based in the Atlanta area

About WorkBoard

WorkBoard is the pioneer in AI-driven strategy execution solutions, empowering enterprises to align, measure, and achieve their most important outcomes. With our platform, organizations can operationalize strategy in real time, foster alignment across teams, and accelerate growth. Our customers include some of the world’s most innovative companies across technology, financial services, healthcare, and more.

We’re backed by top-tier investors and led by a diverse, mission-driven team that’s passionate about redefining how organizations execute strategy at scale. At WorkBoard, you’ll have the opportunity to join a fast-growing, category-defining company where your work directly impacts how leaders shape the future.

The Opportunity

The direct WorkBoard buyer is typically the CEO or GM of a business unit, and our platform is deployed to all employees under the P&L owner – giving the company an exceptionally large market opportunity.

As the Director of Strategic Services, this role presents a rare opportunity to see first-hand and influence how companies and teams formulate their strategic objectives, operationalize them to drive results, and make a tangible impact on employee engagement and business outcomes.  You will form strategic advisor relationships with C-Level Executives, and coach their teams to define, communicate, and operationalize their results achievement.

You will play a pivotal role in making strategic priorities relevant and meaningful at every level of the organization, and being a trusted advisor from pre to post sales. Your results expertise will enable our customers to increase the business results they realize from the WorkBoard platform over time.

The Role

As the Director of Strategic Services, you will provide prospective and new customers with expert advice on how to better execute strategy and maximize performance, drive an excellent platform launch and introduction process and serve as an active guide in the early stages of a customer's journey to define and achieve measurable value that increases over time.

You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders and their teams, aligning execution with long-range and short-range goals through scalable, data-driven operating models and high-impact enablement.

What we're looking for:

• You are business-savvy and draw on your combination of real-world experience and education to work seamlessly and fluently with leaders across a wide range of functional disciplines at large enterprises.

• You are a self-starter with strong ownership skills, willing to support many customer accounts, deploying impactful strategies to accelerate our clients’ and WorkBoard’s growth.

• You have a strong interest and experience in strategy development, strategy deployment, and operating model optimization.

• A minimum of 10 years of work experience and ideally, experience at a strategy firm such as McKinsey, Bain, BCG, or a management consulting firm like PwC, Accenture, Deloitte, or Slalom.

• A plus if you have worked for a high-growth B2B SaaS company.

• You have experience in both strategy execution and strategic portfolio management.

• You have an arsenal of successful tactics for connecting business value to technology. You are genuine, warm, positive, engaging, and empathetic.

• Proven experience leading enterprise-level implementation or consulting engagements, ideally in SaaS or strategy execution domains.

• Exceptional communication and storytelling skills; ability to influence at all levels of an organization.

• Passion for helping organizations achieve their best possible results.

You'll be skilled and super effective at:

• Leading executive conversations and working sessions.

• Deck creation, design, and graphical representation of complex concepts for executive-level presentations

• Leveraging your natural curiosity to quickly understand a client’s business while demonstrating tact and poise under pressure

• Delivering exceptional customer experience and value to customers, demonstrated by successfully closing contract renewals and partnering with sales to identify and close expansion and new business opportunities

• Communicating & listening with the ability to credibly and confidently engage executives

• Understanding complex, matrix organizations and navigating them effectively to create value for both our clients and the company

• Mapping and understanding existing strategy execution and portfolio management processes and partner with clients on a path forward

• Engaging various techniques to deepen customer value over time

WITHIN ONE MONTH, YOU'LL:

• Build a deep understanding of our buyer, their pain points, our methodology and how we work as a team

• Deep-dive with Customer Success, Sales, and Product Management teams to learn more about our solution, go-to-market and roadmap and the partnership with the Services team

• Meet with 5 enthusiastic WorkBoard customers and 5 prospective customers to understand senior leadership challenges and how we help

• Know your client teams and the objectives and key results they are looking to achieve in the quarter and the next year

• Be a daily user of WorkBoard and SFDC to help drive rocket ship growth

• Dazzle a WorkBoard expert with your enthusiastic demo

• Confidently articulate the value, benefits and relevance of our powerful solution easily and effectively

• Have action plans in place to achieve the Key Results for your business

WITHIN THREE MONTHS, YOU'LL:

• Guide 15+ clients in setting and aligning an ROI based value journey

• Be a valued partner by helping more than 40 leaders use WorkBoard’s Agents, Scorecards, Biz Reviews and Meetings in order to run their business for results, on a weekly basis

• Spend a great deal of time with our amazing customers both in person and virtually

• Lead white glove enablement sessions with 20 senior leaders

• Have successfully secured 2 commitments to be a customer reference.

• Successfully partner with Customer Success to close renewals and identify 3 opportunities for expansion revenue

WITHIN SIX MONTHS, YOU'LL:

• Have two dozen executive and chief of staff customer relationships that you can tap for insights, references, case studies and thought partnership any time to express the business value WorkBoard is helping them drive for their company

• Know your customers are continually getting value by creating a successful track-record of closing renewals, securing expansion and up-sell opportunities, and closing services revenue.

THE TEAM

You will be joining a matrixed team focused on igniting and delivering value quickly to our buyers.  We are in growth mode, and we are a passionate no-ego bunch that “falls in love” with our customers and is fully dedicated to ensuring their success.

OUR VALUES - WE LIVE BY THE 4 H’S

Humble experts ~ Hungry  for the opportunity ~ Intellectually honest ~ Operating as one happy  team

A FEW OF OUR AWESOME BENEFITS

• Flexible PTO & sick days

• Paid holidays

• Health insurance

• 401K with employer matching

• Quarterly Bonuses based on company performance

• Bi-weekly All-Hands Meetings

• And much more!

The US salary range for this full-time position is $150-175k OTE annual salary. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and geographic location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Role: Data Operations Analyst

Location: Chennai

CTC: 3.12 LPA

Every insight NIQ delivers starts with Operations getting it right.

Behind every report, every market trend, and every business decision our clients make is trusted, high-quality data. As a Data Operations Analyst, you'll play a key role in making that happen.

Working within NIQ's global Operations function, you'll ensure market data is accurate, complete, and ready for delivery to some of the world's most recognized brands. You'll investigate data issues, validate information, and help maintain the quality standards our clients rely on.

But this role is about more than data quality.

Operations at NIQ is undergoing one of the most significant transformations in its history. Automation, AI-enabled workflows, smarter technologies, and digital platforms are reshaping how we work. Rather than replacing human expertise, these technologies enable our teams to focus on critical thinking, solving complex problems, and continuously improving how we deliver value to clients.

From day one, you'll work alongside experienced colleagues in a collaborative global environment while developing future-ready skills in data, technology, automation, and operational excellence.

If you're naturally curious, enjoy solving problems, and want to build a career where technology and human judgement work together, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

• Research product information and accurately classify and maintain data within NIQ databases.
• Perform quantitative and qualitative quality checks to ensure market data meets NIQ's global quality standards.
• Manage monthly production activities using NIQ's proprietary platforms, ensuring data is delivered accurately and on time.
• Investigate, analyze, and resolve data issues and exceptions.
• Monitor market developments and understand how they impact data quality.
• Work alongside AI-enabled tools and automated workflows, applying critical thinking and human judgement to validate outputs and resolve exceptions.
• Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve efficiency, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
• Use data and operational insights to identify trends, improve quality, and enhance performance.
• Collaborate with colleagues across global teams to deliver trusted, high-quality data that supports client decision-making.

Qualifications

Skills for Success

We're looking for curious, adaptable people who are excited about learning and solving problems.

• A passion for working with data and solving problems.
• Curiosity and enthusiasm for learning new technologies and digital tools.

• The ability to work effectively within structured processes while identifying opportunities for improvement.

jobs.title: Senior Procurement Specialist
jobs.description:
Keep our supply chain moving – ensuring 100% material availability for next-level radar systems.

As our Senior Procurement Specialist, you keep our supply chain running smoothly and secure critical components for high-tech radars. You own key supplier relationships, resolve complex delivery bottlenecks, and mentor junior buyers across the team. Working closely with Production, Logistics, Service & Support, and Sales, you ensure parts arrive on time. You report to the Head of Procurement and keep our production line moving without a hitch.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Strategic sourcing and negotiation: Prepare proposals, request quotes, and negotiate competitive purchasing terms and pricing. Focus on high-complexity categories like PCBs, custom cabling, and computer components.

 - Supplier relationship management: Manage daily vendor operations and build strong long-term relationships with critical suppliers. Conduct regular performance reviews and on-site visits to drive continuous improvement.

 - Operational supply chain support: Ensure on-time sourcing of parts for Manufacturing and Service & Support teams. Resolve daily supply chain showstoppers and coordinate non-conformances quickly across departments.

 - Data integrity and system accuracy: Maintain precise supplier and category data in our ERP system. Keep lead times, contact details, and BOM cost prices up to date at all times.

 - Process improvement and escalation: Act as the primary escalation point for complex delivery disputes and bottlenecks. Identify process gaps and implement practical automation to boost purchasing efficiency.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - BA or MSc in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field.

 - 5+ years of procurement and strategic sourcing experience in technical manufacturing.

 - Strong background in sourcing electronics, PCBs, cabling, and computing hardware.

 - Deep expertise in ERP systems like SAP or NetSuite and MRP logic.

 - Fluent English, both spoken and written.

 - Strong analytical skills, financial acumen, and high attention to detail.

 - Collaborative team player comfortable communicating across diverse cultures and technical teams.

 - Willingness to travel occasionally to supplier sites.

N.B. Don't worry if you don't tick every box. Our mission is a journey, and there's plenty to learn along the way. If most of this fits, we'd love to hear from you.

A Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and a background check are part of our screening process. We appreciate your understanding.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

 - Comprehensive pension plan;

 - Commuting allowance;

 - 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

 - Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

 - High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role;

 - An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from;

 - As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Robin Radar is a technology leader in tracking and classifying small objects. Our radars and software help prevent bird strikes in aviation, reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife, and protect critical infrastructure from drone threats. Our work shows up at airports, wind farms, military sites and nature reserves around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning?

You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Staff DevOps / Platform Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid (3 days a week on-site in Mohali) role, reporting to the Director, Product Revenue in the Product Operations department.

This individual contributor role owns DevOps, AWS infrastructure, release reliability, security hygiene, and platform maintainability for a business-critical internal platform while leveraging practical AI-assisted development workflows to improve delivery speed and quality.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Own DevOps, CI/CD, deployments, monitoring, logging, production support, and operational reliability for an existing business-critical internal platform

• Manage and improve AWS infrastructure using Terraform, including secure access controls, integrations, secrets practices, and infrastructure hygiene

• Ensure weekly releases are safe through testing, rollback planning, monitoring, post-release checks, and continuous improvements to release reliability

• Improve code quality, performance, documentation, test coverage, engineering hygiene, and platform maintainability across APIs, workflows, dashboards, and integrations

• Use AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate development, debugging, automation, and testing while helping define practical guardrails for safe AI-based development and partnering with Product Operations stakeholders to translate platform needs into reliable technical execution

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

• You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• 5–6 years of experience in DevOps, platform engineering, infrastructure, SRE, software engineering, or a related role

• Strong hands-on experience with AWS, Terraform, CI/CD, monitoring, deployments, logging, and production support

• Practical full-stack development experience with technologies such as Python, Node.js, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, or similar

• Experience improving release reliability, application performance, code hygiene, documentation, test coverage, and operational stability

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience implementing AI-assisted engineering workflows, autonomous agents, or LLM-powered platform automation to accelerate developer productivity and system reliability

• Experience with Docker, Kubernetes/EKS/ECS, Lambda, CloudWatch, RDS, S3, or API Gateway

• Experience integrating with tools such as Jira, Salesforce, Slack, Confluence, Tableau, Power BI, or similar

jobs.title: Pizza Chef - Cecconis Bicester Village

The Role…

At Soho House, a Pizza Chef oversees the pizza station from dough stretching and topping to baking and plating. They play a key role in maintaining quality standards and ensuring a smooth, consistent service and is responsible for preparing and cooking a variety of high-quality pizzas using fresh, seasonal ingredients.

Your main responsibility is for demonstrating strong knowledge of dough handling, use of pizza ovens (wood-fired, gas, or electric), and excellent timing. They must be a team player who thrives in a fast-paced kitchen, with a passion for high standards and exceptional food presentation. .

What's in it for you?

• Team meal whilst on shift prepared by our chefs

• Soho Friends Membership

• 50% Team discount on Food & Drink, 7 days a week

• Staff Room Rates

• Health Cash Plan (option to up to 2 additional dependents)

• Dental Plan (option to add up to 2 additional dependents)

jobs.title: (Senior) Account Manager - Retail & CPG Vertical
jobs.description:
WongDoody creates human experiences! WongDoody schafft menschliche Erfahrungen in 24 Locations auf 4 Kontinenten. Wir glauben, dass die Zukunft gestaltbar ist. Indem wir menschliche Erfahrungen durch Kreativität und Technologie gestalten, arbeiten wir daran, eine Zukunft zu schaffen, an die wir glauben.

Für uns beginnt dies mit unserer eigenen Kultur. Wir streben danach, ein integratives Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem jeder Mensch sein ganzes Wesen in die Arbeit einbringen kann. Unsere Kund:innen sind Marken, an die wir glauben, von globalen Großunternehmen über lokale Held:innen bis hin zu Start-ups, die wir lieben. Mit jedem unserer Partner:innen begeben wir uns auf eine Reise der Co-Creation, bei der wir die Grenzen des Möglichen ausloten und den Raum erforschen, in dem Kreativität und Technologie aufeinander treffen.

Unser Team aus gut gelaunten, offenen, werteorientierten und kollaborativen Problemlöser:innen konzentriert sich bei allem, was wir tun auf ein Ziel: menschliche Erfahrungen. Menschliche Erfahrungen sind die Berührungspunkte, an denen Marken mit Kund:innen in Kontakt treten. Wir transformieren Unternehmen, indem wir mit Hilfe von Strategie, Kreativität, Daten und Technologie ansprechende, inspirierende Momente schaffen - unterstützt durch die globale technologische Stärke von Infosys.

Große Marken. Viel Raum für Deine Ideen.

Eine Maus, die die ganze Welt kennt. Ein Supermarkt, der Lebensmittel liebt. Und Kaffee, bei dem jede Woche eine neue Welt dazugehört. Klingelt’s? Genau für solche Marken entwickeln wir Ideen, Kampagnen und digitale Erlebnisse.

Und unsere Kundenwelt geht noch weiter: von Skincare und Interior bis zu Automotive und Technologie, von B2C bis B2B. Unsere Themen: Social & Influencer Marketing, Campaigning & Content und MarTech Solutions.

Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die mitdenken, eigene Ideen einbringen und Dinge bewegen wollen. Bei uns findest Du den Raum dafür – und ein Team, das Wissen teilt, sich gegenseitig den Rücken stärkt und gemeinsam mit Dir etwas aufbauen möchte.

Unsere lokalen Benefits

• Fexible Arbeitszeiten durch ein Arbeitszeitkonto mit 100 % Überstundenausgleich
• Arbeiten, von wo es dir passt – im Homeoffice, in einem unserer Büros (Stuttgart, Berlin, Düsseldorf) oder sogar befristet im EU-Ausland
• Kostenlose Snacks und Getränke in unseren Büros
• Ein innovatives Arbeitsumfeld mit moderner, technischer Ausstattung – MacBook, dienstliches iPhone sowie alle für deine Arbeit relevanten Tools
• Weiterbildungsangebote, um stets up-to-date zu bleiben
• 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr
• Zuschuss beim Urban Sports Club
• ﻿Mitarbeitervorteile & Rabatte über Corporate Benefits
• Ein inspirierendes Team, mit welchem die Zusammenarbeit für starke Marken Spaß macht

Das erwartet Dich

• Du übernimmst Verantwortung für definierte Accounts und Projekte, baust vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen auf und wirst zur geschätzten Ansprechperson für Beratung und Weiterentwicklung.
• Du verstehst, was Deine Kunden beschäftigt, denkst über das einzelne Briefing hinaus und bringst eigene Empfehlungen und Ideen ins Gespräch.
• Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Expert Lösungen rund um Social & Influencer Marketing, Campaigning & Content und MarTech Solutions – passend zu den Zielen und Herausforderungen Deiner Kunden.
• Du behältst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung Deiner Accounts im Blick: Du erstellst Angebote, begleitest Budgetabstimmungen und pflegst Planung und Forecast gemeinsam mit Deinem Director.
• Du bringst Kund und interne Disziplinen zusammen und hältst die Fäden in der Hand – vom ersten Briefing bis zur Umsetzung. Dabei sorgst Du für klare Ziele, abgestimmte Erwartungen und einen verlässlichen Blick auf Qualität, Timing und Budget.
• Du gestaltest Präsentationen und Workshops, vertrittst Empfehlungen überzeugend und sorgst dafür, dass aus Gesprächen klare nächste Schritte entstehen.
• Du bringst Dich auch über Deine Accounts hinaus ein: mit neuen Impulsen, geteiltem Wissen und Ideen, die unsere Zusammenarbeit besser machen. Dabei bekommst Du Rückhalt, ehrliches Feedback und Raum für Deine Entwicklung.

Das bringst Du mit

• Ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft oder Kommunikation, eine vergleichbare Ausbildung oder einen anderen passenden beruflichen Weg sowie mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im Account Management.
• Erfahrung im Agenturumfeld und Freude daran, Kundenbeziehungen eigenständig zu führen und weiterzuentwickeln. Auch aus dem Projektmanagement bringst Du eine gute Grundlage mit, wenn Du bereits belastbare Beratungs- und kaufmännische Verantwortung übernommen hast.
• Ein gutes Gespür für Marken, Märkte und Zielgruppen sowie die Fähigkeit, aus Kundenbedürfnissen konkrete Empfehlungen abzuleiten.
• Erfahrung mit digitalen Kampagnen, Social Media, Content oder Influencer Marketing und Interesse daran, Dein Wissen um digitale Plattformen und MarTech Solutions zu erweitern.
• Kaufmännisches Verständnis: Du kannst Angebote und Budgets einordnen und erkennst, was eine wirtschaftlich gesunde Kundenbeziehung ausmacht.
• Eigeninitiative und eine lösungsorientierte Haltung: Du sprichst Herausforderungen früh an, entwickelst Vorschläge und bringst Themen voran.
• Eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise, klare Prioritäten und ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann Du selbst entscheidest und wann Du andere einbindest.
• Teamgeist, Offenheit für Feedback und Lust, Wissen zu teilen und gemeinsam Neues auszuprobieren – auch rund um KI und neue Technologien.
• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse, mit denen Du sicher beraten, präsentieren und diskutieren kannst.

Für uns zählt allein Deine Persönlichkeit und Deine beruflichen Fähigkeiten. Dein Geschlecht, Alter oder Aussehen, Deine Herkunft oder sexuelle Orientierung spielen für uns keine Rolle – wir sind offen für die Zusammenarbeit mit jeder Person.

jobs.title: Operations Manager - West Midlands Sort Centre
jobs.description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.



THE TEAM
• ~160 people,  around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation



The Opportunity

You will report to the Site Manager/Head of Site and will run shifts at one of our Hybrid Sort Centres (HSCs), leading 50–100+ operatives through high-volume, time-pressured sortation where minutes matter and small deviations cascade into missed deadlines. Each of our HSCs handle over 40 million parcels annually, with our largest site measuring more than 300,000 sq ft.

You will also be accountable for whether the site is measurably better in a month than it is today for each of our key metrics. You are on the floor for your shift, every shift. This is not a project role with occasional site visits and it is not a desk job, the forward work happens along with running the operation.

 

Who will thrive in this role

 - Deliver shift plan end to end people deployment, throughput, quality standards, and health & safety compliance

 - Lead, develop, and performance-manage a frontline team of 50–100+ operatives

 - Build the mechanisms that hold the operation together. Build controls, cadences, metrics, SOPs, change management and own their adoption, not only their design

 - Plan ahead for future shifts; labour, training, and the risks you can see coming before they land

 - Own the end-of-shift handover; what happened, what is at risk, what the next shift needs to know

 - Stay decisive through volume peaks, outages, and labour gaps. Triage, solve the problem at hand quickly, contain the impact, restore flow

 - Present and write clearly whether briefs, escalations, handovers or post-incident reviews. Decisions here get made based off what you wrote

 - Implement changes into a live operation such as introducing robotics, launching new sortation tech or onboarding new clients. We are changing the operations constantly which means you’ll roll change out mid flight and bring your team along the journey.

 

Who you are

 - Scaled something from zero: a site, a market, a process or a program.

 - Managed a physical operation: quick commerce, grocery, e-commerce fulfillment, last mile, 3PL, food production, airport ground handling, rail. Anywhere with a hard cut off and people on the floor.

 - Communicate in both directions and have strong people management skills: you can brief 80 operatives at shift start and take a problem to senior leadership the same day.

 - Built a mechanism that held: a control, a cadence, a metric, a document standard. Something you authored that changed how frontline teams worked.

 - Own numbers rather than report them:  you can name a metric you created or redefined, explain why the previous one was wrong, and say what changed afterwards.

 - Understand frontline work: one of these must be true: you have personally led frontline teams; you have worked embedded in and around a frontline population day to day, without the reporting line; or you have been accountable for outcomes delivered by frontline people you did not employ.

You do not need to have worked in parcels, fulfilment, or sortation. Several of our most talented people had not.

 

Backgrounds that translate well

 - Program Manager in a logistics or e-commerce business

 - Operations Excellence and Continuous Improvement

 - Strategy & Operations

 - Transformation manager

 - Launch and Expansion Manager

 - Regional operations manager

We have hired well from corporate operations, from central operations inside large UK retailers and carriers, and from quick commerce and marketplace operators. Consulting backgrounds work where you implemented, not only recommended; we are keen to understand what you who actually rolled it out.

 

Hiring process

Our hiring process is fast.

 - Initial screen (15 min)

 - Hiring Manager conversation (90 min) - 45 min onsite interview immediately followed by a 45 min site tour where you shadow an existing shift manager

 - Final interview (45 min). Decision and offer within 48 hours



Who Thrives at Relay?

 - Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

 - Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

 - 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

 - All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

 - People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

 - Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.
   
   If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.



Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

jobs.title: Gestor de Mercado de Capitais - Standard Invest
jobs.description:
Promover e comercializar os produtos e serviços disponibilizados pela Sala de Mercados da Standard Invest, identificando as necessidades financeiras e de investimento dos clientes e apresentando soluções adequadas ao seu perfil. O titular da função deverá contribuir para o cumprimento das metas comerciais, o crescimento sustentável das receitas e o fortalecimento das relações com os clientes, assegurando uma experiência de serviço de excelência e o cumprimento das políticas internas, dos limites de risco e dos requisitos legais e regulamentares aplicáveis.

Funções Essenciais

Acompanhamento dos Mercados Financeiros

• Monitorizar a evolução dos mercados financeiros, das taxas de juro, dos preços dos activos e dos principais indicadores económicos.
• Acompanhar tendências sectoriais, alterações regulamentares e desenvolvimentos de produtos.
• Recolher, analisar e sintetizar informação de mercado relevante para a equipa e para os clientes.
• Identificar riscos e oportunidades resultantes da evolução dos mercados e do contexto macroeconómico.

Gestão da Carteira de Clientes

• Gerir e desenvolver uma carteira de clientes, assegurando um acompanhamento regular e orientado para as suas necessidades financeiras e de investimento.
• Preparar propostas comerciais, apresentações, análises de mercado e outros materiais de apoio às interacções com os clientes.
• Acompanhar a actividade, a rentabilidade e o potencial de crescimento da carteira.
• Disponibilizar informação clara, precisa e atempada, apoiando os clientes na tomada de decisões de investimento.

Desenvolvimento Comercial

• Identificar e desenvolver oportunidades de negócio junto de clientes actuais e potenciais.
• Promover vendas cruzadas, em articulação com outras áreas da Standard Invest e do Grupo.
• Recomendar produtos e serviços adequados aos objectivos, necessidades e perfil dos clientes.
• Acompanhar o processo comercial desde a identificação da oportunidade até à concretização da transacção.

Análise de Clientes e Gestão de Informação

• Analisar as carteiras dos clientes, o histórico de transacções e a informação financeira e comercial disponível.
• Avaliar demonstrações financeiras, fluxos de caixa, calendários de dividendos e outros dados relevantes.
• Utilizar dados financeiros e de mercado para identificar oportunidades de investimento, desinvestimento ou optimização das carteiras.
• Assegurar a exactidão, confidencialidade e actualização permanente da informação dos clientes.

Atendimento e Experiência do Cliente

• Receber, analisar e responder às solicitações dos clientes de forma clara, profissional e atempada.
• Articular com as equipas operacionais e de suporte para assegurar a resolução eficaz de dúvidas, reclamações ou constrangimentos.
• Desenvolver relações de confiança e de longo prazo, assentes na transparência, no conhecimento técnico e na qualidade do serviço.
• Recolher o feedback dos clientes e propor melhorias aos produtos, serviços e processos internos.

Gestão de Risco e Conformidade

• Assegurar que as actividades comerciais e as transacções respeitem as políticas internas, os limites de risco e a regulamentação aplicável.
• Garantir transparência na apresentação das características, custos, riscos e potenciais benefícios dos produtos.
• Identificar e reportar atempadamente potenciais riscos operacionais, comerciais, reputacionais ou regulamentares.

Inovação e Transformação Digital

• Apoiar a implementação das iniciativas e da estratégia digital da Standard Invest.
• Promover a utilização dos canais digitais e das ferramentas de auto-atendimento disponibilizadas aos clientes.
• Identificar oportunidades de simplificação e automatização dos processos comerciais e operacionais.

jobs.title: Senior BizOps Analyst - Product Operations
jobs.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Senior BizOps Analyst - Product Operations to join our team. This is a hybrid role, reporting to the Director, Product Revenue in the Product Operations department.

In this fast-paced, high-impact individual contributor role, you will combine strong business acumen with SQL, Python, data modeling, dashboards, custom data applications, and AI-enabled workflows. You will help Product Operations turn ambiguous business problems into clear signals, scalable analytics, decision workflows, and practical tools that improve how teams operate.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Partner with Product leadership to clarify high-priority business questions and define the signals, dashboards, workflows, or AI agents needed to accelerate product and operational decision-making

• Own the Product Operations signals repository as the single source of truth for business logic, data inputs, definitions, owners, status, and documentation

• Build clean, reusable data models and advanced SQL transformations that power dashboards, custom applications, decision workflows, and AI agents

• Develop dashboards and Python-based custom data applications when standard BI tools are not sufficient, ensuring solutions are adopted and actively used by teams

• Translate ambiguous Product Operations problems into buildable specifications, review AI agent outputs, apply ML/NLP techniques where useful, and present signal performance and recommendations clearly to stakeholders

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

• You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• 3–5 years of experience in data, analytics, business operations, product operations, or a related role

• Strong SQL skills, practical Python experience, and the ability to transform, structure, and validate complex datasets

• Strong data modeling skills with the ability to design clean, scalable, reusable datasets and metric/signal definitions

• Proven ability to translate ambiguous Product Operations problems into buildable signal specifications, dashboards, applications, or workflows, supported by strong documentation, communication, and independent execution skills

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience designing, evaluating, or integrating AI agents, LLMs, or automated decision workflows to streamline product operations and signal detection

• Experience working directly with Product teams

• Experience building internal tools or custom applications beyond standard BI dashboards

jobs.title: Head of Product Marketing & Campaigns - US (all genders)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful.

Through our platforms GotPhoto.com http://GotPhoto.com and fotograf.de http://fotograf.de, we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens.

Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories https://gotphoto.com/success-stories/ along the way.

As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments.

Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before.




HEAD OF PRODUCT MARKETING & CAMPAIGNS

Do you want to connect product innovation with market execution and lead the team behind it?

Are you ready to own a GTM process, a campaign calendar across markets, and a team of four at a fast-moving B2B SaaS company?

...then you are our perfect match!

This role is remote from the US or Canada (Eastern or Central Time) and reports directly to our Marketing Director.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Drive Product Marketing Maturity & GTM Execution

 - Product Marketing Leadership: Transform Product Marketing into a strategic engine by defining clear value props, go-to-market playbooks, and crisp customer positioning.

 - Go-To-Market Alignment: Audit and fix current GTM gaps to ensure reliable, high-impact product launches that unify Product, Revenue, and Support teams around a shared timeline.

Own the Campaign Calendar for our markets

 - Plan and run the campaigns that deliver our MQL targets in the growth market US as well as in the established markets Germany / Austria / Switzerland and UK.

 - Prioritize and sequence campaigns and its content across channels together with your team and agency partners.

Deliver Events That Work

 - Run online events with strong attendance and offline events that our customers rate highly.

 - Make sure every event ties back to the campaign calendar and our growth targets.

Build an Active Online & Offline Community

 - Turn customers, prospects, and advocates into passionate brand fans across both digital spaces and in-person touchpoints. 

 - Design programs, rituals, and peer-to-peer engagement that continuously educate, activate, and empower our community.

Lead a Team of Four

 - Lead product marketing, content marketing, events, community and social media.

 - Set clear goals, build operational workflows and develop your people.

 - Manage the agency that delivers our website and graphic work, from briefing to quality review.

Work Across Teams and Markets

 - Collaborate closely with Product, Sales and Customer Support.

 - Bring a US perspective into a global marketing team that also serves DACH and the UK.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Experience

 - B2B SaaS Marketing: You have 7 to 10 years of experience, including product marketing and GTM launches.

 - SMB Environments: You know how to reach and convert small and mid-sized business customers.

 - People Leadership: You have led a marketing team and know how to build workflows around it.

Skills

 - Strategic GTM Thinking: You connect product strategy to market execution.

 - Hands-on Campaign Execution: You can plan a campaign and also ship it.

 - Stakeholder Management: You align Product, Sales and Support without friction.

 - Tools: HubSpot is a must; the Atlassian suite is a plus.

 - Language: Excellent written and spoken English.

Mindset

 - Extreme Ownership: You take responsibility for results, not only for tasks.

 - Pragmatism: You choose the solution that works over the one that looks perfect.

 - Finisher Mindset: You bring projects across the line.

 - Builder Mentality: You enjoy creating structure where none exists yet.




WHY YOU’LL LOVE LIFE AT GOTPHOTO

 - Work Where You’re Best: In the US, we are a remote-first organization that prioritizes impact over office hours. While our roots are international, we empower our US team to design a workspace that fuels their best work—whether that’s a home office, a local café, or wherever you find your focus. You bring the talent; we provide the flexibility.  Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We believe in flexibility that respects your lifestyle. You have the option to work abroad for up to 40 days per year. Whether you are visiting family or simply seeking a change of scenery, we support a work-from-anywhere culture that helps you stay inspired.

 - Recharge & Unwind: We prioritize your well-being over a fixed tally of hours, which is why we offer a flexible, unlimited PTO policy and flexible sick days. Whether you need a long-awaited vacation, or time to recover from the unexpected, you have the autonomy to take the time you need to stay at your best.

 - Comprehensive Care: We provide comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you and your family are fully covered. We complement our core healthcare with a broad range of additional benefits, offering a mix of company-sponsored coverage and voluntary options designed to protect your income and your household.

 - Multicultural & Inclusive Team: We thrive on diverse perspectives. Our international team fosters a culture of mutual respect and professional exchange, ensuring that fresh ideas and tolerance are at the heart of everything we build together.

 - Fuel Your Growth: We’re big on learning. You’ll get a dedicated education budget to explore new ideas and grow professionally.

 - Stay Active, Wherever You Are: Your wellbeing matters to us. Through FitOn, you’ll get access to a wide range of online fitness and wellness classes — from yoga and strength training to cardio and mindfulness — so you can stay active and recharge wherever you work.




WHAT MATTERS TO US

Research shows that candidates from underrepresented backgrounds may refrain from applying for positions if they feel they don't meet all qualifications. We strongly encourage you to apply if you’re interested: we're excited to discover how your distinctive experience can enhance our team!

We work as one team. Wherever you come from. However, you identify. We believe in equal opportunities.

jobs.description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to know our team:

In Product, ideas come alive. The world is moving fast so our culture empowers ownership and minimal bureaucracy. That’s the environment that enables you to do what you think is right – and quickly. Our Product Managers move fast, fail, learn, and pivot.

Being a product-centric organization, our team works cross-functionally to build products from conception to launch by bringing together engineering and business worlds. Agoda Product Managers work closely with executive leadership and have high visibility among the C-suite; they have direct impact on Agoda’s growth and strategy. jobs.title: Senior People Partner - GTM
jobs.description:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.



Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.



Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.



A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.



🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.



 💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.



🤝  We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.



💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.



Orbital is building the AI technology powering the future of enterprise legal work. We're growing fast, and we need a Senior People Partner who wants to help us get this right from the ground up.



This isn't a maintain-the-machine role. You'll be the first People hire in the US, partnering with our GTM leadership while also owning the design and build of people solutions that actually scale. Strategy and execution. Influence and craft. Both, in the same role.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

You'll sit across two layers of how our People function operates: Partner and Product.

 - As a Partner, you'll work closely with our go-to-market managers, coaching them through performance, team health, and people challenges, and building the kind of trusted relationships that give you real signal on what needs fixing.

 - As a Product builder, you'll take those insights and turn them into scalable solutions: frameworks, enablement tools, programs, and processes that don't just solve the immediate problem but grow with the business.

Your early focus will include manager capability, performance enablement, and building out the US-specific foundations of our People stack, including compliance, leave administration, and multi-state employment. But you'll help shape the roadmap, not just inherit one.




YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF YOU

 - Have strong People Partnering experience, ideally supporting GTM, Sales or Commercial teams

 - Know US employment law well: FLSA, FMLA, Title VII, ADA, multi-state compliance, at-will

 - Think like a product manager: you diagnose before you design, and you measure what you ship

 - Are energised by ambiguity and building from scratch, not navigating existing bureaucracy

 - Bring both the strategic thinking and the hands-on drive to see things through

 - Are curious about AI and technology and actively look for ways to work smarter

 - Experience in high-growth tech or legaltech; OTE and variable comp exposure; any UK employment law familiarity.




WHAT WE'RE OFFERING

 - $165,000-$185,000 base salary depending on experience, plus equity, 401k match, and comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage.

 - Hybrid role: 2 days in our New York office. Generous PTO, parental leave, commuter benefits, and a personal development budget.

 - You'll be joining at the moment it matters, early enough to shape how the US function is built, with the backing of an experienced London-based team behind you.




THE PROCESS

 1. Screening call (60 min)

 2. Hiring Manager call (60 min)

 3. Take-home task

 4. Panel discussion and Culture conversation (90 min)

 5. Offer

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.



💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.



💰 This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on several factors, which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements.



Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.

jobs.title: InfoSec Lead
jobs.description:
Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work.



Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual.



Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate.



A bit about us:

🚀 We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on.



🏢 Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal-grade precision.



 💰 We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date.



🤝  We're trusted by 5,000+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster.



💡 Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one.




THE ROLE

Orbital has been scaling fast, and we’re scaling or security and compliance with it. We're hiring a senior, NYC-based InfoSec Lead to own our information security due diligence, compliance, and vendor risk end-to-end - bringing structure and consistency to work that's currently covered on a contractor basis.

Now is the time to bring this function in-house, focusing on automating manual tasks (such as customer DDQs), enhancing our compliance stance, and ultimately securing the Infosec function as a proactive enabler of our growth.

This is a full-time InfoSec role, working alongside our UK-based IT Manager. Whilst experience in IT operations or IT management is helpful, the Infosec Lead and IT Manager report independently to our Head of Operations and own separate (but naturally interconnected) remits.

You’ll also work closely with Engineering, Product, Legal and our external Infosec support, to keep security and compliance embedded in how the business runs, not bolted on after the fact.

Based in the US, with ideally some flexibility to come to the New York office.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN




INFOSEC & COMPLIANCE DELIVERY

You will:

 - Own our InfoSec strategy and roadmap: set the direction for how security and compliance scale with the business, not just an executor; identify control gaps and weaknesses, prioritize remediation, and track it through to completion.

 - Own our risk program: run risk identification, assessment and treatment, keep the risk register current. You're making the call on what's an acceptable risk.

 - Own third party risk assurance, in both directions: run vendor security reviews for vendors we bring on (or are renewing with) and own customer & vendor due diligence (DDQs) when we’re the ones being assessed.
   
   - Pull in support required from the rest of the business and jump on client calls when needed to resolve DDQs.
   
   - Drive automation on the DDQ side specifically, so it doesn’t eat a disproportionate share of your time as the function matures.

 - Own our existing and future compliance certifications: you’ll be responsible for maintaining compliance with existing standards (ISO 27001 and SOC2 Type 2) and pursuing future certifications relevant to us. Management of the compliance program will be end-to-end, and involve ISMS management reviews, quarterly access control reviews, audit evidence gathering, scheduling and remediation tracking.
   
   - This also includes keeping policy & public-facing security documentation (eg. our trust centre) current - so certification is a continuously-run capability rather than a periodic scramble.

 - Partner cross-functionally: work with Engineering, Product, and Legal to embed security and compliance requirements into how we build and sell, and stay close enough to product changes that customer-facing security information is always accurate.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Significant senior in-house or scale-up InfoSec leadership experience: you've owned due diligence, vendor review, and compliance work end-to-end inside a fast-moving business, not just advised from the outside.

 - Strong understanding of cloud & cloud security, and ideally previous technical background in IT Security or SWE / DevOps.

 - A track record of scaling due-diligence processes, not just running them manually, you know how to spot what can be templated, automated, or self-served, and you make that happen rather than just wishing for it.

 - Comfortable being close to engineering: you don't need to write code, but you're happy sitting in technical conversations, understanding product changes, and knowing enough about IT systems to weigh in sensibly on security-sensitive changes.

 - Pragmatic and delivery-focused: you know the difference between a genuine risk and a distraction, and you keep due diligence and audit work moving at commercial pace rather than becoming a bottleneck.

 - AI-literacy with working familiarity with AI governance (ISO 42001, EU AI Act etc).

 - Comfortable operating independently: this is an individual-contributor role to start, with real ownership of the roadmap rather than a narrow, audit-only remit.

 - Working knowledge of privacy law is important (GDPR/CCPA/US state privacy laws) to partner with our legal function.




WHY THIS MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

 - You want to run day-to-day IT operations or manage IT staff. That sits with our IT Manager, not this role.

 - You prefer tasks defined and handed to you. This is a role for an independent decision maker... you're expected to identify what needs doing, set the plan, and drive it to closure yourself, not wait to be briefed.

 - You feel more comfortable with a narrowly-defined, audit-only remit. This role sits close to Engineering, Product, and Legal, and is expected to actively reduce manual DDQ overhead over time, not just process tickets.




WHY JOIN ORBITAL

 - Shape how security and compliance scale with the business... the processes and playbooks here are still being built.

 - Genuine cross-functional influence: you'll be close to Engineering, Product, and Legal, not sitting outside them.

 - Genuine momentum: $60m Series B, doubling headcount, expanding across two continents.

 - Work alongside a leadership team that treats security as a business enabler, not just a risk function.

🔒 Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital. We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on.



💡 At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Director of Sales
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

The Director of Sales will represent Rootstock Vaults as the sell side and find the buy side for its products. You will sign funds, treasuries and trusts, bitcoin holders and bitcoin companies as customers for dollar loans, dollar yield and, as they become available, bitcoin yield opportunities.

Success is a loan book that grows past RootstockLabs' own treasury on arm's-length customers who stay, at a spread that pays for the product.

You will work with the Director of Partnerships on distribution partners, Product team on offers and pricing, and Legal team on terms and checks.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Deliver and own the Rootstock Vaults sales plan: ideal customer profile and target list for each buyer type, conversion assumptions and a weekly forecast, delivered within your first 60 days

• Run sales as a clean, repeatable process from month 3: qualify and check every counterparty before terms are shared, code every lost deal by reason, and keep the pipeline current in the CRM each week

jobs.title: Sr. People Partner
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

At Samsara, our People Partners contribute to organizational strategy and meaningfully impact business outcomes. We are looking for a Senior People Partner to support key segments across our Go-To-Market (GTM) and Sales teams.  Reporting directly to the Director, GTM People Partners, you will work alongside executive leadership, facilitate strategy, and solve high-impact, real-world business challenges.

We’re moving fast, reinventing playbooks, and actively embracing the new era of AI and modern organizational dynamics. We operate with a creative, problem-solving mindset that prioritizes common-sense solutions and business-focused metrics. If you thrive on building trusted leader relationships, tackling complex talent challenges, and driving measurable impact, this is the team for you.

This role is open to candidates residing in the US or Canada.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

• Act as a Strategic Thought Partner: Establish yourself as an indispensable, embedded partner to sales and GTM leaders by aligning talent priorities directly with business outcomes.

• Drive Creative Problem-Solving: Acts with urgency, proactively diagnosing team, manager, and organizational needs, and recommends business aligned solutions.

• Execute Core Talent Programs: Drive continuous talent management, compensation/reward programs, and retention strategies designed to lower attrition in high-volume GTM environments.

• Collaborate Across the People Function: Partner seamlessly with Regional People Partners, Program Managers, and COEs to build, scale, and seamlessly deliver strategic people solutions.

• Champion Samsara's Culture: Role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

• Connect in Person: Travel roughly once per quarter for leadership offsites, business strategy meetings, and key team gatherings.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• 6+ years of relevant experience in People Operations.

• Experience partnering with go-to-market teams (sales, CS or similar), or broader People experience (programs, talent, etc.) alongside business partnering.

• Learning oriented with demonstrated experience leveraging AI to automate routine tasks.

• Ability to work well in a fast-paced, iterative environment, open to changes in focus and direction.

• Excellent analytical capability, attention to detail, and problem-solving acumen.

• Experience using data to identify insights and influence leadership decision-making.

• Effective communication, consulting, coaching and facilitation skills.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
