jobs.title: People Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In two years' time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over one million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.


ABOUT THE ROLE

At Bitvavo, we believe that exceptional employee experiences fuel high performing teams and bold company growth. As a People Operations Specialist, you will be the day to day engine behind the employee lifecycle across our pan European, multi entity setup, supporting everything from onboarding to offboarding, and keeping our core HR processes running accurately and smoothly.

You will bring structure and reliability to high volume operational work, while building deep expertise across our European entities. This is a strong next step for someone who has moved past the basics of HR administration and is ready to take real ownership of processes, with support close at hand as you grow.


LOCATION

This role is based in Amsterdam. Relocation is not available for this position, and we are only considering candidates who are currently residing in the Netherlands.


WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

 - Act as the first point of contact for employee inquiries, managing and resolving requests through our ticketing system within defined SLAs, and support benefits administration and documentation updates

 - Provide day to day support across the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, contracts, benefits, visas, leaves and data changes, across our multi entity setup

 - Input and validate employee data in Personio, supporting accurate and up to date digital employee files across our entities

 - Prepare basic payroll mutations, such as salary changes, allowances, deductions and leave requests, and support the payroll accuracy process

 - Coordinate onboarding and offboarding tasks end to end, ensuring a smooth and unified experience for new hires and leavers

 - Assist in creating and maintaining People Ops documentation, templates and checklists, and help spot opportunities to streamline manual steps in the processes you run

 - Maintain data accuracy and contribute to monthly reporting

 - Escalate non standard, high risk or complex issues to the Team Lead with clear context

 - Build growing knowledge of People Ops processes, compliance requirements across our entities, and HRIS capabilities

 - Collaborate closely with People Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, managers and other business stakeholders to provide high quality operational support


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

This role requires at least 3 years of experience in a People Operations or HR Generalist role, including a mandatory minimum of 2 years of experience in the Dutch market with Dutch labour law. We are not able to consider candidates without this experience.

You are reliable, detail oriented, and genuinely care about getting things right for the people you support. You are comfortable owning recurring processes end to end, but you also know when something is outside the standard playbook, and loop in your Team Lead with the context they need to make fast decisions.

 - Ideally gained in a fast paced, tech or scale-up environment

 - Comfortable managing administrative processes across multiple entities

 - Strong prioritization and attention to detail, able to handle multiple open threads at once without losing accuracy

 - Excellent written and verbal English communication skills


DESIRABLE

 - Exposure to HR practices in other European countries

 - Experience with HRIS systems, EOR services or ticketing systems

Every contract you process, every question you answer and every onboarding you coordinate shapes how people experience Bitvavo, from their first day to their last. That’s real impact. If you’re someone who takes ownership, delivers and lifts the team around you, come and make it happen with us!

At Bitvavo, we believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, foster creativity, and lead to better outcomes. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ability, or any other characteristic. Join us and be part of a team that values and celebrates your unique contributions.

Bitvavo does not accept resumes from staffing, search, or recruitment firms without a signed agreement. If you send us a resume without such an agreement, we may contact the candidate directly without any obligation whatsoever and no fee of any kind will be paid should we hire the candidate.


WHAT WE OFFER

At Bitvavo, we believe in attracting, motivating and retaining talented people through market-competitive offerings that go beyond compensation alone. To learn more about our total rewards package and the benefits we offer, visit our Life at Bitvavo page.

• Support future laboratory planning, including capacity assessments, instrument selection, and introduction of new services.
• Mentor and support laboratory staff through technical training, knowledge sharing, and competency development.
• Ensure laboratory is operated in a safe manner in accordance with Eurofins H&S system requirements.

• Significant experience in a UKAS/INAB 17025 Laboratory. Working with ICP-MS, ICP-OES, Gallery/Kone or other automated photometric analyser, Ion Chromatography and other Wet Chemistry techniques– will have extensive maintenance and troubleshooting experience on most of the above listed techniques.
• 5 years experience in method development, method optimisation and validation.
• Able to research and advise on emerging technologies, method improvements, automation and emerging contaminants.
• Able to develop any new and diverse Inorganic analytical techniques as required by the customer and business.
• Able to demonstrate technical knowledge to supervise and lead others through training, coaching and mentoring.
• Proven track record of training, knowledge sharing in respected scientific techniques within commercial set-up.
• Able to investigate complex investigations related to performance of the methods, implement change improvements and preventative measures.
• Quality: ensure that quality systems are fit for purpose, including improving documentation, processes, training.
• Perform testing as required to ensure customer and operational needs are met.
• Scientific Degree in Chemistry or Analytical Chemistry.

Soft skills expected:

Ability to manage projects and coordinate tasks,

Ability to work meticulously and in an organized manner,

Time-conscious and organized,

Strong written and verbal communication skills,

Ability to communicate with third parties

What can we offer you?

• Fixed term contract;
• Flexible working hours;
• A dynamic team with flat hierarchies and opportunities for active participation;
• Personal and professional development opportunities, as well as exclusive benefits for Eurofins employees;

We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.

We embrace diversity! Eurofins network of companies believe in strength and innovation through diversity, being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.

Sustainability matters to us!  We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we also count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!

Find out more in our career page: https://careers.eurofins.com/

Company description: Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organisations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 35 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to ca. 65,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of 950 laboratories in 60 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.9 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition
jobs.description:
Nex is on a mission to help families rediscover the joy of movement. Created by parents for parents, Nex combines technology and play to deliver fun, social, and interactive experiences powered by natural body motion, encouraging kids and adults to move more, play more, and have fun together. Nex Playground, the company’s award-winning active play system, is purpose-built to get families moving year-round, with safety and privacy as core considerations in its intentional design. It is certified kidSAFE+ COPPA compliant and built to support healthy, active play for all ages and abilities.

Nex Playground features a growing library of 50+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. Content includes collaborations with partners like Hasbro, Sesame Workshop, and NBCUniversal. Nex has been recognized by Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, TIME’s Best Inventions, and Parents’ Best Entertainment System for Families, and has earned Red Dot, IDEA, and Core77 international design awards. We encourage you to explore Have Fun and Is Motion Gaming Back?, as they offer a deeper look into our culture, values, and explain how our approach to motion gaming differs from previous generations.

Nex employees may be expected to collaborate with colleagues across different time zones. Depending on the role and location, occasional travel may also be required for company events, external meetings, and other business-related activities.

Important Notice: ⚠️ To protect yourself from recruitment scams, please note that Nex communicates through official company emails ending in @nex.inc. If you receive a suspicious email or message, please do not respond and report it immediately to us.

Location: San Jose, California (Hybrid)
Annual salary: USD 175,000 - USD 200,000
Final base salary within this range will be determined based on job-related factors, including the candidate’s experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.
Type: Full Time

The Role

Nex is scaling fast, and we’re looking for a Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition to lead our US TA team through it. You’ll drive how we find, engage, and win top talent across technical and non-technical functions, including GTM, Creative, and G&A, while building a high-performing team and recruiting engine that keeps pace with our growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who thrives on speed and ambiguity. You’ll partner closely with business leaders as a trusted advisor on talent strategy and workforce planning. You’ll challenge assumptions and push for data-informed hiring decisions.

You’ll lead and develop the recruiting team, driving execution, performance, and consistent hiring standards. You’ll also lead complex technical, GTM, G&A, and executive searches yourself. The goal is a talent function that moves fast without compromising on quality.

What You'll Do

The role is about 60% hands-on recruiting and 40% people leadership. As we scale, expect the balance to shift toward leadership.

• Recruit directly for executive, senior leadership, and hard-to-fill roles across technical, GTM, and G&A functions, from market mapping through closing.

• Lead the day-to-day of the US Talent Acquisition team, keeping recruiting priorities, resources, and capacity aligned with changing business needs.

• Coach, develop, and grow a team of recruiters. Set goals, drive accountability, and build their business acumen and influencing skills, while creating a team culture of ownership and continuous learning.

• Deliver against quarterly and annual hiring targets, with proactive pipelines for critical and hard-to-fill roles.

• Own the talent attraction strategy, using competitive intel, market research, targeted sourcing, and activations to build top-of-funnel pipeline in competitive markets.

• Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and business leaders on talent availability, market conditions, compensation expectations, and hiring approach.

• Challenge hiring assumptions and influence decisions on role requirements, leveling, interview process, and candidate selection.

• Use data to spot talent trends, benchmark against competitors, measure how well each sourcing channel works, and flag hiring risks and bottlenecks before they affect the business.

What You Bring

• 8 - 10+ years of recruiting experience, with at least 3 - 5 years managing and growing recruiting teams at a company in rapid growth.

• A proven track record of leading complex executive, senior-level, and hard-to-fill searches across technical, GTM, Creative, and G&A functions.

• Hands-on experience designing sourcing and talent attraction programs from the ground up. You’re fluent in employer brand, recruitment marketing, and modern recruiting tech, including LinkedIn Recruiter, ATS/CRM platforms, and AI-powered sourcing tools.

• Comfort with numbers. You use recruiting data to understand what’s working, anticipate hiring demand, and give leadership clear, actionable recommendations.

• Strong influence with senior leaders. You build credibility quickly, give candid advice, and aren’t afraid to challenge a hiring decision when it matters.

• A solid understanding of US recruiting compliance, and experience partnering with People, Legal, and other stakeholders.

• You thrive when things are moving fast: you’re comfortable with shifting priorities, ambiguity, and rolling up your sleeves.

#LI-Hybrid

We Offer

• Competitive compensation package.

• Flexible working hours and vacation policy.

• Product-driven culture that treasures talents and individual growth.

• Front-row seat and hands-on experience with cutting edge technologies in the evolving gaming field

Nex is located in San Jose, California, USA and Hong Kong. Learn more about us at https://www.nexplayground.com/about.

We encourage applications even if you don’t meet more than 50% of the requirements — we believe that experience comes in many forms!

Nex is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. jobs.title: Design Project Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most by challenging norms and fixing the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7/365, and created an ER experience that focuses on what our pets and pet parents really need. We’ve done the same for our people (VEGgies), finding a way to say YES so they are empowered to achieve great things, grow in unexpected ways, and find a place where they truly belong.

We’re rethinking emergency care from every angle—from how we run our hospitals to how we support the people working inside them. That’s where our headquarters team comes in. Whether building technology to make our hospitals more efficient, recruiting and growing incredible VEGgies, or bringing our brand to life through marketing, our VQ (VEG Headquarters) team makes it all possible—ensuring our hospitals and people have everything they need to help pets and their families.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

At VEG, we find a way to say YES–and this role brings that mindset to how we design hospitals that make a different kind of emergency care possible. As Design Project Manager, you’ll combine the hands-on design of new VEG hospitals while also assisting with relocations, expansions, and renovations; seeing each project through from initial site evaluation and space planning through construction and opening. You’ll turn spaces into functional, welcoming hospitals for our teams, customers, and pets.

You’ll develop floor plans, guide external architects and engineers, review construction documents, and keep design decisions and deliverables moving. Working cross-functionally with Real Estate, Construction, Operations, and hospital leadership, you’ll balance clinical needs, customer experience, brand standards, and project schedules.

You’ll see your work directly help people and their pets when they need it most, find ways to bring VEG’s hospital experience to life, learn from the people using it, and help make the next hospital better.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Own hospital design projects. Lead the design process primarily for new hospitals, while supporting relocations, expansions, and renovations. Manage schedules, deliverables, decisions, and approvals across multiple projects, anticipating risks and keeping work moving from site evaluation through opening.

• Turn challenging spaces into functional hospitals. Evaluate existing conditions and site constraints, then develop test fits and floor plans that support clinical workflows, customer access, equipment needs, and VEG’s design standards.

• Bring the right people and requirements together. Guide external architects, engineers, and consultants, and partner with Real Estate, Construction, Operations, IT, Facilities, and hospital leaders to resolve competing needs and deliver coordinated designs.

• Get the details right before construction. Critically review architectural and engineering documents for accuracy, coordination, and alignment with approved plans and standards. Work with architects and permitting partners to resolve gaps, review comments, and approval requirements.

• Solve problems as projects become real. Partner with Construction on field conditions, requests for information, submittals, substitutions, and value-engineering decisions. Explain tradeoffs, protect essential functionality, and ensure approved changes reach the right people and documents.

• Improve the next hospital through what you learn. Gather feedback from hospital teams and completed projects, and help strengthen layouts, finishes, details, specifications, and review processes so good solutions carry forward and recurring problems do not.

WHAT YOU NEED

• Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Interior Design, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Architectural licensure or NCIDQ certification is welcome but not required.

• 5+ years of experience in architectural design or design project management, including responsibility for multiple concurrent projects.

• Experience delivering commercial interiors or tenant improvement projects from space planning through construction. Experience designing veterinary hospitals (or other animal care facilities) is a huge plus. Retail, restaurant, healthcare, or other repeat-location programs are particularly relevant.

• Strong space-planning skills and the ability to turn operational requirements into functional, buildable layouts.

• Experience coordinating external architects, engineers, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

• Ability to read and critically review architectural, structural, and mechanical, electrical, and plumbing drawings.

• Working knowledge of building codes, accessibility requirements, and permitting processes, with the ability to identify issues and coordinate resolution with the architect of record.

• Proficiency in AutoCAD and Bluebeam; experience with Revit, SketchUp, rendering tools, and project management software is a plus.

• Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through, with the ability to manage shifting priorities and keep decisions moving.

• Clear written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to explain design recommendations to people without a design background.

• Ability to travel up to 25% of the time, when needed.

• Ability to be in-person at VQ (our headquarters in White Plains, NY) 4 days per week.

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive Compensation Including ($100,000 - $130,000) + bonus + benefits.

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, and access to free therapy or counseling.

• Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary, and offering inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families.

• Unlimited PTO to use for vacation or sick days—however you need it!

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people.

• And the little (big) things, like casual office attire, ability to bring your fur baby to work, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry and free lunches twice a week!!

• Company laptop and a monthly cell phone reimbursement.

BETTER TOGETHER: WHY IN-PERSON MATTERS AT VEG HQ

Our hospitals thrive on in-person collaboration, and VQ is no different. Time in the office sparks stronger connections, meaningful conversations, and better results—all bringing our core values to life. We prioritize being present because our values are best achieved side by side. Plus, we make getting here easy with free parking and a shuttle from the White Plains Metro-North station.

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist - Bilingual (Spanish) PST Timezone
jobs.location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Global Seller Onboarding Specialists manage the final stages of the sales funnel, working with US merchants to drive the deal through to activation and accelerate the onboarding process. Global Seller Onboarding Specialists use deep product and industry knowledge to project-manage the onboarding stage of the sales process.  They’ll be responsible for and guiding sellers through the discovery and onboarding journey and ensuring that sellers are optimally scoped, educated, set up and trained to leverage the potential of Square’s platform. They are additionally instrumental in ensuring the documentation and tracking of feature requests to inform future product roadmaps. This is a customer-facing role that involves a combination of remote and onsite merchant interactions.

A successful Implementation Specialists will: (1) provide an incredible onboarding experience for Sellers, (2) accelerate the sales cycle by specialising onboarding and training, (3) develop new efficiencies to shorten the onboarding sales stage, and (4) support Square’s international expansion efforts.

You Will

• Drive world-class onboarding and implementation experiences for Square’s sellers, ensuring accountability to go-live timelines and accelerating deal velocity wherever possible.

• Cultivate strong cross-functional relationships with Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product to align on the seller journey, remove barriers, and deliver faster outcomes.

• Anticipate and resolve obstacles by managing stakeholder communications and developing scalable strategies that drive consistent success. Master Square’s platform, products, integrations, and ecosystem, staying ahead of new features and releases to serve as a trusted subject-matter expert.

• Lead high-impact, multi-merchant projects with competing priorities, ensuring effective resource allocation and timely delivery.

• Create and maintain engaging training materials for both internal teams and external partners.

• Execute accurate data entry and migration tasks for select sellers as part of the onboarding process

Your typical day will include:

• Remote merchant work: virtual consultation calls and training, advising on hardware/software/operations, staff training, menu building, and hardware installation.

• Occasional onsite merchant work, including training and hardware install.

• Data Entry: configure customer account, optimise menu setup, and other data entry tasks involved in getting a merchant onboard.

You Have

• BA/BS degree, preferably

• 4-5+ years of experience in a customer facing role, preferably in software implementation, support, sales/account management or customer success.

• An infectiously positive attitude, as well as a desire to perform at a high level on a continuous basis, and uplift the team around you.

• Bias for action; performance driven with the confidence to operate independently.

jobs.title: Engineering Lead, Growth
jobs.description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 


HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Growth Engineering at Airwallex is building an AI-native platform that powers customer acquisition, activation, conversion, retention, and expansion. We're developing scalable infrastructure, intelligent decision systems, and automation capabilities that connect product, sales, and marketing to drive measurable business outcomes.

As an Engineering Lead, you'll lead a team of engineers to design, build, and scale the platforms and experiences that power Growth at Airwallex. You'll combine technical leadership, hands-on problem-solving, and strong execution to turn ambitious growth opportunities into reliable products and measurable business impact.

 - Lead engineering execution, owning the delivery of complex Growth initiatives from technical planning and architecture through implementation, launch, and continuous improvement.

 - Drive technical direction, guiding the design of scalable backend services, frontend applications, event-driven systems, and AI-native platform capabilities that enable experimentation, personalization, and growth automation.

 - Build and develop a high-performing engineering team, providing technical mentorship, coaching, clear expectations, and a culture of ownership, collaboration, and engineering excellence.

 - Partner across functions, working closely with Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, and other engineering teams to translate ambiguous business problems into actionable roadmaps and technical solutions.

 - Drive measurable business outcomes, leveraging experimentation, customer insights, and data to prioritize high-impact opportunities, accelerate iteration, and improve growth performance.

 - Raise the engineering bar, establishing strong practices for system design, code quality, performance, reliability, security, observability, and operational excellence.
   
   

US: You'll work from our San Francisco office three days a week.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR


ESSENTIALS

 - 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including experience leading engineering teams or complex technical initiatives, and a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

 - Strong technical expertise in backend, frontend, or full-stack engineering, with experience designing, building, and operating scalable production systems using technologies such as Python, Java/Kotlin, React, or TypeScript.

 - Proven technical leadership and execution skills, with a track record of leading complex engineering projects, making sound architectural decisions, managing technical tradeoffs, and delivering high-quality solutions.

 - Demonstrated ability to lead and develop engineers, through mentorship, technical guidance, effective delegation, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

 - Strong ownership, product judgment, and cross-functional collaboration, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, influence stakeholders, prioritize effectively, and translate business objectives into measurable engineering outcomes.


PREFERRED

 - Experience building growth platforms, experimentation systems, customer segmentation engines, marketing automation, or product-led growth experiences.

 - Experience developing AI-powered applications or agentic workflows, including LLM integration, tool orchestration, evaluation, and production observability.

 - Experience with distributed systems, event-driven architectures, data pipelines, and cloud infrastructure such as AWS or GCP.

 - Experience leading cross-functional engineering initiatives involving Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, Sales, or Revenue Operations.

 - Experience establishing engineering processes, improving delivery predictability, and scaling team execution in fast-moving environments.

 - Experience in high-growth technology companies, fintech, payments, or regulated environments.
   
   


YOU'LL THRIVE HERE IF

 - You have high agency and ownership. You proactively identify high-impact opportunities, take accountability for outcomes, and empower your team to deliver.

 - You're a technical leader who builds. You stay close to architecture and implementation, make sound technical decisions, and lead by example.

 - You're pragmatic and outcome-oriented. You balance engineering quality, delivery speed, and business impact, prioritizing what moves the needle.

 - You're comfortable leading through ambiguity. You bring structure to complex problems, set clear priorities, and make thoughtful decisions with incomplete information.

 - You grow people and teams. You coach engineers, delegate effectively, create clarity, and build a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.

 - You communicate proactively and influence effectively. You align stakeholders, surface risks early, navigate tradeoffs, and drive decisions across functions.

 - You thrive in a global environment. You're comfortable leading and collaborating across distributed teams in APAC, EMEA, and the US.
   
   


LEARN MORE ABOUT YOUR TEAM

Growth at Airwallex is building a unified, AI-native growth system across product, sales, and marketing. Rather than applying AI to isolated tasks, we use customer context, machine learning, automation, and continuous learning to transform how Airwallex acquires, activates, converts, retains, and expands customers.

You’ll build high-traffic platforms, experimentation frameworks, and intelligent decision systems that turn signals—such as company profile, product usage, lifecycle stage, behavior, and intent—into personalized journeys, next-best actions, and measurable incremental value.

The work spans both human + AI and autonomous operating models: AI-native tools that increase the leverage of growth teams, alongside agentic workflows that can research opportunities, launch and optimize campaigns, orchestrate customer journeys, and measure outcomes within clear strategies and guardrails.

The challenge is to combine consumer-technology speed with the precision, trust, and regulatory complexity of global B2B finance. If you enjoy owning ambiguous problems end to end, prototyping quickly, measuring real business impact, and using every outcome to improve the next decision, you’ll help define how an AI-native global financial platform grows.

jobs.title: Primary Care Physician (Senior Health)
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

About Senior Health:

One Medical Seniors is a network of primary care practices where we take the time to know our patients as true individuals, and proactively provide the care, support, and inspiration they need to live their best life. We created a high-impact relationship based care model that particularly benefits adults on Medicare and those who might need more attention. Our care model changes everything - the team, outcome-focused payment, customer service, and the technology that supports our care. Our practices offer smaller panel sizes, no billing or coding, and the opportunity to lead systemic change in health care delivery while working with a true team. One Medical Seniors wants to restore humanity to healthcare, for both patients and team members.

We are seeking Primary Care Physicians to join our growing, outpatient practices in Charlotte, NC. Our Team Physicians work closely with the Medical Directors to play a critical role in both care delivery and ongoing practice innovation. Rediscover the "joy in practice" while working in a value-based care environment with a team to support you in delivering high quality patient care.

What you'll likely work on

• Provide best in class comprehensive primary care in an outpatient setting.

• Partner with the care team and leverage One Medical Seniors coaching and integrated behavioral health models to engage our geriatric patient population in care and drive behavior change.

• Utilize our proprietary Electronic Health Record to plan care for individual patients and maximize impact on the population.

• State of the art practice setting designed for a team-based practice model

• Leadership that values your input and understands the importance of work/life balance

• Weekly protected time during the work day, to gather with fellow One Medical Senior providers for team building and shared discussion of challenging cases.

• Willing to obtain additional state licensure and credentialing for One Medical virtual primary care in additional states

What you’ll need:

• At least 2 years of primary care experience required.

• Currently licensed or ability to obtain licensure in the state of North Carolina

• The ability to build successful relationships with team members and communicate effectively both 1-on-1 and in groups.

• Can thrive in a fast-growing, mission driven organization focused on using data to improve patient outcomes.

• Board Certification in Internal or Family Medicine required.

This role is based at our Pineville Office in Charlotte, North Carolina

One Medical is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The base salary range for this role is $240,900 to $288,000 based on a full-time schedule. Final determination of starting pay may vary based on factors such as practice experience and patient care schedule. Additional pay may be determined for those candidates that exceed these specified qualifications and requirements. For more information, visit https://www.onemedical.com/careers/

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

Your work schedule could be subject to change based on business direction at any time.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to COO

Bish Enterprises is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and dependable Executive Assistant to support our Chief Operating Officer (COO).

This role is much more than traditional administrative support. The Executive Assistant will help the COO manage priorities, organize information, coordinate communication, track commitments, and keep important projects and follow-ups moving across the company.

The right person will become a trusted administrative partner who can anticipate needs, manage multiple priorities, communicate professionally, and independently close open loops without requiring constant direction.

You should be comfortable working in an environment where priorities can change quickly, interruptions happen, and follow-through matters.

Key Responsibilities

Executive & Calendar Support

• Manage and maintain the COO's calendar, appointments, meetings, and scheduling priorities.
• Coordinate and confirm phone calls, Teams/Zoom meetings, appointments, and other commitments.
• Identify scheduling conflicts and help prioritize the COO's time.
• Make sure the COO has the documents, notes, links, background information, and other materials needed before meetings.
• Coordinate travel, accommodations, itineraries, events, and related logistics.
• Help keep the COO prepared for upcoming meetings, deadlines, commitments, and responsibilities.

Email, Communication & Follow-Up

• Help organize and maintain the COO's email inbox and communications.
• Track requests, commitments, deadlines, and follow-up items.
• Draft, format, proofread, and review emails, correspondence, reports, presentations, quotes, and other materials.

• Screen and appropriately direct incoming communications.

Project & Team Coordination

• Follow through on outstanding items until they are resolved.
• Help maintain accountability across projects and departments.

Administrative & Business Support

jobs.title: Sales Team Coordinator | ON-SITE
jobs.description:
Bish Enterprises is seeking a proactive, organized, and customer-focused Sales Team Coordinator to support and coordinate the daily activities of our sales team.

This is a hands-on sales support, customer service, and people-coordination position. The employee will help organize priorities, monitor assignments, follow up with team members, coordinate communication, and make sure sales-related tasks continue moving forward.

The Sales Team Coordinator serves as a central point of communication between sales representatives, customers, management, and other departments.

Work Location

This is a full-time, on-site position located at:

508 S D Road

Giltner, Nebraska 68841

The employee is expected to work from the Bish Enterprises office during normal working hours.

This is not a remote or hybrid position.

Applicants must be able to reliably commute to the Giltner office.

A company laptop may be provided for business use. Receiving a company laptop does not make this a remote or hybrid position.

Travel Requirement

Some business travel is required.

Travel may include:

• Customer visits
• Trade shows
• Agricultural events
• Equipment demonstrations
• Training
• Sales meetings
• Dealer visits

Travel may occasionally involve early mornings, evenings, weekends, or overnight stays.

The amount and location of travel may vary depending on customer needs, company events, sales activities, and the agricultural season.

The employee must be willing and able to travel when required.

Sales Team Coordination

The Sales Team Coordinator will help organize and coordinate the daily work of the sales team.

Responsibilities include:

• Helping communicate daily and weekly priorities to members of the sales team.
• Tracking sales-related assignments, deadlines, customer commitments, quotes, orders, and follow-up activities.
• Contacting team members for updates, missing information, and task completion.
• Reminding team members of deadlines, meetings, customer commitments, and required follow-ups.
• Making sure assigned tasks have a clear owner, deadline, and next step.
• Following up when work is incomplete, overdue, unclear, or missing.
• Helping organize and facilitate sales meetings.
• Preparing meeting agendas, notes, action items, assignments, and follow-up lists.
• Monitoring progress on action items discussed during meetings.
• Helping keep sales representatives aligned with company priorities and customer expectations.
• Identifying stalled opportunities, communication gaps, workload conflicts, or missing information.
• Escalating repeated delays, unresolved problems, or serious concerns to management.
• Helping maintain consistent use of the company’s CRM, calendars, sales procedures, and reporting systems.
• Assisting with onboarding and training coordination for new sales team members.
• Helping organize training materials, system access, schedules, meetings, and follow-up activities.

This role includes meaningful people coordination and day-to-day oversight of sales activities.

The employee may provide direction, follow-up, and accountability to members of the sales team. However, final authority regarding hiring, termination, compensation, formal discipline, and major personnel decisions remains with company management unless otherwise assigned.

Customer Service and Communication

The Sales Team Coordinator will help support customers throughout the sales process.

Responsibilities include:

• Answering customer phone calls, emails, and other inquiries in a friendly and professional manner.
• Gathering the information needed to understand the customer’s request.
• Directing technical, pricing, warranty, service, or product questions to the appropriate team member when necessary.
• Following up with customers regarding quotes, orders, availability, appointments, delivery information, and next steps.
• Providing customers with accurate information based on approved company materials and pricing.
• Communicating delays, changes, and updates clearly and promptly.
• Documenting customer commitments and making sure promised follow-ups are completed.
• Assisting with customer concerns by gathering information and coordinating with the appropriate department.
• Following customer issues through until they are resolved or transferred to the correct person.
• Representing Bish Enterprises professionally when communicating with customers, vendors, dealers, visitors, and industry contacts.

Quotes, Orders, and Sales Support

Responsibilities include:

• Preparing customer quotes, proposals, product information, and sales documents using company templates and approved pricing.
• Reviewing documents for accuracy and completeness before they are sent.
• Receiving customer orders and accurately entering the required information into company systems.
• Confirming customer contact information, products, pricing, delivery details, payment requirements, and other order information.
• Monitoring open quotes and orders to help prevent missed deadlines or incomplete tasks.
• Coordinating with production, parts, service, shipping, accounting, marketing, and other departments.
• Checking order status and identifying possible delays or missing information.
• Communicating order updates to the appropriate sales representative, customer, or manager.
• Scheduling customer calls, meetings, demonstrations, appointments, and follow-ups.
• Maintaining sales calendars and communicating scheduling changes.
• Assisting with preparation for trade shows, customer visits, sales meetings, and equipment demonstrations.

CRM, Reporting, and Administrative Support

Responsibilities include:

• Entering and maintaining customer, lead, quote, order, and follow-up information in the company’s systems.
• Keeping customer contact information, notes, deadlines, sales stages, and next steps complete and current.
• Preparing regular sales reports using information from the CRM, spreadsheets, and other company systems.
• Organizing information clearly for management and the sales team.
• Highlighting overdue follow-ups, open quotes, customer concerns, order issues, and other items requiring attention.
• Completing data entry, filing, document preparation, and record organization.
• Maintaining commonly used sales materials, templates, documents, and office supplies.
• Helping improve sales coordination procedures, tracking systems, and internal communication.

Independence and Accountability

The successful candidate must be able to work independently after receiving appropriate training.

The employee will be expected to:

• Keep track of assigned tasks and deadlines.
• Follow up without needing repeated reminders.
• Ask questions when instructions or information are unclear.
• Identify routine problems and take reasonable action to solve them.
• Find the correct person or resource when assistance is needed.
• Communicate delays, mistakes, or concerns promptly.
• Keep management informed about important customer, sales, or team issues.
• Address incomplete work professionally and respectfully.
• Balance being supportive with maintaining clear expectations.
• Work confidently with different personalities and communication styles.

This position may not be a good fit for someone who requires constant step-by-step direction for routine work or who is uncomfortable following up with coworkers about incomplete assignments.

Work Schedule

This is a full-time position that generally requires approximately 44 to 50 working hours per week.

The normal schedule is Monday through Friday.

Saturday, early-morning, evening, or additional hours may occasionally be required due to:

• Customer deadlines
• Company travel
• Trade shows or events
• Equipment demonstrations

Some scheduling flexibility may be available with management approval.

Any schedule adjustment must still allow the employee to meet customer needs, attend required meetings, complete on-site responsibilities, coordinate the sales team, and fulfill travel requirements.

jobs.description:
About the Role

This is not a traditional sourcing role. We're looking for someone who was an engineer first and wants to put that technical depth to work finding and winning the best engineers in the market. You'll build and run outreach campaigns, keep pipelines full for specific engineering roles, and bring a steady, systematic hustle to it. You can run a genuinely technical first call, get into the nuts and bolts of what someone built and their level of ownership, and tell the difference between top-tier and the rest after a single conversation.

You'll report directly to the hiring manager on a tight-knit team of six, with visibility and room to grow into ownership of how we source and evaluate engineering talent. We'll teach you the recruiting craft - the technical judgment is what you bring.

• Build and maintain pipelines of top-1% engineering talent for specific open roles

• Design and run proactive outreach campaigns to elite engineers - persistent, high-volume, and well-written

• Review GitHub profiles and other technical signals to identify genuinely strong candidates

• Run technical first calls that go deep on what a candidate actually built

• Screen for real quality, filtering aggressively so that only the best talent reaches the hiring team

• Partner closely with the hiring manager and recruiter to calibrate on what "great" looks like for each role

• Help shape Together AI's approach to technical sourcing as the function grows

Requirements

• A hands-on engineering background - you've worked as an engineer of some kind. A CS degree is a strong plus.

• The ability to read a GitHub profile and glean real signal about someone's depth and quality

• Enough current technical fluency to run a deep, credible first call with a strong engineer

• Persistence, hustle, and resilience - you're energized by outbound and unfazed by rejection

• Based in San Francisco

Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. AI application developers get high-performance inference that scales reliably, fine-tuning and reinforcement learning for creating frontier-level specialized models, and pre-training at massive scale for fully custom intelligence, all around a marketplace of leading open models that teams can run, adapt, and own. jobs.title: Sales Team Manager (on-site)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Bish Enterprises is seeking a hands-on, performance-driven Sales Team Manager to lead and strengthen our sales organization. This role is designed for a leader who is comfortable managing KPIs, coaching salespeople, improving CRM and follow-up discipline, and remaining directly involved in customer acquisition and sales execution.

As a Sales Manager, you will lead our small but dedicated sales team, drive customer acquisition, increase revenue growth, and oversee direct sales efforts. Collaborating with upper management as well as our marketing team, you'll devise strategic sales and marketing plans, manage the marketing budget, and ensure our campaigns align with our brand identity.  This role will be directly involved with the day-to-day sales, while simultaneously providing coaching, guidance, and accountability to our sales team members.

Your knack for analyzing the effectiveness of these strategies will be critical to optimizing our sales potential. As the primary contact for sales-related issues, we will rely on your proactive problem-solving skills. Join us as we continue to foster growth and success within the agricultural equipment sector.

Job Responsibilities:

• Assist in determining price schedules and discount rates
• Assist in identifying issues with shipping through direct involvement to help provide clarity on invoices and increased efficiency, productivity, and safety within that department
• Assist in the preparation of budgets and budget expenditures
• Collaborates effectively with others for the success of the department; promotes a free flow of information & ideas across departments
• Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates
• Confer with department heads or staff to discuss topics such as contracts, selection of advertising media, or product to be advertised
• Confer with organizational members to accomplish work activities
• Coordinate and/or manage sales activities
• Demonstrate a high degree of business acumen
• Documenting/Recording Information (Maintain operational records, Prepare forms or applications)
• Ensures all customers, internal and external, are kept informed of issues.
• Exhibits a positive attitude. Promotes superior customer service.
• Follows all proper communication channels with invoice process, with thorough communication and positive internal and external customer relations
• Manage and provide leadership to the sales team
• Monitor customer preferences to determine the focus of sales efforts
• Oversee sales staff
• Plan and direct staffing, training, and performance evaluations to develop and control sales and service programs (if applicable)
• Plan and prepare advertising and promotional material to increase sales of products or services, working with customers, company officials, sales departments, and advertising agencies
• Plan, present, and/or facilitate sales presentations and meetings
• Provide presentation and product demonstration support during the introduction of new products and services to customers
• Provide up-to-date and accurate information on sales numbers (Current, Goal, Trend, etc.)
• Provides problem/issue resolution for customers and other sales personnel to ensure optimal positive customer service.
• Read trade journals and professional literature to stay informed on trends, innovations, and changes that affect media planning
• Reports to CEO/COO and/or Customer when additional items are required, preventing possible customer dissatisfaction.
• Represent the company at trade association meetings to promote products (as needed)
• Resolve customer complaints regarding sales and service
• Review operational records and reports to project sales and determine profitability

Required

• 5+ years of progressive sales experience, preferably in B2B, equipment, automotive, industrial, agricultural, technical products, or another performance-driven sales environment. Candidates with exceptional commercial leadership experience may be considered with fewer years of direct sales experience.
• Demonstrated experience leading, coaching, or managing salespeople or another strongly performance-driven team.
• Proven ability to work toward and manage measurable KPIs, sales goals, customer acquisition targets, revenue objectives, and individual/team accountability.
• Experience managing a sales pipeline and maintaining disciplined CRM documentation, follow-up, and reporting.
• Demonstrated ability to coach employees, address underperformance, establish expectations, and drive improvement.
• Strong customer-facing communication and the ability to build credibility with farmers, equipment operators, business owners, and technically knowledgeable customers.
• Ability to manage customer opportunities from initial contact through follow-up, quoting, closing, and continued customer communication.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to establish processes and structure in a fast-moving environment where procedures may still be evolving.
• Practical proficiency with Microsoft Excel, reporting tools, CRM software, and common business applications.
• Strong business judgment, problem-solving skills, and ability to work independently while collaborating closely with ownership and other departments.
• Comfortable learning specialized agricultural equipment and working directly with customers who may have significant practical farming and equipment knowledge.
• Must be able to work on-site in Giltner, Nebraska. Candidates outside a reasonable commuting distance must be willing to relocate.
• Must be available for the stated work schedule, including seasonal demands and 2–4 Saturdays per month.

Preferred

jobs.title: Regional Environmental, Health & Safety Manager
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

EAST COAST TIMEZONE ONLY

Nebius is building the infrastructure that powers the next generation of AI — and we're scaling fast. In line with our values, we're committed to an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, and we're looking for an experienced Environmental, Health & Safety Manager to set the direction, standards and capability that keep our expanding operations safe, compliant and sustainable.

This is no ordinary role. We need a decisive, credible leader who owns the regional EHS agenda — someone who can set strategy, build a high-performing team, and act as the trusted voice of EHS at leadership level, while staying close enough to the detail to guide, challenge and support when it matters most.

This is a genuine opportunity to shape how EHS operates as Nebius scales. You'll have real autonomy to set priorities, build capability across your team and sites, and influence decisions at a regional and business level — backed by strong support from senior stakeholders and a growing global EHS function.

You'll be accountable for the performance, maturity and culture of EHS across your region — leading through others, setting the standards your team and sites work to, and stepping in personally when situations demand calm, experienced judgement under pressure. Above all, you'll help make sound EHS practice a source of competitive advantage for Nebius, not a compliance exercise.

What you'll do

• Set and own the regional EHS plan, turning policy and legislation into clear priorities and controls for your sites.

• Translate the global EHS strategy into everyday practice across your region, making sure teams are well supported and equipped with the toolkit to advance site EHS performance.

• Lead, manage and develop local teams — setting objectives, building capability, and owning outcomes.

• Act as the senior EHS voice with regional and site leadership — advising on risk and holding the business to account.

• Own regional governance and assurance — audits, inspections, and the quality of your team's risk assessments and controls.

• Take personal command of major incidents and crises — leading investigations, building a learning culture, and reporting to executive level with composure under pressure.

• Set the standard for construction, commissioning, operations and other high-risk activity, equipping specialists to manage risk on the ground.

• Own the regional EHS performance narrative — turning data into insight that drives decisions and accountable action plans.

• Review EHS data and performance metrics regularly, acting on trends and insights to drive continuous improvement across the region.

• Support the wider environmental and sustainability agenda, partnering with teams to embed it across your region.

• Represent Nebius with regulators, industry bodies and partners, protecting its credibility on EHS.

• Champion Nebius's culture and values, embedding EHS as core to how the business operates.

What we're looking for

Credible, decisive, and people-focused. You'll bring:

• NEBOSH Diploma (or equivalent), Environmental Science, Industrial Hygiene, or related field, plus 6+ years' Environmental, Health & Safety experience, including experience leading or managing a team.

• Deep working knowledge of country and regional legislation, with a track record of shaping policy and standards, not just applying them.

• A genuine subject-matter expert — able to go deep on technical detail when needed, while spending most of your time enabling others to deliver.

• Proven experience supporting incident response and investigations, including in high-pressure, high-consequence situations, with the composure to make sound decisions under stress.

• A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and holding them to account.

• Experience coaching and developing teams and capability.

• Strong commercial and organisational judgement — able to balance risk, cost and pace.

• Excellent communication skills, with the gravitas to advise, challenge constructively, and represent EHS externally.

• A continuous-improvement mindset and the ambition to build a function, not just run a programme.

Preferred

• 8+ years' experience, including international or multi-site regulatory environments.

• Experience within data centres, critical infrastructure, construction, engineering, commissioning or other high-risk environments.

• Chartered status or equivalent: CMIOSH, GradIOSH working towards Chartered, NCRQ Level 6, or equivalent senior EHS qualification.

• Experience managing regional budgets and cross-site resourcing.

Why Nebius?

• Lead with impact — set the direction for EHS as Nebius scales.

• Build something lasting — grow a team and a function, not just deliver a programme.

• Operate at leadership level — advise, influence and be accountable alongside the business.

• Be backed — join a growing global EHS function with real investment behind it.

• Grow with us — build a lasting career as Nebius continues to scale.

Our approach

Environmental, health and safety isn't something we do separately — it's how we do the job. Strong outcomes come from partnership, trust, collaboration and shared accountability. As Manager, your role is to set the standard, build the capability, and create an environment where leaders and teams are equipped to make good decisions, manage risk effectively, and speak up, learn and improve.

If you want to lead a function where your judgement is trusted and you can genuinely shape how we work, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Nebius. Help build the future of AI infrastructure — safely, responsibly and together.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range

$107,000—$134,000 USD

Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive compensation

• Career growth and learning opportunities

• Flexibility and ownership

• Collaborative and innovative culture

• Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

• International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior GRC Analyst
jobs.description:
Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows.

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

Tines is seeking an experienced Senior Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Analyst to help execute and operate our compliance programs during a pivotal growth phase. Reporting to our Director of GRC, you will work across our commercial certifications — SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, 27701 and 42001 — and our FedRAMP program, while supporting vendor risk management and customer security assurance.

This is a hands-on execution role. You'll partner with our Staff GRC Analysts, who set certification strategy, and own the operational delivery behind it: collecting evidence, testing controls, running audit cycles, assessing vendors, and answering the security questions our customers and prospects ask. You'll also have a real mandate to automate the parts of this work that shouldn't be manual, using Tines itself.

Location: Based remotely in the United States.

What you’ll be doing:

• Certification and Audit Execution — Drive audit cycles end to end for SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 / 27701 / 42001: evidence collection, control testing, auditor liaison, and remediation tracking. Support gap assessments for net-new certifications we're evaluating.

• FedRAMP Program Support — Support our FedRAMP efforts, including gap analysis, remediation planning, documentation development, and coordination with 3PAO assessors.

• Continuous Control Monitoring — Operate the year-round monitoring cadence that keeps certifications live between audits — scan and pen test reporting, control drift detection, and evidence freshness.

• Vendor Risk Management — Run vendor security assessments, evaluating security controls and compliance posture before acquisition, and help mature our third-party risk program.

• Risk Assessment and Management — Conduct risk analyses for systems, processes, and third-party applications, and implement appropriate controls to mitigate identified risks.

• Customer Security Assurance — Respond to customer security inquiries, questionnaires, and audit requests, and support Sales on RFPs and RFQs. Keep our Trust Center documentation current.

• Contract Review and Management — Partner with Legal to review contracts for security and compliance requirements, ensure appropriate security provisions are included, identify compliance risks and recommend mitigating controls. Help develop standardized security language for various contract types.

• Compliance Automation — Use Tines to streamline compliance processes, evidence collection and reporting, and reduce the manual load on the team.

• Policy Development and Maintenance — Review, update and develop security policies and procedures aligned with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

• Cross-functional Collaboration — Partner with Engineering, Product, IT, Legal, HR and leadership to embed compliance requirements into organizational processes.

• Regulatory Monitoring — Stay current with evolving compliance standards and regulatory requirements relevant to our business and our customers.

What you bring with you:

• 8-12 years of experience in IT compliance, security, or risk management

• Hands-on experience implementing or maintaining ISO 27001 compliance

• Strong knowledge of SOC 2 compliance frameworks and audit processes, including evidence collection and control testing

• Experience supporting FedRAMP certification processes and requirements

• Experience conducting vendor security assessments and risk analyses

• Excellent understanding of information security principles, controls, and best practices

• Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple compliance initiatives simultaneously

• Exceptional communication skills for translating technical requirements to non-technical stakeholders

• Previous experience on the audit side — at a 3PAO or audit firm (e.g. Coalfire, Schellman, KPMG) — or driving gap remediation for certification readiness

• Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISA, or CISM

• Experience with compliance automation tools and techniques, or scripting/API experience for evidence automation

• Continuous monitoring (ConMon) and compliance reporting experience

• Knowledge of cloud security principles and controls (AWS, Azure, GCP)

• Experience reviewing contracts for security and compliance requirements

• Experience in SaaS or technology companies

• Familiarity with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA)

• Experience working in remote-first environments

Target Annual Compensation: $175,000-190,000

Applicants for this opportunity must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

#LI-JF1

At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are. We’d love to hear from you.

Tines provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, colour, ethnic or social origin, genetic features, language, religion or belief, political or any other opinion, membership of a national minority, property, birth, disability, age or sexual orientation.
