jobs.title: Financial Solutions Guide 1
jobs.description:
To maintain a strong connection with our members and local communities and better understand their unique needs, we are currently considering applications from candidates residing in Oregon and Washington for all open positions. We appreciate your understanding as we focus our hiring efforts in these specific regions. And, we encourage all qualified candidates from these states to apply, as we look forward to learning more about your unique skills and experience!

Where You Will Work:

3701 W 11th Ave, Eugene, OR 97402 (Branches)

Work schedule is Wednesday - Saturday.

Pay Range: The target hourly pay range for this position is $18.70 - $21.25. The full hourly pay range is $17.00 - $25.50.

• We provide an additional $2.00 per hour bilingual differential for those employees who can support our members' financial needs effectively in a second language; subject to verification of strong grasp of financial terms utilizing language skillset.

• Compensation decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, and education or training. Should an offer of employment be made, we will consider individual qualifications. In addition to your salary, compensation incentives are available for the hired applicant. Incentives are performance based and targets vary by role.

Job Overview:

This position embodies Peak Credit Union’s mission of Investing in People and Championing Success by delivering exceptional member experiences with authenticity, care, and precision. Guided by our values of Authenticity, Boldness, Collaboration, Dignity, and Empathy, this role builds the foundation of lasting member relationships, helping individuals access the financial tools, resources, and confidence needed to achieve their goals. Through accurate transactions, meaningful interactions, and steadfast support, the Financial Solutions Guide 1 advances Peak’s vision of creating communities where everyone feels financially secure and ensures our purpose of providing everyone with access to financial empowerment and independence.

What You’ll Do:

• Welcomes and engages members by greeting all visitors warmly, managing branch traffic with a sense of urgency to ensure minimal wait times and a positive member experience, while remaining attentive to relationship-building cues that support consultative sales conversations.

• Promotes credit union products and services by proactively identifying, referring, and originating credit union products and services to meet member needs, strengthening financial relationships, demonstrating sales acumen through effective discovery, confident product positioning, and closing skills, consistently meeting or exceeding assigned referral sales targets.

• Processes member transactions, accurately receives, processes, and posts deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and loan payments while maintaining complete and accurate transaction records, leveraging each interaction as an opportunity to uncover needs and introduce value-aligned solutions.

• Resolves member inquiries and concerns, responds to member requests, concerns, and complaints with professionalism and empathy, ensuring warm hand-offs and timely follow-up for full resolution, while recognizing when service moments can transition into sales opportunities that support the member’s financial well-being.

• Makes outbound calls to members/customers to support outreach initiatives, relationship building, and organizational goals.

• Performs specialized financial functions, completes wire transfers and other complex transactions while ensuring compliance with established policies and procedures, and identifies opportunities where specialized products or services may benefit the member.

• Balances cash drawer and daily transactions; assists with vault balancing, dispenser maintenance, certifications, key assignments, and cash orders under management oversight.

• Records detailed notes on member interactions, complex situations, and transactions to ensure clear communication and consistent service delivery, capturing relevant sales insights to support follow-up and relationship growth

• Demonstrates professionalism and continuous Learning by taking initiative to learn new systems, processes, and policies; completing required training; and maintaining a professional image while contributing positively to the team environment, including ongoing development of sales skills, product knowledge, and consultative techniques.

• Supports branch and organizational operations and provides staffing support as needed across locations and departments, and performs other duties as assigned to ensure operational excellence and continuity of service, while helping the branch achieve overall sales and growth objectives.

• All other duties as assigned.

When You'll Be Working: Monday- Friday: 9:00am - 5:30pm and rotating Saturdays: 9:30am - 1:30pm in Eugene area or Albany. Part-Time 28 hours per week.

Qualifications:

• Minimum of one (1) year of experience interacting with customers and handling cash, or an equivalent combination of work experience.

Bonus Points If You Have:

• Demonstrated skills including, bilingual skills, consultative sales skills to uncover member needs, make tailored recommendations, and build lasting financial relationships.

What You’ll Bring:

• Ability to perform in an environment with frequent changes and competing demands.

• Open to feedback and respond with professionalism and dignity, delivering information to members and co-workers.

• Ability to continuously learn and maintain knowledge of credit union systems, processes, and compliance requirements.

• Ability to problem solve and make decisions relevant to the role and experience.

• Ability to embrace and promote a positive, collaborative work environment.

• Ability to role model our core values.

• Maintain confidentiality with minimal supervision.

Total Rewards:

This position is eligible for Full-Time Regular benefits. Employees and their eligible family members have access to a wide array of employee benefits, such as medical, dental, vision and life insurance coverage.

• Includes an option for Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance to be paid at a 100% by company for the employee only coverage.

• We also offer Health Care FSA (HCFSA), Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions, and Dependent Care FSA (DCFSA).

• Employees also have access to Life and AD&D insurance.

• Employees are able to enroll in our 401k plan.

• Full-Time Regular employees accrue 8 hours of vacation and 8 hours of sick leave, on a monthly basis.

• Full-Time Regular hired employees also receive 11 paid holidays throughout the calendar year, 1 floating holiday, 16 hours of self-care time, and 16 hours of volunteer time.

All benefits except 401k start the first of the month following date of hire. Employees become eligible to contribute to 401k on the first of the month following 60 days of employment.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Specialist, Core Tech
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Anduril's Core Tech Manufacturing Team rapidly iterates and builds cutting-edge defense hardware, specializing in advanced mechanical actuators and motion control systems for Anduril's sea and air vehicle platforms. As we scale these products from prototype to high-rate production, the quality bar is set on the manufacturing floor — every actuator that ships is characterized, exercised, and qualified against its performance spec before it leaves the line.t.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a Manufacturing Specialist to join our rapidly growing team in Costa Mesa, CA. In this role, you will be responsible for the assembly and integration of Actuators and Vehicle Avionics along with supporting test equipment. Your expertise will help ensure that our products meet the highest standards of quality and reliability.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Assemble flight and non-flight hardware, ensuring adherence to stringent quality standards

• Construct test racks, mechanical, and electrical equipment for integration and testing

• Diagnose and troubleshoot test stand and hardware issues

• Work with engineering to create and execute test plans to inform product acceptance, development, and qualification

• Meticulously document test results and issues

• Create work orders, manuals, maintenance plans, and other documentation for actuator builds and test equipment

• Design and build tooling and fixtures

• Utilize precision measuring instruments to ensure components meet specifications

• Train other technicians and supervise new product development builds

• Investigate and resolve nonconformances, providing feedback for continuous improvement

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 7+ years experience in aerospace, aviation, military, or other high-reliability industries

• Electrical troubleshooting skills and familiarity with data acquisition devices and software

• Mechanical troubleshooting and repair ability including familiarity with fluid systems

• Computer skills necessary to test, document and update digital systems

• Proven ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while maintaining attention to detail

• Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

• Able to lift up to 50 lbs. unassisted

• Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Associate degree or higher in electronics, electrical engineering technology, or related field

• Experience with LabVIEW, Python, or other test automation/scripting tools, and version control systems (e.g., Git)

• Familiarity with environmental testing (thermal cycling, vibration, humidity) and ESS procedures

• Working knowledge of IPC-A-610 acceptability standards; hand soldering per J-STD-001 and/or rework experience

• Knowledge of ISO 9001 / AS9100 Quality Management Systems

• Aviation, defense, or aerospace production testing experience

• Experience with data analysis or statistical process control (SPC) for test yield monitoring

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

• Experience designing simple fixtures, nests, or other shop-aids

• Design and build of other electromechanical systems

• Experience interpreting test data and qualifying equipment

• Able to stand for long periods, climb ladders, bend, grasp, sit, pull, push, stoop, and stretch as needed

US Hourly Range

Specialist/Level 1: $32 - $43/hour
Specialist/Level 2: $37 - $49/hour
Specialist/Level 3: $41 - $54/hour

Your job level will be tailored to your individual qualifications, including your job-related knowledge, skills, education, and experience.

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Materials Operations Coord
jobs.description:
The Material Operations Coordinator plans, creates, and releases daily order waves for Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) operations based on order volume, inventory availability, operational capacity, and shipping priorities. The essential duties and responsibilities for the DTC Material Operations Coordinator position include the following:

• Monitors order volume and workflow throughout the shift and adjusts wave releases and priorities to support efficient order fulfillment.
• Reviews system data, order demand, inventory availability, and operational requirements to determine appropriate order release sequencing.
• Coordinates with DTC Operations leadership to balance workload across picking, packing, replenishment, and shipping areas.
• Monitors wave and order progress to identify potential delays, inventory issues, capacity constraints, or other exceptions that may impact customer orders.
• Researches and assists with resolving order, inventory, and system discrepancies that may prevent orders from progressing through fulfillment.
• Prioritizes expedited, time-sensitive, and other high-priority orders based on business and customer requirements.
• Coordinates with Inventory, Transportation, Operations, and other internal departments to support accurate and timely order fulfillment.
• Reviews and interprets operational reports and data to identify backlogs, workload needs, and potential risks to daily fulfillment goals.
• Communicates changes in order volume, priorities, system issues, and operational constraints to appropriate partners.
• Maintains accurate system data and documentation related to wave planning and order processing.
• Supports changing business needs and peak-volume periods by adjusting wave plans and priorities accordingly.
• Performs work with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
• Ability to operate a computer using Microsoft Office software and learn Blue Yonder WMS.
• Other responsibilities and tasks assigned by your manager or supervisor.

• Experience working in a warehouse, distribution, logistics, or DTC/e-commerce fulfillment environment preferred.
• Ability to analyze and interpret order volume, inventory, workload, reports, graphs, and other operational data.
• Strong WMS familiarity,
• Strong organizational and planning skills with the ability to prioritize work in a fast-paced environment.
• Ability to prepare reports as needed (daily, weekly, monthly).
• Strong attention to detail and ability to perform work accurately.
• Ability to identify issues, research discrepancies, and coordinate with appropriate teams to support resolution.
• Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office, with the ability to learn warehouse management and order processing systems.
• Strong written and oral communication skills.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with management, warehouse staff, Inventory, Transportation, and other internal partners.
• Ability to read and interpret order information, inventory reports, shipping documents, and other operational documentation.
• Strong and accurate data entry skills.
• Ability to adapt to changing order volumes, priorities, and operational needs.

Join New Era Technology, where People First is at the heart of everything we do. With a global team of over 3,000 professionals, we're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and inspired to grow. Our mission is to securely connect people, places, and information with end-to-end technology solutions at scale.

At New Era, you'll join a team-oriented culture that prioritizes your personal and professional development. Work alongside industry-certified experts, access continuous training, and enjoy competitive benefits. Guided by our core attributes — putting people first, embracing continuous learning, and thriving through collaboration and inclusion — we nurture our people to deliver exceptional customer service.

If you want to make an impact in a supportive, growth-oriented environment, New Era is the place for you. Apply today and help us shape the future of work—together

Vice President, Procurement position with New Era Technology offers you the following:

• Full Benefits

• Medical

• Dental

• 401K match

• 7 company holidays + generous PTO

*** At this time, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.

The Vice President, Procurement is New Era Technology’s first enterprise procurement leader and will build and lead a centralized procurement function across all entities, regions and business lines. Reporting to the CFO, this role will establish procurement strategy, policy and governance; lead strategic sourcing and category management; develop supplier partnerships; and oversee a hybrid team of internal and outsourced resources. The Vice President, Procurement will partner with Finance, IT, Operations and business leaders to deliver cost-effective, compliant and scalable purchasing that supports company growth.

PRIMARY DUTIES:

• Build and lead the retained procurement organization, including the Director of Procurement Operations, category managers and a Contracts / CLM Manager; transition buying roles from acquired entities into the centralized model.

• Evaluate, select and contract the outsourced/offshore execution partner; define retained-versus-outsourced scope, service-level agreements (SLAs) and the transition plan, and manage ongoing partner performance.

• Implement a single enterprise source-to-pay process, purchasing policy and intake process, bringing regional purchasing, including Brazil and Mexico, into the enterprise model.

• Enforce delegation of authority through preventive, system-based controls, including corporate card and off-PO spend; partner with the Controller, Accounts Payable and Treasury on vendor-master and banking-detail changes.

• Own enterprise vendor-master and contract standards, including a central contract repository and renewal calendar; partner with General Counsel and GRC on third-party risk.

• Develop category strategies for IT hardware, software and SaaS, telecom, distribution, field-services subcontracting and indirect spend; consolidate supplier contracts into enterprise agreements with improved pricing, terms and rebates.

• Define the procurement charter for internal-use purchasing (CIO) and customer-facing/resale purchasing (CTO), including an escalation path for shared vendors.

• Shape procurement systems requirements as part of the Business Central and ConnectWise consolidation, spend-management platform and contract repository.

• Build the enterprise spend cube, dashboards and KPIs; report performance and compliance to the CFO and executive team, ensuring reported benefits are validated by Finance.

EXPERIENCE:

• 15+ years of procurement or supply chain experience, including at least 7 years leading procurement teams at director level or above.

• Proven record of building or centralizing procurement in a multi-entity organization, ideally one grown through acquisitions.

• Direct experience designing and managing a hybrid model with an outsourced or offshore procurement partner, including SLA definition, transition and ongoing governance.

• Strong technology category experience, including IT hardware, software and SaaS, telecom, and technology distribution (e.g., national/global IT distributors and OEM partner programs).

• Track record of supplier consolidation and negotiating enterprise agreements, pricing, terms and rebate programs.

• Working knowledge of source-to-pay controls, including delegation of authority, vendor-master governance, segregation of duties and fraud prevention.

• Experience implementing or optimizing procurement and ERP systems, spend analytics and contract lifecycle management tools.

• Experience leading across U.S. and international operations, including Latin America.

• Background in an IT solutions provider, systems integrator, value-added reseller or managed services company, with exposure to purchasing for internal use and customer resale.

• PREFERRED: Experience in a private equity-backed or high-growth environment with a defined value-creation timeline.

• PREFERRED: Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, ConnectWise, Power BI / Fabric or comparable platforms.

• PREFERRED: Exposure to third-party risk management frameworks (e.g., ISO 27036, NIST SP 800-161) and ESG supply-chain reporting.

LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read, understand, and interpret job-related documents, instructions, policies, and communications in English. Ability to communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing, with employees, customers, vendors, and other business partners, as applicable to the position.

REQUIRED EDUCATION / CERTIFICATIONS: Bachelor’s degree in business, supply chain, finance or a related field. MBA and/or professional certification (CPSM, CIPS, CPM) preferred.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Regular use of hands and fingers to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment, including repetitive motions such as typing, scrolling, and mouse use. Ability to communicate effectively and understand verbal communication in person, by telephone, and through video conferencing or other remote communication tools. Ability to view and read information on computer screens and printed materials, including the ability to adjust focus. The position requires prolonged periods of computer use and viewing a computer screen.

WORK ENVIRONMENT: U.S.-based role with travel to U.S. and international sites.

EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK: This position generally operates during normal business hours; however, specific start and end times may vary based on business needs, workload, and job responsibilities. Occasional work outside of normal business hours may be required.

TRAVEL: Travel to U.S. and international sites is expected; frequency to be confirmed.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer — Engineering Systems, Continuous Integration
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


ABOUT SNOWFLAKE

Snowflake is building the AI Data Cloud, enabling organizations around the world to mobilize data and develop applications at global scale. The Engineering Systems organization builds the infrastructure, tools, and platforms that help Snowflake engineers develop, test, and deliver high-quality software efficiently.

The Continuous Integration team is responsible for the systems that power builds, tests, validation, and developer workflows across Snowflake’s engineering organization. As a Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will help define the technical direction of critical CI infrastructure used by thousands of engineers across a rapidly growing, multi-cloud codebase.


AS A STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER, YOU WILL

 - Own the technical direction and architecture of large-scale Continuous Integration services and infrastructure.

 - Design, build, and operate distributed systems that support reliable, performant, and secure software delivery.

 - Lead the development of CI capabilities that improve build reliability, test execution, developer productivity, and release velocity.

 - Partner with engineering leadership, product managers, and teams across Snowflake to define quarterly and long-term technical roadmaps.

 - Drive architectural decisions across build systems, test orchestration, resource scheduling, workflow execution, and developer tooling.

 - Identify systemic bottlenecks in the software delivery lifecycle and develop solutions that improve engineering efficiency at scale.

 - Establish high standards for design, code quality, testing, observability, reliability, and operational readiness.

 - Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and collaborative problem-solving.

 - Lead complex projects involving multiple teams and cross-functional dependencies.

 - Participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, and long-term reliability improvements.

 - Evaluate emerging technologies and industry practices to keep Snowflake’s developer platform scalable and effective.


OUR IDEAL STAFF SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE

 - 7+ years of industry experience designing and building production software systems.

 - A track record of technical leadership across complex, multi-team engineering initiatives.

 - Deep experience designing and operating distributed systems at scale.

 - Experience building or significantly evolving enterprise-grade Continuous Integration or Continuous Delivery systems.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and systems design.

 - Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, C++, Python, or Go.

 - Experience making architectural decisions involving scalability, reliability, performance, security, and maintainability.

 - A strong understanding of developer productivity and the software development lifecycle.

 - Excellent problem-solving skills and sound technical judgment.

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.

 - A collaborative mindset and a demonstrated ability to mentor and influence engineers across teams.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with CI/CD and build systems such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Bazel, ArgoCD, or comparable platforms.

 - Experience with build optimization, caching, parallel execution, incremental builds, or distributed test scheduling.

 - Experience designing multi-tenant systems with strong isolation, reliability, performance, and security requirements.

 - Experience with Kubernetes, containers, or public cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.

 - Experience operating large-scale developer platforms or engineering infrastructure.

 - Experience with observability, monitoring, alerting, and production operations.

 - Experience authoring technical roadmaps, architecture documents, project plans, postmortems, and root-cause analyses.

 - Experience working with data systems, distributed storage, or cloud-based services.

 - A history of improving engineering practices and multiplying the effectiveness of teams.


WHY ENGINEERING SYSTEMS AT SNOWFLAKE?

Reporting to the AP Manager, you’ll play an important role in managing supplier invoices, processing payments and maintaining accurate financial records. You’ll work closely with internal teams across Victoria and Queensland, ensuring invoices are correctly coded, approved and paid on time.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers, resolving discrepancies and managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

• Process supplier invoices, ensuring purchase orders are referenced and invoices are accurately GL coded.

• Manage the accounts payable inbox, forwarding invoices to the relevant teams for purchase orders and approvals.

• Process employee reimbursements and reconcile supplier statements.

• Prepare and process weekly, semi-monthly and end-of-month payment runs.

• Maintain organised records of processed invoices within the appropriate payment folders.

You’re a proactive and organised individual with a strong eye for detail and the ability to manage high volumes of financial administration accurately. You enjoy working collaboratively, communicating with stakeholders and ensuring deadlines are met.

About CSA and Waste Services Group

CSA Specialised Services is part of Waste Services Group (WSG), one of Australia's largest integrated providers of managed services, waste collections and post-collection services to the SME resource recovery market.

With operations across Victoria, New South Wales and Queensland, WSG has grown through a combination of organic growth and strategic acquisitions. jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager, AI-Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

 - Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

 - Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

 - Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

 - Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

 - Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

 - Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

 - Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

 - Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

 - Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

 - Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

jobs.title: Head of Data Science & Analytics
jobs.description:
ABOUT LEAP

Leap is one of the fastest-growing benefits solutions and a category-defining pioneer in employer specialty pharmacy. We are reshaping how life-changing therapies are delivered and financed, ensuring patients get the treatment they need while employers finally get a fair deal.

Specialty drugs and infusions represent nearly 10% of all healthcare spend and are the fastest-growing cost category for employers. Leap tackles this challenge with a novel approach: eliminating hidden markups, expanding access to high-quality infusion providers, and bringing clarity and fairness to how therapies are priced and paid for.

We’re proud to partner with numerous Fortune 500 companies and leading TPAs. Each patient we serve creates immediate ROI: lower costs, improved access, and better care. Join us as we redefine what’s possible in specialty care.




ABOUT THE ROLE

How do you identify patients who could benefit from specialty care support within broad, imperfect healthcare datasets? How do you forecast treatment demand across populations where a small number of patients can drive substantial variation? How do you reliably estimate the savings and impact of a care model when claims arrive late, treatment patterns change, and the alternative course of care isn’t always directly observed?

As Head of Data Science & Analytics, you’ll lead Leap’s work on these questions. You’ll develop the methods and models that help us identify patients, anticipate their needs, forecast population behavior, and measure our effect on costs, adherence, and access to care. Your work will directly inform how we engage members, support clients, source therapies, and invest in the business.

Our team has built a solid foundation across data engineering, analytics, and operational reporting. This role builds on that work, bringing dedicated data science and analytical leadership to substantially expand our capabilities. You’ll develop new ways to predict what comes next, evaluate which analytical models are effective, and apply those insights across a rapidly growing business.

You’ll partner directly with leaders across Finance, Commercial Growth, Client Success, Pharmacy, Clinical Operations, and Product to answer complex analytical questions that shape our strategy and strengthen the operational reporting they use to run their teams. Building on our existing infrastructure, you’ll work with data engineering and analytics colleagues to strengthen shared metrics, expand reporting capabilities, and embed quality controls that keep our numbers reliable as Leap scales. You’ll own a cross-functional roadmap that connects these investments to business priorities, giving every team a clear view of performance and the analytical tools to improve it.

This is a hands-on leadership role with room to build a team and shape the function. It reports to Leap’s President and co-founder.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


DEVELOP PATIENT INTELLIGENCE AND PREDICTIVE MODELS

 - Develop methods for identifying patients who may benefit from Leap using medical and pharmacy claims, eligibility records, clinical information, and operational data.

 - Translate incomplete and fragmented observations into useful signals about therapy utilization, treatment status, care transitions, and opportunities for engagement.

 - Develop and validate models of patient engagement, treatment initiation, adherence, and persistence, with clear definitions of what the available data can reliably establish.

 - Evaluate models for accuracy, calibration, bias, and operational usefulness, accounting for missing data, claims lag, and differences across populations.

 - Partner with Engineering, Product, and Clinical Operations to bring validated methods into production workflows and monitor their performance over time.


FORECAST POPULATION BEHAVIOR AND DEMAND

 - Build population-level models that connect covered lives to specialty therapy utilization, serviceable members, active patients, and treatment volume.

 - Account for stochastic variation, sparse observations, population differences, and the outsized effect of individual patients and high-cost therapies.

 - Apply appropriate statistical methods—such as hierarchical models, time-to-event analysis, and simulation—to estimate outcomes and quantify uncertainty.

 - Forecast performance by client, therapy, and time period, distinguishing underlying trends from random variation and changes in data availability.

 - Backtest forecasts, investigate deviations, and translate results into decisions about procurement, clinical capacity, client strategy, and financial planning.


ESTABLISH RIGOROUS METHODS FOR MEASURING IMPACT

 - Develop defensible methodologies and algorithms for estimating Leap’s savings, patient adherence, access to care, and broader program impact.

 - Define appropriate baselines and counterfactuals, accounting for factors such as patient selection, treatment mix, site of care, drug pricing, and observation periods.

 - Establish a consistent relationship between pre-sale savings estimates, account forecasts, and realized results, making assumptions and sources of uncertainty explicit.

 - Design experiments and observational analyses to understand which engagement and care interventions improve outcomes.

 - Partner with Finance, Clinical, and Client Success leaders to make these methods reproducible, explainable, and useful for internal decisions and client reporting.


PARTNER ACROSS THE BUSINESS AND SCALE OPERATIONAL REPORTING

 - Work directly with functional leaders to identify their most important data science and operational questions, translating them into a shared roadmap for models, analyses, and reporting.

 - Build on Leap’s existing reporting infrastructure to support growing client and patient populations, more complex operations, and new business capabilities.

 - Partner with each team to develop reliable views of its performance, including volumes, conversion, capacity, timeliness, quality, and outcomes, with the ability to investigate what drives changes.

 - Strengthen shared definitions and calculations for core metrics—including member funnel stages, activation, treatments, adherence, and savings—so company-wide reporting and departmental views remain consistent.

 - Expand Omni and the underlying analytical models into a durable self-service environment, making validated metrics accessible across dashboards, ad hoc analyses, and AI-assisted queries.

 - Own the reporting lifecycle with data engineering and analytics counterparts: prioritize requirements, define acceptance criteria, validate outputs, support adoption, and maintain reporting as workflows evolve.

 - Maintain the business data dictionary and documentation of analytical methods and source lineage, with clear communication when definitions, sources, or methodologies change.


EMBED QUALITY AND REPRODUCIBILITY

 - Establish standards for reviewing, testing, and validating models, analyses, and recurring reporting.

 - Partner with Engineering on checks for data completeness, freshness, identity matching, and reconciliation across systems.

 - Ensure important patient and operational events are captured and represented consistently throughout the analytical workflow.

 - Make results reproducible through shared calculation logic, version control, documented assumptions, and appropriate peer review.

 - Make changes in results understandable, distinguishing business movement from new data, source corrections, or methodological updates.


LEAD AND BUILD THE FUNCTION

 - Set the scientific and analytical direction for Leap, balancing foundational capabilities with opportunities to deliver new value.

 - Hire, develop, and lead data scientists and analysts as the company grows.

 - Work closely with data engineering and product counterparts to translate analytical requirements into durable technical capabilities.

 - Communicate complex methods and findings clearly, helping colleagues understand both what the evidence supports and where uncertainty remains.

 - Build a culture of curiosity, rigor, and practical experimentation across the company.




QUALIFICATIONS


REQUIRED

 - You’ve developed statistical or machine learning methods that informed real decisions or became part of operational workflows, and you’ve owned their validation and ongoing performance.

 - You have strong statistical foundations and experience with several relevant methods, such as hierarchical or Bayesian modeling, forecasting, survival analysis, causal inference, or simulation. You know how to choose an approach that fits the data and the decision.

 - You’ve worked hands-on with large healthcare datasets, including claims or eligibility data, and understand their coding, timing, completeness, and interpretation challenges.

 - You’ve worked with functional leaders to define how outcomes and performance are measured, built a roadmap from their most important questions, and delivered the models, reporting, and quality controls that put it into use.

 - You’ve led data scientists or analysts, or built a substantial capability as an early technical hire, and want to remain close to the work.

 - You use AI tools effectively while maintaining independent judgment, reproducibility, and appropriate validation.


PREFERRED

 - Experience in specialty pharmacy, payer, PBM, actuarial, health benefits, or clinical outcomes analytics.

 - Experience identifying patient cohorts or treatment patterns from longitudinal healthcare data.

 - Experience measuring healthcare costs, adherence, or program impact using experimental or observational methods.

 - Experience forecasting low-frequency, high-cost events or heterogeneous populations with limited historical data.

 - Experience with analytical data modeling, semantic layers, and self-service reporting tools such as dbt, Omni, or Looker.

 - An advanced degree in statistics, biostatistics, computer science, applied mathematics, economics, epidemiology, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent applied experience.

 - Experience building in a fast-growing company.



At Leap, we’re building an outlier company with real impact — and that takes focus, energy, and commitment. If that excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Leap is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. We’re committed to building a team that reflects a diversity of perspectives, experiences, and identities.

At NerdWallet, we're on a mission to provide clarity for all of life's financial decisions. Every small business has a unique story, and we're passionate about helping entrepreneurs access the financing they need to start, grow, and succeed. As part of our Small Business Sales team, you'll play a critical role in developing the sales professionals who make that mission possible.

We're looking for a Sales Trainer who is passionate about developing people, elevating sales performance, and building a culture of continuous learning. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role where you'll partner closely with Sales Leadership to onboard new Account Executives, coach existing team members, and reinforce the sales behaviors that drive exceptional customer outcomes.

You'll spend time where it matters most—embedded with the sales team—observing live customer conversations, facilitating coaching sessions, analyzing performance trends, and helping representatives sharpen their consultative selling skills. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy helping others succeed, and love translating coaching into measurable business impact, we'd love to meet you.



WHERE YOU CAN MAKE AN IMPACT:

As a Sales Trainer, you'll serve as a trusted partner to Sales Leadership while helping representatives build the confidence, skills, and product knowledge needed to succeed.

This role is approximately 70% new hire onboarding facilitation and 30% ongoing sales coaching. You'll:

 - Lead an engaging onboarding program that prepares new Account Executives to confidently navigate customer conversations, master our sales process, and achieve ramp expectations.

 - Deliver ongoing coaching through live call observation, call reviews, role plays, deal strategy sessions, objection-handling exercises, and pitch refinement.

 - Maintain a consistent presence on the sales floor, identifying coaching opportunities and providing timely, actionable feedback that improves performance.

 - Reinforce NerdWallet Small Business's Challenger-based and consultative sales methodology throughout every stage of the customer journey.

 - Coach representatives on discovery, objection handling, urgency creation, lender positioning, financing education, ROI articulation, follow-up strategy, and closing execution.

 - Become a subject matter expert on small business financing, alternative lending solutions, borrower profiles, lender programs, and deal positioning.

 - Partner closely with Sales Leadership, Business Development, Product, and Operations to ensure onboarding and coaching remain aligned with business priorities, market trends, and product updates.

 - Analyze call recordings, coaching observations, and performance metrics to identify recurring skill gaps and develop targeted coaching plans.

 - Create and continuously improve practical enablement materials including playbooks, talk tracks, call examples, role-play scenarios, and job aids.

 - Support frontline sales managers by reinforcing coaching best practices and driving consistency across teams.


WHERE YOU CAN GROW:

At NerdWallet, learning doesn't stop after onboarding. As a Sales Trainer, you'll have the opportunity to influence the development of an entire sales organization while partnering closely with leadership to shape coaching strategy, improve onboarding programs, and continuously raise the bar for sales excellence. You'll build strong cross-functional relationships, expand your expertise in sales enablement, and directly contribute to the growth of both our people and our business.




YOUR EXPERIENCE:

 - 1+ years of experience in sales training, sales enablement, sales coaching, or frontline sales leadership within a fast-paced, quota-driven organization.

 - A proven track record of onboarding new sales representatives and improving speed to productivity.

 - Experience coaching sales professionals through live observation, call reviews, role plays, and direct feedback.

 - A strong understanding of Challenger, consultative, and transactional sales methodologies.

 - Excellent communication, facilitation, and relationship-building skills.

 - The ability to deliver direct, actionable coaching while building trust and credibility across the sales organization.

 - Experience using sales and enablement technologies such as Gong, Salesforce, LMS platforms, or similar tools.

 - A data-driven mindset with the ability to connect coaching activities to measurable improvements in sales behaviors and business outcomes.

 - Willingness to travel approximately twice per quarter to support in-person onboarding, training, and coaching.

Preferred qualifications:

 - Formal certification or experience with recognized sales methodologies such as Challenger, SPIN Selling, Sandler, or MEDDICC.

Success in this role will be measured by the impact you have on the development and performance of our sales organization. You'll help new hires ramp more quickly, improve the quality of customer conversations, strengthen sales execution, increase conversion rates and funded revenue, reduce recurring performance gaps, and build a culture where coaching is an everyday part of winning.

We also understand the importance of flexibility to work remotely, both for personal and professional reasons. jobs.description:
Team and Role

This role is part of our Product Design team, which turns a deep understanding of our users and customers into product experiences they love. Our designers bring expertise across design systems, visual design, interaction design, content design, and product design. At ServiceNow, design has an intentional seat at the table, and we partner with Engineering and Product Management from the outset.

We're looking for a Senior Director of Product Creative Direction to define and evolve the visual expression of our product portfolio. This leader will set a distinctive product visual direction, translate it into a scalable system, and help teams make complex enterprise software feel clear, coherent, modern, and unmistakably ServiceNow.

This is a product-focused creative leadership role. You will work as part of cross-functional software development teams and partner across Platform and the business units to connect creative vision with customer needs, product strategy, and technical realities. Product teams retain ownership of their product strategy, design, roadmap, quality, and delivery; this role provides shared visual direction, systems, critique, and enablement.

You will also advance the responsible use of AI in creative work and make accessibility intrinsic to the product visual language.

What you get to do in this role

• Define and champion a differentiated visual direction for the product portfolio, grounded in our brand, customer needs, product strategy, and the evolving relationship between people and AI.

• Establish a clear point of view across typography, color, composition, iconography, illustration, motion, data visualization, density, and other visual foundations.

• Create future-state concepts, reference experiences, and exemplars that make the visual direction tangible.

• Work with Design Systems, Product Design, Content Design, Accessibility, Localization, and Research to translate the visual language into scalable foundations, components, patterns, and guidance.

• Partner with Design Systems, Product Management and Engineering throughout the software development lifecycle so the creative direction can be applied effectively in shipped products.

• Define where consistency is essential, where variation creates value, and how teams can extend the system without creating a centralized bottleneck.

• Lead the strategy for AI-enabled creative exploration, prototyping, asset creation, system evolution, and evaluation, focusing on meaningful gains in range, speed, consistency, and quality.

• Move promising AI approaches from experimentation to repeatable practice through pilots, playbooks, training, exemplars, responsible-use standards, and measurable adoption goals.

• Provide creative direction and hands-on critique for priority, cross-product initiatives while reinforcing product-team ownership.

• Partner with Brand and Marketing so the company expression and product experience tell a coherent story while remaining useful and native to interactive software.

• Make accessibility intrinsic to the creative vision and visual foundations, partnering with Accessibility and Engineering to meet or exceed applicable standards, including WCAG 2.2 AA.

• Lead, develop, and attract exceptional visual, motion, and multidisciplinary design talent.

• Build the culture, enablement, and shared critique practices that help product designers and distributed visual designers understand, apply, and continually raise the visual craft bar.

• Build a network of creative leaders and contributors across the business units who can extend the direction while maintaining coherence.

Preferred Qualifications

• 12+ years of experience in product design, visual design, experience design, creative direction, or a related field, including significant leadership experience shipping complex digital products.

• A portfolio demonstrating exceptional visual craft and creative leadership across shipped product experiences, not only brand campaigns or marketing communications.

• Experience defining or materially evolving a visual language across a complex, multi-product software portfolio.

• Deep understanding of design systems, including visual foundations, design tokens, components, patterns, governance, contribution models, and the relationship between design and code.

• Demonstrated experience adopting AI-enabled creative tools and workflows and moving teams from isolated experimentation to sustained, responsible use at scale.

• Proven ability to influence senior executives and align multiple organizations without relying solely on reporting authority.

• Strong systems thinking and the ability to connect an inspiring creative idea to the practices and adoption mechanisms required to make it real at scale.

• Demonstrated commitment to accessible and inclusive design, with working knowledge of WCAG and platform accessibility considerations.

• Excellent communication, storytelling, facilitation, and critique skills, including the ability to make a direction compelling to executives and actionable for delivery teams.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Data Platform
jobs.description:
ABOUT LEAP

Leap is one of the fastest-growing benefits solutions and a category-defining pioneer in employer specialty pharmacy. We are reshaping how life-changing therapies are delivered and financed, ensuring patients get the treatment they need while employers finally get a fair deal.

Specialty drugs and infusions represent nearly 10% of all healthcare spend and are the fastest-growing cost category for employers. Leap tackles this challenge with a novel approach: eliminating hidden markups, expanding access to high-quality infusion providers, and bringing clarity and fairness to how therapies are priced and paid for.

We’re proud to partner with numerous Fortune 500 companies and leading TPAs. Each patient we serve creates immediate ROI: lower costs, improved access, and better care. Join us as we redefine what’s possible in specialty care.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Data powers nearly every part of Leap: launching new clients, identifying patients, coordinating care, sourcing drugs, and measuring savings. As we grow, more teams depend on our data platform, and their needs often compete for the same engineering capacity.

You’ll own the product direction and delivery of Leap’s data platform and integrations. A central part of your role will be bringing structure to how work reaches Data Engineering: understanding requests across teams, clarifying the underlying needs, and making explicit decisions about what gets prioritized, when, and why. You’ll build a process that makes it easier for teams to get their needs addressed and for engineers to focus on the most important work.

Working closely with our data engineers, you’ll turn those priorities into well-scoped projects with clear milestones, dependencies, and acceptance criteria. Your remit will span our ingestion engine, data quality and traceability, and integrations that embed Leap into client and partner workflows. Engineering owns architecture and implementation; you’ll help define the capabilities we need and sequence investments alongside immediate business commitments.

This is a hands-on technical product role. You should be comfortable querying BigQuery, reading Airflow DAGs and dbt models, evaluating a Fivetran connector, and investigating a malformed eligibility file. You bring the technical judgment and product discipline to clarify scope, challenge assumptions, and keep delivery on track.

You’ll work closely with Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Analytics, Implementation, and Client Success. This role sits within Leap’s Engineering organization.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES


INTAKE & CROSS-TEAM PRIORITIZATION

 - Own the intake process for Data Engineering, giving teams a clear way to submit requests and visibility into how decisions are made.

 - Work with requesters to understand the problem, business impact, urgency, and downstream dependencies before committing engineering capacity.

 - Reconcile competing needs across teams, distinguish firm deadlines from preferred timing, and make trade-offs explicit.

 - Maintain a single prioritized backlog and roadmap that balance client launches, business needs, platform improvements, and reliability.

 - Resolve conflicting requests with stakeholders and bring decisions that require leadership input forward with clear options and a recommendation.

 - Keep teams informed about what is committed, what is deferred, and why. Revisit priorities as needs change, with a clear view of the impact on existing commitments.

 - Continually improve intake so that gathering requirements and reaching decisions require less back-and-forth as Leap grows.


PRODUCT OWNERSHIP & DELIVERY

 - Translate prioritized needs into clear problem statements, requirements, dependencies, and measurable acceptance criteria.

 - Work with engineers to break projects into deliverable milestones, test assumptions, and establish realistic timelines.

 - Coordinate dependencies across teams and external partners so work is ready to proceed when engineering capacity is available.

 - Track delivery, surface risks early, and agree on changes to scope or timing with the teams affected.

 - Validate completed work against acceptance criteria and confirm it solves the original business need.


DATA PLATFORM & RELIABILITY

 - Maintain a working understanding of the data stack: how data moves through it, which teams depend on it, and where ownership or capabilities are unclear.

 - Own product requirements for a reusable ingestion engine, including validation, normalization, error handling, and onboarding workflows.

 - Identify recurring manual work and one-off implementations, and prioritize shared capabilities that reduce the effort required to support growth.

 - Support engineering-led architecture and tooling decisions by clarifying business requirements and weighing implications for delivery, reliability, cost, and future needs.

 - Define requirements for data provenance: where data comes from, how it is transformed, where it is used, and who is responsible for it.

 - Establish expectations for freshness, completeness, and accuracy with data consumers, and work with engineering on monitoring, alerting, and escalation.

 - Ensure sources, data contracts, ownership, and key platform decisions are documented; drive recurring data quality issues toward durable resolution.

 - Partner with Analytics on metric lineage and with Security on requirements for access controls, PHI handling, retention, and third-party data use.


CLIENT & PARTNER INTEGRATIONS

 - Scope eligibility, claims, clinical, drug pricing, and operational data integrations, including formats, delivery methods, refresh cadences, and downstream requirements.

 - Partner with Implementation to make client onboarding faster and more repeatable, with clear readiness criteria and ownership at each step.

 - Identify and scope opportunities to embed Leap into client and partner tools through APIs, data exchanges, and workflow integrations.

 - Work with external technical teams to resolve requirements, confirm dependencies, and coordinate testing and launch.

 - Validate that integrations work end to end and meet the needs of the teams and workflows that depend on them.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Teams know how to request work, what information is needed, and how prioritization decisions are made.

 - Competing requests are resolved promptly, with clear trade-offs and fewer rounds of clarification.

 - Engineering works from an agreed set of priorities, with clear scope, known dependencies, and measurable acceptance criteria.

 - Teams can plan around credible delivery commitments, and changes are communicated early.

 - New clients and data sources launch through increasingly standardized processes.

 - Data sources, transformations, and ownership are documented and traceable.

 - Platform investments reduce manual work, recurring issues, and the effort required to support growth.

 - Integrations make Leap a more connected part of client and partner workflows.




QUALIFICATIONS


REQUIRED

 - Experience owning technical products or programs involving data platforms, infrastructure, or integrations—as a technical product manager, technical program manager, solutions architect, or engineer with product ownership responsibilities.

 - Experience managing intake and prioritization across multiple teams with competing needs, including resolving disagreements, negotiating scope, and building alignment around what gets done first.

 - A track record of taking ambiguous needs through scoping, prioritization, and delivery, including managing dependencies and making difficult trade-offs.

 - Strong SQL skills and enough fluency in Python, orchestration tools, and transformation frameworks to investigate issues and challenge technical assumptions.

 - Experience with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake, ingestion tools such as Fivetran, and workflows built with tools such as Airflow and dbt.

 - Experience delivering external file-based or API integrations with incomplete documentation, inconsistent data, and changing requirements.

 - The ability to reason about system architecture and explain how technical choices affect delivery, reliability, cost, and future capabilities.

 - Clear writing: you produce specs engineers can build from and documentation other teams can use.

 - Practical experience using AI tools to accelerate analysis, technical investigation, documentation, or delivery, with sound judgment about validating outputs and handling sensitive data.


PREFERRED

 - Experience with healthcare eligibility, medical or pharmacy claims, clinical data, or drug pricing.

 - Familiarity with healthcare data standards such as X12, NCPDP, or HL7/FHIR.

 - Experience working with PHI in a HIPAA-regulated environment.

 - A background in data, analytics, implementation, or software engineering.

 - Experience building reusable integration capabilities or embedding products into partner workflows.

 - Experience establishing product and delivery practices at an early-stage company.



At Leap, we’re building an outlier company with real impact — and that takes focus, energy, and commitment. If that excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

Leap is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. We’re committed to building a team that reflects a diversity of perspectives, experiences, and identities.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Enterprise is central to Anthropic's mission. The organizations that could benefit most from Claude often have the most demanding needs, with rigorous requirements around end-user experience, procurement, security, and permissions. We believe earning their trust is essential to ensuring AI benefits the world broadly.

We're looking for a Staff+ Full Stack Engineer for our Enterprise pillar—the team that makes Claude enterprise-ready at scale. When a Fortune 500 company rolls out Claude to 100,000 employees, the admin, governance, and management experiences you build are what their IT leaders, security teams, and end users touch every day. This is a high-agency role where the product questions are as open as the architecture ones: you'll help decide what these products are, not just how they're built, and you'll see your work land with real teams at the world's largest enterprises.

What you'll do

• Own technical design and delivery for enterprise-facing products end-to-end across the stack—from admin consoles and governance surfaces to the APIs and data models behind them

• Partner with product, design, and go-to-market to turn enterprise customer workflows into shipped product, not just execute against a spec

• Set technical direction and standards for your team: architecture, code quality, and how the team builds

• Work directly with enterprise customers, admins, and sales during key conversations, translating what you learn into engineering priorities

• Build the primitives that let the world's largest organizations deploy, govern, and get value from Claude at scale

• Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar across the team, working with influence rather than authority

You may be a good fit if you

• Have 8+ years of software engineering experience, ideally with 2+ years at a Staff or equivalent technical leadership level

• Have led the design and delivery of complex customer-facing products across the full stack

• Have built enterprise SaaS products and understand what IT admins, security reviewers, and procurement teams need to say yes

• Are comfortable working directly with enterprise customers and translating what you learn into technical decisions

• Have built products from 0 to 1 in fast-moving environments, and can set technical direction with limited precedent to lean on

• Drive cross-team alignment to ship impactful work, with influence over authority

Strong candidates may also have

• Experience with enterprise identity, permissions, and administration surfaces (SSO/SCIM, RBAC, audit, usage and spend visibility)

• Experience building AI products and turning model capabilities into applications people actually use

• Experience as startup founders or early-stage employees

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$405,000—$485,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Moveworks is looking for a mixed-methods Principal Experience Researcher, AI to turn complex user behavior into clear, actionable product direction. You’ll combine qualitative research with quantitative analysis to understand not only what people do, but why they do it.

You’ll serve as a critical bridge between end-user experiences and the machine learning systems that power them. By translating user needs, behaviors, and feedback into measurable signals, you’ll help teams evaluate and improve model performance—and ensure our AI creates experiences that are useful, trustworthy, and intuitive.

This is a generalist research role for someone comfortable working across methods and stages of product development. You don’t need an engineering background, but you should be curious about how AI systems work and able to collaborate effectively with technical partners.

What you get to do in this role

• Identify and prioritize opportunities across the end-user journey by connecting large-scale behavioral data with qualitative insights, shaping product strategy and roadmap priorities.
• Set research strategy and prioritize the research portfolio around high-impact user and business questions, selecting approaches that balance scope, depth, speed, and confidence to guide investment decisions.
• Translate user needs and behaviors into clear signals that inform the design, development, and evaluation of AI and machine learning systems.
• Define the evaluation strategy for AI-powered experiences, establishing frameworks, quality standards, and shared success measures across product, design, and machine learning teams that connect model performance to usability, relevance, trust, and user outcomes.
• Investigate model and experience failures, identify recurring patterns, and recommend improvements across the product and underlying systems.
• Serve as a strategic partner to product, design, engineering, data science, and machine learning leaders, framing critical questions, challenging assumptions, and aligning teams on evidence-based product direction.
• Evaluate new concepts and product experiences throughout development—from early discovery and prototyping through launch and continuous improvement.

• Strong grounding in qualitative and quantitative research methods, including generative and evaluative approaches, with sound judgment in sampling, survey design, experimentation, bias, validity, and data interpretation.
• Demonstrated ability to analyze large or complex behavioral datasets, including product usage logs, and translate findings into actionable product insights.
• Strong written, verbal, and visual communication skills, including the ability to make complex findings clear to different audiences.

• Experience conducting lean UX research in a fast-paced environment.
• Experience researching AI-powered, machine learning, conversational, search, or recommendation experiences.

jobs.title: Sr. Security Analyst (Threat Detection)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. SECURITY ANALYST (THREAT DETECTION)

We are a target of both nation states and actors focused on brand destruction. Information drives our business, and we must protect against unauthorized changes, improper destruction, loss, or theft of that information. As a highly visible and dynamic organization, we must also value and guard against damage to our reputation and brand. Finally, it is paramount that we defend against loss of control or confidence in our systems to guarantee the highest probability of mission success. As a SpaceX Security Analyst, you will be responsible for analyzing and responding to threats directed at our environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Support the SpaceX Security Operations Center (SOC) as our frontline responder by identifying, triaging, and remediating security detections and anomalies.

• Provide incident response support as a key stakeholder by investigating security incidents from initial detection through root cause.

• Assist in evidence collection and collaboration with SpaceX engineering teams to proactively improve and secure systems from future attacks.

• Contribute towards impactful detection capabilities for the environment targeting sophisticated attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).

• Enhance endpoint and network visibility, along with detection and response playbooks, to protect SpaceX people, missions, and assets.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• 5+ years of information security, networking and/or systems engineering experience and a Bachelor's degree in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, information technology, or other STEM discipline; OR 7+ years of information security, networking and/or systems engineering experience in lieu of a degree.

• Experience with operating system internals and auditing for Linux, Windows, or macOS platforms.

• Experience with network and host-based collection tools.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Deep understanding of classic and emerging threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures in both pre- and post-exploitation phases of attack lifecycles.

• Deep understanding of incident response processes.

• Experience using Elastic, Splunk and/or other SIEMs.

• Experience with scripting language(s) for the purposes of automating security operations and incident response processes.

• Experience with reverse engineering, C2 exploitation, and broader system/network forensics.

• Security community contributions (blog posts, conference talks, CTFs, tool development, etc.).

• Knowledge of cloud infrastructure and cloud security.

• SANS/GIAC, OSCP or similar certifications.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
