jobs.title: Staff Thermal Engineer
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

Role Overview:

CHAOS is seeking a Staff Thermal Engineer to perform thermal and fluid-flow analysis of electronic components, circuit card assemblies (CCAs), and electronic enclosures. The role spans design trades, detailed analysis, hardware integration, qualification, and production support.

You will analyze heat transfer and internal fluid flow, including air and liquid coolants in cabinets, coldplates, and heat exchangers. You will work closely with electrical and mechanical designers, providing technical guidance to improve thermal performance and resolve design challenges. You will plan and support tests, perform data reduction, and correlate thermal models with test results.

• This is a full-time, on-site position in El Segundo, CA.

• This requisition is open to candidates who may be considered for a lower or higher job level. Final level and grade will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.

Responsibilities:

• Perform hand calculations and detailed thermal analyses of electronic components, CCAs, and enclosures

• Develop and use ANSYS Icepak models for electronics cooling and internal air and liquid coolant flow

• Analyze cooling systems that include cabinets, coldplates, heat exchangers, and related hardware

• Assess temperatures, flow distribution, pressure drop, and thermal margins across expected operating conditions

• Define model inputs, assumptions, and boundary conditions, and communicate their effect on results

• Provide practical thermal design guidance to electrical and mechanical designers

• Identify thermal risks and recommend design changes in collaboration with multidisciplinary teams

• Participate in design and peer reviews

• Plan and support thermal tests, analyze test data, and correlate models with test results

• Support board and system bring-up, qualification, troubleshooting, and production issues

• Document analysis methods, assumptions, results, and recommendations

Minimum Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related STEM field and 7+ years of relevant experience

• Hands-on experience performing electronics thermal analysis using ANSYS Icepak

• Strong working knowledge of heat transfer, thermodynamics, and fluid mechanics

• Experience analyzing thermal performance of electronic components, circuit boards, or enclosures

• Ability to perform engineering hand calculations and assess when detailed simulation is needed

• Experience analyzing liquid-cooled coldplates and heat exchangers

• Experience with forced-air cooling, flow distribution, pressure-drop analysis, and fan performance

• Strong technical communication skills and ability to work independently across engineering disciplines

• Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance

Preferred Requirements:

• Experience with Macroflow, STAR-CCM+, NX thermal, or other thermal or CFD software

• Experience planning or supporting thermal tests, reducing test data, or correlating analysis models

• Experience with aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability electronic systems

• Familiarity with MIL-STD-810, RTCA/DO-160, or VITA-48

Why CHAOS?

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, AI Accounting & Ledger Systems
jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI-native platform integrated with 60+ EHRs.



Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000+ clinicians across 500+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”



Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.



The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.



About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Engineering Manager for the team that owns the financial core of our revenue cycle product. That's three things: the ledger that records every financial event, the reports that billing managers and CFOs close their books on, and the analytics that tell a practice how it's doing.

You'll manage 6 to 8 engineers, from early-career to Senior Staff, own the roadmap with your product partner, and be accountable for financial correctness across the platform. We're partway through rebuilding this surface: moving a decade of report logic onto a drift-free ledger and a modern OLAP layer, while customers keep closing their books on the old one.


What You'll Do

 - Manage and grow a team of 6 to 8 engineers. Hiring, performance, career growth. Build people who can each run a customer escalation, a data migration, or an incident end-to-end without you in the room.

 - Set the roadmap with your product partner. The goal is to get from building whatever report a customer asked for to customers building their own reports and closing their books without us involved.

 - Own financial correctness. For this team, wrong numbers are a worse failure than a slow page. You'll own the systems that catch silent errors: shadow parity harnesses, cross-report tie-out checks, drift monitoring, and correctness SLOs next to the uptime ones.

 - Lead multi-quarter migrations (ledger report migration, OLAP golden views) incrementally, with parity checks at each step, without breaking anyone's close.

 - Own the customer relationship at the top of the stack. Sit with comptrollers, CFOs, and RCM directors at our largest sites during month-end. Turn their definition of "correct" into software, and turn recurring escalations into roadmap.

 - Run cross-team execution with the payments/posting team, data infrastructure, and ops so upstream changes don't quietly break downstream numbers.



What You Have

 - 5+ years managing software engineers, including senior and staff-level ICs. You've grown engineers into leads and staff engineers, and you can name them.

 - You've shipped financial, reporting, or data-intensive systems in production where the numbers had to tie. You know how a report can be technically correct and still wrong to the person reading it.

 - Backend and data fluency. You can review a query plan, push back on a ledger design, and debug a parity failure yourself. Staff engineers will take you seriously because you engage with the substance.

 - You've set direction for a product surface and can say what it should look like in 12 months.

 - You're comfortable across the table from a CFO explaining why a number moved.

 - Operational discipline: on-call, SLOs, and monitoring for correctness as well as availability.

 - You move fast on incomplete information and reset timelines honestly when the work turns out bigger than expected.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Healthcare RCM, billing, practice management, or clearinghouse background. Or fintech experience with ledgers, close automation, or reconciliation (BlackLine, FloQast, Numeric, Stripe, Modern Treasury).

 - OLAP stores (StarRocks, ClickHouse, Druid) run alongside PostgreSQL.

 - Double-entry accounting, append-only ledgers, or audit-trail requirements.

 - Leading a platform re-architecture while keeping the existing system shipping.

 - Shipping LLM features to production. We run an AI report builder that handles thousands of custom reporting requests.



Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in @commure.com http://commure.com. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

jobs.title: Classified IT Asset & Procurement Administrator
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anduril is seeking a Classified IT Asset & Procurement Administrator who will be responsible for cradle-to-grave of IT assets across the enterprise. They will work with IT Systems Engineers to help specify, order, and maintain accountability of a multitude of assets across multiple sites.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Research, select, order, and lifecycle manage IT hardware and software, including workstations, servers, network hardware, appliances, etc.

• Manage endpoint specifications and selection and adoption across Anduril teams.

• Implement asset tracking system and Data Center Infrastructure Manager (DCIM) tools

• Assist with the imaging and configuration of systems and devices and their deployment to sites

• Act as point of contact for Corporate Technology teams to provide guidance and procurement assistance.

• Work with business lines to provide high quality delivery to provide best in class end user technology.

• Track and ship hardware to remote sites as needed

• Work with Facilities, Security, and Cybersecurity to coordinate build-outs of new spaces

• Other projects and duties as assigned

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Advanced knowledge of computer components and IT hardware

• Experience with ticketing systems, such as Jira or ServiceNow

• Experience with creating technical documentation

• Experience with asset/inventory tracking systems or tools

• Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with Windows and/or Linux system imaging

• Enterprise IT Asset Management or consulting background

• Experience managing QBR process with key vendors

US Salary Range

$112,000—$149,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

• No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

• Please always verify communications: Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address. Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

• Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

• What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Data Privacy

To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/.

By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. jobs.title: Product Manager II
jobs.description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.

Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.

The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.

WHO WE ARE:

The Trade Desk is a global technology company with a mission to create a better, more open internet for everyone through principled, intelligent advertising. Handling over 600 billion queries per day (more than 100 times the query volume of search globally), our platform operates at an unprecedented scale. We have also built something even stronger and more valuable: an award-winning culture based on trust, ownership, empathy, and collaboration. We value the unique experiences and perspectives that each person brings to The Trade Desk, and we are committed to fostering inclusive spaces where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work every day.

Do you have a passion for solving hard problems at scale? Are you eager to join a dynamic, globally- connected team where your contributions will make a meaningful difference in building a better media ecosystem? Come and see why Fortune magazine consistently ranks The Trade Desk among the best small-medium-sized workplaces globally.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

We are looking for driven Product Managers who learn fast, who are humble and value teamwork; who are hungry, and believe they can make our customer's world a much better place. The ideal candidate will be technical, data-driven, creative, business savvy, and love elegant user experience. They will be growth-oriented and able to strive for product-market fit with their teams.

The kind of person who joins The Trade Desk Product Team is fearless, courageous, passionate, and willing to dream big and then execute on it. We are committed to helping you grow, challenging you with hard, meaningful work, and celebrating our successes and failures together. Yes, we do fail at times because we believe the risk is part of making big bets. So we take the risks and learn from them.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:

The Trade Desk is a rapidly growing company, as our CEO often says: "we're only 2% done". We are facing the biggest paradigm shift in advertising in the last century as the industry moves towards data-driven, results-oriented advertising.

As a Product Manager on the Forecast and Planning team, you’ll be at the forefront of driving the team’s forecasting AI capabilities, along with expanding the capabilities of our core forecast and planning products across the entirety of The Trade Desk product set.  You’ll become an expert in how best to apply AI to forecast and planning experiences. You’ll serve as a key connector between executive stakeholders, engineers, researchers, and UX designers to ensure cohesive, high-impact solutions. You will champion a user-centric approach, deeply understanding and advocating for user needs and preferences. Your decisions will be data-driven, rooted in analytics and user insights. Additionally, you will align your strategies with our company's core values and long-term objectives. You will need to navigate ambiguous situations to establish clarity through well-defined execution plans. This role also entails collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to develop strategic product roadmaps that align with business goals and user needs.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE:

-3+ years of Product Management experience or relevant experience

-Background in ad tech and user experiences/user interfaces

-Background in software development, engineering, Machine Learning, or data science/analytics a plus

-Background in AI solutions a plus

-Passion -- your work matters. Your features matter. You care and give your all.

-Grit -- sometimes solutions take creative thinking and multiple iterations. You try many different approaches to the right answer.

-Collaborative -- the best PMs are not necessarily those with the best ideas, but those that ensure the right thing gets done.

-Selfless -- Product Management is about making sure the best work gets done by the team, and making sure they share in the credit.

-Empathy -- As a PM you are the voice of the customer and need to represent them from a position of deep understanding.

-Entrepreneur -- as a PM you need to get out there and convince others of your ideas

-Excellent communication/presentation skills both in large and small groups.

-A sustained track record of making significant, self-directed, and end-to-end contributions to large and impactful software projects

-Ability to solve complex, technical problems with creative solutions while managing tradeoffs

-Strong interest in what computing can do -- a passion for technology and how to apply that to problems of massive scale

Nice-to-haves

-Experience working with distributed teams - we have over 20 offices globally

-Experience in the advertising technology space

Contract Manager

Required Qualifications

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to lead teams and coordinate complex requirements across military, Government, and contractor stakeholders.

Preferred Experience

Candidates will be particularly competitive with previous experience supporting:

• U.S. Army Combined Arms Center (CAC)

• Army Centers of Excellence

• Army training proponents

• CATS development and sustainment

• ARTEP/Mission Training Plans

The ideal candidate is a seasoned Army leader who understands both the operational Army and institutional training environment. This individual should be comfortable leading personnel, coordinating with senior Government and military stakeholders, managing deliverables, and applying Army training doctrine and systems to support training-product development.

Candidates with direct Battalion/Brigade operations experience, CATS expertise, DTMS/ATN familiarity, and an active Secret clearance will be especially well aligned with this opportunity.

jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

Redwood Materials is seeking a strategic and business-minded leader to head our Total Rewards and People Analytics function. Reporting directly to the Chief People Officer, this role sits at the center of many of the company's most important talent, compensation, and workforce decisions.

You will lead compensation, benefits, equity, and people analytics for a rapidly growing organization spanning manufacturing, engineering, business operations, and corporate functions. As a trusted advisor to the Chief People Officer and executive team, you will help shape how we attract, reward, retain, and develop talent while building the analytical capabilities that inform workforce decisions across the company.

This is a highly visible role with regular exposure to executive leadership and the Compensation Committee. The successful candidate will play a central role in executive compensation strategy, equity program design and governance, board-level people reporting, and the development of scalable programs that support Redwood's continued growth.

This position can be based in Reno, NV or San Francisco, CA and follows a hybrid work model with an expectation of at least three days per week on-site.

• Lead the design and administration of compensation programs, including job architecture, market benchmarking, salary structures, pay equity analysis, incentive design, and annual compensation planning.

• Lead executive compensation analyses and recommendations, partnering closely with the Chief People Officer, Finance, and Legal.

• Own Redwood's equity compensation program, including plan governance, grant administration, vesting management, employee communications, and executive equity matters. Partner closely with Legal and Finance to ensure programs remain compliant and scalable.

• Lead preparation of compensation and people-related materials for the Board of Directors and Compensation Committee, including executive compensation reviews, benchmarking, workforce insights, and strategic recommendations.

• Develop compelling people insights and board-ready reporting that enable data-driven decisions on talent, retention, organizational health, and workforce trends.

• Oversee benefits strategy and administration, including health, retirement, wellness, vendor management, contract negotiations, and annual program evaluation.

• Partner closely with HRIS, IT, Finance, Legal, Payroll, and broader People team leaders to ensure programs are operationally sound, compliant, and built to scale.

Desired Qualifications

jobs.title: Internal Harness and Interconnect Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Company

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.

The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.

About the Job

Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean’s harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.

This role would exist in the Core Systems Integration & Test team. As the Internal Harness & Interconnect Engineer, you will own the dry-side nervous system of our node technology. You will be responsible for the architecture, physical hardening, and end-to-end delivery of all internal wiring, cabling, and interconnects across the entire system. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our Electrical Engineering and Core Systems & Software teams, manage external manufacturing partners, and serve as the go-to technical authority on the shop floor when diagnosing and resolving integration issues. Your work will directly dictate the reliability and signal integrity of critical computing and power systems operating in continuous, uncrewed maritime environments.

Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis. You will own your designs cradle-to-grave, from first concept through fabrication and deployment at sea. If you are an excellent engineer, regardless of your background, we want you to apply.

We strive to be the best engineering team on the planet and we compensate our team accordingly.

Responsibilities

• Be a leading contributor on the complete interconnection lifecycle for all dry-side node electronics – including connector selection, harness routing, wire termination, backshell integration, potting, strain relief, and mechanical retention.

• Develop and standardize robust harness assembly workflows (crimping, soldering, potting, connectorization, and continuity/hipot testing) to ensure repeatable, high-yield builds from prototype to production.

• Embed Design for Excellence (DFX) into every harness iteration:

• DFM: Simplify connector counts, standardize keying/polarization, and optimize routing to eliminate mis-mates and reduce assembly cycle time.

• DFT: Integrate automated continuity test points and derating strategies to survive continuous thermal-mechanical stress and high-vibration ocean environments.

• Architect clean signal and power pathways, eliminating electromagnetic interference, crosstalk, and ground loops between high speed data channels and power lines.

• Manage the interconnect BOM and vendor pipeline driving procurement, tolerance analysis, second-sourcing, and obsolescence mitigation for future node architecture rollouts.

• Drive quality verification and shop-floor triage, leading first article inspections and serving as the primary technical authority to debug electrical interconnect anomalies during system integration.

Required Qualifications

• Demonstrated capability in designing, packaging, and documenting complex wiring harnesses and interconnect assemblies for high-reliability systems (e.g., aerospace, marine, automotive, robotics, industrial automation or other harsh environments).

• Deep technical knowledge of connector families (e.g., Phoenix, Amphenol, Deutsch, Molex), specialized wire insulation/jacketing materials, and cable shielding techniques.

• Demonstrated track record diagnosing and resolving noise, grounding, and signal integrity artifacts in mixed data/power cabling architectures.

• Proficiency in wire harness design software (e.g., Zuken E3.series, RapidHarness, or equivalents).

• Hands-on expertise with harness fabrication, crimp validation, rework tools, and diagnostic instrumentation (DMMs, oscilloscopes, TDRs, insulation testers/meggers).

Desired Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or equivalent field.

• Familiarity with industry manufacturing standards such as IPC/WHMA-A-620 (Class 3) or high-reliability aerospace/military equivalents.

• Experience designing interconnects for sealed enclosures, pressure vessels, or chassis exposed to rigorous shock, vibration, and thermal cycling environments.

• Experience with high-speed data transmission (Ethernet, RF, high-speed differential pairs), fiber optic terminations, or high-voltage DC distribution.

• Familiarity with automated wire processing equipment and automated harness test systems (e.g., Cirris, CableEye).

• Proven track record establishing vendor second-sourcing and qualification pipelines for custom cable assemblies and specialized interconnect hardware.

• Direct work with hand

The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed.

Additional Requirements

• Travel to vendors and test sites as needed

• Intermittently able to work longer hours and weekends to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work-life balance, including flexiblePTO and flexible working hours.

Compensation and Benefits

If hired for this full-time role, you will receive:

• Cash compensation of $125,000 - $175,000.

• Equity in the company. We’re all owners and if we’re successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation.

• A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including: Flexible paid time off Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold-level PPO plan for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long-term financial support if you become disabled) Ability to contribute to tax-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA

• Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed).

Location

This is an on-site position. Our offices, lab, and shop are located in Portland, Oregon.

jobs.title: Senior SEO Strategy Lead (SEO, AEO, GEO)
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

Organic search is one of Airbnb's largest and most efficient acquisition channels, and the rise of AI answer engines is reshaping how travelers discover places to stay, things to do, and trusted Hosts. This role sits at the intersection of growth marketing, content strategy, and emerging AI search behavior, partnering closely with product, engineering, content, and data science teams to make Airbnb the trusted source that search engines and AI models cite.

The Difference You Will Make

As Senior Growth Marketing Lead, SEO, AEO, GEO, you will own the strategy and day-to-day execution for how Airbnb shows up in Google, AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and the assistants that come next. You are an execution-focused operator with a career built in SEO — you write your own SQL, size opportunities from raw data, and ship. Success in this role means measurable gains in organic visibility, rankings, AI citations, traffic, bookings, and downstream conversion, along with a measurement framework that proves the business value of organic channels. This is a chance to define what AEO and GEO mean for Airbnb and build the playbook others follow.

A Typical Day

• Own the organic growth strategy and content roadmap across SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) — covering technical SEO, content, on-site experience, and visibility in AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, and Perplexity.

• Manage internal content strategy for these acquisition channels: set priorities, briefs, templates, and quality standards for content and landing pages that drive organic and AI-referred traffic.

• Run the channel hands-on — pull and analyze your own data in SQL, size opportunities, prioritize by impact, and drive launches and experiments from backlog to measured result.

• Lead cross-functional relationships with product and engineering teams, embedding SEO and AEO best practices into web properties, app surfaces, and structured data.

• Improve how well AI models understand Airbnb's listings, product, and policies so they represent Airbnb accurately and cite it as a source.

• Build and evolve the measurement framework for SEO, AEO, and GEO — attribution models, leading and lagging indicators, dashboards, and revenue impact — including the ability to demonstrate the value of work that's difficult to attribute, such as preventive technical work or emerging AI channels.

• Establish Airbnb's point of view on how AI-generated answers are reshaping travel discovery, and translate complex technical concepts into clear business narratives for senior leaders.

Your Expertise

• 10+ years of experience in SEO, including 2+ years in a senior/leadership capacity engaging with executives.

• Strong SQL skills, writing your own queries to analyze crawl, log, search console, and conversion data without relying on analysts for core questions.

• Proven track record of shipping SEO programs at scale and driving significant organic growth, from prioritization through launch and measurement.

• Expertise in both technical SEO and content strategy, including site architecture, structured data, indexation, and content quality.

jobs.title: Consultant, Product Safety and Stewardship
jobs.description:
Preferred locations: Columbus or Cincinnati, OH; Irvine or Los Angeles, CA; Tampa, FL; Charlotte, NC; or Arlington, VA office.  Other office locations and remote work will be considered.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. No sponsorship is available for this position.

Are you excited about understanding, interpreting, and navigating complex policy issues? Are you motivated by creating sustainable change that benefits society and nature? Are you a curious and open-minded person?

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Environment & Health Division as our new Health Science Consultant and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

Ramboll Americas Engineering Solutions, Inc. (Ramboll) is a leading scientific environmental consulting firm providing a broad range of technical services to both public and private sector clients. Ramboll is seeking an entry-level Consultant in its Columbus (Dublin) or Cincinnati, Ohio; Irvine or Los Angeles, California; Tampa, Florida; Charlotte, NC; or Arlington, Virginia offices (although other office locations and remote work will be considered) to support client projects related to chemical safety, product stewardship, regulatory compliance, and environmental and human health risk assessment associated with industrial chemicals, consumer products, and environmental contaminants. The successful candidate will work under the direction and supervision of senior scientists to serve clients in the chemical and basic materials industries; food, cosmetic, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries; pesticides, consumer products, and specialty products industries.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Perform independent research and critical review of chemical, biochemical, and general toxicology/safety data and literature.
• Conduct database searches on product and chemical regulations
• Collect, compile, analyze, and present technical information to prepare client reports, memoranda, and presentations, as well as various notifications for submittals to governmental agencies.
• Work with others on cross-disciplinary teams to review physical/chemical properties and conduct exposure and risk assessments.
• Participate in internal team calls, and project calls and meetings with clients and government regulators.

About you

From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company. For this role, your starting point is:

• BS or MS degree in Chemistry or Biochemistry (or similar relevant STEM field), ability to apply basic chemistry principles to problem-solving, along with analytical, statistical, computing, and quantitative analysis skills.
• Great verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, which include technical writing, business writing, presentation skills, and ability to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences.
• Ability to critically evaluate and synthesize data from diverse sources and of varied quality, and to identify those studies and results that are the most relevant to the chemical safety and assessment of human and environmental health risks.
• Capability to work both, independently, and as part of a project team in a multi-tasking environment, and support and manage changing priorities and workloads.
• Willingness to travel for internal or client meetings, as required.

What we can offer you

• Meaningful, high-impact work
• Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
• Competitive compensation and benefits
• Professional development and leadership opportunities
• A collaborative and inclusive culture
• The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

Salary Transparency Statement

At Ramboll, we are committed to fair and transparent compensation practices that support our people and our purpose of creating sustainable societies. The anticipated base salary range for this position is $68,730 – $94,504 per year. This range reflects the compensation we reasonably expect to offer at the time of posting. Actual compensation will vary based on factors such as location, skills, experience, education, and internal equity. Because we operate across multiple U.S. markets, pay may differ depending on the cost of labor in specific locations. In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for bonus, overtime or other forms of compensation and we offer a comprehensive benefits package that supports well-being, professional development, and work-life balance. Our recruiters are happy to share more about the specific salary range and total rewards package applicable to your location during the hiring process.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll in the Americas

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll in the Americas has thousands of experts working across more than 70 offices. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Environment & Health, Water, Energy, and Planning & Urban Design.

Where People Flourish

Our mission is to create sustainable societies where people and nature flourish. This means that a culture of inclusion is embedded in everything we do.  Our people bring diverse backgrounds and experiences to the company, enabling us to deliver innovative and forward-thinking solutions to our clients. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, regardless of age, disability or medical condition, gender identity, marriage and domestic partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, ancestry, or national origin, religion or belief, sex and sexual orientation, military service and veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Ramboll wants to ensure opportunities are accessible to candidates with disabilities. So, please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

Ready to join us?

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

jobs.title: Director, HR Business Partner & Talent Management
jobs.description:
About Redwood Materials

Redwood Materials was founded in 2017 by JB Straubel, co-founder and former CTO of Tesla, on a simple but radical idea: the critical minerals powering the energy transition already exist. They just need to come back. Today Redwood is the largest lithium-ion battery recycler in North America — recovering, refining, and redeploying critical minerals from end-of-life batteries back into the supply chain. On the energy side, Redwood has deployed the largest second-life battery project in the world, delivering power to AI data centers in months rather than years using proprietary energy architecture engineered entirely in-house. The company is profitable, the market it operates in is projected to grow 20 to 50 times over the next decade, and Redwood is the only company with the supply chain, the technology, and the operational scale to lead it.

At Redwood, we are building the foundation for a more sustainable future. As we continue to scale, we are seeking a strategic, hands-on HR leader who thrives at the intersection of business strategy, organizational effectiveness, talent development, and operational execution.

Reporting to the Chief People Officer, this role serves as the primary HR Business Partner to our Chief Operating Officer and Chief Commercial Officer and their leadership teams. This leader will help shape the people, organization, and talent strategies that enable Redwood's manufacturing, operations, supply chain, commercial, and business development organizations to scale effectively.

The Director will oversee HR Business Partner support for our manufacturing operations, lead a small team of HR Business Partners, and partner closely with a peer Director HRBP supporting our technology and corporate functions. Together, these leaders will help build the talent infrastructure required for Redwood's next phase of growth.

Success in this role requires the ability to move seamlessly between frontline realities and enterprise strategy, influencing executive decisions while maintaining a deep understanding of employee and operational needs. We are looking for a builder who is energized by creating scalable programs, processes, and capabilities from the ground up while remaining willing to roll up their sleeves and drive execution.

What You'll Do

• Serve as the strategic People partner to the Chief Operating Officer, Chief Commercial Officer, and their leadership teams, helping shape organizational strategy, workforce planning, leadership effectiveness, and talent priorities.

• Partner directly with executives and senior leaders to align people strategies with business objectives and support organizational growth, performance, and workforce effectiveness.

• Act as a trusted advisor and coach, providing guidance on organizational design, leadership development, succession planning, change management, employee relations, and team effectiveness.

• Lead and develop a small team of HR Business Partners supporting our Nevada and South Carolina manufacturing facilities and partner closely with the HR leader supporting our Germany manufacturing operations. Together, ensure consistent people practices, talent strategies, and leadership support across Redwood's manufacturing footprint while balancing local business and regulatory needs.

• Build strong relationships across all levels of the organization, from executive leaders to frontline employees, ensuring people strategies remain grounded in operational realities.

• Partner with leaders to assess organizational capabilities, identify workforce risks and opportunities, and develop plans that support long-term business objectives.

• Leverage workforce data, talent insights, and business metrics to identify trends, challenge assumptions, and improve business outcomes.

• Partner closely with Recruiting, Total Rewards, HR Operations, and People Analytics to deliver integrated people solutions that enable business growth, attract and retain talent, and create a consistent employee experience.

• Influence hiring, workforce planning, organizational design, compensation, talent, employee experience, and workforce analytics strategies by effectively leveraging the expertise of Centers of Excellence across the People Team.

• Lead complex organizational and talent initiatives, balancing strategic thinking with practical execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Talent Management & Leadership Development

In partnership with a peer HRBP leader, this role will help design and build Redwood's talent management capability from the ground up.

• Design and implement leadership development programs that strengthen capabilities from frontline supervisors through executive leaders.

• Build career pathing and development frameworks for individual contributors across manufacturing, operations, commercial, technical, and corporate functions.

• Establish talent review processes that provide visibility into organizational capability, critical talent, and future leadership needs.

• Identify high-potential talent and develop succession plans for key leadership and technical positions across the company.

• Partner with executives and business leaders to assess organizational capability and build talent strategies that support Redwood's long-term growth.

• Develop scalable approaches to performance management, employee development, and leadership effectiveness.

• Assess current and future workforce capabilities and create strategies to address organizational and talent gaps.

• Create solutions that help employees grow their careers while ensuring Redwood has the talent required to achieve its long-term business goals.

What We're Looking For

• Proven success serving as a strategic advisor to senior executives in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.

• Strong business acumen and the ability to translate business strategy into talent and organizational solutions.

• Demonstrated experience building leadership development, succession planning, career development, and talent management programs.

• Experience partnering effectively across Recruiting, Total Rewards, HR Operations, People Analytics, and other People functions to deliver business outcomes and inform decision-making through data and insights.

• Experience supporting manufacturing, operations, industrial, energy, or similarly complex workforce environments.

• A hands-on leadership style with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and personally drive outcomes.

• Exceptional coaching, influencing, communication, and relationship-building skills across all levels of the organization.

• Equally comfortable in executive leadership meetings, manager coaching conversations, and on the manufacturing floor engaging with frontline employees.

The ideal candidate is a builder, strategist, and operator who can partner credibly with C-suite leaders, develop exceptional leaders and teams, and create the talent systems that will help Redwood scale for years to come.

The position is full-time. Compensation will be commensurate with experience.

We collect personal information (PI) from you in connection with your application for employment with Redwood Materials, including the following categories of PI: identifiers, personal records, professional or employment information, and inferences drawn from your PI. We collect your PI for our purposes, including performing services and operations related to your potential employment. If you have additional privacy-related questions, please contact us at privacy@redwoodmaterials.com.

jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description:
MEET METHOD

Method has built the most modern way to connect to consumer financial accounts. Combining real-time liability connectivity with instant payment execution, Method’s API is designed to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use.

We have helped 45+ million users connect 350+ million liability accounts credential-less and processed over $2.5B in payments, helping users save millions in interest. One in every three credit cards in the United States is in the Method ecosystem and leading financial institutions like SoFi, Bilt, Cleo, Sezzle, Figure & Aven rely on our APIs to build magical experiences for millions of consumers.

We’re a team of 50+ people spread across offices in Austin, SF, New York City, and Washington D.C! We’re excited to continue the momentum working alongside our investors and advisors from Andreessen Horowitz, Emergence Capital, Y Combinator, Avra, and Ardent. To learn more about us, check out our blog https://methodfi.com/resources/company-updates!


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring Method's first Design Engineer. This is someone who spends most of their time in the code, but with an elite eye and talent for product, visual, and motion design. You'll partner with our Head of Design to own the craft layer across all of Method's web properties: website, design system, demos, and product. You'll work as a duo to set the aesthetic direction, make the technical calls, and ship the work.

Method is a developer-first financial connectivity platform, and our visual identity should feel like it. We want our products to feel precise, technically credible, and genuinely interesting to look at.

We're rebuilding our entire visual and interactive layer at once: a token system covering color (built on perceptual color science), typography, and spacing, a design system from the ground up, a new marketing site, a dashboard with generative UI and charting, and the embedded experience our partners put in front of their own users. Because the embedded product runs inside our partners' apps, it needs to adapt to match their brand, automatically.

You'll work closely with engineers and our Head of Design to bring a level of frontend craft to Method that the current team can't fully own, and oversee a ton of green-space to up-level how customers and end-users interact with Method. Open source is part of this role. We want to build things worth sharing and give Method a point of view the design and creative-coding communities respect.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the visual and interactive quality of Method's design system including component states, motion, and consistency across surfaces.

 - Build shader-based experiences for the website using Three.js and WebGL: hero sections, ambient motion, branded interactive moments.

 - Redesign and elevate the dashboard beyond a reskin; considered transitions, polished data visualization, generative UI components driven by JSON.

 - Architect a component library that supports dynamic, on-the-fly UI construction (charts, layouts, elements assembled from structured data).

 - Make judgment calls on when to invest in bespoke work versus leveraging existing tooling, and communicate those tradeoffs clearly.

 - Reduce reliance on contractors for production design and front-end UI work.

 - Collaborate with engineers and Head of Design on design direction; eventually help scope and hire adjacent design talent as the team grows.


WHO YOU ARE

 - You have shipped interactive web work that required writing shaders; Three.js, WebGL, GLSL. Your portfolio shows it!

 - You understand the full stack from GPU rendering to React component architecture; you know why it matters that this runs in-browser and not as a video.

 - You have strong aesthetic opinions and the technical range to execute them without a dedicated designer handing you comps.

 - You've built production design systems and component libraries that others actually use.

 - You're an individual contributor by nature and default to building.

 - You've worked at or contributed to places with genuine design craft: design studios, developer tooling companies, creative agencies, or strong indie dev work.

 - You're comfortable being the only person in this specialty for a while; you don't need structure to make progress.

 - Depth and quality of your experience matter more than years. Apply even if you've never carried the Design Engineer title.


EXTRA AWESOME

 - Background in creative coding, gaming, or CGI; you understand shaders from multiple angles.

 - Open source contributions to Three.js, shader communities, or creative coding libraries.

 - Experience with motion design tooling (Rive, Framer, Lottie) and opinions on when to use it versus roll your own.

 - Experience at companies or studios known for frontend craft

 - Familiarity with generative UI patterns and JSON-driven component rendering.

--

The annual US base salary range for this role is: $150,000-$200,000.



BENEFITS AVAILABLE TO FULL TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Medical, Dental, Vision; basic medical plans 100% covered

 - Flexible PTO

 - $30/day Lunch allowance when working from the office

 - 12 weeks parental leave

 - Commuter benefits; employer-sponsored

 - Phone/internet stipend 

 - WFH stipend 

 - Student loan repayment contribution 

 - Lifestyle Spending stipend 

 - Learning & Development stipend 

 - Hybrid-office stocked with snacks

 - Quarterly team off-sites




IN-OFFICE POLICY 

For most roles are Method, we expect a regular in-person presence at one of our hubs in NYC, Austin, SF or DC. We have embedded flexibility to work remotely for a week here and there, but the general expectation is a minimum 2-3 days/week in office on average. What does not work is full-time remote. 




ACCOMMODATIONS

Method provides reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance with your application due to a disability, please contact us at talent@methodfi.com to request an accommodation.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description:

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: CMC Asset Lead (Director level, consulting)
jobs.description:
About Us

Shennon Biotechnologies is developing precision immunotherapies for solid tumors through an integrated technology platform spanning target discovery, ultra-high-throughput microfluidics-driven functional screening, computational therapeutic design and safety prediction. Where conventional discovery tests binders sequentially over months, Shennon's TCELERATOR platform profiles more than 10 million single-cell interactions at once, identifying functional leads in a single experiment. This unified engine is supported by proprietary human tumor datasets and an expanding network of academic and clinical collaborators. The Company is developing both antibody-based and TCR-based T-cell engagers designed to address surface and intracellular cancer targets. Its initial oncology pipeline includes programs in small cell lung cancer, ovarian cancer and hepatocellular carcinoma. ShennonBio is based in San Francisco.

The Role

Our lead program is a trispecific TCE with dual tumor antigen targeting for small cell lung cancer. We are looking for someone to own CMC for it end to end, from the handoff out of discovery through to IND.

This is a director-level role: hands-on and accountable for the work, not an executive building a function. The role reports on an interim basis to the Head of Research, pending the hire of the Chief Scientific Officer.

Responsibilities

• Build one integrated CMC plan from development candidate nomination to first in human, and own the timeline inside it.

• Run the CDMO selection as a competitive RFP rather than a negotiation with 1 vendor. The current field spans US, European and Chinese CDMOs, and the same package has to go to all of them so the quotes can be read against each other on a normalized basis.

• Negotiate and manage the selected CDMO: cell line development, process development, analytical development, technology transfer, GMP drug substance and drug product, and stability.

• Own quality for outsourced manufacture. We own no plant, so the quality agreement with the CDMO, batch record and deviation review, OOS handling, specifications, and the release and disposition decision on GMP material all sit with this role.

• Own the CMC budget and forecast. The CDMO quotes in hand run into the high single digit millions, a significant share payable at order initiation, and vendors price schedule acceleration at a premium of roughly 20 percent. This role decides which of those line items are real and holds the forecast against the cash plan.

• Own the analytical and release strategy, including the cell-based potency assay, which in our experience FDA asks for on a bispecific IND whether or not the CDMO quoted it.

• Secure GLP tox material, which sits outside the current CDMO quotes, and own clinical supply downstream: labeling, packaging, comparator sourcing and shipment to trial sites.

• Author and QC Module 3, build the CMC content of the pre-IND briefing package, and take part in the agency meetings that follow.

• Flag the format-driven CMC risks early. The molecule is a multispecific, so correct chain pairing, product-related species and the purification strategy are live questions that should shape format selection rather than be discovered after it.

Qualifications and Experience

• A PhD in a relevant discipline, or a BS or MS with at least 12 years in biologics CMC.

• At least 1 biologic taken from development candidate to IND with the CMC package filed, ideally a bispecific or multispecific rather than a monoclonal.

• Direct experience selecting and managing CDMOs, including writing the RFP and reading the quotes critically.

• Quality fluency sufficient to negotiate a quality agreement and to make a release decision on outsourced GMP material.

• Module 3 authoring or QC, and enough regulatory fluency to defend the CMC section in an agency meeting.

• Comfort working with CDMOs in China alongside US and European options, and a clear view on the trade-offs.

• Judgment on when to push a timeline and when to refuse one. We have been quoted anywhere from 6 to 13 months to a first GMP batch and we need someone who can tell which numbers are real.

What this role is not

A VP or head of function, a people manager, or a full-time hire on day 1. Depth on the work matters more than the title.

Company Culture

Collaboration, ownership and authenticity.

Terms

Consulting agreement to start, with a monthly hours cap, since there is 1 program today. Remote is fine and we have no geographic preference at this stage. As further programs reach the same point, the role is intended to convert to a full-time permanent position, which at that point would be co-located in San Francisco.

jobs.title: Senior CNC Programmer
jobs.description:
Advanced Reentry Technologies

Who We Are:

Inversion is an aerospace and defense company pioneering advanced reentry technology to enable next-generation capabilities from space. By combining high-performance materials, precision aerodynamics, and mission-driven autonomy, Inversion is transforming reentry into an operational capability for an entirely new class of missions.

The company’s highly maneuverable reentry spacecraft, Arc, is designed for rapid global cargo delivery, hypersonic testing, and other national security missions that require precise, controlled flight through the atmosphere. Arc creates an entirely new transportation domain, unlocking unprecedented speed and global reach.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, Inversion designs, manufactures, and integrates its spacecraft under one roof, enabling the company to move rapidly from concept to flight. The company is backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Spark Capital, and Lockheed Martin Ventures, with customers across the U.S. government and commercial space industry.

Position Overview:

We are seeking a Senior CNC Programmer to support the development and production of precision aerospace components. This role focuses on hands-on CNC programming, machining optimization, and close collaboration with engineering and quality teams in a fast-paced startup environment.

You will play a key role in turning complex designs into reliable, repeatable manufacturing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• CNC Programming & Machining.

• Program 3-, 4-, and 5-axis CNC mills and/or CNC lathes for aerospace components.

• Develop and optimize CNC programs for tight-tolerance, high-complexity parts.

• Select tooling, fixtures, and machining strategies to meet quality and cycle-time goals.

• Work closely with design and manufacturing engineers on DFM feedback.

• Interpret complex engineering drawings, CAD models, and GD&T.

• Support rapid prototyping and frequent design iterations.

• Assist with transitioning parts from prototype to production.

• Follow aerospace quality standards and internal manufacturing procedures.

• Support inspections, FAIs, and resolution of non-conformances.

• Maintain accurate documentation of programs and setup sheets.

• Contribute to process improvements that increase efficiency and repeatability.

Required Qualifications:

• Typically 5+ years of CNC programming experience in aerospace or high-precision manufacturing.

• Experience programming multi-axis CNC machines 5-axis.

• Experience with lathe programming.

• Proficiency with Mastercam CAM software.

• Strong understanding of GD&T and tight-tolerance machining.

• Experience machining aluminum alloys, titanium, and/or nickel-based superalloys.

• Ability to support machine setup and on-the-floor troubleshooting.

Our office headquarters is located in Playa Vista, CA. This position requires in office presence.

The California hourly rate for this role is currently $40.00 - $60.00.  Pay Grades are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data.  Individual pay will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: interviews and an assessment of several factors that are unique to each candidate, job-related skills, relevant education and experience, certifications, abilities of the candidate and internal equity.

ITAR Compliance:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Inversion provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

Inversion collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws.  If you are a US Job Applicant see the CCPA Privacy Policy Notice for further details.

jobs.title: Principal Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Building Healthcare That Remembers 

Every time you call a doctor's office, the system forgets you the moment you hang up. You wait on hold, explain everything from scratch, get bounced between lines, and hope someone follows up. Everyone has felt this. No one should have to. 

At Assort Health, we're building one continuous conversation for every patient. An AI agent that knows who you are, remembers how you like to be reached, and carries that context from your first symptom to your full recovery. What began as the first voice AI agent to schedule a specialty appointment has become the largest proprietary specialty dataset in healthcare: 285 million patient interactions, 62,000 care protocols, 1.6 million decision pathways. 

We went from 15 people in 2025 and will cross 250 by the end of 2026. Revenue is up 20x in 15 months and we've raised $222 million, including a recent $120 million Series C https://www.assorthealth.com/blog/assort-health-raises-120-million-series-c-to-scale-largest-deployment-of-ai-agents-for-the-patient-journey at a $1.2 billion valuation. We've also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and the 2026 Enterprise Tech 30 as the only healthcare AI company on the list!

Healthcare spends $1.1 trillion a year on administration instead of care. If you want to help change that, apply below.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a B2B product marketer who can turn complex technology into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with buyers and users across provider groups and health systems. As Principal, Product Marketing, you'll take ownership of go-to-market strategy for one of Assort's major market segments, Health Systems — not just defining positioning and messaging, but owning the segment's overall growth and performance. Reporting to the Head of Product Marketing, you'll partner closely with the GTM team — Sales, Demand Generation, and Customer Success — and act directly on the levers that accelerate pipeline, win rate, and revenue in your segment. You'll join with significant ownership and autonomy at a pivotal moment in our growth, you'll have the opportunity to shape its direction. This role is ideal for someone who thinks like a business owner, combines strategic rigor with hands-on execution, moves fast, and wants their work to have an outsized impact.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own go-to-market strategy and performance for Health System, a major market segment —from positioning and messaging through pipeline, win rate, and revenue growth—serving as the single point of accountability for the segment's success.

 - Partner closely with Sales, Demand Generation, and Customer Success on segment GTM execution, identifying and acting directly on the highest-leverage opportunities to accelerate growth.

 - Lead integrated product launches for your segment by defining strategy, success metrics, and required assets in partnership with Product, Demand Generation, and Sales.

 - Own customer proof strategy—including case studies, video spotlights, and ROI narratives—in partnership with Content Marketing to shorten sales cycles within your segment.

 - Define and maintain the sales enablement strategy (pitch narrative, battlecards, product collateral, objection handling) for your segment, ensuring consistency and adoption across the revenue team.

 - Partner with Product and Revenue leadership on pricing, packaging, and monetization strategy to accelerate segment ARR growth.

 - Act as the market and competitive authority for your segment, translating industry trends, regulatory changes, and competitor activity into clear points of view and GTM recommendations.

 - Represent your segment's voice in company-wide strategic planning, pulling in market and performance data to influence roadmap and resourcing decisions.
   
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 7–10+ years of B2B SaaS, sales-led growth product marketing experience, with a track record of owning go-to-market strategy and being held accountable for revenue or growth outcomes for a product line, segment, or business unit—not just marketing outputs.

 - Proven ability to execute in early-stage or fast-moving environments, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Product, Sales, and Marketing.

 - Exceptional storytelling and executive-level communication skills—written, verbal, and visual.

 - Strong technical fluency, with the ability to translate product complexity into clear customer value and confidently engage with technical and revenue audiences.

 - Working knowledge of marketing and analytics platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Marketo, GA, Looker) and basic design tools (e.g., Slides, Figma).
   
    


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience in provider and health system organizations, EHR ecosystems, regulated markets, or applied AI platforms.




BENEFITS & PERKS FOR ASSORTIES

 - 💸 Competitive Compensation – Including salary and employee stock options so you share in our success.

 - 📚 Lifelong Learning – Annual budget for professional development, plus training opportunities to help you grow.

 - 💻 Office Setup Stipend – We’ll outfit your in-office workspace so comfy as it's productive.

 - 🩺 Top-Tier Health Coverage – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, because your health comes first.

 - 🏖 Flexible PTO – We trust you to take the time you need to recharge and come back ready to crush it.

 - 🚆 Commuter Benefits – We cover eligible transportation costs to make your trip to work easier.

 - 👵 401(k) – Build your retirement savings.
   
   


HOW WE WORK & WHAT WE VALUE

Our team at Assort Health moves fast, stays focused, and is fueled by a desire to serve our customers and patients. Our company values guide how we work—they are present in how we show up, make decisions and work together to move our mission forward. We bring a Day One Drive, relentlessly striving to improve, keep a 5-Star Focus, as our customers are our lifeblood, always Answer the Call, remembering that ownership and accountability are paramount, and show up with One Pulse, because we are one team, with one rhythm and one result. Our team is growing and we are looking for motivated, hardworking, and passionate talent. If you want to make healthcare accessible for everyone, we’d love to hear from you!
