jobs.title: Product Manager, Onboarding and Growth
jobs.description:
Hi, I’m Geo, Ashby’s VP of Product. I joined Ashby August ‘26; read more about why I joined here. https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/all/a-letter-from-chris-geoghegan-on-joining-ashby I’m looking for a growth-oriented product manager to help users onboard and expand their usage of the product.

At Ashby, we have a unique approach to building products https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/ashbys-operating-principles (more on that below). As a PM, your primary goal is to eliminate frustration and bring delight to our customers. You’ll work with engineers who deeply understand the customer and business problem and own the solution end-to-end. This means that you spend less time writing detailed specs and more time with customers and doing deep product thinking.

Our unique approach is working. We’re growing >100% year over year and have notable customers such as Notion, Linear, OpenAI, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best in class among our peers. We’re backed by amazing investors like Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Lachy Groom, and many more!




THE CHALLENGE

The surface area of our flagship ATS product is growing, and we are launching new products. This means customers are less likely to organically adopt the things that create value for them.

Historically, onboarding has been human-driven by our amazing Customer Success team https://www.ashbyhq.com/blog/culture/customer-success. And now, we’re ready to productize our learnings. As Ashby grows, we need a single owner who can think deeply about the customer journey and design the product and email experiences that help users achieve their desired outcomes and get the most out of Ashby.

This isn’t just about onboarding individuals. It requires thinking about how to onboard organizations with different roles and stakeholders with different goals. It’s going to be a fun challenge.




WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON

 - Customer Journey: This role isn’t focused on conversion rate optimization or running A/B tests. Instead, you’ll gain a deep understanding of the entire Customer Journey. Then you’ll design a thoughtful onboarding experience for each role, prioritizing how we can use the product and email to help users at different stages.

 - Product Led Growth: You’ll spearhead our product-led growth motion by working closely with our Customer Success team. They own our human-led onboarding and, in many respects, have designed the first version of this. You’ll also own transactional email (i.e. email triggered by product signals) as it is an extension of the product experience.

 - Adoption Metrics: This is our first-ever product team focused on growth and onboarding, so you’ll be responsible for defining and tracking key metrics to assess whether our onboarding experience helps customers realize value sooner. We have a small but mighty data team that you’ll partner with, but for the most part, you’ll be responsible for defining and analyzing these growth metrics yourself.

 - Product Qualified Leads: You’ll also work closely with our Revenue Operations team to figure out the bridge between product signals that initiate go-to-market activity. You’ll own the definition of a Product Qualified Lead (PQL) and work with the RevOps team to determine how to route them.

 - User Experience: Finally, you’ll own changes to features to make onboarding easier and drive adoption. If you think changing how a given feature works is critical to making onboarding easier, it isn’t off limits. Eventually, we’ll want you to create frameworks and consult with other product teams to help them drive adoption for their product areas.




YOU COULD BE A GREAT FIT IF

 - You’ve owned onboarding, expansion, or growth for a B2B SaaS product

 - You have strong product taste, and you think of growth as more art than science

 - You’ve built a growth strategy rooted in principled thinking, research, and data

 - You can show evidence of driving long-term growth results

 - You have an unnatural curiosity and excitement about the end-user and the jobs they do

 - Your written communication skills are excellent

 - You’ve developed product metrics deeply connected to customer value

 - You can point to exceptional relationships with customer success teams

 - You know how to coach and motivate high-agency engineers and drive urgency




WE WORK DIFFERENTLY

At Ashby, the role of Product Managers is different from what I’ve seen in most product orgs. At a high level, PMs are responsible for shipping impactful product changes at high velocity, consistently and over an extended period. When we think about impactful product changes, our primary goal is to remove frustration and add delight.

At many organizations, PMs are required to write detailed specs that handle every edge case. Designers are required to mock up every pixel. At Ashby, it’s different. We believe individual contributors do their best work when they have a deep understanding of the end user and the business, and ownership of the solution. This is reflected in the engineers Ashby hires: they own projects end-to-end and deeply understand the problems they are solving. PMs are expected to give significant white space in their specs. As a result, PMs can spend less time managing tickets and more time with customers and thinking deeply about the product strategy.

At Ashby, PMs need to be the pace-setters for their product areas. This means they bring a healthy level of impatience and time-paranoia to the table. This does not mean cutting corners or demanding that engineers work unreasonable hours. As a PM, you can help engineers by managing the project scope well, identifying when it’s appropriate to bring in help, or being ruthless about prioritization.

In particular for this role, we think it’s unlikely you’ll be able to A/B test your way to the right solution. We think it’s more likely to build great onboarding through deep thinking. A big part of that is research; you should expect to spend a significant amount of your time researching and understanding customer problems, and then a significant amount of time writing down your thinking.

Finally, Ashby isn’t simply an ATS. Right from the foundations, it was designed to be much more than that. It’s a platform modelled around how organizations (from early-stage startups to massive enterprises) think about recruiting, managing, and retaining top talent. As a PM at Ashby, you should, over time, get familiar with our most common building blocks. You’ll invest not only in product improvements but in platform thinking.




INTERVIEW PROCESS

If this also sounds exciting to you, please apply. We review every application and aim to get back to candidates within 2-3 days. For candidates that advance to the interview process here is what you can expect:

 1. Intro Call with Geo (VP, Product) - 30 mins

 2. Product Experience Deep Dive - 45 mins

 3. Assignment
    
    1. Prepare written assignment (expect to set aside ~2 hours)
    
    2. Present assignment - 60 mins

 4. Final Round Interview - 2 hours
    Mostly focused on cross-functional Interviews to meet more of the team. This is a critical hire for us and a role that will touch a lot of functions - we want to make sure you'll meet folks you'll be working closely with




BENEFITS

 - 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.

 - Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year.

 - Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.

 - Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

 - $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

 - $250/month tool budget plus access to Claude, Cursor, and Codex with generous token budgets.

 - If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with 100% of premiums covered by Ashby. In other countries, we provide high-quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

To request reasonable accommodations, please contact hiring@ashbyhq.com.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Building Healthcare That Remembers 

Every time you call a doctor's office, the system forgets you the moment you hang up. You wait on hold, explain everything from scratch, get bounced between lines, and hope someone follows up. Everyone has felt this. No one should have to. 

At Assort Health, we're building one continuous conversation for every patient. An AI agent that knows who you are, remembers how you like to be reached, and carries that context from your first symptom to your full recovery. What began as the first voice AI agent to schedule a specialty appointment has become the largest proprietary specialty dataset in healthcare: 285 million patient interactions, 62,000 care protocols, 1.6 million decision pathways. 

We went from 15 people in 2025 and will cross 250 by the end of 2026. Revenue is up 20x in 15 months and we've raised $222 million, including a recent $120 million Series C https://www.assorthealth.com/blog/assort-health-raises-120-million-series-c-to-scale-largest-deployment-of-ai-agents-for-the-patient-journey at a $1.2 billion valuation. We've also been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 and the 2026 Enterprise Tech 30 as the only healthcare AI company on the list!

Healthcare spends $1.1 trillion a year on administration instead of care. If you want to help change that, apply below.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a B2B product marketer who can turn complex technology into clear, compelling narratives that resonate with buyers and users across provider groups and health systems. As Senior Manager, Product Marketing, you'll own positioning, messaging, and go-to-market (GTM) strategy across the portfolio, with particular focus on building out Assort's market and competitive intelligence function — from competitor tracking and win/loss analysis to the industry analyst relationships that shape how the market sees us. Reporting to the Head of Product Marketing, you'll serve as a strategic partner to Demand Generation, Sales, and Product — shaping how we tell our story, launch products, and win in the market. You'll join with significant ownership and autonomy, and as we build out the product marketing function around you, you'll have the opportunity to grow alongside it. This role is ideal for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, moves fast, and wants their work to have an outsized impact.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own Assort's competitive intelligence function end-to-end—competitor tracking, win/loss analysis, and real-time battlecards—translating industry trends, regulatory changes, and competitor activity into clear points of view and GTM recommendations.

 - Build and manage relationships with leading healthcare industry analysts (e.g., KLAS, Gartner), owning our participation in rankings, reports, and briefings that shape how the market perceives Assort.

 - Own and socialize a unified messaging and positioning framework that resonates with COOs, practice managers, and clinicians, and is used consistently across all GTM motions.

 - Lead integrated product launches by defining strategy, success metrics, and required assets in partnership with Product, Demand Generation, and Sales to drive 30%+ of net-new pipeline.

 - Define and maintain the sales enablement strategy (pitch narrative, battlecards, product collateral, objection handling), ensuring consistency and adoption across the revenue team.

 - Partner with Product and Revenue leadership on pricing, packaging, and monetization strategy to accelerate ARR growth.

 - Help establish the processes and operating rhythms that will serve as the foundation for a growing product marketing team.
   


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5–8+ years of B2B SaaS, sales-led growth product marketing experience, including ownership of positioning and GTM strategy for complex products sold to non-technical buyers.

 - Proven ability to execute in early-stage or fast-moving environments, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Product, Sales, and Marketing.

 - Exceptional storytelling and executive-level communication skills—written, verbal, and visual.

 - Strong technical fluency, with the ability to translate product complexity into clear customer value and confidently engage with technical and revenue audiences.

 - Working knowledge of marketing and analytics platforms (e.g., HubSpot, Marketo, GA, Looker) and basic design tools (e.g., Slides, Figma).

 - Experience building or scaling a competitive intelligence program and/or managing relationships with industry analysts (e.g., KLAS, Gartner) strongly preferred.
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in provider organizations, EHR ecosystems, regulated markets, or applied AI platforms.




BENEFITS & PERKS FOR ASSORTIES

 - 💸 Competitive Compensation – Including salary and employee stock options so you share in our success.

 - 📚 Lifelong Learning – Annual budget for professional development, plus training opportunities to help you grow.

 - 💻 Office Setup Stipend – We’ll outfit your in-office workspace so comfy as it's productive.

 - 🩺 Top-Tier Health Coverage – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, because your health comes first.

 - 🏖 Flexible PTO – We trust you to take the time you need to recharge and come back ready to crush it.

 - 🥗 Meals & Snacks – Lunch, dinner, and snack breaks that fuel great ideas.

 - 💪 Fitness Stipend – Your wellness matters. We reimburse monthly membership costs to support your health.

 - 🚆 Commuter Benefits – We cover eligible transportation costs to make your trip to work easier.

 - 👵 401(k) – Build your retirement savings.
   
   


HOW WE WORK & WHAT WE VALUE

Our team at Assort Health moves fast, stays focused, and is fueled by a desire to serve our customers and patients. Our company values guide how we work—they are present in how we show up, make decisions and work together to move our mission forward. We bring a Day One Drive, relentlessly striving to improve, keep a 5-Star Focus, as our customers are our lifeblood, always Answer the Call, remembering that ownership and accountability are paramount, and show up with One Pulse, because we are one team, with one rhythm and one result. Our team is growing and we are looking for motivated, hardworking, and passionate talent. If you want to make healthcare accessible for everyone, we’d love to hear from you!

Please note: the Assort Health Talent Team will only email you from an assorthealth.com http://assorthealth.com email address.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Quality Engineering – Performance, Scalability & Reliability
jobs.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Senior Director, Quality Engineering – Performance, Scalability & Reliability

Location: San Francisco, CA | San Jose, CA

Team: Product & Engineering

Type: Full-Time

About Okta

Okta is the World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable companies to protect the identities of their applicants, employees, and customers, while providing seamless access from any device, anywhere.

Thousands of customers, including Adobe, JetBlue, and Farmers Insurance, trust Okta to help them work faster, boost efficiency, and stay secure. Okta’s top priority is to provide a reliable, scalable, and secure platform. We are building a world where anyone can safely use any technology, and we need exceptional leaders to help us achieve this vision.

Position Overview

As the Senior Director of Performance, Scalability, and Reliability Engineering, you will be responsible for leading the global strategy, architecture, and execution of end-to-end performance testing, capacity planning, and system reliability across all Okta product lines.

In this high-impact executive role, you will lead a team of high-performing engineers and managers dedicated to ensuring the Okta Identity Cloud operates at peak efficiency, extreme throughput, and five-nines (99.999%) availability. You will partner closely with Core Engineering, Product Management, Infrastructure, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) to drive proactive performance testing, push the limits of system scalability, and build guardrails that keep Okta resilient against massive enterprise loads. You will lead a team to conduct Integration testing and Perf testing across Okta Products and Platforms for Auth0 and Okta Workforce Identity suite of Products.

You will also lead scalability and reliability testing for Okta’s agentic AI products to ensure we can scale at Enterprise grade performance and deliver the same reliability as we do for SSO for global customers

What You’ll Do

Executive Leadership & Strategy: Define and execute the long-term technology roadmap for Integration testing, performance engineering, stress testing, scalability modeling, and reliability validation across Okta’s Workforce Identity Cloud and Customer Identity Cloud (Auth0).

Massive-Scale Performance & Chaos Testing: Oversee the development and maintenance of enterprise-scale load, stress, endurance, and chaos testing frameworks capable of simulating millions of peak concurrent authentications and API requests.

Architecture & Scalability Guidance: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior engineering leaders and principal architects, evaluating system designs, microservices, database topologies, and cloud infrastructure for performance bottlenecks and failure modes.

Proactive Reliability & Guardrails: Shift performance and reliability testing left into the CI/CD pipeline, establishing performance budgets, regression alerts, and automated baseline validation for every release. Use AI to improve test coverage, simulate real-world use cases and elevate the quality of Testing process and tools with in Okta

Capacity Planning & Cost Efficiency: Drive predictive capacity planning models that align infrastructure provisioning and cloud spend with customer growth, traffic spikes, and high-volume identity events (e.g., Cyber Monday, election cycles, mega-enterprise rollouts).

Incident Post-Mortems & Resilience: Partner with SRE and Incident Management to analyze critical system outages and performance degradations, driving root-cause analysis (RCA) and translating lessons learned into automated performance test suites. Use AI to conduct analysis and identify problems and set up improved methods for Rate limiting Okta APIs and supporting Customer events such as Conferences etc.

Team Building & Talent Mentorship: Lead, grow, and empower a world-class organization of performance engineers, tool developers, and engineering managers. Foster an inclusive, high-performance engineering culture.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

15+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering, Quality Engineering, or Infrastructure, with 8+ years in direct engineering management/leadership roles.

Track record leading high-performing performance engineering, scalability, or SRE organizations at a multi-tenant, hyper-scale SaaS or Cloud infrastructure company.

Deep technical expertise in cloud architectures (AWS, GCP), distributed systems, microservices, containerization (Kubernetes, Docker), and databases (SQL, NoSQL, Caching architectures).

Hands-on proficiency with performance testing tools and frameworks (e.g., JMeter, Locust, k6, Gatling, Distributed Load Generation) and APM/Observability stacks (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, New Relic).

Strong domain understanding of API performance, rate limiting, token validation, network protocols (HTTP/2, gRPC, TLS), and identity protocols (SAML, OAuth2, OIDC).

Proven track record of managing multi-million dollar cloud infrastructure efficiency initiatives and capacity planning models.

Exceptional communication, negotiation, and cross-functional executive alignment skills.

Preferred Qualifications:

Prior experience in the Identity and Access Management (IAM), Cyber Security, or mission-critical enterprise SaaS domain.

Experience integrating Chaos Engineering practices (e.g., Gremlin, Chaos Mesh) into production and staging pipelines.

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

jobs.title: Security Analyst Internship
jobs.description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is transforming workforce development with an AI-powered marketplace of skill-building courses and learning pathways. We help organizations build skills and stay compliant through a high-quality content catalog, seamless LMS/LXP integrations, and advanced capabilities like skills-based curation and multilingual content creation. More than 2,000 companies, including 150+ of the Global 2000, rely on OpenSesame to develop the world's most productive and admired workforces.
Learn more: www.opensesame.com/about

Internship Overview

OpenSesame seeks passionate, driven students to join us for a paid summer internship program. Suppose you’re intelligent, curious, and full of fresh ideas. In that case, this is your chance to collaborate with an exceptional team and gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment.

As a Security Analyst Intern, you’ll work on real-world compliance and security challenges, contribute to impactful solutions, and collaborate with teams across OpenSesame to strengthen our security and compliance posture.

About the Security and Compliance Team

At OpenSesame, our Security and Compliance Team ensures our company meets the highest industry standards and regulatory requirements. We focus on compliance with ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, ISO 42001 and other security frameworks, vendor risk assessments, incident response, and policy enforcement.

Our team partners across departments to mitigate risks, respond to security threats, and maintain a strong security culture. Through continuous learning and innovation, we protect the organization and help drive secure business growth.

Performance Objectives

2 Weeks

• Gain hands-on experience with GRC compliance tools such as Drata and security tools such as Crowdstrike.

• Learn how to leverage Claude and AI features for creating vulnerability dashboards and reports.

• Shadow team members to understand security and compliance workflows.

• Become familiar with JIRA, Confluence, and other project management tools for tracking compliance-related tasks and projects.

30 Days

• Assist in collecting and reviewing technical security evidence for audits and tracking.

• Support security initiatives, including phishing simulations, email security, and pen-testing programs.

• Learn compliance features of our SAST tooling for tracking and reporting vulnerabilities.

• Propose and develop workflow automations to streamline GRC and security operations.

60 Days

• Take ownership of assigned security projects, contributing independently to deliverables.

• Become comfortable owning several audit evidence collection tasks in Drata.

• Assist in analyzing vulnerability findings and tracking remediation efforts.

• Gain hands-on familiarity with AWS cloud security operations and vulnerability assessments.

Additional Program Details

• Friday, October 23, 2026

Program Dates:

• Full-time (32 to 40 hours/week) for 20 weeks

• Must commit to working regular office hours in the US continental time zones (e.g. from 9 AM EST to 5 PM EST or 9 AM PST to 5 PM PST within Monday to Friday period

Compensation:

• Standard: $18/hour

Fully Remote Role: Interns must have access to a reliable, high-speed internet connection during working hours. OpenSesame will provide a company laptop for use throughout the internship, which must be returned at the conclusion of the internship.

Ready to make an impact? Apply now and bring your creativity, energy, and problem-solving skills to OpenSesame. We’re excited to see what you’ll bring to the table!

We use AI. For real. Every team at OpenSesame works with AI tools daily, not as a buzzword, but as practice. You'll build fluency that most companies are still talking about adopting, with hands-on training and clear guardrails to experiment responsibly. AI amplifies your creativity and judgment. It doesn't replace them. The skills you build here travel with you.

Location: This position can be based anywhere in the U.S.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. CPRA (California Candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. jobs.title: Technical Enablement Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Socket helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just check out their tweets https://socket.dev/love to see for yourself!)


Founded by Feross Aboukhadijeh https://www.linkedin.com/in/feross/, a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised $ https://socket.dev/blog/series-b125M in funding https://socket.dev/blog/series-c from top angels, operators, and security leaders.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Socket is looking for a Technical Enablement Lead to own technical readiness across Customer Engineering: Sales Engineers, Technical Account Managers, Customer Success Managers and Support. You'll start with Sales Engineering, where the need is biggest right now.

You'll be the technical voice of enablement. SEs trust you to know the product well and to find the answer fast when you don't. You'll report to our Head of Enablement, who owns learning design and delivery, and together you'll build the engine that gets new hires ready and keeps everyone current. You'll work closely every day with the Head of Sales Engineering, the SE managers and the other Customer Engineering leaders.

We're hiring fast and shipping product fast. Your job is to turn field gaps into training that scales, starting with getting SEs demo and POC ready, and to keep the team current as new features ship. You'll need to learn the product fast, build fast, and use AI tools to scale yourself so one person can support a team that keeps growing. You'll spend real time in demos, POC reviews and call recordings, and that's where most of your roadmap comes from. You won't start from zero. There's an existing SE onboarding program, an LMS, hands-on labs and a weekly SE training series to build on.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Onboarding & Certification:

 - Own technical onboarding for new Sales Engineers so they're ready to demo and run POCs as quickly as possible, then build the same for TAMs, CSMs and Support

 - Build hands-on labs and certification paths, and certify people before they're in front of customers on their own

 - Work with SE leadership on the demo standard every SE is held to, and train and certify against it

 - Agree with Customer Engineering leaders what "ready" means for each role, and track ramp against it



Knowledge & Content:

 - Own the Customer Engineering technical knowledge base: audit what exists, retire what's outdated, and keep what stays accurate and self-serve

 - Build deployment and troubleshooting guides for the hardest setups, starting with Socket Firewall in enterprise networks (proxies, ZTNA, private registries like Artifactory and Nexus)

 - Own technical competitive material for the tools SEs run into most



Stay Close to the Field:

 - Listen to calls and sit in on POC reviews and escalations to find where people get stuck, and fix it with training

 - Bring patterns back to Engineering: missing docs, confusing UX, and the questions that keep pulling engineers into deals



Launch Readiness:

 - Work with the engineers shipping each feature so the field is trained before customers see it

 - Turn each release into field-ready material: a short lab or demo, a talk track, deployment steps and known limitations

 - Run a regular technical session for SEs and Customer Engineering




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

Required:

 - 6+ years in a technical customer-facing or technical enablement role (Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Solutions Architect, TAM, Support Engineer, Technical Enablement, or similar)

 - You've run demos, POCs, deployments or escalations yourself, not just trained people on them, and you can explain the product to an SE, an AE and an engineer at the right level for each

 - You've built training other people use without you (labs, demos, certifications, videos, playbooks) and can tell us how you knew it worked

 - You use AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, or similar) to build and maintain content, and can show how that lets you support a much bigger team than you could alone

 - Working knowledge of how developers build and ship software: package managers like npm or PyPI, CI/CD, and source control (Git, GitHub, GitLab)



Preferred:

 - Background in application security, SCA, supply chain security or developer tooling

 - You've kept a field team current on a fast release cadence, weekly or every couple of weeks

 - Can read/write basic scripts in Python, JS, or Go, enough to build and maintain labs

 - Experience with enterprise networking and proxies (ZTNA, secure web gateways, private package registries)



Our Interview Process

 1. Informational with a member from our Talent Team

 2. Virtual f2f with the Hiring Manager

 3. Virtual f2f with a few members of the team

 4. Presentation

 5. Final Interview 

Hiring is a big decision on both sides. Read more about our Hiring Philosophy  https://socket.dev/hiring-philosophyand how we approach the process at Socket.



Benefits: Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer:

 - Market competitive salary bands

 - Meaningful equity program

 - Comprehensive health benefits for you and your family (99% coverage)

 - Flexible time-off, holidays, and winter shutdown to rest & recharge

 - Paid parental leave

 - Remote-first, with quarterly team off-sites 



At Socket, we

 1. Pursue Excellence: We set ourselves apart by consistently delivering work of exceptional quality and distinction.

 2. Move with urgency and focus: We prioritize swift, decisive action.

 3. Think rigorously: We care about being right and it often takes reasoning from first principles to get there. We value alternative perspectives and have constructive discussions.

 4. Trust and amplify: We overtrust, always assume good intent, and give specific feedback to help each other improve.

 5. Feel a strong sense of ownership: We wear many hats and feel a strong sense of overall ownership of the company and we're non-territorial regarding our nominal domains.

 6. Are customer obsessed: We relentlessly prioritize the needs of our customers, striving to exceed their expectations and delight them at every interaction.

jobs.title: Medical Science Liaison - Rare Disease
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL), Rare Disease is a field-based scientific expert and a key scientific resource for clinicians, academic institutions, and professional organizations in the Rare Disease community. This individual builds relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), leads scientific exchange on Natera's Rare Disease test, and brings field insights back to Rare Disease leadership. The MSL works closely with the Rare Disease Sales, Marketing, and Medical teams to help bring the test to more patients. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy and reports to the Director of MSLs, Rare Disease.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Provide scientific and clinical presentations on Natera products, with a focus on Rare Disease, and respond to customer requests for information about marketed and developing products.

• Develop, maintain, and manage relationships with KOLs from the Rare Disease community and other relevant healthcare professionals.

• Capture field insights on clinical practice, unmet needs, and market dynamics, and share them with Rare Disease leadership.

• Serve as a medical and scientific resource for the Natera Sales and Marketing teams, and collaborate with Marketing to develop educational materials for healthcare providers and patients.

• Participate in clinical research, data analysis, and scientific writing.

• Work with PHI in paper and electronic form. Complete HIPAA/PHI privacy, general policy and procedure compliance, and security training within the first 30 days of hire, and keep Natera training requirements current.

jobs.title: Revenue Accounting Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.




ABOUT YOU

Our revenue is credit-denominated and consumption-based — usage billing, prepaid credit drawdown, and concurrency pricing across a growing enterprise base — which is close to the most complex revenue profile in infrastructure software. The load-bearing questions are open and there are few set policies and processes.

You will be the technical authority on revenue. You will own the entire Order to Cash cycle, from interfacing with our sales team, reviewing contracts, assessing terms in accordance with ASC 606, implementing workpapers and schedules, documenting conclusions, and assisting with billing and collection efforts. If building processes from square one and taking ownership of some of the most complex revenue arrangements excites you, this is the role for you.

You'll thrive as a Revenue Accounting Manager if you:

 - are obsessed with making the best product for our customers

 - are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems

 - work hard and can build and ship fast

 - are focused on polish, detail and quality

 - are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills

The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd implement LiveKit, and potentially tinkering with it 😊




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Author our revenue accounting policy set — principal versus agent on brokered inference, breakage on expiring credits, performance obligation identification and allocation, minimum commitment versus overage, and contract modifications — and make each one stand up to an external auditor

 - Own the monthly revenue close: recognition, the deferred revenue rollforward, contract asset and liability balances, and the flux analysis

 - Own the revenue portion of our external audit, from the PBC list through the technical positions

 - Replace manual revenue entries with an automated billing-to-revenue reconciliation and a documented exception process — revenue should be computed by a system and reviewed by a person, with invoice accuracy above 99% and root-cause tracking on the misses

 - Govern order to cash: billing accuracy, dispute resolution, and an AR and collections process with real DSO and aging targets

 - Own commission capitalization and amortization under ASC 340-40

 - Review non-standard deal structures before they're signed, so the accounting consequence is a decision rather than a discovery




WHO YOU ARE

 - You're a licensed CPA with a Big 4 or comparable technical accounting foundation, plus real industry experience in a high-growth startup environment

 - You have demonstrable ASC 606 experience with usage-based or consumption revenue

 - You write technical memos that a reviewer can follow without a meeting: facts, guidance, analysis, conclusion

 - Experience assessing GAAP guidance and implementing it in real-world situations

 - You've owned a monthly revenue close hands-on, and you've closed revenue through at least one external audit

 - You're comfortable being the technical authority without a bench behind you




NICE TO HAVE

 - Billing system implementation or migration — Metronome, Stripe, Zuora

 - Pre-IPO or first-audit experience

 - Enough SQL to validate a recognition schedule against raw usage data yourself




OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

 - An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

 - Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

 - Competitive salary and equity package

 - Health, dental, and vision benefits

 - Flexible vacation policy



LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

jobs.title: Director, Strategy
jobs.description:
About the Company

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.

The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.

About the Job

Panthalassa is raising capital, developing commercial partnerships, and entering the public stage while building a new category of clean energy and computing infrastructure. As Director, Strategy, you will help determine how we finance the company and how we describe it to the investors and partners whose support will shape its growth.

Reporting to the EVP, Strategy and working closely with the CEO, you will run much of the day-to-day work behind capital formation and investor relations: models, materials, diligence, updates, and the conversations that keep leadership and investors working from the same facts. You will also help shape and articulate the company’s views on the markets, technologies, and institutions around it, from energy and hard tech to financial markets and government.

The role calls for the analytical standards of a top investor or banker and the initiative of an operator. You can build a financing model, test one built by someone else, and write for a sophisticated audience.

This is a global role with a schedule to match. Deals span time zones and often require work at night, on weekends, or with little notice. You are expected to be available when needed and will have flexibility to manage your schedule around the work.

At first, this is primarily an individual-contributor role on a small team. As the company expands, you may hire and lead a team and take responsibility for a broader share of the strategy function.

About You

You have done demanding analytical work at a top-performing venture firm, startup, investment bank, consultancy, or comparable organization, and now want direct responsibility for building a company. You have exceptional judgment and know what it takes to bring a complex, multi-party deal to a close. We would like you to:

• Love using AI and detest obvious AI writing. You use the tools every day and edit the output until it reflects your own judgment and voice.

• Hold informed views on the technical and economic forces shaping AI, compute infrastructure, and energy, and defend them among people who know those fields well.

• Have worked across time zones and business cultures, adjusting the pace, context, and formality of your communication without sacrificing clarity.

• Move fluently among Google Docs, Excel, Figma, Airtable, and other business tools, and learn new platforms quickly. Bonus points for basic coding skills.

• Know cap table math and NVCA documents inside and out.

• Handle sensitive information and relationships with care and discretion.

Responsibilities

• Investor Relations: Manage investor relationships between financings. Write regular updates, maintain the data room, and run diligence processes, and keep information flowing to financial partners at the appropriate cadence for each relationship.

• Capital Formation: Work with leadership to set financing strategy, round size, structure, process, and timing, then help drive each transaction from preparation through close.

• Financial Modeling: Build and own models for financings, operating scenarios, and capitalization. Test assumptions and review work produced by others.

• Writing: Produce investor letters, board materials, memos, one-pagers, and correspondence with exceptionally high standards for clarity, accuracy, and voice.

• Presentations: Develop decks that pair analytical rigor with strong visual judgment to explain complex technical, financial, and strategic plans.

• Market Intelligence: Track relevant markets, companies, investors, and public debate. Turn what you learn into views and recommendations the team can use.

• AI-Assisted Research: Use AI extensively to accelerate research and strengthen analysis. Check sources, test the reasoning, and edit the output to the standard expected of work sent under your name.

• Company Representation: Represent Panthalassa in meetings with investors and partners and at conferences and events.

• Team Development: Help recruit, manage, and develop strategy hires as the function expands.

Required Qualifications

• At least four years of relevant experience in startups, venture capital, investment banking, management consulting, or a comparable analytical environment.

• Expert command of Excel and PowerPoint, plus ease with Google Sheets, Keynote, and Figma.

• Excellent writing and a willingness to share samples.

• Fluency with financing structures, cap tables, valuation, and scenario modeling.

• Deep working knowledge of AI infrastructure and energy, including the major companies, investors, technologies, and policy debates.

• Experience working with investors, partners, or colleagues across countries and time zones.

• A record of taking responsibility for outcomes under tight deadlines, incomplete information, and high stakes.

Desired Qualifications

• Experience at a growth-stage company in technology, energy, or infrastructure.

• Experience inside a founder-led company or working closely with one as an investor or adviser.

• Experience building and managing a small team.

If the role sounds right and your experience does not map neatly to every item above, we would still like to hear from you.

Compensation and Benefits

If hired for this full-time role, you will receive:

• Cash compensation of $200,000 - $325,000, depending on experience.

• Equity in the company. We’re all owners and if we’re successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation.

• A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including: Flexible paid time off Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold-level PPO plan for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long-term financial support if you become disabled) Ability to contribute to tax-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA

• Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed).

Location

This is an on-site position. Our offices, lab, and shop are located in Portland, Oregon. Hybrid candidates who are willing to spend substantial time in Portland will also be considered.

You will also help establish how this work is done at Panthalassa with the Vice President of Talent and People Operations.

You will help leaders make better decisions about their teams, build the organization we need, and work through difficult people issues with sound judgment. Your work will move between workforce planning, organizational design, manager coaching, and sensitive employee matters. You will need to learn how manufacturing works while keeping the broader company in view.

Our approach to this work starts with understanding the business and the people doing it. We earn influence through trust, credibility, and useful advice. We expect managers to lead their teams, and we help them get better at it. Policies and processes have a purpose, but they do not replace judgment.

We are looking for someone who is direct, approachable, and steady when things get messy, and who knows when an approach from a past company should be left behind. Someone who can challenge a leader without making it a contest, take a concern seriously without escalating the temperature, and bring a sense of humor without losing sight of the stakes.

Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

What Success Looks Like

• Manufacturing leaders seek your perspective because you understand their work and help them make better decisions.

• Managers handle feedback, performance, and team issues themselves, earlier and with greater confidence.

• Employees on every shift trust you to listen, give them a straight answer, and follow through—even when the answer is not what they hoped for.

• Manufacturing worksites stay connected to HQ and the broader company. You help information move in both directions, bring site perspectives into company decisions, and address gaps in communication and coordination.

• The practices you build are simple enough that people actually use them.

Responsibilities

• Spend real time on the production floor at all three sites. Learn how Manufacturing Engineering, Production, and Supply Chain work, and keep information moving between the sites and HQ.

• Partner with the Vice President of Manufacturing and manufacturing leaders on team structure, leadership capacity, and role clarity, weighing effects on other teams and sites.

• Help leaders plan for the work ahead: whether to hire, move people, use contractors, or reorganize. Partner with Talent Acquisition on hiring, and lead the people side of site expansions.

• Build the manufacturing portion of our job families, levels, and career paths, and coach managers to use them in hiring, development, and promotion.

• Coach managers, including new ones as we add leadership layers, to set clear expectations, give useful feedback, address performance early, and develop their people. In hard situations, guide them without taking over—the team stays theirs.

• Handle complex employee matters, including conflict, accommodations, investigations, and exits, with care and proportion. Most issues need a conversation or a change in how we work; few need formal action.

• Give direct advice, including when you disagree. Explain your reasoning, listen to other perspectives, and help people reach a workable decision.

• Bring organizational patterns and risks to the Vice President of Talent and People Operations with a clear recommendation.

• Build processes only where they solve a real problem, and retire them when they stop serving the organization.

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of progressive experience in HR or People Partner roles, including substantial independent partnership with senior leaders.

• Experience supporting hourly employees, salaried employees, and contractors across multiple worksites, with credibility on the production floor as well as in the office.

• Experience helping a fast-growing or changing organization make decisions about structure, workforce needs, and leadership capacity.

• Strong manager-coaching skills, with examples of helping managers improve how they lead rather than taking over their responsibilities.

• Sound judgment on complex employee matters and employment law, including knowing when to involve legal counsel.

• Demonstrated ability to earn trust and influence decisions without reporting authority, including challenging senior leaders while remaining a credible partner.

• Clear communication, discretion, and steady judgment under pressure, and comfort working through ambiguity without a fully built process.

Desired Qualifications

• Experience supporting manufacturing or another technically complex, shift-based organization, ideally including opening or expanding a worksite.

• Experience in a high-growth startup where you helped build the organization and adapted your approach as it grew.

The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed.

Additional Requirements

• Travel to vendors and test sites as needed

• Intermittently able to work longer hours and weekends to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work-life balance, including flexible PTO and flexible working hours.

Compensation and Benefits

If hired for this full-time role, you will receive:

• Cash compensation of $150,000 - $195,000

• Equity in the company. We’re all owners and if we’re successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation.

• A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including: Flexible paid time off Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold-level PPO plan for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents) Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long-term financial support if you become disabled) Ability to contribute to tax-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA

• Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed).

Location

Our offices, lab, shop, and manufacturing worksites are located in the Greater Portland, Oregon area. This role is expected to work regularly onsite and travel between worksites on a weekly basis.

jobs.title: Manager, Strategic Enterprise Sales
jobs.description:

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

jobs.title: Senior Mission Integration Engineer - Payload I&T
jobs.description:
Spacecraft represent the most pressing unmet need across the entire aerospace industry. As more launch vehicles come online and the cost to orbit decreases, more companies launching payloads to space continue to emerge.

For the first time in history, this influx of payload companies combined with reduced launch costs has resulted in a massive increase in need for commercial spacecraft platforms, known as satellite buses. These buses hold the payloads of our customers and are flown on launch vehicles.

Apex manufactures these satellite buses at scale using a combination of software, vertical integration, and hardware that is designed for manufacturing. Our spacecraft enable the future of society: ranging from earth observation to communications and more.

We’d love for you to join us on our mission of providing humankind access to the galaxy beyond our planet. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

Apex is seeking a Senior Mission Integration Engineer specializing in Payload Integration & Test to join our expanding team. The Mission Integration team turns our foundational spacecraft platform into the backbone of customer missions. It is a hands-on role owning the planning and execution of customer payload integration and SV level test campaigns.



Responsibilities

• Lead the planning of space vehicle I&T campaigns and drive execution on the cleanroom floor.

• Lead customer technical engagements to develop bus to payload integration procedures.

• Plan and execute space vehicle level environmental testing, including random vibration, quasi-static load, and TVAC.

• Plan and execute SV level functional testing to demonstrate integrated vehicle functionality.

• Lead space vehicle propulsion load operations for dynamic testing and launch.

• Review results of coupled loads analysis (CLA) and thermal analysis for incorporation into test planning.

• Travel to launch sites for vehicle integration, system checkouts, and launch rehearsals.

• Develop and maintain customer system-level documentation, including specifications, interface control documents, and system design descriptions.

• Support requirements analysis, verification, and validation activities to ensure compliance with customer needs and industry standards.

• Identify and assess technical risks associated with system design, development, and operation.

• Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, including electrical, mechanical, and software engineers, to ensure system integration and performance.

• Communicate technical concepts, requirements, and issues clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Participate in customer meetings, design reviews, and project status updates.



Requirements

• U.S. Person status, as this position needs access to export-controlled data.

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

• 8+ years of experience working on complex hardware systems (spacecraft preferred).

• Experience in satellite manufacturing or related industries (aerospace, defense, or high-tech).

• Strong understanding of space systems integration and test.

• Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and managing timelines in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize and adapt to shifting demands.

• High attention to detail with a focus on delivering concise and technical review content.



Preferred

• Previous spacecraft, launch vehicle, or payload engineering experience.

• Experience with CubeSat, small satellite, or rideshare mission integration.

• Experience working with prime contractors or government entities.

• Familiarity with flight software, embedded systems, and space communications protocols (CCSDS, S-band, X-band, etc.).



#LI-RC1


WHY JOIN APEX?

Apex believes in creating a work environment that you look forward to embracing every day. Our employees love working at Apex, and we want you to love it too. We're a fast-growing startup that has raised more than $500M in funding, and we invest heavily in our people from day one.




WHAT WE OFFER FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES:

 - Shared upside: Receive equity in Apex, letting you benefit from the work you create

 - Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, plus $100k life insurance at no cost

 - Comprehensive PTO package:  Starting at 15 days vacation, growing to 20+ days annually, plus 10 paid holidays

 - Competitive 401(k) plan: Generous matching - 100% match on first 3%, 50% on next 2%

 - 8 weeks paid parental leave: Plus childcare reimbursement up to $350/day for work-related travel

 - Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks: To keep you fueled throughout the day

 - Vibrant community: Monthly office socials, pickleball tournaments, run club, and gatherings for you and your family

 - Your dream desk setup: All the tools you need to be your most productive self

 - World-class Playa Vista office: With the benefit of in-person collaboration with amazing coworkers and flexibility to integrate work and life

 - Real impact opportunity: Work alongside experts from aerospace, new space, and other cutting-edge industries to make a lasting difference




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

Compensation ranges are set by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. A candidate's specific level and base pay are determined case by case and may vary with job-related skills, education, experience, technical capabilities, and internal equity. Beyond base salary, full-time hires are also eligible for long-term incentives in the form of stock options, along with medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) retirement plan.




ITAR REQUIREMENTS

Apex's work is governed by U.S. export control laws, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) and the Export Administration Regulations (EAR). To be eligible for this role, applicants must either (1) qualify as a U.S. Person, meaning a U.S. citizen or national, a lawful permanent resident (green card holder), a refugee admitted under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or an individual granted asylum under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, or (2) be able to obtain the required export authorizations from the U.S. Department of State, the U.S. Department of Commerce, or another applicable U.S. government agency. You can learn more about ITAR here https://www.pmddtc.state.gov/?id=ddtc_kb_article_page&sys_id=24d528fddbfc930044f9ff621f961987.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Apex Technology, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Candidates and employees are always evaluated based on merit, qualifications, and performance. We will never discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager - Hybrid Power & Aircraft
jobs.description:
ABOUT ODYS

At Odys, we’re mobilizing power, with Hybrid Power Systems developed for aerospace and in-demand everywhere. It’s the kind of mission diversity that demands a fresh way of thinking.

We began with an early bet on hybrid, when the mobility industry was focused on batteries. We designed, tested, and validated our first 1 MW high-speed generator in 12 months. And then we pushed further, developing systems with greater power density in less time. Today, our Hybrid Power Systems offer outputs ranging from 20 kW to 4 MW, with applications in the air or on the ground.

One of those applications is Laila, an unmanned drone designed for critical logistics and defense missions. With its 100 kW-class onboard Hybrid Power System, Laila can support medical cold-chain transport or serve as an aerial platform for counter-UAS measures.

The market interest has been overwhelming: Over 30 inbound requests from leading US and global manufacturers, and 14+ DoD contracts.

Our team comes from deep tech and aerospace, with backgrounds spanning drone and aircraft development, high-volume production, and electrified mobility.

We operate with urgency and ownership at every level. We validated high-speed generator technology faster than our peers, not because we skipped steps, but because we've been doing this long enough to know which ones matter most.

Creating the future of power, in the air and on the ground, is a challenge we’ve been training our entire lives for. If that sounds like you, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

Odys Aviation is seeking a senior Program Manager to own execution across our active power generation and aircraft development programs. Our portfolio spans internally funded R&D and customer-funded engagements, with applications in aircraft hybrid propulsion, nuclear power conversion, expeditionary power systems, data centers, and other industrial power users.

In this role, you will run multiple concurrent programs, including DoD efforts, from award through delivery. You will own cost, schedule, and scope; keep engineering, supply chain, and test aligned to committed dates; and serve as the primary point of contact for customers, primes, and government sponsors.

This is a hands-on role close to the hardware. You will also support capture and proposal activity as we grow the pipeline and help stand up the quality and program process a company at our stage needs to scale.

Don't meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Odys, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own cost, schedule, scope, and risk across multiple concurrent programs spanning internal R&D and customer-funded development

 - Build and maintain integrated master schedules that tie engineering milestones to long-lead procurement, build, and test windows

 - Serve as the primary interface to customers, primes, and government sponsors: run program reviews, deliver status and technical reporting, and negotiate scope and schedule changes

 - Manage DoW program execution end to end, including contract deliverables (CDRLs), milestone and payment events, period-of-performance tracking, and coordination with contracting officers and technical points of contact

 - Translate statements of work into executable work breakdown structures, staffing plans, and budgets, and track actuals against them

 - Partner with supply chain on long-lead procurement, supplier selection and follow-up, BOM readiness, and recovery plans when parts slip

 - Drive cross-functional execution across propulsion, aircraft, power electronics, manufacturing, and test teams, surfacing blockers early and holding owners to dates

 - Maintain risk and opportunity registers with real mitigations, and escalate with a recommendation rather than a status

 - Help implement and mature quality and program processes, including configuration management, document control, change control, gate reviews, and corrective action

 - Manage compliance obligations on government programs, including export control, data rights, property, and reporting requirements

 - Communicate program health clearly and honestly to leadership, with the underlying data behind it
   
   


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - B.S. in Engineering, or equivalent technical background paired with program management depth

 - 7+ years managing hardware development programs in aerospace, defense, energy, or industrial hardware

 - Demonstrated ownership of multiple concurrent programs, including at least one taken from award through delivery

 - Direct experience managing DoD-funded programs (SBIR/STTR, OTA, prime subcontract, or similar) and their deliverable, reporting, and compliance requirements

 - Working familiarity with hybrid or electrified power system development: engines or turbines, generators, power electronics, energy storage, thermal management, and integration and test

 - Experience managing hardware supply chain risk, including long-lead items, custom fabrication, and supplier recovery

 - Technical fluency sufficient to hold your own with engineers, customers, and primes

 - Fluency with scheduling and program tracking tools (MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira, or equivalent)

 - Clear written and verbal communication, with the judgment to know what leadership and customers need to hear and when

 - Bias toward action, comfort with ambiguity, and a track record in fast-paced, iterative hardware environments
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Prior engineering experience in a hands-on hardware role

 - Experience with aircraft or UAS development programs, including certification or airworthiness pathways

 - Experience with expeditionary or tactical power for defense customers

 - Active or recently held security clearance

 - Experience standing up or maturing a quality management system at a growing company

 - Experience negotiating and administering FAR/DFARS-based contracts and subcontracts

 - PMP, or equivalent formal program management training

 - Familiarity with PLM and ERP/MRP systems

jobs.title: Operations Supervisor (Wastewater)
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:

In coordination with Plant Manager the incumbent will be responsible for providing the day to day oversight of department staff, shift operations, trouble shoot equipment problems and generate work orders as needed, as well as providing operational, commercial and personnel leadership to the plant shift operating teams to maintain efficient and cost effective facility operations while maintaining compliance with all Corporate and Regulatory environmental, health and safety rules and requirements.

Primary Duties/Responsibilities:

• Supervises a staff of Plant Operators – trainees, 1A licensed Operators, 2A licensed Operators and 3A licensed Operators and directs their daily duties in accordance with the requirements of the Plant.
• Work with other plant departments, Engineering, and contractors to coordinate projects.
• Lead and guide shift crews to monitor all facets of plant operations and incoming data.
• Manage, evaluate, schedule, and develop the O&M staff and always ensure adequate staffing.
• Provides leadership and directing in response to alarms and abnormal conditions and lead emergency response actions.
• Independently evaluates and/or supervises the evaluation of the operation, maintenance and performance of wastewater treatment facilities, processes, systems, and equipment.
• Reviews, and supervises implementation of system improvements including analyzing and optimizing existing system designs and operating parameters, supervising performance testing and troubleshooting and resolving complex operational, equipment and instrumentation problems.
• Reviews designs and constructed facilities and makes and approves recommendations for operational improvements.
• Oversees construction management personnel in implementing changes required during facilities upgrades and startup, supervises the work of operational services, treatment plant construction personnel in startup and initial operation of new or upgraded wastewater treatment facilities, processes, systems, and equipment.
• Participate in the development and compliance of operating policies ensuring compliance to all environmental and safety rules.
• Complete reports which document plant status, equipment, operating data, and operational events.
• Collect data on unplanned outages and make recommendations to minimize the probability of similar events.
• Serves as the real-time shift interface with the Commercial Group with respect to plant operations, outages, fuel, generations schedules.
• Perform Issuer and Verifier functions utilizing the approved Lock Out/Tag Out systems to help ensure that safe systems are always in place.
• Manage Department contract deliverables and scheduling.
• Responsible for ordering of materials and supplies.
• Ensures all equipment and processes are well maintained and functioning properly.
• Ensure that workstations and Treatment plant facilities are in clean and safe in accordance with all regulatory requirements.
• Maintain proper operational documents and records.
• Assure work is performed in a safe and professional manner by following all corporate and regulatory policies, procedures, and emergency response procedures.
• Operates equipment and processes manually and through instrument control panels.
• Work weekends, holidays, and be on-call on a rotating basis/schedule as needed.
• Respond to emergencies, work additional hours to complete required tasks as/and when needed.
• Operate company and client owned vehicles.
• Carries out other duties as assigned.

Work Environment:

• Work is performed both inside and outside with exposure to all kinds of weather conditions.
• Incumbents may be occasionally exposed to some noise, sewage, silica, dust, fumes, smoke, gasses, greases, oils, electrical energy, solvents, and vibrations.
• Incumbents may work on slippery/uneven surfaces, around machinery with moving parts, moving objects/vehicles, and ladder/scaffolding, below ground and may be exposed to water and other liquid materials.

Education/Experience/Background:

• High School Diploma or GED, bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in Environmental Science, Engineering, Biology/Laboratory, or related fields preferred.
• 5+ years of experience working in a plant operations position.
• 10+ years of experience required working in the Wastewater Treatment or related field is preferred.
• Experience with maintenance systems, project contract administration in the water/wastewater utilities industry is preferred.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

• Strong process control knowledge is a must.
• Excellent reading, math, writing, scientific, and verbal communication skills.
